Heaviest of the small shields, it is impressively weighty and thus able to deflect attacks with ease.
Skill: Weapon Skill
Equipping this shield in the left hand allows one to perform the Skill of the right hand weapon.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 3,000 souls once she has been given the Easterner's Ashes.

entities.name: Eleonora
entities.desc:
A strange weapon found among malformed inhabitants of the Profaned Capital.
The Profaned Flame was triggered by the curse of these women, relatives of a certain oracle, but despite their culpability, they went on living without any cares.
Skill: Feast Bell
Hold up axe and wave to emit a solemn chime to temporarily make weapons lacerating, and to restore HP for each hit.
entities.avail: Found in the Profaned Capital. Guaranteed drop from the already awoken Monstrosity of Sin found on the lower level of the ruined chapel that lies in the toxic swamp.
entities.notes: • Once per playthrough, one can be traded with the Nestling in exchange for a Hollow Gem.

entities.name: Elkhorn Round Shield
entities.desc:
Standard round wooden shield. The blue antlers are reminiscent of designs found in Mirrah.
Wooden shields are light, manageable, and offer relatively high magic absorption.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 1,500 souls.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for the same price once she is given Greirat's Ashes.

entities.name: Estoc
entities.desc:
Large thrusting sword used for piercing through the armor of knights.
The sharp edge of the sword's rock-solid blade can also be used in slashing attacks.
Skill: Shield Splitter
Aim carefully, and attack in a large forward lunge to pierce through enemy shields and inflict damage directly.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Assassin class.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by Greirat for 3,000 souls once he returns from his first scavenge expedition in the Undead Settlement.
entities.notes: • Accepts all infusions.

entities.name: Ethereal Oak Shield
entities.desc:
Charbronze shield used by Millwood Knights that slowly regenerates HP.
This shield appears to be blessed by a great, if faded, image of the ethereal oak.
Skill: Weapon Skill
Equipping this shield in the left hand allows one to perform the Skill of the right hand weapon.
entities.avail: Found in the Painted World of Ariandel, on a corpse found in a tower of the Millwood ruins. The corpse is located at the bottom half of the tower after going up a ladder and then going down the stairs.

entities.name: Executioner's Greatsword
entities.desc:
Greatsword of a debauched executioner used for beheadings.
This sword retains a keen memory of its executioner's duty, and absorbs FP from each fallen foe.
Skill: Stomp
Use one's weight to lunge forward with a low stance and increased poise, and follow with strong attack for a spinning slash.
entities.avail:
Found at the graveyard in the Cathedral of the Deep.

From the Cleansing Chapel, make way into the graveyard and proceed in the general straightforward direction until reaching the other end. A small enclosed area with several corpses and some loot can be found, one of which is the sword. Upon picking it up, however, the corpses, some of which are infested, will come to life and ambush the player.

entities.name: Exile Greatsword
entities.desc:
Bloodstained greatsword wielded by one of the Watchdogs of Farron, who preside over the slumber of fallen warriors. The blade is a reminder of the exile's past misdeeds.
Inhuman strength is required to wield this heaviest of curved greatswords.
Skill: Spin Slash
Slice into foes with a large spinning motion, and continue spinning to transition into a strong attack.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Exile Watchdog that wields it in the Road of Sacrifices.

entities.name: Falchion
entities.desc:
Standard curved sword and widely-used slashing weapon.
The falchion's flesh-rending slash attacks are greatly compromised against armor and tough scale-covered hides.
Skill: Spin Slash
Slice into foes with a large spinning motion, and continue spinning to transition into strong attack.
entities.avail: Dropped by falchion-wielding Skeletons (with heads) in the Undead Settlement and Catacombs of Carthus.
entities.notes: • When held in two hands, this weapon's attacks do not rebound off of shields.

entities.name: Farron Greatsword
entities.desc:
Greatsword of the Abyss Watchers which is atypically paired with an unusual dagger.
The dagger is utilized as a wedge in the left hand while the greatsword is held in the right, a unique technique that was synonymous with the Undead Legion. Confounds foes in the manner of wolves hunting prey.
Skill: Parry
Deflect an attack when timed properly and follow up with a critical hit, executed with the dagger.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Blood of the Wolf with Ludleth of Courland at no soul cost.
entities.notes: • Deals increased damage to abyssal enemies.

entities.name: Firelink Greatsword
entities.desc:
The Lords of Cinder linked the First Flame, and this Greatsword was wielded by their deific manifestation.
This coiled sword, found thrust in the bonfire, existed long before the throneless lords themselves.
Skill: Ember
The fading flame momentarily illuminates and launches itself forward.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Lords with Ludleth of Courland.

entities.name: Flamberge
entities.desc:
Greatsword with an undulating blade. The blade, resembling flame, was crafted to mutilate flesh and induce bleeding.
Skill: Stance
While in stance, use normal attack to break a foe's guard from below, and strong attack to slash upwards with a forward lunge.
entities.avail: Drop from the Flamberge-wielding Thralls in the Undead Settlement, Cathedral of the Deep, Grand Archives and Dreg Heap.

entities.name: Follower Javelin
entities.desc:
Light spear wielded by the Farron Followers. Balanced to allow for throwing.
The Followers attack in groups, surrounding foes, shielding themselves, and thrusting their spears at their foes. On a final command, they hurl their spears at their fallen foe, to give the retired warrior an honorable send-off.
Skill: Hurl Spear
Emulate the practice of the Followers by throwing an illusory spear that assumes temporary form.
entities.avail:
Found in the Painted World of Ariandel:

From the Snowfield bonfire, run to the right toward the collapsing snowy ridge. After falling down the collapsing ridge, hug the right wall to avoid the wolves. After a little bit of walking you will encounter a path up guarded by a wolf. Up at the very top of the path there is a group of about five Farron Followers who will all attack you at once if you get near, so prepare for a fight. Behind them is a corpse holding the Follower Javelin.
entities.notes: • Unlike other weapons, a jumping attack cannot be followed with another attack. This is possibly a bug.

entities.name: Follower Sabre
entities.desc:
Great curved sword wielded by Farron Followers. Its great weight enables heavy-handed chain attacks.
The Followers brandish their swords to hunt warriors taken by the Abyss. Their technique is honed to face men, implying those yet to lose their human aspect are their likeliest prey.
Skill: Prying Wedge
A chain attack that wedges below foes and swings upward, breaking their guard. Strong attack can be used to follow up the onslaught with a fatal blow.
entities.avail: From the Ariandel Chapel, head back toward the bridge and cut it down. Climb down the ladder and continue on the rooted path. After several drop-downs, there will be a circular area with several roots leading downward, the Follower Sabre will be on a corpse above a torch-carrying Farron Follower.

entities.name: Follower Shield
entities.desc:
Standard shield used by the Farron Followers. Crafted with wood and reinforced with metal.
Imbued with a faint resistance to the Abyss.
Skill: Weapon Skill
Equipping this shield in the left hand allows one to perform the Skill of the right hand weapon.
entities.avail: From the Snowy Mountain Pass bonfire, head forward until you reach the bell. Once you see the bell, head left until you reach the cliff and turn left again following the ridge; you should then see the corpse containing the Follower Shield.
entities.notes: Can be buffed and infused.

entities.name: Follower Torch
entities.desc:
An offensive torch used by the Farron Followers. Provides light and doubles as a weapon.
Some forms of the Abyss manifest as pus within the body, treated from ancient times with fire.
Skill: Breathe Fire
Spit a combustible fuel across the torch to breathe flame in a front-sweeping motion.
entities.avail: Can be found after the Snowy Mountain Pass bonfire. Proceed forward until you reach the bell. Run past it to just before the collapsing ridge leading to the Earth Seeker. Instead of taking the ridge down, turn left and continue until you reach a cliff. Drop down to the path below the cliff and proceed right to find a corpse containing the weapon, guarded by a Farron Follower.
entities.notes: • For the purposes of critical attacks, this weapon uses the multipliers of the Hammer weapon class.

entities.name: Four-Pronged Plow
entities.desc:
This four-pronged plow is shaped like a fist, and is a worker's tool in the Undead Settlement.
Not originally intended for battle, but serves as a deadly weapon owing to its sharp points.
Skill: Charge
Hold spear at waist and charge at foe. Only, it is important to have good footing.
entities.avail: Dropped by Peasant Hollows who wield them in the Undead Settlement.

entities.name: Frayed Blade
entities.desc:
A dragon weapon symbolizing Darkeater Midir.
The once-exquisite blade is now stained black, and frayed at the hilt. Without its sheath, it will soon crumble into nothing.
Skill: Hold
Assume a holding stance in which a normal attack sends a shockwave along the earth, and a strong attack commences a series of slashes.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Darkeater Midir with Ludleth of Courland for 5,000 souls.
entities.notes: • It can deflect certain projectiles

entities.name: Friede's Great Scythe
entities.desc:
A great scythe wielded by Sister Elfriede, with a curved blade thinly coated by Painted World frost that easily breaks the guard of shields.
In the painting, the scythe is a symbol of a long-lost home, possibly explaining Elfriede's preference for it.
Skill: Elfriede's Stance
Conjure a magic bladed support scythe into the left hand while the great scythe remains in the right, a stance derived from Elfriede's former swordmanship. Use normal attack to leap forward and swing twice, or strong attack to coat the earth with running frost.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Sister Friede with Ludleth of Courland for 10,000 souls.

entities.name: Fume Ultra Greatsword
entities.desc:
This twisted sword, the heaviest of all ultra greatswords, resembles black slate.
This weapon, said to belong to a traitor from long ago, was so heavy that it found no owner, and became a forgotten relic of history.
Skill: Stomp
Use one's weight to lunge forward with a low stance and increased poise, and follow with a crushing strong attack.
entities.avail: Obtained by defeating Knight Slayer Tsorig by the large lava pool in the Demon Ruins, beneath Smouldering Lake.
entities.notes: Cannot be infused.

entities.name: Gael's Greatsword
entities.desc:
Greatsword of Slave Knight Gael, the only weapon that he kept with him from beginning to end.
Originally an executioner's sword made for decapitation, this blade is heavily chipped and stained with the blood of countless battles.
Skill: Blade of Peril
A precarious technique unique to undead Gael. Leap in any direction, slamming the greatsword to the ground, then follow with normal attack for a large spinning slash, or strong attack to back-step and jump forward in an overhead slam.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Slave Knight Gael with Ludleth of Courland for 20,000 souls.
entities.notes:
• One of the most versatile weapons in game due to its ability to deal Thrust and Strike damage exclusively with a very effective moveset.
  • Like the Executioner's Greatsword, it is a very effective weapon to use against skeletal enemies.

entities.name: Gargoyle Flame Hammer
entities.desc:
Stone torch hammer wielded by gargoyles of the Profaned Capital.
The Profaned Flame, which never goes out, imbues this weapon with a fire attack.
Skill: Kindled Flurry
Anchor weapon in earth and use strong attack to launch successive volleys of fire form the tip of the hammer.
entities.avail: Dropped by hammer-wielding Gargoyles in the Profaned Capital and Grand Archives.

entities.name: Gargoyle Flame Spear
entities.desc:
Stone torch spear wielded by gargoyles of the Profaned Capital.
The Profaned Flame, which never goes out, imbues this weapon with a fire attack.
Skill: Kindled Charge
Hold spear at waist and charge at foe, and use momentum to transition to a fiery strong attack.
entities.avail: • Dropped by spear-wielding Gargoyles in the Profaned Capital and Grand Archives.

entities.name: Ghru Rotshield
entities.desc:
A rotting makeshift shield scavenged by the forest-dwelling Ghrus.
Barely effective as a shield. However, its rotten state has made it poisonous, and resistant to other poisons as a result.
Skill: Shield Bash
Without lowering your guard, strike the enemy with the shield to knock them back or stagger them. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by spear-wielding Ghrus in Farron Keep.
  • Dropped by spear-wielding Smouldering Ghrus in Smouldering Lake.

entities.name: Giant Door Shield
entities.desc:
Unusually shaped paired greatshields resembling great doors.
Heirlooms of the knight who was known as the protector of the meek, yet who failed to protect anyone.
Skill: Lockout
Get a stalwart defense, and shield bash, or strong attack for a heave that holds shields to block nearly all damage.
entities.avail: Found in The Dreg Heap. Shortly past the Earthen Peak Ruins bonfire, an Angel and several Thralls guard an open area. The Giant Door Shields can be found at the end of a path leading to the bottom of a cliff, where another Thrall guards it.
entities.notes:
• Cannot be buffed offensively or defensively (e.g., neither Magic Shield nor Blessed Weapon can be applied, regardless of infusion or which hand the weapon is held in).
  • When out of FP, activating Lockout will still block without change, but the fortification state becomes obsolete, it simply becomes a regular block.
  • Blocking does not negate status effects, not even during its fortification state.

entities.name: Glaive
entities.desc:
This halberd with a large blade was a scythe refitted for battle.
Designed for slicing, and inflicts slash damage.
Skill: Spin Sweep
Sweep foes in a large spinning motion, and utilize momentum to transition into an overhanded strong attack smash.
entities.avail: Sold by Greirat for 3,500 souls once he returns from his first scavenge run in the Undead Settlement.

entities.name: Golden Falcon Shield
entities.desc:
A metal shield fashioned in the form of a falcon with wings outstretched.
The golden falcon was the emblem of an ancient band of sellswords, and even to this day, many mercenaries remain who look upon it as a token of good fortune.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Found in the Crucifixion Woods area of the Road of Sacrifices. Near the end of the ruins that lead to the Crystal Sage, there is an area to the right guarded by several Sage's Prentices and a Sage's Devout, with a stairway that eventually leads to a Ring of Sacrifice. Before reaching the top of the stairs, exit out of the structure through the broken wall, and follow the ledges to the left, where the shield can be found on a corpse, overlooking the area guarded by the two Exile Watchdogs.

entities.name: Golden Ritual Spear
entities.desc:
A ritual spear presented to Darkmoon Knights before Sulyvahn claimed the title of Pontiff.
Can also be used as a staff. Sorceries cast using this weapon channel the wielder's faith.
Skill: Steady Chant
Boost the strength of sorceries for a very short period.
entities.avail: Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley. From the Pontiff Sulyvahn bonfire, exit the cathedral and hug the left wall, going indoors temporarily and then going up the stairs leading to the Deacons patrolling the upper walkway. Turn around and re-enter the cathedral, then cross the bridge and turn right, leading to a Mimic that drops it.

entities.name: Golden Wing Crest Shield
entities.desc:
A blue knight's shield engraved with a golden wing crest.
This shield is exceptional amongst the enchanted blue shields; not only does it boast high magic absorption, but also enables its wielder to parry spells.
Skill: Spell Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand. Also deflects spells.
entities.avail: Dropped by Lion Knight Albert after defeating him at the Grand Archives.

entities.name: Gotthard Twinswords
entities.desc:
The hunters known as the King's Black Hands wielded paired weapons. These belonged to Gotthard, who fled the castle.
Gotthard rose quickly through the knighthood, no surprise to those who have witnessed his swordsmanship.
Skill:Spin Slash
Slice into foes with a large spinning motion, and use strong attack to lengthen attack and end with a double-bladed thrust.
entities.avail: Found in Lothric Castle, on the lifeless body of Black Hand Gotthard, just before the entrance to the Grand Archives. The body will only appear once the player has defeated the first three Lords of Cinder: Abyss Watchers, Aldrich and Yhorm.

entities.name: Grass Crest Shield
entities.desc:
Old medium metal shield of unknown origin.
The grass crest is lightly imbued with magic, which slightly speeds stamina recovery.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Found in the Road of Sacrifices, near the Crucifixion Woods bonfire. The shield can be looted from a corpse lying beside a tree near the first Great Crab.

entities.name: Great Club
entities.desc:
Wood club fashioned from the branch of a giant tree. Requires considerable strength to wield.
A hard, durable weapon. Its weight makes it easier to break the guard of shields.
Skill: Warcry
Let out a spirited war cry that temporarily boosts attack, and enables special consecutive attacks.
entities.avail: Guaranteed drop from the Exile Watchdog who wields it in the Road of Sacrifices.
entities.notes: • With a Heavy Infusion and 99 Strength, the Great Club has an attack rating of 641, and over 700 with Warcry active.

entities.name: Great Corvian Scythe
entities.desc:
Great scythe of the forlorn souls guided by heretical storytellers.
The mistress of the Painted World is said to wield a great scythe herself.
Great scythes inflict profuse bleeding, such that the blood splatters on the wielder.
Skill: Neck Swipe
This attack aims for the scruff of a foe's neck, and when successful, functions as a head shot, inflicting heavy damage.
entities.avail: Dropped by scythe-wielding Corvians.

entities.name: Great Mace
entities.desc:
Large mace wielded by the knights of the Cathedral of the Deep.
The extremely heavy strike attacks of this weapon are devastating and will break weaker shields with a single blow. Wielding such a weapon will require inhuman strength.
Skill: Perseverance
Anchor weapon in earth to temporarily boost poise. Damage reduced while activated.
entities.avail:
Cathedral of the Deep

  • Dropped by Cathedral Knights who wield them.

Consumed King's Garden

  • Dropped by Consumed King's Knights who wield them.

entities.name: Great Machete
entities.desc:
This giant machete has a slash attack, and is a worker's tool in the Undead Settlement.
This dismantling tool was not originally intended for use in battle.
Skill: Sharpen
Scrape the blade to sharpen and enable a cleaner cut.
entities.avail: Dropped by Hollow Manservants in the Undead Settlement.

entities.name: Great Scythe
entities.desc:
Attacks with this large scythe, normally used for crop harvesting, are effective at breaking past shields.
The magnificent sharp curved blade instils fear in opponents. Perhaps it is their survival instinct at work.
Skill: Neck Swipe
This attack aims for the scruff of a foe's neck, and when successful, functions as a head shot, inflicting heavy damage.
entities.avail: Found in the Undead Settlement. From the Dilapidated Bridge bonfire, head onward and enter the destroyed house located in front of the graveyard where the giant archer's arrows start raining down. Go upstairs, turn around and jump toward the broken wooden floorboards to reach it.

entities.name: Great Wooden Hammer
entities.desc:
This giant wooden hammer is a worker's tool in the Undead Settlement.
Intended to grind flesh and bone to prepare for burial, rather than use in battle.
Skill: Spin Bash
Bash foes with a large spinning motion, utilizing momentum to transition into a overhand strong attack smash.
entities.avail: Dropped by Peasant Hollows who wield them in the Undead Settlement and Irithyll Dungeon.

entities.name: Greataxe
entities.desc:
Greataxe resembling a hunk of raw iron.
If one possesses the inhuman strength required to lift the weapon, the great heft of its attacks will send foes flying.
However, since every swing makes use of one's entire body, attacks leave the wielder wide open retaliation.
Skill: Warcry
Let out a spirited warcry that temporarily boosts attack.
entities.avail:
High Wall of Lothric

  • Dropped by greataxe-wielding Large Hollow Soldiers.

Cathedral of the Deep

  • Dropped by greataxe-wielding Large Devouts.

Farron Keep

  • Found in the ruined fortress. From the Old Wolf of Farron bonfire, take the lift up. The weapon can be looted from a corpse near the Stray Demon.

Lothric Castle

  • Dropped by greataxe-wielding Large Hollow Soldiers.
entities.notes:
• Although the weapon description states that the axe resembles a hunk of iron, in actuality it is fully embossed on both sides with a full floral design.
  • The hollows that use this weapon never use its weapon art. They also hold it differently than you can.

entities.name: Greatlance
entities.desc:
This lance features a long pole, and was originally intended to be used by knights for jousting.
This weapon is primarily used in charging attacks, and would require tremendous strength and dexterity to be handled by a mere foot soldier.
Skill: Charge
Hold spear at waist and charge at foe. Only, it is important to have good footing.
entities.avail:
Found in Lothric Castle.

From the Dragon Barracks, go upstairs and head left to find the Greatlance guarded by a red-eyed Lothric Knight.
entities.notes: Can benefit from Leo Ring.

entities.name: Greatshield of Glory
entities.desc:
A greatshield adorned with flowing patterns, a celebration of an ancient glory.
Boasts the highest stability of such shields, but with reduced stamina regeneration speed.
Perhaps it is glory that begets indolence.
Skill: Shield Bash
Without lowering your guard, strike the enemy with the shield to knock them back or stagger them. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Dropped by a Mimic in the Profaned Capital, in the treasury room to the right of Yhorm the Giant's boss arena.

entities.name: Greatsword
entities.desc:
This ultra greatsword, with its thick blade, is one of the heaviest of its kind.
Highly destructive if intolerably heavy.
There would appear to be some credence to the rumors that this sword tested the true limits of human strength.
Skill: Stomp
Use one's weight to lunge forward with a low stance and increased poise, and follow with strong attack for a spinning slash.
entities.avail: Found in the Farron Keep, on top of one of the two broken bridge sections, near the area with the first brazier and opposite to some Purple Moss Clumps.
entities.notes: • At 99 Strength, a fully upgraded Heavy Greatsword has 676 AR.

entities.name: Greatsword of Judgment
entities.desc:
A ceremonial sword, held in Pontiff Sulyvahn's left hand, representing the judgment of the moon, but with magic far closer to sorcery than any existing lunar power. Its dark blue hues, deeper than the darkest moon, reflect sorcerer Sulyvahn's true nature.
Skill: Stance of Judgment
Assume stance to unleash dark magic. Use normal attack for a lunging thrust, and strong attack to emit side-sweeping wave.
entities.avail: Transpose the Soul of Pontiff Sulyvahn with Ludleth of Courland for 3,000 souls.

entities.name: Gundyr's Halberd
entities.desc:
Halberd of Gundyr the Champion, received when he was charged with his duty.
This old cast-iron halberd has the power to break poise, and is said to never crumble, seeming to suggest that Gundyr was fated to eternal service from the beginning.
Skill: Champion's Charge
Hold spear at waist and charge at foe, and use momentum to transition into sweeping strong attack.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Champion Gundyr with Ludleth of Courland.

entities.name: Halberd
entities.desc:
This long-hilted weapon mixing spear and axe is difficult to handle, requiring both strength and dexterity.
Can be thrust like a spear or swept sideways like an axe, making it a versatile weapon effective against multiple foes.
Skill: Charge
Hold spear at waist and charge at foe. Use strong attack while charging to extend the length of the charge.
entities.avail:
Firelink Shrine

  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 1,500 souls.

High Wall of Lothric

  • Dropped by Large Hollow Soldiers who wield them.

Cathedral of the Deep

  • Dropped by Large Devouts of the Deep who wield them.

Lothric Castle

  • Dropped by Large Hollow Soldiers who wield them.

entities.name: Hand Axe
entities.desc:
A crude hand-axe that serves both as a weapon, and a tool of many uses.
Favored by pyromancers of the Great Swamp, this axe has a short range but only moderate weight, and reasonable damage. Easily wielded, and more powerful than it appears.
Skill: Warcry
Let out a spirited warcry that temporarily boosts attack.
entities.avail:
• Starting weapon of the Pyromancer class.
  • Undead Settlement
    • Found on a corpse next to Cornyx's cell, just above the Cliff Underside bonfire.

entities.name: Handmaid's Dagger
entities.desc:
Dagger used by handmaids of the Profaned Capital.
Each successful attack replenishes a slight amount of FP.
It is said that these women took pleasure in wounding others.
Skill: Blind Spot
Use against shielded opponents to break through their guard by attacking from the side.
entities.avail: Dropped by Jailer Handmaids in the Profaned Capital.

entities.name: Harald Curved Greatsword
entities.desc:
Giant gold-decorated curved sword wielded by warriors of the Harald Legion, who sought the dark soul.
The swords sank into the dark with the legion, where their blades were severely corroded.
Skill: Sever
Hold the giant blade with both hands and slash repeatedly at foe's feet.
entities.avail:
Found in The Dreg Heap.

From the Earthen Peak Ruins bonfire, proceed through the area with the firing Angel. Keep descending while heading toward the general right direction until reaching the poison swamp. Run past a cluster of Poisonhorn Bugs. The greatsword can be looted from a corpse lying below a big log that serves as a bridge.

entities.name: Harpe
entities.desc:
The large sickle-shaped body, used for severing corpses, is a worker's tool in the Undead Settlement.
The sharp edge is on the inside of the weapon, itself designed for cutting and pulling, the allowing for good damage against shielded foes.
Skill: Quickstep
Instantly step behind or around the side of foes. Especially effective when lock on to target.
entities.avail: Dropped by the sickle-wielding Peasant Hollows in the Undead Settlement and Irithyll Dungeon.

entities.name: Havel's Greatshield
entities.desc:
A tremendously solid and heavy greatshield, cut straight from a great slab of stone.
Said to be a relic of the legendary Havel the Rock, along with the Dragon Tooth. The shield is imbued with a special power reminiscent of Havel himself.
Skill: Stone Flesh
Raise the shield in silent prayer, turning the user's body into a solid mass of stone.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by Havel the Rock in Archdragon Peak. Accessed by heading down the stairs from the Great Belfry bonfire, moving across the courtyard and up another set of stairs. There will be a ladder on the left side, ascend it and Havel can be found standing before a dead wyvern.
  • Alternatively, the Man Serpent Summoners have a small chance of summoning Havel. The first time he is defeated, he will drop the greatshield along with the Dragon Tooth.

entities.name: Hawkwood's Shield
entities.desc:
Shield that belonged to Hawkwood, a deserter from the Undead Legion.
The unique swordsmanship of the Watchers does not normally allow for the use of shields. The unique swordsmanship of the Watchers would not allow such a shield, and Hawkwood's very possession of it was telltale of his defeat.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
Found in the Cemetery of Ash, in front of a gravestone located on the right path before entering Firelink Shrine, guarded by a Starved Hound. It is the same grave where Hawkwood the Deserter can sometimes be found praying.

The shield will only appear here if Hawkwood is killed, or after he leaves the shrine once the Abyss Watchers have been defeated.

entities.name: Heavy Crossbow
entities.desc:
A large, powerful crossbow. Must be readied before firing.
Bolts must be equipped in order to use crossbows. Up to two kinds of bolts can be equipped at a time, and these can be switched as necessary.
Skill: Tackle
Lunge into a shoulder tackle, pushing back enemies to create distance.
entities.avail: Dropped by the crossbow-wielding Cathedral Knight found on the rafters of the Cathedral of the Deep.

entities.name: Heretic's Staff
entities.desc:
Catalyst used by generations of heretic sorcerers.
Sorcery is a logical academic discipline, and the power of sorceries depends heavily on the caster's intelligence.
Skill: Steady Chant
Boost the strength of sorceries for a very short period. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Found on a corpse on the Road of Sacrifices. From the Crucifixion Woods bonfire, head into the nearby ruins that lead to the Crystal Sage. Inside the first room with several Sage's Prentice and a Sage's Devout the staff can be found inside an alcove on the first floor next to the stairs.

entities.name: Heysel Pick
entities.desc:
Choice weapon of Yellowfinger Heysel, a Finger of Rosaria and xanthous scholar.
This is both a weapon and a sorcery staff. The gold specks are remnants of lost sorceries.
Skill: Steady Chant
For a short moment, boost the strength of sorceries. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Road of Sacrifices
    • Dropped by Yellowfinger Heysel. She will only drop it once, regardless of where she is defeated or if she invades the player multiple times.
  • Cathedral of the Deep
    • Dropped by the Man-grub in Rosaria's Bed Chamber. It will only appear after both Aldrich, Devourer of Gods and Yhorm the Giant have been defeated.

entities.name: Hollowslayer Greatsword
entities.desc:
Greatsword used for a lifetime by a masked knight. Harbors the fears that lurk within the minds of Hollows, and is particularly effective against them.
Bestowed to a proper Mirrah knight long ago. Two-hand to execute special sword techniques.
Skill: Stance
While in stance, use normal attack to break a foe's guard from below, and strong attack to slash upwards with a forward lunge.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Rotted Greatwood with Ludleth of Courland for 1,000 souls.
entities.notes: • Deals 20% bonus damage to Hollow enemies (does not apply to hollowed players in PvP).

entities.name: Immolation Tinder
entities.desc:
Profaned Flame wielded by the Irithyllian witches, frigid spirits roaming the Boreal Valley.
This torch, both a weapon and a staff, is enshrouded in an everlasting flame.
Skill: Punitive Flame
Punish foes with a flame that blankets the ground.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Fire Witches in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
entities.notes:
• Much like the Gargoyle Flame Spear and hammer, the tinder can be used as a makeshift torch to light up spaces.
  • Due to the strong attack being used to cast sorcery, it's impossible to do a standard strong attack with this weapon.
  • The weapon's skill doesn't go nearly as far as when the fire witches use the same weapon art. It also lacks the explosive attack that can launch you in the air that the fire witches use against you, through this weapon.

entities.name: Irithyll Rapier
entities.desc:
Thrusting sword bestowed upon the Outrider Knights of the Boreal Valley. This weapon is shrouded in frost, and causes frostbite.
Every Outrider Knight one day devolves into a beast, constantly hounded by Pontiff Sulyvahn's black eyes.
Skill: Shield Splitter
Aim carefully, and attack in a large forward lunge to pierce through enemy shields and inflict damage directly.
entities.avail: Guaranteed drop from the Boreal Outrider Knight in Lothric Castle.

entities.name: Irithyll Straight Sword
entities.desc:
Straight sword bestowed upon the Outrider Knights of the Boreal Valley. This weapon is enshrouded in frost, and causes frostbite.
Every Outrider Knight one day devolves into a beast, constantly hounded by Pontiff Sulyvahn's black eyes.
Skill: Stance
While in stance, use normal attack to break a foe's guard from below, and strong attack to slash upwards with a forward lunge.
entities.avail: Found in the Undead Settlement. Guaranteed drop from the Boreal Outrider Knight guarding the entrance to the Road of Sacrifices.

entities.name: Iron Round Shield
entities.desc:
An orthodox, round small shield made from metal.
Small shields offer little damage absorption and stability, but they are lightweight and ideal for parrying.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Thief class.
  • Dropped by sword and shield-wielding Hollow Soldiers in the High Wall of Lothric, Lothric Castle and Grand Archives.

entities.name: Izalith Staff
entities.desc:
Ancient catalyst of the Witch of Izalith and her daughters, used long before the dawn of chaos and of pyromancy.
With the birth of the Chaos Flame, the flame witches were at once both sorcerers and shamans. Faith adjusts the power of sorceries cast using this catalyst, and the staff also seems to boost the power of dark sorceries.
Skill: Steady Chant
Boost the strength of sorceries for a very short period. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
Found in the Smouldering Lake.

In the corridor with the Giant Hound Rat and numerous smaller Hound Rats before the Basilisks, there is an illusory wall that hides a chest. Behind that chest is a second illusory wall which leads to a drop-down alcove, above several Basilisks, where the staff can be found.
entities.notes:
• As the longest staff in game, it has extended reach when casting Farron Flashsword.
  • This staff deals the most physical damage out of all the non-weapon staves.

entities.name: Kite Shield
entities.desc:
An orthodox metal shield.
Medium shields are the most average of shields, providing a practical balance of damage absorption, stability and weight.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Herald class.
  • Sold by Greirat for 4,000 souls.
    • Sold by Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Greirat's Ashes.

entities.name: Knight Shield
entities.desc:
Orthodox shield of the kind commonly used by low-ranking knights.
Medium shields are the most average of shields, providing a practical balance of damage absorption, stability and weight.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Knight class.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 1,500 souls once he returns from pillaging the Undead Settlement.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Greirat's Ashes, provided that he has returned from pillaging the Undead Settlement.

entities.name: Knight's Crossbow
entities.desc:
Crossbow used by the proud knights of Lothric. It bears an elaborate gold design.
The crossbow has been blessed with the power of lightning, in anticipation of the use of Lightning Bolts.
Skill: Tackle
Lunge into a shoulder tackle, pushing back enemies to create distance.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by sword-wielding Lothric Knights.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 3,000 souls once he returns from pillaging Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she is given Greirat's Ashes, provided that he has at attempted to pillage Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
entities.notes:
• This weapon is the only archery weapon in the entire game (including bows and greatbows) that has an elemental infusion.
  • Though it drops from Lothric knights, they don't actually use the weapon.

entities.name: Large Club
entities.desc:
Large wooden club. Requires considerable strength to wield.
Characterized by savage leaping attacks. Its weight makes it easier to break the guard of shields.
Skill: Warcry
Let out a spirited warcry that temporarily boosts attack, and enables a special consecutive strong attack.
entities.avail: Found in the Undead Settlement, on a corpse near the Demon.

entities.name: Large Leather Shield
entities.desc:
Orthodox round shield covered with leather.
Medium shields are the most average of shields, providing a practical balance of damage absorption, stability and weight.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 800 souls.
entities.notes: • One can be traded with Pickle Pee in exchange for a Twinkling Titanite (only once per playthrough).

entities.name: Leather Shield
entities.desc:
An orthodox, round small shield covered with leather.
Small shields offer little damage absorption or stability, but they are lightweight and make ideal instruments for parrying.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Sorcerer class.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 500 souls.

entities.name: Ledo's Great Hammer
entities.desc:
Great Hammer wielded by the Silver Knight Ledo. Ledo's Hammer is by far the heaviest weapon amongst those wielded by the knights of Anor Londo.
Ledo, an eccentric who traveled across the outskirts, became a close friend to the giants and even Havel, the Rock.
Skill: Call to Stone
Spin to lure stones to the steel hammer, and use strong attack to transition into an earth slam that shatters the stones in a shockwave.
entities.avail: Dropped by Silver Knight Ledo.

entities.name: Light Crossbow
entities.desc:
Standard crossbow wielded by common soldiers.
Must be readied before firing.
Bolts must be equipped in order to use crossbows. Up to two kinds of bolt can be equipped at a time, and these can be switched between as necessary.
Skill: Tackle
Lunge into a shoulder tackle, pushing back enemies to create distance.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 1,000 souls.
  • Dropped by Hollow Soldiers.

entities.name: Llewellyn Shield
entities.desc:
Metal shield crafted by the great smith.
Fashioned from rare geisteel, it excels at various types of damage absorption.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Dropped by Horace the Hushed. It can be obtained by killing him at any point in the game, including in Smouldering Lake.

entities.name: Long Sword
entities.desc:
A balanced, widely-used standard straight sword.
Inflicts reliable standard damage, as well as high thrust damage.
Skill: Stance
While in stance, use normal attack to break a foe's guard from below, and strong attack to slash upwards with a forward lunge.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Knight class.
  • Dropped by Hollow Soldiers who wield them.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 1,000 souls.
  • Road of Sacrifices
    • Dropped by Sage's Prentices who wield them.
  • Cathedral of the Deep
    • Dropped by Devouts of the Deep who wield them.
    • Dropped by Devout Bombers.

entities.name: Longbow
entities.desc:
Longbow commonly used by hunters.
Arrows must be equipped in order to use bows. Up to two kinds of arrow can be equipped at a time, and these can be switched as necessary.
Skill: Puncture
Pull the arrow further back for a more powerful shot that can also pierce shields.
entities.avail:
• High Wall of Lothric
    • From the High Wall of Lothric bonfire, take down the stairs on the right and proceed onward through the area with two Starved Hounds and a couple of Large Hollow Soldiers. Climb up the stairs at the end and the bow can be looted from a corpse next to the first Pus of Man.
  • Catacombs of Carthus
    • Dropped by bow-wielding Skeletons.
    • Dropped by the bow-wielding Skeleton Swordsmen.

entities.name: Lorian's Greatsword
entities.desc:
Ultra greatsword of Lorian, Prince Lothric's older brother. Cast in smoldering molten steel, and stained black.
Before Lorian embraced his brother's curse, he was a knight who single-handedly slayed the demon prince, but the victory eternally scorched his sword with flame.
Skill: Flame of Lorian
Lunge forward to transform smolder into flame, and follow with strong attack to launch flame across ground.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Twin Princes with Ludleth of Courland.
entities.notes: • Can be given to Ludleth of Courland, along with Lothric's Holy Sword, to transpose them into the Twin Princes' Greatsword.

entities.name: Lothric Knight Greatshield
entities.desc:
Greatshield of the renowned Lothric Knights, decorated with a holy symbol.
The knights who formed the High Priestess' guard carried greatshields such as these, which were granted high magic absorption through her blessing.
Skill: Shield Bash
Without lowering your guard, strike the enemy with the shield to knock them back or stagger them. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by spear-wielding Lothric Knights.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 5,000 souls after he returns from pillaging Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid if she is given Greirat's Ashes, provided that he has successfully pillaged the Undead Settlement.

entities.name: Lothric Knight Greatsword
entities.desc:
Ultra greatsword of the venerable knights of Lothric. Imbued with the strength of lightning, the trademark of dragon hunting.
Very few have demonstrated the extreme strength and dexterity required for this weapon, even in the long history of the Lothric Knights.
Skill: Stomp
Use one's weight to lunge forward with a low stance and increased poise, and follow with strong attack for an upward slash.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by Lothric Knights who wield them.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by Greirat for 7,000 souls once he returns from his second scavenge expedition in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Greirat's Ashes, by either killing him once he has successfully returned from pillaging Irithyll, or by looting his corpse there if he failed.

entities.name: Lothric Knight Long Spear
entities.desc:
Long spear wielded by the proud Lothric Knights.
Designed for long-range thrusting.
Lothric spear knights are known for their steadfastness, and this spear boosts the poise of its wielder.
Skill: Charge
Hold spear at waist and charge at foe. Use strong attack while charging to extend the length of the charge.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by pike-wielding Lothric Knights.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 4,500 souls once he returns safely from pillaging Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Greirat's Ashes, provided that Greirat has pillaged at least the Undead Settlement.

entities.name: Lothric Knight Shield
entities.desc:
Shield of the renowned Lothric Knights, decorated with the royal crest.
The Lothric Knights contended with dragons, and their shields have suitably high lightning absorption befitting a Dragonslayer's arms.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by sword-wielding Lothric Knights.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 3,000 souls once he returns from his second scavenge run in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

entities.name: Lothric Knight Sword
entities.desc:
A well-crafted straight sword designed for thrusting attacks, wielded by the venerable Knights of Lothric
The Knights of Lothric, with their drakes, once crushed anything that threatened their shores. Of course, that was a long, long time ago.
Skill: Stance
While in stance, use normal attack to break a foe's guard from below, and strong attack to slash upwards with a forward lunge.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by Lothric Knights who wield them.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 4,000 souls once he returns from his second scavenge expedition in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

entities.name: Lothric War Banner
entities.desc:
The flagpole that once carried the Lothric crest, and guided the knights long ago.
The tip of the pole is fitted with a sharply pointed decoration, letting it serve as a spear.
Skill: Lothric War Banner
Wave the flagpole high in the air, like the days of yore, summoning an ethereal war banner that invigorates the attack of those who gather under it.
entities.avail:
Found in The Dreg Heap.

From the first bonfire, head forward and keep dropping through the level until breaking through a large stained glass window. Go through the archway on the left, immediately turn right and drop to a small patch of ash below. Head forward and enter the archway seen in the distance. Turn left, head toward the two Lothric Knights in this area and cross over the small fallen tower beyond them.

Keep heading forward and downward and make a big drop after passing the first Murkman, landing on another patch of ash barely visible below.

Keep advancing through the linear path and drop to a corridor with two red-eyed Lothric Knights. Follow this corridor until reaching a small terrace with a corpse holding the banner.

entities.name: Lothric's Holy Sword
entities.desc:
Prince Lothric's straight sword, blessed by Emma with potent magic.
Young Lothric was meant to be a champion, and was expected to wield this platinum sword, but some things will remain distant dreams forever.
Skill: Sacred Lothric Light
Assume stance to imbue sword with sacred light, and use strong attack to release light together with a great thrust of the sword.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Twin Princes with Ludleth of Courland for 5,000 souls.
entities.notes: • Can be given to Ludleth, along with Lorian's Greatsword, to transpose them into the Twin Princes' Greatsword.

entities.name: Lucerne
entities.desc:
A polearm with a sharp, hard pronged head that inflicts thrust attacks.
The Lucerne is wielded overhand like a hammer, or can be swung from the side to break through shields.
Skill: Spin Sweep
Sweep foes in a large spinning motion, and utilize momentum to transition into an overhanded strong attack smash.
entities.avail: Found on a corpse at the High Wall of Lothric, in the courtyard guarded by patrolling Lothric Knights, just before encountering Vordt of the Boreal Valley.

entities.name: Mace
entities.desc:
Iron hammer designed for use in battle. A common weapon for clerics.
This bladeless strike weapon is effective against most foes, and can break the guard of a shield.
Skill: Perseverance
Assume an unfaltering stance of prayer to temporarily boost poise. Damage reduced while activated.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Cleric class.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 600 souls.

entities.name: Mail Breaker
entities.desc:
A small sword made for thrusting attacks.
This hard, edgeless sword can pierce through tough armor, and boasts a deadly critical attack.
Skill: Shield Splitter
Aim carefully, and attack in a large forward lunge to pierce through enemy shields and inflict damage directly.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Sorcerer class.
  • High Wall of Lothric
    • Found on a corpse in the room prior to Greirat's cell.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Sirris will gift the player a Blessed Mail Breaker after assisting her in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

entities.name: Man Serpent Hatchet
entities.desc:
Hatchet of the serpent men guarding Archdragon Peak.
Has a unique, broadly curved blade that can sneak past shields.
Skill: Warcry
Let out a spirited warcry that temporarily boosts attack, and pierce through shields to inflict direct damage.
entities.avail: Dropped by Man Serpents in Archdragon Peak.

entities.name: Man-grub's Staff
entities.desc:
Staff of the man-grubs who guard Rosaria's Bed Chamber. Their holy symbol is formed at the tip.
Wielder's luck strengthens the effects of sorceries.
The man-grubs have clearly been reborn, but as what?
Skill: Steady Chant
Boost the strength of sorceries for a very short period. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Reward for reaching Rank 2 in the Rosaria's Fingers covenant.
entities.notes:
• The Spell Buff is always displayed at 100, but it does in fact increase with higher investments of Luck.
  • However, weapon buffs such as Great Magic Weapon will use the listed 100 Spell Buff.

entities.name: Manikin Claws
entities.desc:
Weapon of the Pale Shades, assassins of the Sable Church of Londor. The curved claws cause heavy bleeding.
When two-handed, claws are equipped to each hand.
Skill: Quick Step
Instantly step behind or around the side of foes. Especially effective when locked on to target.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Londor Pale Shade when defeated for the first time.

entities.name: Mendicant's Staff
entities.desc:
A staff with a small bowl attached to the tip, similar to a mendicant's crook.
Absorb additional souls from fallen foes.
The staff's history is unclear. It may be a relic of an ancient serpent's greed, or a ritual artifact used to summon souls.
Skill: Steady Chant
Boost the strength of sorceries for a very short period. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Dropped by Man Serpent Summoners in Archdragon Peak
entities.notes: • Can be traded with the Nestling in exchange for the Sunlight Shield (only once per playthrough).

entities.name: Millwood Battle Axe
entities.desc:
Battle axe wielded by Millwood Knights. Its blade is blessed by the symbol of the Ethereal Oak.
A hefty axe normally wielded by the mightiest of warriors.
Skill: Warcry
The unique warcry of the Millwood Knights entailed a leap straight toward the enemy and a fearsome roar.
entities.avail: Found in the Painted World of Ariandel. Within the Snowfield area, enter the destroyed village guarded by Millwood Knights and ascend the tower. The axe is located on an isolated platform at the top that must be jumped or dropped down onto.

entities.name: Millwood Greatbow
entities.desc:
Greatbow crafted with black oak and wielded by Millwood Knights. Only specialized great arrows can be fired from the bow.
It is said that the Millwood Knights used these to face their sworn enemy, the Abyss Dragon.
Skill: Pierce Earth
Fire a greatarrow with a burst of strength and a prayer that violently shakes its target and explodes on impact.
entities.avail:
Found in the Snowfield area of the Painted World of Ariandel.

Upon reaching the derelict village guarded by numerous Millwood Knights, an area looping back to the wooded overlook can be found, to the left before the valley where the Gravetender Greatwolf ambushes the player for the second time. Hooking to the left again upon encountering the flame-tipped Birch Women, are two greatbow-wielding Millwood Knights and several wolves. The greatbow can be found on a corpse in the area, alongside five Millwood Greatarrows.

entities.name: Moaning Shield
entities.desc:
A deformed greatshield given to Eygon of Carim upon being conferred knighthood.
The giant woman's face that protects Eygon is that of his sister, some years his senior.
Skill: Moan
Offer a gentle prayer to the shield, causing the woman's face to give out a low moan and attract enemies.
entities.avail: Dropped by Eygon of Carim, or found on his corpse inside of Irina of Carim's cell in the Undead Settlement after completing her questline.
entities.notes: • Can be traded with Pickle Pee in exchange for a Blessed Gem (only once per playthrough).

entities.name: Moonlight Greatsword
entities.desc:
Legendary dragon weapon associated with Seath the paledrake.
Charge strong attack to its limit to unleash moonlight wave.
Oceiros, the Consumed King, was infatuated with the search for moonlight, but in the end, it never revealed itself to him.
Skill: Moonlight Vortex
Draw sword back and thrust to unleash torrential moonlight.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Consumed Oceiros with Ludleth of Courland for 10,000 souls.

entities.name: Morion Blade
entities.desc:
A twisted sword resembling the towers of Londor's Sable Church. Eight branching blades and thorns induce bleeding.
The church's blessing makes the weapon revel in the agony of its owner. Heavy losses of HP boost attack, a curse most befitting its deformed appearance.
Skill: Stance
While in stance, use normal attack to break a foe's guard from below, and a strong attack to slash upwards with a forward lunge.
entities.avail:
Awarded by Yuria of Londor for fulfilling her initial questline, where she tells the Ashen One how Orbeck of Vinheim has proclaimed himself to be the "Lord of Hollows" and asks if they can see into this matter.

The player must then obtain Orbeck's Ashes and bring them back to Yuria in order to receive the sword.

entities.name: Morne's Great Hammer
entities.desc:
Great Hammer bestowed upon Carim Knights with demonstrate outstanding strength and unwavering faith.
Decorated by a warding charm of Carim Temple, and imbued with the twisted rage of Apostle Morne.
Skill: Morne's Rage
Stick weapon into earth and emit a powerful shockwave. Also, similar to Perseverance, temporarily boosts poise and reduces damage received.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by Eygon of Carim.
  • Alternatively, can be looted from Eygon's corpse in the Undead Settlement, inside Irina of Carim's cell. The body will appear after defeating the Abyss Watchers and Dragonslayer Armour.

entities.name: Morning Star
entities.desc:
Hammer with a sharp spike on its pommel.
One of the more barbaric cleric weapons.
The sharp thorns allow this strike weapon to induce bleeding.
Skill: Perseverance
Assume an unfaltering stance of prayer to temporarily boost poise. Damage reduced while activated.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 2,500 souls once she has been given the Paladin's Ashes.

entities.name: Murakumo
entities.desc:
The curved greatsword of Alva, Seeker of the Spurned, specially forged in an eastern land. Sharp but heavy, this sword requires extreme strength and dexterity to wield.
The search for the spurned had no end, and so the wayfaring knight warmed to a most deformed weapon.
Skill: Spin Slash
Slice into foes with a large spinning motion, and continue spinning to transition into a strong attack.
entities.avail: Guaranteed drop from Alva, Seeker of the Spurned in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, who invades as a dark spirit just before entering the Irithyll Dungeon. The player must be Embered in order to be invaded.

entities.name: Murky Hand Scythe
entities.desc:
A short-shafted hand scythe wielded by the murkmen who rise from the depths.
Enveloped by a black dampness, and imbued with the strength of dark.
entities.avail: Found in the Dreg Heap. After dropping through the glass ceiling, a set of stairs to the left will lead over a bookcase. A corpse will be holding the weapon.

entities.name: Murky Longstaff
entities.desc:
The long-handled staff wielded by the murkmen who rise from the depths.
Slathered with a black murkiness, and fit for dark sorceries.
Skill: Chant from the Depths
Works with staff equipped in left or right hand. Briefly boosts the strength of dark sorceries.
entities.avail: Found in The Dreg Heap. From The Dreg Heap bonfire, proceed through the level until the church with two Lothric Knights. When leaving the church, proceed toward the right. In the back room of the building, a corpse will be holding the staff.

entities.name: Notched Whip
entities.desc:
A whip with thorny spikes that shred skin, causing heavy bleeding.
The Cleansing Chapel uses whips such as these in order to produce the drops as puddles to wipe clean during its rituals.
Skill: Impact
Strike from the left to evade shields and deal a stinging blow that temporarily slows stamina recovery. The shackles of bondage lie deep in the hearts of all humankind.
entities.avail: Found in the Cathedral of the Deep, on a corpse lying on the right side of the Cleansing Chapel.

entities.name: Old King's Great Hammer
entities.desc:
Great Hammer of the Old Demon King.
This weapon has survived since old Izalith, and is imbued with remnants of the Chaos Flame.
Skill: Molten Perseverance
Anchor weapon in earth to temporarily boost poise, and use strong attack to repeatedly stab earth to trigger molten explosions.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Old Demon King with Ludleth of Courland.

entities.name: Old Wolf Curved Sword
entities.desc:
Curved sword bearing the soul of the old wolf that stays with the Watchdogs of Farron.
This sword, like a wolf on the prowl, boosts attack and restores HP with each consecutive hit.
Skill: Wolf Leap
Slice into foes with a large spinning motion, then leap out of harms way and follow with a strong attack.
entities.avail: Found in the Farron Keep. Reward for reaching Rank 1 in the Watchdogs of Farron covenant.
entities.notes:
• Boosts attacks by 10, as long attacking persists. See also the effect of the Pontiff's Right Eye.
  • After six consecutive hits, it restores 120 HP. See also the effect of the Pontiff's Left Eye.

entities.name: Onikiri and Ubadachi
entities.desc:
The hunters known as the King's Black Hands wielded paired weapons. These belonged to Kamui, who looked after the prince.
Kamui brought Onikiri with him to the Undead Settlement, where he forged Ubadachi, and was finally prepared to join the ranks of the royal hunters.
Skill: Onislayer
Leap forward and slash mercilessly with both blades, cutting open foes.
entities.avail: Dropped by Black Hand Kamui after defeating him at the Grand Archives.
entities.notes: • Shares the same skill as the Claw, although they are called different names.

entities.name: Onislayer Greatbow
entities.desc:
A unique greatbow handed down in an eastern land, where tales are told of its use in slaying giant horned oni.
Drawing a bow of this size takes time, and leaves the user vulnerable. Only specialized great arrows can be fired from the bow.
Skill: Puncturing Arrow
Masterfully fires off a great arrow that pierces through all enemies in its path, inflicting damage.
entities.avail: Found in the Profaned Capital. From the Profaned Capital bonfire, climb down the ladder towards Yhorm the Giant's arena, and head towards the bridge guarded by the Headless Gargoyle. Drop off the right side of the bridge, and it can be found on a corpse along with eight Onislayer Greatarrows.

entities.name: Onyx Blade
entities.desc:
Elfriede, the eldest amongst her sisters and leader of the Sable Church, bestowed this sword to her knight.
Only, the sword was a farewell gift, and acceptance signified the knight's resignation from Elfriede's service.
Skill: Elfriede's Blackflame
Enwreath blade with blackflame, born of the similarly-hued flame that smolders within her.
entities.avail: Dropped by Sir Vilhelm when he is defeated in the Corvian Settlement.

entities.name: Painting Guardian's Curved Sword
entities.desc:
A weapon described in legends passed down amongst heretics, wielded by the Painting Guardians.
A uniquely shaped weapon with a flat tip.
Skill: Chained Dance
Execute relentless consecutive attacks while tracing a circle in a unique dance of deadly grace.
entities.avail: Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, on a corpse in the tower of the Church of Yorshka. After unlocking the Prison Tower bonfire, drop into the tower and navigate a series of drop-downs. The Painting Guardian Set is also found in this same area.

entities.name: Parrying Dagger
entities.desc:
Dagger with a greatly curved guard.
A dagger made especially for parrying which is usually equipped in one's left hand in place of a shield.
Skill: Parry
Deflect an attack when timed properly and follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Sold by Unbreakable Patches for 2,000 souls.

entities.name: Partizan
entities.desc:
Spear with blade attached to broad point. Long reach, and can be used with shield up. Attacks faster with shield down.
This weapon can utilize its blade for slicing attacks, and is generally adaptable to many situations, but in cramped quarters, its slices ricochet off walls.
Skill: Spin Sweep
Sweep foes in a large spinning motion, and utilize momentum to transition into an overhanded strong attack smash.
entities.avail: Found in the Undead Settlement, on a hanging corpse above the stairs leading out of the Cliff Underside bonfire. The corpse must be freed with a projectile weapon before the weapon can be obtained.

entities.name: Pickaxe
entities.desc:
Tool used by a miner for digging up earth. Not intended for use in battle.
Yet the strong downward swing of this tool once shattered large boulders, and easily punctures weaker armor.
Skill: Galvanize
Temporarily boost stamina recovery speed by sheer force of will, which an old miner needed to get through the day.
entities.avail: Found in the Irithyll Dungeon, on a corpse near the sleeping Giant Slave.

entities.name: Pierce Shield
entities.desc:
An unusual style of round shield peculiar to the knights of Catarina.
The center of the shield features a large, sharpened spike, which is used to skewer opponents.
Skill: Shield Bash
Without lowering your guard, strike the enemy with the shield to knock them back or stagger them. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by Siegward of Catarina if he dies at any point during his quest.
  • Sold by Unbreakable Patches for 3,000 souls.

entities.name: Pike
entities.desc:
Long spear with a very long hilt. Designed for long-range thrusting.
Has the longest range of the non-projectile weapons, but its very length makes it unwanted in certain situations.
Skill: Charge
Hold spear at waist and charge at foe. Use strong attack while charging to extend distance.
entities.avail:
Found in the Road of Sacrifices:

  • Dropped by Lycanthrope Hunters.
  • Dropped by Sage's Prentices.

entities.name: Plank Shield
entities.desc:
Makeshift shield cobbled together from wooden planks.
Provides minimal protection, and at the cost of moderate humiliation.
Skill: Shield Bash
Without lowering your guard, strike the enemy with the shield to knock them back or stagger them. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Deprived class.
  • Found in the Undead Settlement. Taking the right-side path from the burning tree with the praying Evangelist and Peasant Hollows, break some crates to the right before entering the stable area, to reveal a hidden path. Traverse the rooftops on the left, killing the Thralls along the way, to find it on a corpse before the Cage Madman.

entities.name: Pontiff Knight Curved Sword
entities.desc:
Curved sword wielded by the Pontiff’s knights, frigid spirits that linger in Irithyll.
The large blade appears to be eaten away by insects, making it lightweight but also brittle.
Skill: Frost Blade
Execute large spinning motion to imbue blade with frost, and follow through with a strong attack that slashes with a giant blade made of frost.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 6,000 souls once he returns from his pillaging journey to the Undead Settlement.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she is given Greirat's Ashes.
  • Dropped by Pontiff Knights in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

entities.name: Pontiff Knight Great Scythe
entities.desc:
Great scythe wielded by the Pontiff's knights, frigid spirits that linger in Irithyll.
The large blade appears to be eaten away by insects, making it lightweight but also brittle.
Skill: Frost
Create a bone-chilling frost with each swing of the greatscythe that causes a temporary frost effect.
entities.avail: Dropped by the great scythe-wielding Pontiff Knight before Pontiff Sulyvahn in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
entities.notes: The Faith requirement does not affect its attack rating. However, casting the weapon art without the required Faith results in failure and does not consume FP, and attacks will consume more stamina.

entities.name: Pontiff Knight Shield
entities.desc:
Shield of the Pontiff's knights, frigid spirits that linger in Irithyll.
This blue-gray shield, shrouded in a thinly cold air, is light and brittle.
Skill: Weapon Skill
Equipping this shield in the left hand allows one to perform the skill of the right hand weapon.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 3,000 souls once he returns from his pillaging journey to the Undead Settlement.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she is given Greirat's Ashes.
  • Dropped by Pontiff Knights who wield them in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

entities.name: Porcine Shield
entities.desc:
Shield base on a pig's head, depicted with unsettling authenticity.
Shields such as these were made to shame weak-willed knights, and those who carried these shields were subject to merciless ridicule. No one will defend a craven who abases himself.
Skill: Shield Bash
Without lowering your guard, give the enemy a good shove with the shameful pig's snout. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Obtained by trading an Undead Bone Shard with Pickle Pee (only once per playthrough).

entities.name: Preacher's Right Arm
entities.desc:
The dessicated right hand of a white-faced locust that rose from the abyssal swamp, that happens to perform as a catalyst for sorcery.
The white-faced locusts were meant to beckon men to the dark with sermons, but most of them are unable to think past their own stomachs, the unruly mob!
Skill: Feasting Branch
Use souls to weave a sharp branch to fillet prey. Can be used repeatedly.
entities.avail: Found in the Ringed City. From the Ringed City Streets bonfire, head into the swamp, turn right, and head straight toward the big building seen in the distance. Past a Judicator Giant and surrounded by several small White-faced Locusts, is the tip of a sunken tower, where a corpse sitting on it holds the staff.

entities.name: Priest's Chime
entities.desc:
Sacred chime for casting miracles of the Gods, of the type given to Lothric priests.
To cast a miracle, the caster learns a tale of the Gods, and says a prayer to be blessed by its revelations. The faith of the supplicant affects the strength of the miracle.
Skill: Gentle Prayer
Recovers HP for a period of time, albeit extremely slowly. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Sold by Greirat for 4,000 souls once he has returned from his scavenge expedition in the Undead Settlement.
entities.notes: • Can be traded with Pickle Pee in exchange for the Help me! Carving.

entities.name: Profaned Greatsword
entities.desc:
A ceremonial sword, held in Pontiff Sulyvahn's right hand, representing the Profaned Flame.
Long ago, when Sulyvahn was yet a young sorcerer, he discovered the Profaned Capital and an unfading flame below a distant tundra of Irithyll, and a burning ambition took root within him.
Skill: Profaned Flame
Temporarily summon the Profaned Flame. Lunge forward and use strong attack to enshroud blade in flame.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Pontiff Sulyvahn with Ludleth of Courland for 3,000 souls.

entities.name: Pyromancer's Parting Flame
entities.desc:
The pyromancy flame of Livid Pyromancer Dunnel that attracts the echoes of the death.
When Dunnel lost his hideous spouse, he gave his own pyromancy flame as an offering, which transformed into a parting flame. Not long after, Dunnel became a mad spirit, cursed to wander the lands.
Skill: Parting Flame
Release store of death echoes to gain a modest dose of Estus.
entities.avail: Found on a corpse in the Painted World of Ariandel, in the tower where Livid Pyromancer Dunnel invades (Crossbreed Priscilla's boss arena). The path to the tower is hidden behind an illusory wall in the lower level of Ariandel Chapel basement.

entities.name: Pyromancy Flame
entities.desc:
Flame catalyst used by pyromancers.
Equip a pyromancy flame to utilize pyromancy. Pyromancies must be attuned at a bonfire to use.
Skill: Combustion
Creates a powerful flame in the wielder's hand. One of the most basic pyromancies, and for this very reason, the flame create is fierce. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Pyromancer class.
  • Given by Cornyx of the Great Swamp once he relocates to Firelink Shrine.

entities.name: Quakestone Hammer
entities.desc:
A Stonehammer wielded by the Millwood Knights, with a head of naturally-formed stone.
The Knights of Millwood would fight hand-in-hand with the earth itself, and this weapon, among the oldest in Millwood, is symbolic of that relationship.
Skill: Quake
Burrow hammer head into the ground with a great slam, and use strong attack to upheave earth, creating a shockwave that rumbles like a mighty warcry.
entities.avail: In the Snowy Mountain Pass area, before the final stretch leading to the basement of Ariandel Chapel. There is a fork that leads to the left, and eventually to a Millwood Knight wielding a Millwood Greatbow. The Quakestone Hammer is on a corpse behind him.

entities.name: Rapier
entities.desc:
A lightweight thrusting sword used in noble duels employing refined techniques.
The primary attack of a thrusting sword is a series of stabs that render foes vulnerable for a devastating final thrust. Can also attack with shield up.
Skill: Stance
From stance, use normal attack to back step and execute a surprise attack, or strong attack for consecutive thrusting.
entities.avail: Found in the High Wall of Lothric, on a corpse lying to the left after exiting the small courtyard with a fountain patrolled by a Winged Knight.

entities.name: Red Hilted Halberd
entities.desc:
Long-hilted weapon mixing spear and axe. The red-hilted halberd is associated with clerics.
Can be thrust like a spear or swept sideways like an axe, making it a versatile weapon effective against multiple foes.
Skill: Perseverance
Assume an unfaltering stance of prayer to temporarily boost poise. Damage reduced while activated.
entities.avail: Found in the Undead Settlement's sewers. The Grave Key is required to unlock the gate in the sewage system that gives access to this area. It is found at the center of the room where the player is attacked by Skeletons for the first time.

entities.name: Red and White Shield
entities.page: Red and White Round Shield (Dark Souls III)
entities.desc:
Standard round wooden shield. It features a striking red and white design.
Wooden shields are light, manageable, and offer relatively high magic absorption.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
Found in the Undead Settlement. After using the Grave Key to gain access to the small catacombs area guarded by the Giant Hound Rat, navigate the tunnels and exit out into the ravine, heading towards the room containing the ladder that leads to Irina of Carim. Before entering, look up and use a projectile weapon like a bow to shoot down the lootable corpse. A Blessed infused Red and White Round Shield that has been upgraded to +1 can be obtained.

The area can also be accessed by casting Spook from the foot of the bridge spanning the chasm and falling down into the pit, without having to go through the catacombs. The Silvercat Ring will also work to prevent fall damage.

entities.name: Reinforced Club
entities.desc:
A club made more deadly by the attachment of numerous nails to its heads.
The nails allow this strike weapon to be lacerating, but the damage caused by their insertion has reduced its durability, making the weapon fragile.
Skill: Warcry
Let out a spirited war cry that temporarily boosts attack, and enables a special consecutive strong attack
entities.avail: Found in the Undead Settlement, on one of the corpses lying on the graveyard beyond the Dilapidated Bridge, where the Giant Archer's arrows rain down.

entities.name: Repeating Crossbow
entities.desc:
This crossbow, customized for repeat-firing to face mobs alone, was wielded by Slave Knight Gael.
Used in the battles of an endless journey, this crossbow is covered with twists and dinks, rusted with blood, and made extremely brittle from overuse.
Skill: Repeat Fire
Assume stance to activate repeat firing mechanism, and repeat fire with normal and strong attacks.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Slave Knight Gael with Ludleth of Courland for 5,000 souls.
entities.notes: • Does not need a full ten bolts to use Repeat Fire. As long as at least one bolt is in the player's possession, it can be used.

entities.name: Ricard's Rapier
entities.desc:
A strikingly decorative rapier of an Undead prince spoken of in ancient stories.
Although many of the tales surrounding the prince are questionable, this thrusting weapon suggests that the stories of his graceful technique were in fact true.
Skill: Ricard's Lunge and Press
Assume a quick stance, lunge forward, and execute a stunning chain attack. Sustain offensive with strong attack.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Rapier Champion the first time he is summoned and defeated by the player in Archdragon Peak, before reaching the Great Belfry.
entities.notes:
• Can be buffed and infused.
  • This can benefit from the Sharp Gem infusion as this is a Dexterity-based weapon.

entities.name: Ringed Knight Paired Greatswords
entities.desc:
Paired black greatswords wielded by the Ringed Knights.
The arms of early men were forged in the Abyss, and betray a smidgen of life. For this the gods cast a seal of fire upon such weapons, and those who possessed them.
Skill: Ember
Cross the twin timeworn greatswords to reignite a short-lived flame. A lightning-quick upward heave slices the very air, and transitions into normal or strong attacks.
entities.avail: Found in The Ringed City. Guaranteed drop from the paired greatswords-wielding Ringed Knight in front of the Church of Filianore when killing him for the first time.

entities.name: Ringed Knight Spear
entities.desc:
Black spear wielded by the Ringed Knights. The arms of early men were forged in the Abyss, and betray a smidgen of life.
For this reason the gods cast a seal of fire upon these spears, and those who possessed them.
Skill: Ember
Thrust the timeworn spear and watch it restore its ancient brilliance and reignite a short-lived flame, whose dull aftermath will carry on.
entities.avail: Found in the Ringed City. On the great stairway leading from the Inner Wall to the Streets, there is a small side path close to the bottom of the stairs where the second trio of Harald Legion Knights is encountered. After traversing the hallway filled with Curse-inflicting Undead Clerics, the spear can be found on a corpse to the right, guarded by a spear-wielding Ringed Knight.

entities.name: Ringed Knight Straight Sword
entities.desc:
Straight sword wielded by the Ringed Knights.
The arms of early men were forged in the Abyss, and betray a smidgen of life.
For this reason the gods cast a seal of fire upon these swords, and those who possessed them.
Skill: Ember
Stand ready with the timeworn blade as it restores its ancient brilliance and reignites a short-lived flame. From this stance, transition to normal or strong attack.
entities.avail: Found in The Ringed City. From the Ringed City Streets bonfire, go towards the Judicator Giant, turning right before reaching the sunken church guarded by Ringed Knights. At the top of a hill to the right, there will be a sunken building with a non-aggressive White-faced Locust atop, the sword can be found near him.

entities.name: Rose of Ariandel
entities.desc:
A flail used by the bulbous Father of the Painted World to shred his own skin, producing blood to appease the flame.
Both a weapon and a miracle catalyst.
Ariandel, being the restorer of the Painted World, knew that it was painted with blood, and only blood could protect the secret.
Skill: Awakening
Violently flail oneself to trigger an awakening that temporarily boosts the strength of miracles, just as the good Father used the rose himself.
entities.avail: Transpose the Soul of Sister Friede with Ludleth of Courland for 3,000 souls.
entities.notes: • There are tiny, clawed hands on the end of each whip, each one resembling a bird's foot.

entities.name: Rotten Ghru Curved Sword
entities.desc:
A crude, half-rotten curved sword.
Choice weapon of the blunt-horned Ghrus, descendants of the acolytes of Farron Keep.
The rancid blade is drenched in rotten waste, making it acutely poisonous.
Skill: Spin Slash
Slice into foes with a large spinning motion, and follow with strong attack for a spinning vertical-slash.
entities.avail:
• Farron Keep
    • Dropped by Ghrus.
  • Smouldering Lake
    • Dropped by Smouldering Ghrus.

entities.name: Rotten Ghru Dagger
entities.desc:
A crude, half-rotten dagger.
Choice weapon of the blunt-horned Ghrus, descendants of the acolytes of Farron Keep.
The rancid blade is drenched in rotten waste, making it acutely poisonous.
Skill: Quickstep
Instantly step behind or around the side of foes. Especially effective when locked on to target.
entities.avail: Dropped by dagger-wielding Ghrus in the Farron Keep.

entities.name: Rotten Ghru Spear
entities.desc:
A crude, half-rotten curved spear.
Choice weapon of the blunt-horned Ghrus, descendants of the acolytes of Farron Keep.
The rancid tip is drenched in rotten waste, making it acutely poisonous.
Skill: Charge
Hold spear at waist and charge at foe. Use strong attack while charging to extend the length of the charge.
entities.avail:
• Farron Keep
    • Dropped by spear-wielding Ghrus.
  • Smouldering Lake
    • Dropped by spear-wielding Smouldering Ghrus.
entities.notes:
This weapon does well on a low-level quality build when infused with a Refined Gem.

This weapon shares the same moveset as the spear, meaning it does well when paired with the Leo Ring.
