entities.name: Round Shield
entities.desc:
Standard round wooden shield.
Wooden shields are light, manageable, and offer relatively high magic absorption.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Warrior class.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 1,000 souls.

entities.name: Sacred Bloom Shield
entities.desc:
A treasured antique of the Way of White, known to some as the Sorcerer's Bane.
The large blossom design that graces the shield is said to be a sacred flame, and the shield is blessed with high magic protection.
Skill: Spell Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand. Also deflects spells.
entities.avail: Found in Lothric Castle, on a ledge near the Winged Knight Set. The area lies behind an illusory wall located behind the twinaxe-wielding Winged Knight that awaits up the ladder of a small tower shortly after the initial Lothric Castle bonfire.

entities.name: Sacred Chime of Filianore
entities.desc:
A sacred chime blessed by Princess Filianore, matriarch of the church.
Filianore's favor knows no boundaries, and this sacred chime expand the range of vicinity-affecting miracles that heal, cure, or provide other enhancements.
Skill: Pray for Favor
Works with chime equipped in left or right hand. Heal HP very slowly for a duration of time. Affect caster and those in vicinity.
entities.avail:
Found in the Ringed City. Gifted upon accepting Shira, Knight of Filianore's request to slay Darkeater Midir. This can only be done before interacting with Filianore in the area after Halflight, Spear of the Church.

If missed at this location, it will be dropped by Shira after defeating her at Pygmy's Throne.
entities.notes: • This weapon has a Strength requirement, though this essentially has no effect, as there are no starting classes that do not meet it.

entities.name: Sage's Crystal Staff
entities.desc:
Crystal catalyst presented as a gift by the Crystal Sages to their favorite pupil, Kriemhild.
Crystal spheres devour the will of the user, and this staff increases the potency of sorceries at the cost of increased FP consumption for Skills.
Skill: Steady Chant
Boosts the strength of sorceries for a very short period. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Dropped by Daughter of Crystal Kriemhild in the big courtyard at the highest floor of the Grand Archives.

entities.name: Saint Bident
entities.desc:
A silver bident decorated by a holy symbol, formerly wielded by Saint Klimt. He discarded this weapon, that draws upon one's faith, on the day that he put his own faith behind him.
Skill: Charge
Hold spear at waist and charge at foe. Use strong attack while charging to extend the length of the charge.
entities.avail: Found in the Cathedral of the Deep, on a corpse near the Giant Slave located on the opposite end from the boss room.

entities.name: Saint's Talisman
entities.desc:
Medium for casting miracles of the Gods.
Ivory talismans are given only to women clerics, and faith greatly affects their effectiveness.
There is a certain frailty to this talisman, which undermines the steadfastness granted by its Skill.
Skill: Unfaltering Prayer
Temporarily increases poise while casting miracles, preventing enemy attacks from interrupting prayer. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Found in the Undead Settlement. After obtaining the Grave Key and navigating the sewers below the settlement, it can be found on a corpse in the room just before the ladder leading up to Irina of Carim's cell, guarded by numerous Hound Rats.

entities.name: Saint-tree Bellvine
entities.desc:
Sacred chime for casting miracles of the Gods. A bellvine cut from a small saint-tree that has been meticulously tended to.
Saint-tree bellvines are customary in the far north, and allow for faster casting than ordinary sacred chimes.
Skill: Gentle Prayer
Recovers HP for a period of time, albeit extremely slowly. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Found in the Cathedral of the Deep. From the Cleansing Chapel bonfire, exit the cathedral and drop into the nearby riverbed. The chime can be found in the middle of the open path to the left, guarded by three Corpse Grubs.
entities.notes: • Can be traded with Pickle Pee in exchange for the Help me! Carving (only once per character).

entities.name: Scholar's Candlestick
entities.desc:
A candlestick covered in ivory scales once used by the Scholars of the Great Archives.
This served as their guiding light, as well as a tool of self-restrain. Even today, wielders of this weapon benefit from the resulting sorcery-strengthening properties.
Weapon Skill: Guiding Light
The candle provides a temporary source of light which reveals additional guidance.
entities.avail:
• Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 3,500 souls once he returns from pillaging Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for the same price once she is given Greirat's Ashes, provided that he has at least survived pillaging the Undead Settlement.
  • Grand Archives
    • Dropped by Grand Archives Scholars.

entities.name: Scimitar
entities.desc:
Small curved sword that excels in swift movements and consecutive attacks.
The scimitar's flesh-rending slash attacks are greatly compromised against armor and tough scale-covered hides.
Skill: Spin Slash
Slice into foes with a large spinning motion, and follow with strong attack for a spinning vertical-slash.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 600 souls.
  • Dropped by Skeletons who wield them in the Catacombs of Carthus.

entities.name: Sellsword Twinblades
entities.desc:
Paired scimitars used by certain sellswords. The scimitars' sharp blades make for effective slashing attacks, but fare poorly against metal armor and tough scale-covered hides.
With a scimitar in each hand, the wielder can vary their onslaught with unique left-handed attacks when in the proper stance.
Skill: Spin Slash
Slice into foes with a large spinning motion, and continue spinning to transition into a strong attack.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Mercenary class.
  • Found behind the Black Knight at the far end of the swamp in Crucifixion Woods.

entities.name: Shield of Want
entities.desc:
Shield of an ancient king who was cursed by an all-consuming thirst. In the end, he was no king.
The residue of the king's lust still smolders within this shield, increasing the number of souls absorbed when enemies are defeated.
Skill: Weapon Skill
Equipping this shield in the left hand allows one to perform the Skill of the right hand weapon.
entities.avail: Found in the Smouldering Lake, guarded by the Carthus Sand Worm.

entities.name: Short Bow
entities.desc:
Standard small bow. Its size allows for quick shots.
Arrows must be equipped in order to use bows. Up to two kinds of arrow can be equipped at a time, and these can be switched between as necessary.
Skill: Rapid Fire
Swiftly nocks arrows with finesse after drawing the bow, allowing for consecutive shots.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Thief class.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 1,000 souls once he returns from his first scavenge run in the Undead Settlement.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for the same price once she is given Greirat's Ashes.

entities.name: Shortsword
entities.desc:
Small straight sword excelling in thrusting attacks.
The shortsword is a light and easily wielded straight sword, due to its minimal attribute requirements.
Skill: Stance
While in stance, use normal attack to break a foe's guard from below, and strong attack to slash upwards with a forward lunge.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 600 souls.

entities.name: Shotel
entities.desc:
Broadly curved sword known as the favored weapon of the tragic Embraced Knight.
Shaped to sneak around the defenses of shields, this sword requires ample dexterity to wield effectively.
Skill: Spin Slash
Slice into foes with a large spinning motion, and follow with strong attack for a spinning vertical-slash.
entities.avail: Two are sold by Unbreakable Patches for 4,000 souls.

entities.name: Silver Eagle Kite Shield
entities.page: Silver Eagle Kite Shield (Dark Souls III)
entities.desc:
Orthodox metal shield engraved with a crest depicting a silver eagle.
Medium shields are the most average of shields, providing a practical balance of damage absorption, stability and weight.
Skill: Weapon Skill
Equipping this shield in the left hand allows one to perform the Skill of the right hand weapon.
entities.avail: Found in the High Wall of Lothric. Make way to the big room with several Large Hollow Soldiers and Starved Hounds, near the end of the level. Upon entering, follow the catwalk on the right and the shield can be looted from a chest located in a nearby corner.

entities.name: Silver Knight Shield
entities.desc:
Heavy shield carried by the Silver Knights who served the old royal family. A flowing canal is chiseled deeply into its face.
The Silver Knights stayed behind to protect the humble manor and ruined cathedral. Though their goddess has long since left, her blessing upon her knights' shields remains.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Dropped by Silver Knights.

entities.name: Small Leather Shield
entities.desc:
A small, leather-covered round shield.
It features a large central protrusion designed for parrying attacks.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Undead Settlement
    • From the Undead Settlement bonfire, enter the first house and immediately turn right. The shield can be looted from one of the hanging corpses.
  • Archdragon Peak
    • Dropped by the hatchet-wielding Man Serpents that carry them.
entities.notes:
• The parry type is Special (Long).
  • In Dark Souls 1, this shield originally used the parry type: Fast

entities.name: Smough's Great Hammer
entities.desc:
Twisted great Hammer associated with Smough, the last knight to remain at his post, guarding the ruined cathedral.
Restore HP while attacking, a carryover from Smough's past as an executioner.
Skill: Perseverance
Anchor weapon in earth to temporarily boost poise. Damage reduced while activated.
entities.avail: Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, inside the middle chest on the upper gallery floor of the Distant Manor. The area is located shortly after exiting the drainage with several Sewer Centipedes and is guarded by three Silver Knights.
entities.notes:
• Restores 2 HP with each successful hit.
  • Restores 4 HP with each successful two-handed strong hit.

entities.name: Sniper Crossbow
entities.desc:
Long-range heavy crossbow used by Carim snipers.
Its lengthy base makes aiming difficult, and accurate usage requires a trained, dexterous hand.
Skill: Tackle
Lunge into a shoulder tackle, pushing back enemies to create distance.
entities.avail: Found in Lothric Castle, on a corpse on a small tower guarded by a Hollow Soldier that throws Undead Hunter Charms, before reaching the Dragon Barracks bonfire. To reach it, the player must drop into the moat before the Lothric Wyverns and follow the path to the right, defeating several Hollow Assassins and a Winged Knight in order to reach it.

entities.name: Soldering Iron
entities.desc:
Branding iron used by the jailers prowling Irithyll Dungeon.
Press its searing tip against foes to inflict fire damage, and temporarily block Estus healing.
Skill: Charge
Hold iron at waist and charge at foe. Use strong attack while charging to extend the length of the charge.
entities.avail: Dropped by Jailers in Irithyll Dungeon.

entities.name: Sorcerer's Staff
entities.desc:
Staff used to cast sorceries. A common catalyst given to sorcerers of the Vinheim Dragon School.
Equip a catalyst to use sorceries. Sorceries must be attuned at a bonfire before use.
Skill: Steady Chant
Boost the strength of sorceries for a very short period. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Sorcerer and Assassin classes.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 500 souls.
  • Road of Sacrifices
    • Dropped by Sage's Devouts.

entities.name: Spear
entities.desc:
Common short spear that allows attacking with shield up.
Spear attacks are centered on thrusting, but can inflict high damage when timed with the end of an enemy's swing.
Skill: Shield Splitter
Take a large step forward and make a single focused thrust to puncture enemy shields and inflict damage.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Herald class.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 600 souls.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 600 souls, once she has been given Greirat's Ashes.
  • Dropped by spear-wielding Hollow Soldiers.
  • Dropped by spear-wielding Devouts of the Deep.

entities.name: Spider Shield
entities.desc:
A shield bearing a large etching of a spider.
Shields of this style are commonly used by savage mountain bandits, and offer high resistance to poison.
Skill: Weapon Skill
Equipping this shield in the left hand allows one to perform the Skill of the right hand weapon.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Brigand near the first bonfire in the Cathedral of the Deep.
entities.notes: • Increases Poison resistance by 50 when wielded.

entities.name: Spiked Mace
entities.desc:
Choice weapon of the evangelists of the Cathedral of the Deep, mentors of the dwellers of the Undead Settlement.
Its long, sharp spikes cause great pain and bleeding.
Skill: Spin Bash
Bash foes with a large spinning motion, utilizing momentum to transition into a overhand strong attack smash.
entities.avail: Dropped by Evangelists in the Undead Settlement, Cathedral of the Deep and Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

entities.name: Spiked Shield
entities.desc:
Shield of Longfinger Kirk, the notorious Knight of Thorns. The surface bristles with thorns.
Its vicious design makes it an effective weapon, and its thorns can inflict heavy bleeding on those unfortunate enough to be struck.
Skill: Shield Strike
Use shield to attack enemies. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Dropped by Longfinger Kirk in the Cathedral of the Deep.
entities.notes: • Unlike shields with the Shield Bash skill, shield strike does not provide any blocking frames, making this shield less useful for trading blows.

entities.name: Spirit Tree Crest Shield
entities.desc:
A knight's shield engraved with a crest depicting a spirit tree.
One of the enchanted blue shields. The Spirit Tree Crest Shield greatly reduces lightning damage.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Found in Lothric Castle, in one of the chests in the room where the Boreal Outrider Knight dwells.
entities.notes: • The spirit tree crest is quite similar to the crest of the Ethereal Oak on the cape of the Millwood Knight Armor set.

entities.name: Splitleaf Greatsword
entities.desc:
A long-handled greatsword that made its way from a distant land. Crafted entirely with bronze, making it exceedingly heavy.
Splitleaf refers to the shape of the great blade, and its resemblance to the veins of a leaf.
Skill: Wind Wheel
Spin weapon vigorously above head and sweep foes, and transition with normal or strong attack for continued spin attacks, which whip up wind and gain momentum, strengthening subsequent attacks.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Stone-humped Hag for 11,000 souls.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for the same price if she is given the Old Woman's Ashes and it was not previously purchased from the Stone-humped Hag.
entities.notes:
• This weapon gains S Strength scaling upon max reinforcement and Heavy infusion.
  • Amnesiac Lapp wields this weapon.

entities.name: Spotted Whip
entities.desc:
Whip mottled with venomous-looking spots.
Favored by some female pyromancers of the Great Swamp.
As its noxious appearance would suggest, damage from this whip poisons its victims, slowly but surely guiding them to their deaths.
Skill: Impact
Strike from the left to evade shields and deal a stinging blow that temporarily slows stamina recovery. The shackles of bondage lie deep in the hearts of all humankind.
entities.avail: Found in the Undead Settlement, on the same cage where Cornyx was first found. The whip, along with Cornyx's Set, will only appear after defeating the Old Demon King with the aid of the Great Swamp Cuculus in the Smouldering Lake.

entities.name: Stone Greatshield
entities.desc:
A mossy stone disc. Though terribly heavy, it can serve as a shield.
The disc is a relic of ancient magic, and one can practically feel the power flowing through it.
Skill: Shield Bash
Without lowering your guard, strike the enemy with the shield to knock them back or stagger them. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Dropped by Elder Ghrus in Farron Keep.

entities.name: Stone Parma
entities.desc:
A round, stone shield, once carried by an old knight who turned to stone himself.
It has powerful defensive properties for its size, but is extremely heavy.
Skill: Weapon Skill
Equipping this shield in the left hand allows one to perform the Skill of the right hand weapon.
entities.avail: Found in the Farron Keep. From the first bonfire, follow the general path on the left. The loot containing the shield is visible on the distance, right under a lone Rotten Slug lying beside a tree.

entities.name: Storm Curved Sword
entities.desc:
Curved sword imbued with the strength of the Stormdrake.
The Nameless King, ally of the ancient dragons, fought beside the Stormdrake in countless battles. When the great beast fell, the king claimed his soul, as was the custom in the age of the gods.
Skill: Tornado
Imbue blade with the wrath of storm in a spinning motion, and follow with a strong attack to bear that wrath upon foes.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Nameless King with Ludleth of Courland at a cost of 5,000 souls.

entities.name: Storm Ruler
entities.desc:
Greatsword with a broken blade, also known as the Giantslayer for the residual strength of storm that brings giants to their knees.
Yhorm the Giant once held two of these, but gave one to the humans who doubted him, and left the other to a dear friend before facing his fate as a Lord of Cinder.
Skill: Storm King
Assume stance to imbue sword with storm. Most effective when facing giants.
entities.avail:
• Found beside Yhorm the Giant's throne in the Profaned Capital.
  • Dropped by Siegward of Catarina.

entities.name: Storyteller's Staff
entities.desc:
Staff of a heretic storyteller who shares tales of the Painted World to forlorn souls.
The storytellers, too, are wretched beings with no place to go. Their bodies, souls, and even their staves are all tainted through and through.
Skill: Poison Spores
Expel noxious spores from the formless, parasitical things that inhabit the staff.
entities.avail: Dropped by Corvian Storytellers.

entities.name: Sunless Talisman
entities.desc:
Talisman given to the knights of the Sunless Realms, who serve the nameless moon.
Scales with intelligence, which is rare for a miracle catalyst, but makes it compatible with Dark. In the Sunless Realms, this fact is related first as an initial warning.
Skill: Unfaltering Prayer
Temporarily increases poise while casting miracles, preventing enemy attacks from interrupting prayer. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by Sirris of the Sunless Realms.
  • Found on Sirris's corpse in the Cemetery of Ash if her questline is fully completed after defeating the Twin Princes. The corpse can be found in front of a grave along the cliffs on the right, in the same spot where the Sunset Shield was found.

entities.name: Sunlight Shield
entities.desc:
A large, circular shield made of metal and decorated with a holy symbol depicting the sun.
This shield was used by the old Knight of Sunlight, and the illustration is his own. Regardless, it has no particular divine powers.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Obtained by trading a Mendicant's Staff with the Nestling. The Mendicant's Staff must not be reinforced for the trade to work.
entities.notes: • This trade can only be performed once per playthrough.

entities.name: Sunlight Straight Sword
entities.desc:
Straight sword imbued with the strength of lightning.
This featureless long sword contains the very power of the sun. Perhaps is a relic of one-sided adoration.
Skill: Oath of Sunlight
Raise the sword aloft when praising the sun to boost attack and damage absorption for self and allies in vicinity. The warriors of sunlight are co-operators from an ancient age.
entities.avail: Found in Lothric Castle, dropped by a Mimic in a room adjacent to the white wyvern.
entities.notes:
• Prior to Patch 1.13, the Sunlight Straight Sword originally scaled only with Strength and Dexterity.
  • Although the weapon description claims that it inflicts lightning damage, it actually doesn't have any elemental attack.

entities.name: Sunlight Talisman
entities.desc:
The Knight of Sunlight's personal talisman for casting miracles of the Gods.
The talisman bears the Knight's own holy illustration, an emblem of his unwavering faith. Use of the talisman's Skill fills the user with similar steadfastness.
Skill: Unfaltering Prayer
Temporarily increases poise while casting miracles, preventing enemy attacks from interrupting prayer. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Found in the Farron Keep, on a medium-sized mound of land in the poisonous swamp, to the left of the ladder that leads to the Old Wolf of Farron altar.

entities.name: Sunset Shield
entities.desc:
Shield of the Holy Knights of the Sunless Realms.
Engraved with a brilliant flame crest that burns brightly within the order's customary sunset colors. This design symbolizes those who both harbor and oppose the power of flame.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
Found in the Cemetery of Ash, on a gravestone located near the cliff on the right side of the area between the Iudex Gundyr bonfire and Firelink Shrine.

The shield will only appear after defeating Holy Knight Hodrick together with Sirris of the Sunless Realms in the Pit of Hollows.

entities.name: Tailbone Short Sword
entities.desc:
Twisted dagger cherished by the wretched prisoners of Irithyll Dungeon.
Crafted from a feeble tailbone, and seen as a sign of the dragons. Their screams are oft heard inside the dungeon, as they naively mutilate their unworthy flesh.
Skill: Unleash Dragon
Thrust the dagger to unleash the strength of dragons, similar to an ancient dragon weapon, only with its power tragically faded.
entities.avail: Dropped by dagger-wielding Wretches in the Irithyll Dungeon.

entities.name: Tailbone Spear
entities.desc:
Twisted spear favored by the wretched, failed prisoners of Irithyll Dungeon.
Crafted from a feeble tailbone, and seen as a sign of the dragons. Their screams are oft heard inside the dungeon, as they naively mutilate their unworthy flesh.
Skill: Unleash Dragon
Thrust the spear to unleash the strength of dragons, similar to an ancient dragon weapon, only with its power tragically faded.
entities.avail: Dropped by Wretches who wield them in Irithyll Dungeon.

entities.name: Talisman
entities.desc:
Talisman for casting miracle of the Gods. Once a very common item among the ranks of the old Way of White.
Equip a talisman or a sacred chime to cast miracles. Miracles must be attuned at a bonfire before use.
Skill: Unfaltering Prayer
Temporarily increase poise while casting miracles, preventing enemy attacks from interrupting prayer. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Herald class.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 500 souls.

entities.name: Target Shield
entities.desc:
A small, round metal shield.
The four distinctive protrusions are designed to brush attacks aside, making it ideal for parrying.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Assassin class.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 2,500 souls once he returns from his first pillaging run in the Undead Settlement.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for the same price once she is given Greirat's Ashes.

entities.name: Thrall Axe
entities.desc:
Small hand axe used by Lothric slaves.
A cunning weapon for a cunning lot, this axe is quick and deadly.
Skill: Quickstep
Instantly step behind or around the side of foes. Especially effective when locked on to target.
entities.avail: Dropped by Thralls in the Undead Settlement and the Cathedral of the Deep.
entities.notes: • The Quickstep skill will still function as intended even if the player's FP bar is empty, but a portion of the invincibility frames are lost (further testing required whether all invincibility frames are lost).

entities.name: Torch
entities.desc:
A simple, makeshift torch made from an oily rag wrapped around the end of a stick.
Torches such as these are the easiest way to illuminate one's surroundings, but their use comes at the cost of occupying a hand that would otherwise be free.
Can be used as a rudimentary weapon to inflict fire damage. It possesses no Skill, being an ordinary, basic tool.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 300 souls.
entities.notes: • In Andre's Reinforce Weapon menu, the Torch is categorized as a shield.

entities.name: Twin Dragon Greatshield
entities.desc:
The lightest of all greatshields, made from wood and decorated with a two-headed dragon.
Greatshields are the largest type of shield, and offer both high stability and damage absorption, making it easy to deflect enemy attacks.
Skill: Shield Bash
Without lowering your guard, strike the enemy with the shield to knock them back or stagger them. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Found in the Road of Sacrifices, on a corpse near to the Halfway Fortress bonfire.
entities.notes: • If the Twin Dragon Greatshield is not retrieved prior to the coming of the Eclipse, the item and the corpse holding it will disappear for the rest of the playthrough.

entities.name: Twin Princes' Greatsword
entities.desc:
Sword forged from the reunion of the inseparable swords born from the souls of Lothric and Lorian, the twin princes.
Their union is rooted in a curse, and perpetuated by grief.
Skill: Sacred Light and Flame
While in stance, use normal attack to cast Sacred Lothric Light, and strong attack to cast Flame of Lorian.
entities.avail: Transpose Lorian's Greatsword and Lothric's Holy Sword with Ludleth of Courland. Possessing both weapons in one's inventory, speak to Ludleth of Courland when he is in possession of the Transposing Kiln to unlock additional dialogue. The two weapons can then be joined to create the Twin Princes' Greatsword, sacrificing both in the process.

entities.name: Uchigatana
entities.desc:
A unique katana characterized by the fine craftsmanship of an eastern land where it was forged.
The finely-sharpened blade cuts flesh like butter and causes bleeding, but breaks easily as a result.
Skill: Hold
Assume a holding stance to rapidly execute a lunging slash with normal attack, or a deflecting parry with strong attack.
entities.avail:
Guaranteed drop from the Sword Master in the Cemetery of Ash. He can be found by taking the left path, just before the main entrance to Firelink Shrine.

Even though he is found early in the game, he is quite strong and has a fair amount of health. An easy way to kill him is to knock him off a ledge. If that's the case, resting at the nearby bonfire will make his weapon appear at his spawning spot, at the top of the stairs.

entities.name: Valorheart
entities.desc:
Weapon once wielded by the Champion of the Undead Match. A special paired set consisting of a broad sword and a lion shield.
The champion fought on, without rest, until he lost his mind. In the end, only his page and a lone wolf stayed at his side.
Skill: Lion Stance
While in stance, use normal attack to thrust forward with shield up, and strong attack to execute a shield bash with a lion's roar.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating the Champion's Gravetender and Gravetender Greatwolf.

entities.name: Vordt's Great Hammer
entities.desc:
Great Hammer wielded by Vordt, the outrider knight of the Boreal Valley. Weapon is imbued with frost, and causes frostbite.
Frost accumulated in the body causes frostbite, which saps one's health, lowers absorption, and slows stamina recovery.
Skill: Perseverance
Anchor weapon in earth to temporarily boost poise. Damage reduced while activated.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Boreal Valley Vordt with Ludleth of Courland.
entities.notes:
• Vordt's Great Hammer is one of the few available weapons that can inflict the Frost status effect.
  • At 110 Frost build-up, Vordt's Great Hammer causes the most build-up per swing of any weapon with innate build-up.
  • At 99 Strength, Vordt's Great Hammer +5 achieves 593 attack damage.

entities.name: Warden Twinblades
entities.desc:
Paired weapon wielded by the grave wardens of the Cathedral of the Deep.
The grave wardens of the cathedral, who put down reincarnating copses, wield weapons that cause profuse bleeding, for the loss of blood and bodily fluids is said to slow reanimation.
Skill: Spin Slash
Slice into foes with a large spinning motion, and continue spinning to transition into strong attack.
entities.avail: Dropped by Grave Wardens in the Cathedral of the Deep and the Untended Graves.

entities.name: Wargod Wooden Shield
entities.desc:
Wooden shield reinforced with metal. The largest of the wooden medium shields.
The bizarre pattern featured on the shield is the mark of a mad god, revered as a god of war in remote regions.
Skill: Weapon Skill
Equipping this shield in the left hand allows one to perform the Skill of the right hand weapon.
entities.avail: Found in the Undead Settlement, on a corpse near the Pit of Hollows bonfire.

entities.name: Warpick
entities.desc:
A war hammer with a hard pronged head. Was originally a pickaxe, but was refitted for battle.
This simple but deadly weapon hits heavily with thrust damage, easily puncturing metal armor.
Skill: Galvanize
Temporarily boost stamina recovery speed by sheer force of will, or perhaps as a channeling of the original owner's industrious efforts.
entities.avail: Sold by Greirat for 1,500 souls once he returns from his first scavenge expedition in the Undead Settlement.

entities.name: Warrior's Round Shield
entities.desc:
Standard round wooden shield. It bears a double-bladed axe, the mark of a warrior.
Wooden shields are light, manageable, and offer relatively high magic absorption.
Skill: Weapon Skill
Equipping this shield in the left hand allows one to perform the Skill of the right hand weapon.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 600 souls.

entities.name: Washing Pole
entities.desc:
A stunning, unusually long katana forged in an eastern land.
The extreme length of this blade provides immense range, but also renders the blade extremely fragile.
Skill: Hold
Assume a holding stance to rapidly execute a lunging slash with normal attack, or a deflecting parry with strong attack.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 7,500 souls once she has been given the Easterner's Ashes.

entities.name: Whip
entities.desc:
A leather whip that was never intended for use in combat.
Of little use against armor and tough scales, but quite formidable against enemies with exposed skin.
Skill: Impact
Strike from the left to evade shields and deal a stinging blow that temporarily slows stamina recovery. The shackles of bondage lie deep in the hearts of all humankind.
entities.avail: Found in the Undead Settlement, on a corpse located behind a door near to the second bonfire.

entities.name: White Birch Bow
entities.desc:
A short bow crafted with white birch. Endowed with light-manipulating magic.
The bow is a relic from an ancient land of sorceries that was swallowed by the Abyss, most known for its folktale of the heroic Abysswalker.
Skill: Unseen Arrow
Arrows shot by large pulls of the bow are enchanted with a golden spell that turns them nearly invisible.
entities.avail:
Found in The Ringed City, in the swamp before the Ringed City Streets bonfire.

From the bonfire, cross the swamp, then move to the left, onto the hill guarded by numerous Hobbled Clerics. The bow can be found on a corpse in the area.

entities.name: White Hair Talisman
entities.desc:
Talisman made from a lock of white hair.
This lock of hair belonged to a deformed member of the chaos witches, mothers of the art of pyromancy. Fashioned into a talisman, it enables the wielder to cast both miracles and pyromancies.
Skill: Combustion
Creates a powerful flame in the wielder's hand. One of the most basic pyromancies, and for this reason, the flame created is fierce. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Found on a corpse at the back of a lava pit, behind an illusory wall in the Smouldering Lake.

entities.name: Winged Knight Halberd
entities.desc:
Halberd wielded by the Winged Knights, who swore themselves to the Angels.
The thick, heavy, bloodstained blade can only be swung by one with inhuman strength.
Skill: Chain Spin
Sweep foes in a large spinning motion and use strong attack to continue the motion until stamina is exhausted.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by the Winged Knights who wield them in the High Wall of Lothric and Lothric Castle.
  • Dropped by the two Gertrude's Knights who wield them in the Grand Archives.

entities.name: Winged Knight Twinaxess
entities.desc:
Paired beheading axes wielded by the Winged Knights, who swore themselves to the Angels.
These axes, more befitting of an executioner than a knight, are indented to fit the human body.
Skill: Chain Spin
Sweep foes in a large spinning motion and use strong attack to continue the motion until stamina is exhausted.
entities.avail:
• Lothric Castle
    • Dropped by the twinaxe-wielding Winged Knight found in a small tower between the Lothric Castle and the Dragon Barracks bonfires.
  • Grand Archives
    • Dropped by the twinaxe-wielding Gertrude's Knight found on top of the main dome.

entities.name: Winged Spear
entities.desc:
A long-hilted spear with wing lugs.
Long reach, and can be used with shield up.
Spear attacks are centered on thrusting, but can inflict high damage when timed with the end of an enemy's swing.
Skill: Charge
Hold spear at waist and charge at foe. Use strong attack while charging to extend the length of the charge.
entities.avail: Sold by Unbreakable Patches for 1,500 souls.

entities.name: Witch's Locks
entities.desc:
A whip fashioned from the black hair of a daughter of the Witch of Izalith, creator of the Flame of Chaos.
The long, shining locks woven together to create this whip are imbued with the essence of fire, which can be channeled through the use of its Skill.
Skill: Flame Whip
Temporarily coat the whip in fire, the self-same fire as that which consumed the Witch herself, it is said.
entities.avail: Found inside a chest in the Grand Archives, in a secret room behind a moving bookcase in the darkened room on the second floor, past the large vat with wax. The bookcase's mechanism is triggered by a lever within the same room.
entities.notes: • The weapon's description may be a reference to Chaos Witch Quelaag, as she is the only Daughter of Chaos whose hair is seen by the player, and it is black in color.

entities.name: Witchtree Branch
entities.desc:
The branch of a large, well-tended witchtree, used as a sorcery catalyst.
Witchtree staves are customary in the far north, and allow for faster casting than ordinary catalysts.
Skill: Steady Chant
Boost the strength of sorceries for a very short period. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail:
Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

From Central Irithyll, make way past the plaza with the fountain. To the left of the second Fire Witch there will be a small terrace with a Crystal Lizard. The banister on the right is illusory and will reveal a staircase once hit. Head down the stairs past a Pontiff Knight and toward a cell with a deranged Evangelist named Dorhys inside. The staff lies next to a tree on the right.

entities.name: Wolf Knight's Greatshield
entities.desc:
Greatshield of a knight tainted by the dark of the Abyss, and master of the wolf's blood of Farron.
Boasts consistent defense and divine protection against various status effects.
Skill: Weapon Skill
Equipping this shield in the left hand allows one to perform the Skill of the right hand weapon.
entities.avail: Obtained by reaching Rank 2 in the Watchdogs of Farron covenant.
entities.notes: • When equipped, it increases Bleed, Poison, Frost, and Curse resistances by 50. It has no effect on Toxic resistance.

entities.name: Wolf Knight's Greatsword
entities.desc:
Greatsword of a knight tainted by the dark of the Abyss, and master of the wolf's blood of Farron.
The wolf knight was the first Abyss Watcher, and his sword is more punishing against creations of the abyss.
Skill: Wolf Sword
While in stance, use normal attack for a low spinning slash, or strong attack to leap forward in a vertically-slashing somersault.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Blood of the Wolf and 10,000 souls with Ludleth of Courland.
entities.notes: • Deals increased damage to abyssal enemies.

entities.name: Wolnir's Holy Sword
entities.desc:
A holy sword eroded by the Abyss. When Wolnir fell to the Abyss, he was gripped by a fear of true darkness, and pleaded to the gods for the first time.
This holy sword, together with three armlets stripped from the corpses of clerics, gave him some semblance of comfort.
Skill: Wrath of the Gods
Thrust weapon into earth to emit powerful shockwave. The wrath of those swallowed by the Abyss is a thing to be wary of indeed.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of High Lord Wolnir with Ludleth of Courland.

entities.name: Wooden Shield
entities.desc:
A vertically elongated wooden shield decorated with a white dragon.
Wooden shields are light, manageable, and offer relatively high magic absorption.
Skill: Parry
Repel an attack at the right time to follow up with a critical hit.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Mercenary class.
  • Dropped by Hollow Soldiers who wield them.
  • Road of Sacrifices
    • Dropped by Sage's Prenticese.
  • Cathedral of the Deep
    • Dropped by Devouts of the Deep.
entities.notes: • The Wooden Shield has made an appearance in each Dark Souls game to date, and though the appearance was altered in Dark Souls II to have a lion painted on the front, the version in Dark Souls III uses a higher-quality model of the original Dark Souls design.

entities.name: Yhorm's Great Machete
entities.desc:
Great machete wielded long ago by Yhorm the Giant.
Yhorm once lumbered on the frontlines with a greatshield. But one day, in place of his shield, a left-hand notch was added to his machete, enabling the smashing technique that would become the legacy of his later years.
Skill: Warcry
Let out a spirited warcry that temporarily boosts attack, and enables a crushing strong attack.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Yhorm the Giant with Ludleth of Courland.

entities.name: Yhorm's Greatshield
entities.desc:
Greatshield used long ago by Yhorm the Giant.
Increases the user's poise.
As a lord, Yhorm risked everything and fought unflinchingly as a one-man vanguard. Following the loss of the one he wished to protect, he forsook his shield.
Skill: Shield Bash
Without lowering your guard, strike the enemy with the shield to knock them back or stagger them. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Yhorm the Giant with Ludleth of Courland.

entities.name: Yorshka's Chime
entities.desc:
A sacred chime belonging to Yorshka. Her brother, the former knight captain, presented her with this medium together with another gift: her name.
The ringing of the chime must have done much to soothe her loneliness.
Skill: Gentle Prayer
Recovers HP for a period of time, albeit extremely slowly. Works while equipped in either hand.
entities.avail: Dropped by Company Captain Yorshka in Anor Londo.
entities.notes:
• Can be traded with Pickle Pee in exchange for the Help me! Carving.
  • Since getting this item requires that the player kills Captain Yorshka, it should be noted that the Darkmoon Blade and the Darkmoon Ring, both rewards in the Blade of the Darkmoon covenant, will not be available anymore in that playthrough, unless the player acquires both prior to killing her.

entities.name: Yorshka's Spear
entities.desc:
This treasure, gifted to the Yorshka Church, is enchanted with a soporific spell, and was surreptitiously worshiped by Irithyll slaves.
As a weapon, it is part spear and part hammer, the former allowing thrusting, and the latter allowing strikes.
Skill: Pacify
With a prayer and an offering of this spear, temporarily wear down enemy FP with each strike.
entities.avail: Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, in the darkened room located shortly past the graveyard behind the Church of Yorshka. Climb the ladder on the far-right and walk along the rafters until reaching the other end of the room. Drop down to an elevated platform with a chest that contains the weapon.

entities.name: Zweihander
entities.desc:
Ultra greatsword with a large, long blade. Wielded with two hands, yet still requiring great strength due to its weight.
Execute powerful attacks that take advantage of its weight, or utilize its sharp blade in thrust attacks.
Skill: Stomp
Use one's weight to lunge forward with a low stance and increased poise, and follow with strong attack for an upward slash.
entities.avail: Sold by Greirat for 6,000 souls once he returns from his pillaging travel in the Undead Settlement.

entities.name: Aldrich's Ruby
entities.desc:
A malformed ring left by Aldrich, Saint of the Deep. Recovers HP from critical attacks.
Aldrich, infamous for his appetite for flesh, apparently had the desire to share with others his joy of imbibing the final shudders of life while luxuriating in his victim's screams.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Deep Accursed found in Anor Londo's cathedral.

entities.name: Aldrich's Sapphire
entities.desc:
A malformed ring left by Aldrich, Saint of the Deep. Recovers FP from critical attacks.
Aldrich, infamous for his appetite for flesh, apparently had the desire to share with others his joy of imbibing the final shudders of life while luxuriating in his victim's screams.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Deep Accursed found in the room behind the first Cathedral Knight on the bottom-most floor of the Cathedral of the Deep, before the open area where the two giants are located.

entities.name: Ashen Estus Ring
entities.effect: Increases FP restored by Ashen Estus Flask by 20%.
entities.desc:
Gray crystalline ring crafted from shards.
Increases FP restored by Ashen Estus Flask.
Once a treasure brought before Lothric's Queen, she had it enshrined in the Cemetery of Untended Graves, so that one day an Unkindled might profit from its use.
entities.avail: Found in the Untended Graves. From the first bonfire, proceed onward and turn left on the first path. The ring is guarded by several Corvians and a Storyteller.

entities.name: Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring
entities.desc:
A special ring given to those who are deemed fit to undertake the journey of discovery in Vinheim, home of sorcery.
Greatly boost sorceries.
Apropos to the Dragon School, the seal depicts an everlasting dragon. A bellowing dragon symbolizes the true nature of the consummate sorcerer.
entities.avail:
Found in the Irithyll Dungeon. Requires the Jailbreaker's Key.

Once the key has been procured, from the Irithyll Dungeon bonfire, advance toward the main cell block area and turn right. Proceed straight ahead until reaching the end of the corridor on the upper floor and unlock the barred window at the end. The ring can be looted from a corpse lying on one of the rock ledges accessed afterward.

entities.name: Bloodbite Ring
entities.desc:
One of the bite rings native to Carim.
Increases bleed resistance.
The crafting of these rings is forbidden, perhaps owing to a fear of malleable stones.
Clerics, however, dabble freely in the art.
entities.avail:
• Bloodbite Ring
    • Found in the Undead Settlement. Automatically acquired upon defeating the Giant Hound Rat lurking in the sewers.
  • Bloodbite Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in the Smouldering Lake, on a corpse lying to the right of the giant ballista.

entities.name: Blue Tearstone Ring
entities.effect: Boosts damage absorption by 20% when HP is below 20%.
entities.found: High Wall of Lothric (gift from Greirat)
entities.desc:
A ring set with a large rare tearstone jewel.
Temporarily boosts damage absorption when HP is low.
This stone is said to be a tear of sorrow of the goddess Caitha, and of course, tears are always more beautiful near death.
entities.avail: Found in the High Wall of Lothric. The ring is given to the player by Greirat after he has been freed from his cell and upon agreeing to help him (Cell Key required).

entities.name: Calamity Ring
entities.desc:
A ring made from the orange eye of a calamitous dragon.
Receive double damage.
This ring has no useful powers, and is merely a symbol of dragon worship, a thing quietly passed down amongst its most fervent adherents, some of whom become convinced the task has been bestowed upon them as a sacred duty.
entities.avail: Found in Archdragon Peak. Obtained by performing the "Path of the Dragon" gesture in front of the dragon statue at the Dragon-Kin Mausoleum.

entities.name: Carthus Bloodring
entities.desc:
Ring worn by warriors of the sand kingdom, Carthus. Boosts rolling invincibility, at the cost of defense.
The sword technique of Carthus allows for fluid movement with a curved sword. Masters of the technique are said to dazzle their opponents by moving as weightlessly as a grain of sand.
They live for their High Lord Wolnir, conqueror of most kingdoms known to their people.
entities.avail:
Found in the Catacombs of Carthus.

From the Catacombs of Carthus bonfire, go downstairs and head right. Turn right at the corner and follow the long hallway inhabited by several Skeleton Wheels and Writhing Rotten Flesh to the end, where a corpse can be found holding the ring.
entities.notes: • Prior to the App 1.13 Regulation 1.33 patch, the Carthus Bloodring would reduce absorption by 15% rather than 30%.

entities.name: Carthus Milkring
entities.effect: Boosts dexterity by 3 and obscures the wearer while rolling.
entities.desc:
Ring worn by warriors of the sand kingdom, Carthus.
Slightly boosts dexterity and obscures the wearer while rolling.
The sword technique of Carthus allows for fluid movement with a curved sword. Masters of the technique are said to dazzle their opponents by moving as weightlessly as a grain of sand.
They live for their High Lord Wolnir, conqueror of most kingdoms known to their people.
entities.avail:
Found in the Catacombs of Carthus, located at the end of an alley full of ancient urns after taking the large staircase with the first Skeleton Boulder.

Many of the urns surrounding the ring will release homing projectiles if broken. Additionally, a mage skeleton that throws the same type of projectiles guards the area and may break some unwanted urns with its own attacks. One of the urns is sitting on a pressure plate that will activate a trap of fire bolts if broken.

To easily claim the ring, start by disposing of the skeleton and then take a bow or any other kind of precise ranged attack. Identify the urn sitting on the pressure plate, shoot it from afar and use the nearby columns to take cover. The bolts shot by the trap will destroy most urns around the ring and all released projectiles will vanish once they hit a wall.

entities.name: Chillbite Ring
entities.desc:
One of the bite rings native to Carim. Increases frost resistance.
This ring would never grace Friede's hand, for the painting and its frost became her home.
entities.avail:
Painted World of Ariandel:

  • Gifted by Sister Friede after speaking to her twice inside of Ariandel Chapel.
  • Dropped by Friede if her illusion within the chapel is attacked.
  • Left on Friede's chair if her boss fight is engaged without obtaining the ring from her.

entities.name: Chloranthy Ring
entities.effect: Raises stamina recovery speed by 7 points per second.
entities.desc:
This old ring is named for its decorative green blossom,
but its luster is long since faded.
Raises stamina recovery speed.
entities.avail:
• Chloranthy Ring
    • Found at the bottom of a tower in the Undead Settlement. Jump off the lift that leads to the Road of Sacrifices while riding its upper part and onto a wooden scaffolding, then follow the only path available, fighting a Demon with Siegward along the way. Once reaching the rooftop of the next house, jump toward a nearby tower and enter it. Make way to the bottom and the ring can be found behind some wooden crates, near to the Mirrah Set.
  • Chloranthy Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, behind the pedestal that holds the Ring of the Sun's First Born.
  • Chloranthy Ring+2 (NG++)
    • Found in the Road of Sacrifices. Drop to a small ledge just to the left of the first Corvian Storyteller to find the ring.
  • Chloranthy Ring+3 (The Ringed City)
    • Found in the Ringed City, being held by the statue of Gwyn before the Church of Filianore. On the elevator that leads up to the Ringed Inner Wall bonfire, there is a secret path that eventually leads to a drop-down to the statue.

entities.name: Covetous Gold Serpent Ring
entities.page: Covetous Gold Serpent Ring (Dark Souls III)
entities.desc:
A gold ring depicting a snake that could have been, but never was, a dragon.
Fallen foes are more likely to drop items.
Snakes are known as creatures of great avarice, devouring prey even larger than themselves by swallowing them whole. If one's shackles are cause for discontent, perhaps it is time for some good old fashioned greed.
entities.avail:
• Covetous Gold Serpent Ring
    • Found in the Profaned Capital, on a corpse inside a locked cell along with Siegward. The only access is through an open window reached by jumping from the chapel's roof above the toxic swamp (Old Cell Key required).
  • Covetous Gold Serpent Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, on a corpse lying on a ledge below a broken railing, immediately after the dark room with several Irithyllian Slaves and before reaching the lake surrounding the city.
  • Covetous Gold Serpent Ring+2 (NG++)
    • Found in Archdragon Peak, in the big courtyard after defeating the Nameless King. A corpse on the third stairway on the right can be found holding the ring.
  • Covetous Gold Serpent Ring+3 (The Ringed City)
    • Found in The Ringed City, in a building at the end of the great stairway. It is in the area at the top of the long ladder from the swamp guarded by multiple Hobbled Clerics, past two Ringed Knights and in the room where Amnesiac Lapp is found.

entities.name: Covetous Silver Serpent Ring
entities.page: Covetous Silver Serpent Ring (Dark Souls III)
entities.desc:
A silver ring depicting a snake that could have been, but never was, a dragon. Fallen foes yield more souls.
Snakes are known as creatures of great avarice, devouring prey even larger than themselves by swallowing them whole.
If one's shackles are cause for discontent, perhaps it is time for some old-fashioned greed.
entities.avail:
• Covetous Silver Serpent Ring
    • Located on the roof of Firelink Shrine. Although the Tower Key can be purchased for 20,000 souls from the Shrine Handmaid to gain access to the roof, a patient player can use a tree near the top of the shrine as a ramp to leap onto the roof. The room with the chest containing the ring is hidden behind an illusory wall reached by walking on the rafters located on top of the shrine, where Pickle Pee's lower nest lies.
  • Covetous Silver Serpent Ring +1 (NG+)
    • Found in the Irithyll Dungeon, on a corpse lying on a wooden scaffolding, midway through the shortcut lift near the Irithyll Dungeon bonfire.
  • Covetous Silver Serpent Ring +2 (NG++)
    • Found in the Undead Settlement, near the two Evangelists and the Demon. From the Evangelists, walk outside and drop down to the roof on the right. The ring is on a corpse by the chimney.
  • Covetous Silver Serpent Ring +3 (The Ringed City)
    • Found in The Dreg Heap, soon after meeting the first two Lothric Knights. Go right, into the building where several Murkmen will spawn and you can find the Murky Longstaff. The wall in front of the corpse holding the staff is an illusory wall. Go through the area it hides, until the place where the Great Soul Dregs is. From here, fall down to a ledge to find the ring.
entities.notes:
• The effect of this ring stacks with other items that provide a similar effect, like the Shield of Want and the Symbol of Avarice.
  • If the ring was not collected in Firelink Shrine, it can be found in the same location in the Untended Graves. However, since there is no way to open the bell tower's door and the ladder to access the roof is not present in this area, the only way to reach it is by jumping to the roof from the tree nearby.

entities.name: Cursebite Ring
entities.desc:
One of the bite rings native to Carim.
Increases curse resistance.
The crafting of these rings is forbidden, perhaps owing to a fear of malleable stone. Clerics, however, dabble freely in the art.
entities.avail:
Found in the Profaned Capital.

From the Profaned Capital bonfire, climb down the ladder and exit through a hole in the wall. The path eventually leads to a toxic swamp and the ruins of a chapel. Drop into the swamp and head inside a cavern inhabited by several Sewer Centipedes on the opposite side of the chapel. The ring can be found on a corpse within such cavern.

entities.name: Dark Clutch Ring
entities.effect: • Increases dark attack by 15%. • Reduces damage absorption by 10.
entities.desc:
Ring depicting a hand grasping a purple stone.
Increases dark attack, but compromises damage absorption.
An old fable in Londor claims the lure of the clutch ring reaches out to the crestfallen, who might otherwise be overcome by despair.
entities.avail: Found in the Irithyll Dungeon. Dropped by the Mimic at the far-end of the sewers.

entities.name: Dark Stoneplate Ring
entities.desc:
Stoneplates are symbols of true knights, and dark purple stoneplates are granted to Undead knights.
Increases dark damage absorption.
entities.avail:
• Dark Stoneplate Ring
    • Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, on a corpse in the dark underpass adjacent to the big courtyard with several dead Giant Slaves past Pontiff Sulyvahn's arena. The ring is guarded by a group of Irithyllian Slaves.
  • Dark Stoneplate Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in Lothric Castle, next to the white Lothric Wyvern. From the Dragonslayer Armour bonfire, turn back and stick to the right until an opening on the wall is found. Drop down and access a room with a Mimic and the Braille Divine Tome of Lothric, the ring will be on a corpse outside.
  • Dark Stoneplate Ring+2 (NG++)
    • Found in Farron Keep. From the Keep Ruins bonfire, look behind the building beyond the three Ghrus on the bridge.
entities.notes: • Decreases its effectiveness the higher the player's Dark absorption becomes.

entities.name: Darkmoon Ring
entities.desc:
Ring of the moon deity Gwyndolin, youngest son of Gwyn, the First Lord.
Adds many slots for attunement.
Gwyndolin, also known as the Dark Sun, commands the Darkmoon Knights, and bestows this ring upon the best of them.
entities.avail: Reward for reaching Rank 1 in the Blade of the Darkmoon covenant. Reaching this rank requires giving ten Proof of a Concord Kept to Company Captain Yorshka.
entities.notes: • If the player has attuned spells to at least all but one available slots while this ring is equipped, and attempts to remove the ring after, a warning will appear that they will lose attuned spells by doing so. Confirming the action will remove the spell(s) occupying the final two Attunement slots.

entities.name: Deep Ring
entities.desc:
A ring bestowed upon the Deacons of the Cathedral of the Deep.
Allows attunement of additional spells.
In the Cathedral slumber things most terrible, and as such, the deacons require a grand narrative, to ensure they do not falter in their duty. A philosophy, to ward away the madness beckoned by the grotesqueries at hand.
entities.avail:
Guaranteed drop from a non-hostile Deacon in the Cathedral of the Deep.

From the Cleansing Chapel, walk through the shortcut door on the left (having opened it previously) and take the nearby lift up the tower. The player will enter a room with a Devout of the Deep wielding a crossbow that had previously attacked the player when traversing the area below, and the ledge beyond its window outside the tower will lead further upward towards the cathedral rooftops. At the top of this ladder is a non-hostile Deacon, which can be killed to obtain the ring.
entities.notes:
• If the player has attuned spells to every available slot while the ring is equipped, and attempts to remove the ring after, a warning will appear that they will lose an attuned spell by doing so. Confirming the action will remove the spell occupying the final Attunement slot.

<tabber>Official translation= A ring bestowed upon the Deacons of the Cathedral of the Deep. Allows attunement of additional spells.

In the Cathedral slumber things most terrible, and as such, the deacons require a grand narrative, to ensure they do not falter in their duty. A philosophy, to ward away the madness beckoned by the grotesqueries at hand. |-|Original description (Japanese) = 深みの聖堂、その主教たちに与えられる指輪 記憶スロットを増やす

聖堂はおぞましいものの寝床であり 故に彼らには、大きな物語が必要だった おぞみと共に深くあり、狂わぬほどの物語が |-|Literal translation = Ring given to the bishops of the Church of the Deep. Increases memory slots.

The Church is a cradle of repulsive things, thus they needed a great story. A story deep like the repulsiveness enough to keep them from going insane. </tabber>

entities.name: Dragonscale Ring
entities.desc:
Ring of Oceiros, former king of Lothric.
Reduces damage from backstabs.
In his later years, Oceiros became fascinated with dragons. After going mad, he was more commonly known as the Consumed King. Many assassins were dispatched to his domain, but none returned.
The Consumed King ascribed his resilience to the divine protection of the dragon scale.
entities.avail: Found in the Consumed King's Garden, on a corpse located halfway up the second lift in the area. The player needs to jump off to a ledge as the elevator moves either up or down.

entities.name: Dusk Crown Ring
entities.effect: • Reduces most spells' FP consumption by between 20-25%. • Reduces HP by 15%.
entities.desc:
Leaf-colored crown ring bestowed upon the princess of Oolacile, ancient land of golden sorceries.
Reduces spell FP consumption, but also lowers HP.
Oolacile is synonymous for its lost sorceries, of which the xanthous sorcerers are dedicated scholars. This crown ring is a rare artifact of great magic heritage.
entities.avail: Found in the Irithyll Dungeon, on a corpse lying in the far-left cell of the second cell block.

entities.name: Estus Ring
entities.effect: Increases HP restored by the Estus Flask by 20%.
entities.desc:
A green ring crafted from shards. Increases HP restored by Estus Flask.
This ring was entrusted to a certain Fire Keeper, but in the end she never met her champion, and the ensuing tragic farce became a favorite tale of the masses.
entities.avail:
Found at the bottom of the decrepit bell tower behind Firelink Shrine (Tower Key required).

Climb up the spiraling staircase inside the first tower and enter the second one at the other end of the bridge. While facing the lift inside, drop down onto the various caskets protruding from the walls (preferably on the right side as it is safer, although on the left side the Fire Keeper Set can be obtained) and make way to the bottom of the tower, where the ring can be looted from the lifeless body of an old fire keeper.

entities.name: Farron Ring
entities.desc:
A ring given to Undead Legion of Farron.
Reduces Skill FP consumption.
The Abyss Watchers, for their hunting, required a sword technique that went beyond any existing art. Wolf's blood provided just that, and this ring further extends the effect.
entities.avail:
• Presented to the player by Hawkwood after defeating the Abyss Watchers. The player may have to travel to Firelink Shrine and then reload the area in order to activate Hawkwood's presence.
  • Dropped by Hawkwood if the player kills him at anytime throughout the course of the game after defeating the Abyss Watchers. This can be achieved either at Firelink Shrine or after defeating him in the Farron Keep.

entities.name: Fire Clutch Ring
entities.effect: • Increases fire attack by 15%. • Reduces damage absorption by 10.
entities.desc:
Ring depicting a hand grasping a red stone.
Increases fire attack, but compromises damage absorption.
An old fable in Londor claims that the lure of the clutch ring reaches out to the crestfallen, who might otherwise be overcome by despair
entities.avail: Found in the Undead Settlement, behind the guillotine near the building where Cornyx's cell is located and above the Cliff Underside bonfire.

entities.name: Flame Stoneplate Ring
entities.desc:
Stoneplates are symbols of true knights, and red stoneplates are granted to those who valiantly face Chaos.
Increases fire damage absorption.
entities.avail:
• Flame Stoneplate Ring
    • Found in the Undead Settlement, on a corpse hanging from the highest cliff and near the non-hostile Manservant. The body may fall down the cliff, forcing the player to traverse a big part of the level in order to retrieve it. If this happens, just closing and continuing the game will make it spawn lying below the tree and ready to be looted.
  • Flame Stoneplate Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in the Profaned Capital. From the Profaned Capital bonfire, climb down the ladder and exit through a hole on the wall. Proceed onward until reaching the toxic swamp and climb up the ladder on the right of the chapel's ruins. Drop down near the entrance of the room with the sleeping Monstrosity of Sin and onto a piece of roof visible below. The ring can then be looted from a body lying in a little alcove.
  • Flame Stoneplate Ring+2 (NG++)
    • Found in the Smouldering Lake. From the Demon Ruins bonfire, descend two sets of stairs to reach a big room with two Demon Clerics. Turn right and proceed straightforward into a passage at the end. Hit the carved wall at the very end of this passage to reveal a hidden room with a Black Knight slaying a Ghru. The ring can be found inside.
entities.notes: • Decreases its effectiveness the higher the player's Fire absorption becomes.

entities.name: Fleshbite Ring
entities.effect: Raises poison, bleed, frost and curse resistance by 40.
entities.desc:
One of the bite rings native to Carim.
Raises poison, bleed, frost and curse resist.
The crafting of these rings is forbidden,
perhaps owing to a fear of malleable stone.
Clerics, however, dabble freely in the art.
entities.avail:
• Fleshbite Ring
    • Found on the sixth floor of the Grand Archives, upstairs from the area guarded by four Archive Scholars. The ring is on a corpse on the right, at the end of a hallway filled with several Clawed Curses.
  • Fleshbite Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in the High Wall of Lothric, on a roof not far from the Tower on the Wall bonfire. Head out onto a large roof with a Pus of Man and approach the ladder at the other end. Jump on the half-gated roof in front and loot the corpse.
entities.notes: • The ring has no effect on Toxic resistance.

entities.name: Flynn's Ring
entities.effect: Lowering equip load increases attack power.
entities.desc:
Ring of Flynn, the eulogized thief.
Lowering equip load increases attack power.
Flynn fought with the wind on his side, and was a hero among the weak and poor, yet even his admirers knew that it was little more than an idyllic fable.
entities.avail: Found in the Undead Settlement. Jump off the lift that leads to the Road of Sacrifices while riding its upper part and onto a wooden scaffolding, then follow the only path available, fighting a Demon with Siegward along the way. The ring can be found on a corpse once reaching the rooftop of the next building.
entities.notes:
• Does not grant attack power after 30 equipment weight.
  • Provides a maximum attack power increase of 15%.
    • Attack power is boosted by roughly 0.5% per full point of weight under 30.
  • The ring only boosts physical damage.
    • This includes all forms of physical damage dealt by the wearer, regardless of the source. This means that items like the Kukri, and physical damage spells such as Wrath of the Gods and Boulder Heave, are also affected.
  • The ring's weight is applied before calculation, meaning it will detract slightly from the damage boost.

entities.name: Great Swamp Ring
entities.found: Road of Sacrifices (drop from Great Crab)
entities.desc:
Ring said to be chiseled from the bone of a flame salamander by blighted Pyromancers living in the Great Swamp.
Boosts pyromancies.
It is believed that salamanders are the descendants of demons, born of the Chaos Flame, from which Pyromancy is also said to have originated.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Pyromancer class.
  • Found in the Road of Sacrifices. Dropped by the Great Crab pacing around a patch of deep water near the fortress. That crab is near the tree with two corpses of supposed Pyromancers, as they have the Conjurator Set and Great Swamp Pyromancy Tome with them.

entities.name: Havel's Ring
entities.found: Transposed from the Soul of a Stray Demon.
entities.desc:
A ring for warriors keen on heavy accoutrements. Increases maximum equip load.
This ring was named after Havel the Rock, the battlefield compatriot of Gwyn, the First Lord.
The art of war has been a constant since ages past, and those who follow in Havel's footsteps are no fewer now than in his own day.
entities.avail:
• Havel's Ring
    • Obtained by transposing the Soul of a Stray Demon with Ludleth of Courland.
  • Havel's Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in Archdragon Peak, on a corpse lying immediately to the left after exiting the room where the big mob of Man Serpents were hiding, on the path that leads to the altar that bestows the Twinkling Dragon Torso Stone.
  • Havel's Ring+2 (NG++)
    • Found in Anor Londo, in the Prison Tower where Captain Yorshka resides. Drop down the tower and the ring will be on the third corpse, after the Painting Guardian's Curved Sword and the Painting Guardian Set.
  • Havel's Ring+3 (The Ringed City DLC).
    • After defeating Silver Knight Ledo, drop down from the stone path that led you to the broken tower. The ring is on a ledge after falling down a few times.

entities.name: Hawk Ring
entities.desc:
Ring associated with Hawkeye Gough, one of the Four Knights of Gwyn, the First Lord.
Extends the range of arrows.
In his later years, the giant Gough was blinded, but this did not prevent him from striking down a calamitous dragon with his Greatbow.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by the giant archer at the top of the highest tower in the Undead Settlement.
  • Alternatively, if the player collects all Young White Branches found in the Undead Settlement, the Cathedral of the Deep and the Farron Keep, the giant will die and the ring can then be looted from his body at the top of the aforementioned tower.

entities.name: Hornet Ring
entities.desc:
Ring associated with the Lord's Blade Ciaran, one of the Four Knights of Gwyn, the First Lord.
Boosts critical attacks.
The masked Ciaran was the only woman to serve in Gwyn's Four Knights, and her curved sword granted a swift death to any and all enemies of the throne.
entities.avail:
Found in the Untended Graves.

From the shrine's entrance, follow the path on the right. The ring can be found near the same grave where Hawkwood usually goes to pray in the Cemetery of Ash. It is guarded by a greataxe-wielding Black Knight and will appear only after the Abyss Watchers have been defeated.
entities.notes:
• Like its Dark Souls predecessor, equipping this ring causes the wearer to perform the Demon's Souls critical animations against human opponents, which causes the attacks to be reduced differently by their flat defenses.
  • Different animations will manipulate the foe's positioning differently. For example, a riposte while wearing the Hornet Ring will make the victim fall near the place where they got riposted. Meanwhile a backstab with the Hornet Ring will make the victim roll once after the backstab, causing them to fall further away. This makes fighting near cliffs a solid strategy for players who tend to go for backstabs.

entities.name: Horsehoof Ring
entities.effect: Enemies lose 30% more stamina when kicked.
entities.found: Firelink Shrine (sold or dropped by Patches)
entities.desc:
An old ring with a seal depicting a horse's hoof. Boosts kick effect.
Unbreakable Patches adored this ring and the feeling that it gave him when he kicked his marks into the depths of treacherous traps, but suffered no shortage of ridicule from his associates for relying so heavily on the tired old trick.
But who is the sorrier? The horse who knows only to kick, or the fool who approaches the old beast without thought?.
entities.avail:
Found in Firelink Shrine. Sold by Unbreakable Patches for 500 souls or dropped by him if killed.

For the ring to appear in Patches' inventory, Greirat must be present in Firelink Shrine at the same time as him. If Patches mentions Greirat when talked to, then the ring will be added to his selling wares.

entities.name: Hunter's Ring
entities.desc:
Ring engraved with a portrait of a hunter.
Increases dexterity.
The hunters serve Lothric on the fringes and in the shadows. For generations, rulers of Lothric have relied especially upon the Black Hand hunters to punish enemies in ways that the king's Three Pillars cannot.
entities.avail: Found in the Grand Archives, on a corpse lying at the top of the highest tower of the library's main dome, guarded by three Gertrude's Knights.

entities.name: Knight Slayer's Ring
entities.effect: Enemies lose 20% more stamina when guarding attacks.
entities.desc:
Ring of the savage Tsorig, more commonly known as the Knight Slayer.
Enemies lose more stamina when guarding attacks.
Long ago, Tsorig engaged the guardians of an ancient city in a bloody confrontation, and returned with their rings as his prize, still frozen on their dismembered fingers.
entities.avail:
Catacombs of Carthus

  • Dropped by dark spirit Knight Slayer Tsorig. From the Catacombs of Carthus bonfire, head downstairs and enter the first doorway on the right, where an Ember can be found at the end. Tsorig will invade as the player makes their way out.

Smouldering Lake

  • If the player did not defeat Tsorig in the catacombs, he will drop the ring in this location. He awaits hidden near the lowermost staircase of the level, which leads to a lava pool.

entities.name: Knight's Ring
entities.desc:
Ring engraved with a portrait of a knight.
Increases strength.
In Lothric, the Knight has long been considered one of the Three Pillars of the king's rule, and were thus allowed to rear dragons.
entities.avail:
Found in Lothric Castle.

From the Dragonslayer Armour bonfire head back toward the shortcut lift. Instead of riding it, climb the ladder found around the corner to reach the rooftops and make way to the right and into another room, then climb down the ladder in there. The ring can be found on a corpse at the bottom.

entities.name: Leo Ring
entities.effect: Strengthens thrust weapon counter attacks by 15%.
entities.desc:
Ring associated with Dragon Slayer Ornstein, one of the Four Knights of Gwyn, the First Lord.
Strengthens thrust weapon counter attacks.
Ornstein was the first knight of the sun's eldest born, and his cross spear is said to have pierced scales made of stone.
entities.avail: Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, in a chest on the second floor of the gallery guarded by three Silver Knights, after exiting the drainage ditch with several Sewer Centipedes.

entities.name: Life Ring
entities.found: • Burial gift • Firelink Shrine (sold by the Shrine Handmaid)
entities.desc:
A generations-old ring set with a small red jewel.
Raises maximum HP.
Rings have unique powers, and their discovery will do much to ease a wearisome journey.
entities.avail:
• Life Ring
    • Can be chosen as a burial gift at the beginning of the game.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 1,500 souls once she has been given the Dreamchaser's Ashes.
  • Life Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in the Undead Settlement, on the ledge where Siegward is met the second time after dropping off the upper part of the lift that leads to the Road of Sacrifices. It can be looted from a corpse lying on the second archway, to the right of Siegward.
  • Life Ring+2 (NG+)
    • Found in Lothric Castle. From the Dragon Barracks, cross the bridge and enter the building on the right. Climb up the ladder and exit through the archway on the left. Once outside, head around the corner to the right and from the spot with the corpse hanging on the ledge, drop down to another ledge with a corpse holding the ring.
  • Life Ring+3 (NG++)
    • Found in the Untended Graves, behind Prince Lothric's throne in the ruins of Firelink Shrine.

entities.name: Lightning Clutch Ring
entities.effect: • Increases lightning attack by 15%. • Reduces damage absorption by 10.
entities.desc:
Ring depicting a hand grasping a yellow stone.
Increases lightning attack, but compromises damage absorption.
An old fable in Londor claims that the lure of the clutch ring reaches out to the crestfallen, who might otherwise be overcome by despair.
entities.avail: Found in Archdragon Peak, on a corpse located in an alcove to the left of the gate that leads to the Ancient Wyvern boss battle and past a Man Serpent.

entities.name: Lingering Dragoncrest Ring
entities.effect: Extends length of spell effects by 30%.
entities.desc:
A special ring given to those who are deemed fit to undertake the journey of discovery in Vinheim, home of sorcery.
Extends length of spell effect.
Apropos to the Dragon School, the seal depicts an everlasting dragon. A lingering dragon symbolizes the true nature of the consummate sorcerer.
entities.avail:
• Lingering Dragoncrest Ring
    • Found in the Farron Keep, dropped by the Great Crab dwelling on the murky water to the left of the Keep Ruins bonfire and the main gate. If the player befriended the giant archer, he will lend a hand in defeating it in this place.
  • Lingering Dragoncrest Ring +1 (NG+)
    • Found in the Road of Sacrifices, on a corpse lying near the first Great Crab in the Crucifixion Woods.
  • Lingering Dragoncrest Ring +2 (NG++)
    • Found in the Grand Archives, on a corpse lying halfway up the tower with the three Gertrude's Knights at the library's main dome.
entities.notes:
• Does not affect the duration of effects granted by using skills.
  • The ring reduces the decay rate of the buff while it is worn. This means that the ring must be constantly equipped in order to benefit from the increased duration.

entities.name: Lloyd's Shield Ring
entities.effect: Boosts damage absorption by 25% when HP is full.
entities.found: Firelink Shrine (sold by the Shrine Handmaid)
entities.desc:
Ring given to knights of the Way of White. Depicts Allfather Lloyd's Shield of Caste.
Boosts damage absorption when HP is full.
Much time has passed since the worship of Lloyd was common in the Way of White. The clerics of Carim had always strongly asserted that Lloyd was a derivative fraud, and that the Allfather title was self-proclaimed.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 2,500 souls once she has been given the Paladin's Ashes.
entities.notes: • The ring's effect triggers about at 98% of the player's HP, allowing them to take some damage through a shield and still gain the damage absorption boost.

entities.name: Lloyd's Sword Ring
entities.effect: Boosts attack power by 12.5% when HP is full.
entities.desc:
Ring given to knights of the Way of White. Depicts Allfather Lloyd's Sword of Law.
Boosts attack power when HP is full.
Much time has passed since the worship of Lloyd was common in the Way of White. The clerics of Carim had always strongly asserted that Lloyd was a derivative fraud, and that the Allfather title was self-proclaimed.
entities.avail: Found on a corpse in the Cathedral of the Deep. The body can be found lying on the central wall of the "U"-shaped corridor on the second floor, where the first Giant Slave attacks.
entities.notes:
• The ring's effect triggers at about 98% of the player's HP, allowing them to take a small amount of damage and still gain the attack boost.
  • The ring does not affect the damage of consumable items, such as throwing knives and firebombs

entities.name: Magic Clutch Ring
entities.effect: • Increases magic attack by 15%. • Reduces damage absorption by 10.
entities.desc:
Ring depicting a hand grasping a blue stone.
Increases magic attack, but compromises damage absorption.
An old fable in Londor claims that the lure of the clutch ring reaches out to the crestfallen, who might otherwise be overcome by despair.
entities.avail:
Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

From Central Irithyll, proceed through the level until reaching a cathedral at the end of the main street. The ring can be uncovered behind an illusory wall located to the right of the altar holding the Ring of the Sun's First Born.

entities.name: Magic Stoneplate Ring
entities.found: Consumed King's Garden (dropped by a Consumed King's Knight)
entities.desc:
Stoneplates are symbols of true knights, and blue stoneplates are granted to royal palace guards.
Increases magic damage absorption.
entities.avail:
• Magic Stoneplate Ring
    • Found in the Consumed King's Garden. Guaranteed drop from the Consumed King's Knight guarding King Oceiros's lair.
  • Magic Stoneplate Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in Farron Keep. From the Farron Keep bonfire, head right to an area with deep water and several Basilisks. The ring is on a corpse lying behind a big tree on the left.
  • Magic Stoneplate Ring+2 (NG++)
    • Found in the Profaned Capital. From the Profaned Capital bonfire, climb down the interior ladder, exit through the hole on the wall and turn right. The ring will be toward the end of this path.

entities.name: Morne's Ring
entities.desc:
A malformed ring given to knights of Carim.
Boosts miracles.
Morne served the goddess Caitha and later became an apostle of the Archbishop. They labored together to provide comfort to the suffering.
entities.avail:
Found in the Road of Sacrifices.

From the Road of Sacrifices bonfire, drop from the ledge behind the first Corvian Storyteller. Continue onward until reaching a bridge with another Storyteller at the end and several Corvians scattered about.
