Drop by the right side before crossing and to a small ledge below, then follow the narrow path until reaching a cave guarded by two Festering Starved Hounds. The ring can be found on a corpse inside, along with another one that holds the Braille Divine Tome of Carim.
entities.notes:
• Does not boost miracles that provide buffs or healing.
  • Stacks with other miracle-boosting items such as the Ring of the Sun's First Born.

entities.name: Obscuring Ring
entities.effect: Hides the presence of the wearer when far away.
entities.found: Cathedral of the Deep - gift from Rosaria
entities.desc:
Ring bestowed upon the Fingers of Rosaria, invaders who seek tongues for their goddess.
Hides the presence of the wearer when far away.
It is said that Rosaria, the mother of rebirth, was robbed of her tongue by her firstborn, and has been waiting for their return ever since.
entities.avail: Obtained by reaching Rank 1 in the Rosaria's Fingers covenant by offering 10 Pale Tongues.
entities.notes:
• There is no visual cue that informs the wearer of this ring having taken effect.
  • Only works against human players. AI-controlled enemies will still detect the player normally.

entities.name: Poisonbite Ring
entities.desc:
One of the bite rings native to Carim.
Increases poison resistance.
The crafting of these rings is forbidden, perhaps owing to a fear of malleable stone.
Clerics, however, dabble freely in the art.
entities.avail:
• Poisonbite Ring
    • Found in the Cathedral of the Deep. From the Cleansing Chapel, head in the graveyard's direction but deviate through a narrow path on the right. Make way around a small waterway with three Corpse Grubs until reaching a sleeping Ravenous Crystal Lizard. Enter the narrow passage on its right to find another Corpse Grub guarding the ring.
  • Poisonbite Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in the Undead Settlement. From the Dilapidated Bridge, head through the cemetery until reaching the house at the far end, then head to the left and uphill until reaching the smaller house with the Cleric Set. The ring can be found on a corpse lying behind the well on the left.
entities.notes: • This ring does not increase Toxic resistance.

entities.name: Pontiff's Left Eye
entities.found: Transposed from the Soul of Boreal Valley Vordt.
entities.desc:
Bewitched ring that Pontiff Sulyvahn bestowed upon his knights.
Recovers HP with successive attacks.
Knights who peer into the black orb are lured into battles of death, transformed into frenzied beasts. No wonder the Pontiff only provides these rings to those dispatched to foreign lands.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Boreal Valley Vordt with Ludleth of Courland.
entities.notes: • The healing effect does not occur only with successive attacks; instead, each weapon type has a determined quota that must be satisfied in order for the ring to start healing the player.

entities.name: Pontiff's Right Eye
entities.effect: Boosts attacks to a maximum of +10%, as long as attacking persists.
entities.desc:
Bewitched ring that Pontiff Sulyvahn bestowed upon his knights.
Boosts attacks, as long as attacking persists.
Knights who peer into the black orb are lured into battles of death, transformed into frenzied beasts. No wonder the Pontiff only provides these rings to those dispatched to foreign lands.
entities.avail: Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley. Guaranteed drop from the Sulyvahn's Beast that ambushes on the bridge to Central Irithyll.

entities.name: Priestess Ring
entities.found: Dark Firelink Shrine (sold by the Shrine Handmaid)
entities.desc:
A ring engraved with a portrait of the High Priestess.
Increases faith.
In Lothric, the High Priestess has long been considered one of the Three Pillars of the king's rule. The High Priestess also served as the prince's wet nurse.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid in Dark Firelink Shrine for 1,000 souls.
    • Dropped by the Shrine Handmaid if she is killed in Dark Firelink Shrine.

entities.name: Prisoner's Chain
entities.effect: Gain vigor, endurance, and vitality by 5, but take 4% extra damage.
entities.found: Transpose the Soul of Champion Gundyr.
entities.desc:
Portion of a steel chain used to restrain Gundyr. Gain vigor, endurance, and vitality, but take extra damage.
A prisoner is one who has staked everything on a belief, a proclivity most apparent in the greatest of champions.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Champion Gundyr with Ludleth of Courland.
entities.notes: • Prior to the App 1.13 Regulation 1.33 patch, the Prisoner's Chain would reduce absorption by 10%, rather than 4%.

entities.name: Red Tearstone Ring
entities.effect: Temporarily boosts attack by 20% when HP is below 20%.
entities.desc:
A ring set with a large rare tearstone jewel.
Temporarily boosts attack when HP is low.
This stone is said to be a tear of mourning of the goddess Caitha, and of course, tears are always more beautiful near death.
entities.avail: Found in Lothric Castle, just before the Dragonslayer Armour. From the Dragon Barracks, head across the bridge and through the entrance of the castle, heading upstairs and to the left. Continue forward and outside, where an entrance to the right should be followed, into a small chapel with the shortcut lift to the Grand Archives. Head to the left and outside onto a balcony where a corpse can be found holding the ring.

entities.name: Reversal Ring
entities.effect: Causes males to perform female actions, and vice-versa.
entities.desc:
A divine ring granted to the Darkmoon Gwyndolin in his youth.
Causes males to perform female actions, and vice-versa.
Gwyndolin was raised like a daughter through the aura of the moon, and was said to behave like a sullen brooding goddess.
entities.avail: Found at the very end of Irithyll of the Boreal Valley in the Darkmoon Tomb, to the right of Gwyn's coffin. The area is concealed behind an illusory statue of Lord Gwyn. If Yuria's questline has progressed far enough, the tomb will already be open.

entities.name: Ring of Favor
entities.effect: Increases max HP by 3%, stamina by 9%, and maximum equip load by 5%.
entities.desc:
A ring symbolizing the favor of the Goddess Fina, whose "fateful beauty" is mentioned in legend.
True to the fickle nature of Fina's favor, her ring increases max HP, stamina, and maximum equip load.
entities.avail:
• Ring of Favor
    • Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley. Dropped by one of the two Sulyvahn's Beasts lurking in the Water Reserve.
  • Ring of Favor+1 (NG+)
    • Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, along the rafters above Pontiff Sulyvahn's boss room.
  • Ring of Favor+2 (NG++)
    • Found in the Cathedral of the Deep. On the rooftops leading to the rafters, the ring can be found in an alcove to the left, guarded by a Large Devout of the Deep.
  • Ring of Favor+3
    • Found in The Dreg Heap. In the swamp past the Earthen Peak Ruins bonfire. Located up a large root straight ahead from where you enter the swamp.

entities.name: Ring of Sacrifice
entities.effect: Wearer will lose no souls upon death, but the ring itself breaks afterward.
entities.desc:
This mystical ring was created in a sacrificial rite of Velka, the Goddess of Sin.
Its wearer will lose nothing upon death, but the ring itself breaks.
A sacrifice is only worth as much as the life it spares.
entities.avail:
• Firelink Shrine
    • One can be obtained by trading Loretta's Bone with Pickle Pee (only once per playthrough).
    • Three are sold by Yuria of Londor for 5,000 souls each.
    • Any rings that weren't bought from Yuria before her death will be sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 5,000 souls each once she is given Yuria's Ashes.
  • High Wall of Lothric
    • One is found on a corpse past the Tower on the Wall bonfire, near the Winged Knight. You have to mount the small, flat-topped building (reached by a set of stairs on the right, past the courtyard with the knight, then turning right again and up another set of stairs to reach the rooftop) and jump to an awning which holds the corpse and the ring.
  • Road of Sacrifices
    • One is found on a corpse halfway down a series of ledges on the side of the building to the left of the Exile Watchdogs
  • Irithyll of the Boreal Valley
    • One is found below the quay, on the rightmost corner of the lake surrounding the city, between the Church of Yorshka and the Distant Manor.
  • Consumed King's Garden
    • One is found on a corpse tucked in the corner to the right immediately upon exiting the building containing the main elevator.
entities.notes:
• The Ring of Sacrifice is removed from the player's inventory after being used for revival.
  • The Host of Embers status is lost after revival.
  • Dying as a phantom with the ring equipped will activate it, providing no benefit but still breaking it. As such, one should make sure to swap to other rings whenever summoned.
  • Existing bloodstains will remain intact if the player dies while wearing the Ring of Sacrifice.

entities.name: Ring of Steel Protection
entities.page: Ring of Steel Protection (Dark Souls III)
entities.desc:
Ring of the Knight King of ancient legend. Increases physical damage absorption.
The Knight King was said to be lined with steel on the inside, such that even the talons of mighty dragons did him little harm.
entities.avail:
• Ring of Steel Protection
    • Found in Archdragon Peak, at the ruins where the Ancient Wyvern initially appears. Complete the boss fight and return to the initial area beyond the main gate. At the main fork in front of the bell, turn right into an area with three lootable corpses and approach the ledge on the right. Walk around the railing and onto a narrow path that leads to a corpse holding the ring.
  • Ring of Steel Protection +1 (NG+)
    • Found in the Untended Graves, on a corpse lying to the right of the tower behind the shrine.
  • Ring of Steel Protection +2 (NG++)
    • Found in the Catacombs of Carthus, on top of a small pillar below the left side of the first stone bridge.
  • Ring of Steel Protection +3
    • Found in The Dreg Heap. After falling into the ruins of the Grand Archives and encountering the first Angel, the ring can be found at the end of a wooden scaffolding that is guarded by the Angel. Killing the Pilgrim Pupa and then doubling back will allow it to be picked up safely.

entities.name: Ring of the Evil Eye
entities.page: Ring of the Evil Eye (Dark Souls III)
entities.effect: Absorb 30 HP from each defeated foe.
entities.desc:
This ring captured the foul spirit of an evil eye, a creature that ravaged Astora.
Absorb HP from each defeated foe.
The horrid spirit nearly destroyed Astora, but was eventually defeated by "the sword of one most noble."
entities.avail:
• Ring of the Evil Eye
    • Given by Anri of Astora within the Catacombs of Carthus, if the player tells them the whereabouts of Horace the Hushed.
    • Alternatively, Anri will give the ring to the player in the Church of Yorshka if they are not told of Horace's location.
  • Ring of the Evil Eye+1 (NG+)
    • Found in the Cathedral of the Deep behind the giant concealed statue, right before the Deacons of the Deep.
  • Ring of the Evil Eye+2 (NG++)
    • Found in the High Wall of Lothric, in a corner behind some barrels in the room where the Cell Key and the first Estus Shard are found.
  • Ring of the Evil Eye+3 (The Ringed City)
    • Guaranteed drop from a Mimic found within the Shared Grave area, at the bottom of the stairwell where the Moaning Knight is fought.

entities.name: Ring of the Sun's First Born
entities.page: Ring of the Sun's First Born
entities.desc:
Ring of the Sun's first born, who inherited the light of Gwyn, the first lord.
Greatly boosts miracles.
The Sun's first born was once a god of war, until he was stripped of his stature as punishment for his foolishness. No wonder his very name has slipped from the annals of history.
entities.avail:
Found at Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

From the Pontiff Sulyvahn bonfire, head back out toward the railing and fall straight onto the altar below.
entities.notes:
• Does not boost miracles that provide buffs or healing.
  • Stacks with other miracle-boosting items such as the Crown of Dusk and Morne's Ring.

entities.name: Sage Ring
entities.effect: Shortens spell casting time by increasing virtual Dexterity by 30.
entities.desc:
A ring given to Farron's Undead Legion by one of the preacher twins, known more commonly as the Crystal Sages.
Shortens spell casting time.
The sorcerers of Farron's Abyss Watchers were known to be lonesome warriors who would only rely upon more pragmatic spells.
entities.avail:
• Sage Ring
    • Found in the Road of Sacrifices, in a secluded room guarded by a Lycanthrope to the left of the staircase that gives access to the right entrance of the keep. The room can also be entered by a hole on the floor located between the first and second pillars to the right after entering the final area before the Crystal Sage.
  • Sage Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in the Grand Archives, on a corpse lying along the rafters after dropping down from Gertrude's bird cage, on the east-southern corner.
  • Sage Ring+2 (NG++)
    • Found in the Consumed King's Garden. While riding the lift into the garden, jump off midway onto the platform leading to the Estus Shard. The ring will be on a part of the broken stairs opposite the shard that must be jumped to.

entities.name: Saint's Ring
entities.desc:
A ring bestowed upon a Carim Saint.
Allows attunement of additional spells.
In Carim, the saints give voice to the ancient tales. They memorize countless cumbersome sacred books and read them in sonorous tones, a function for which they are widely renowned.
entities.avail:
Firelink Shrine

  • Sold by Irina of Carim for 300 souls.
entities.notes: • If the player has attuned spells to every available slot while the ring is equipped, and attempts to remove the ring after, a warning will appear that they will lose an attuned spell by doing so. Confirming the action will remove the spell occupying the final Attunement slot.

entities.name: Scholar Ring
entities.desc:
Ring engraved with a portrait of a scholar.
Increases intelligence.
In Lothric, the Scholar has long been considered one of the Three Pillars of the king's rule, and is therefore master of the Grand Archives.
entities.avail:
Found in the Grand Archives.

Pull the lever found to the right of the wooden bridge on the third floor of the library, facing the bridge from the red-eyed Lothric Knight. A pair of bookshelves will move out of the way, giving access to a corpse sitting on a chair holding the ring.

entities.name: Silvercat Ring
entities.desc:
Silver ring depicting a leaping feline.
Prevents damage from falling.
In the Age of Gods, or possibly just following it, an old cat was said to speak a human tongue, with the voice of an old woman, and the form of a fanciful immortal.
entities.avail:
Obtained as a gift from Sirris in Firelink Shrine after helping her defeat Creighton in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

To perform this task, the player must look for Sirris's summon sign near the first half of the bridge that connects the Irithyll of the Boreal Valley bonfire to Central Irithyll and answer her call. If successful, the next time they visit Firelink Shrine, she will greet and thank them for their help, bestowing the ring as a reward.
entities.notes: • Joining Rosaria's Fingers anytime before completing the first phase of Sirris's questline will deprive the player from obtaining the ring in that playthrough, as Sirris will only appear one more time to say goodbye and then disappear from the game.

entities.name: Skull Ring
entities.effect: Wearer is easier to be detected by enemies.
entities.desc:
One of Courland's transposed wonders. Derived from the soul of a Soulfeeder.
Easier to be detected by enemies.
The Soulfeeder was a beast that insatiably absorbed souls to feed its own power. Even after its accursed corpse was burned, it is said that the pungent stench of souls left the air permanently stained.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by Ludleth of Courland in Firelink Shrine.
  • If the player has placed all four cinders on their respective thrones, Ludleth will die in the following cutscene and the ring can then be retrieved from his throne.

entities.name: Slumbering Dragoncrest Ring
entities.effect: Silences all sounds made by its wearer.
entities.desc:
Ring of a clandestine guild of sorcerers based in Vinheim, home of sorcery.
Masks the sound of its wearer.
The Dragon School held effective sovereignty over Vinheim, with a great many adept assassins at its disposal.
entities.avail:
Gift from Orbeck of Vinheim after purchasing the following sorceries:

  • Aural Decoy (2,000 souls)
  • Farron Flashsword (3,000 souls)
  • Pestilent Mist (1,000 souls)
  • Spook (2,000 souls)
entities.notes:
• After the player has purchased the required sorceries, choosing the "Talk" option will yield the ring along with the "Silent Ally" gesture.
    • If the player has not yet satisfied the requirements to obtain the Young Dragon Ring, they will receive it at that moment instead. Selecting the "Talk" option a second time will yield the Slumbering Dragoncrest Ring along with the gesture.
  • A glitch may occur where enemies will still be able to detect the player's presence from behind even when the ring is equipped. Exiting and continuing the game usually fixes this.

entities.name: Speckled Stoneplate Ring
entities.effect: Increases magic, fire, lightning, and dark damage absorption by 5%.
entities.desc:
Stoneplates are symbols of true knights, and speckled stoneplates are granted to those who face an endless journey.
Slightly increases magic, fire, lightning, and dark damage absorption.
entities.avail:
• Speckled Stoneplate Ring
    • Found in the Smouldering Lake, behind a brick wall. The wall is located on the far-left side of the initial cavern (if looking toward the ballista and opposite to the Old Demon King boss room) and can only be destroyed by making one of the arrows to hit it.
  • Speckled Stoneplate Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in the Cemetery of Ash, on a corpse near the Ravenous Crystal Lizard.

entities.name: Sun Princess Ring
entities.desc:
Ring associated with Gwynevere, princess of sunlight and eldest daughter of Gwyn, the First Lord.
The ring is vaguely warm, like a beam of sunlight, and gradually restores HP.
Gwynevere left her home with a great many other deities, and became a wife and a mother, raising several heavenly children.
entities.avail: Found in Anor Londo. From the Aldrich, Devourer of Gods bonfire, ride up any of the two elevators and enter the Chamber of the Princess to find the ring.
entities.notes: • Stacks with other spells and items that restore health over time, such as Replenishment and the Ethereal Oak Shield.

entities.name: Thunder Stoneplate Ring
entities.desc:
Stoneplates are symbols of true knights, and yellow stoneplates are granted to those who would become dragons.
Increases lightning damage absorption.
entities.avail:
• Thunder Stoneplate Ring
    • Found in Archdragon Peak. From the Dragon-Kin Mausoleum, proceed onward through the level along an open side path guarded by several Man Serpents. Once at the other end, look for a wooden scaffolding with another Man Serpent below and drop to it. Climb up the ladder around the corner to find the ring at the top.
  • Thunder Stoneplate Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in the Catacombs of Carthus, in the same alley filled with urns where the Carthus Milkring is found.
  • Thunder Stoneplate Ring+2 (NG++)
    • Found in Lothric Castle. From the Dragonslayer Armour bonfire, backtrack and head left into a room with the shortcut lift for the Grand Archives. Exit through an archway on the left to reach a balcony with the Red Tearstone Ring. Look for a crumbled part on the railing of this balcony and drop down to the roof below. The ring can be found on the right, at the far end of this roof.

entities.name: Untrue Dark Ring
entities.desc:
One of the illusory rings worn by the Hollows of Londor.
Retain human appearance while Hollow.
The Hollows of Londor are wretchedly aged, fraught with deceit, and dubiously secretive. It is no wonder that they are deeply detested.
entities.avail:
Sold by Yuria of Londor for 5,000 souls.

Sold by the Shrine Handmaid if given Yuria's Ashes and the ring was not bought previously.

entities.name: Untrue White Ring
entities.effect: Take the appearance of a phantom.
entities.found: Firelink Shrine (sold by Yuria of Londor)
entities.desc:
One of the illusory rings worn by the Hollows of Londor.
Take the appearance of a phantom.
The Hollows of Londor are wretchedly aged, fraught with deceit, and dubiously secretive.
It is no wonder that they are deeply detested.
entities.avail: Sold by Yuria of Londor for 5,000 souls.
entities.notes: • Will hide the Hollowing status of the wearer, alongside giving them the white phantom aura.

entities.name: Witch's Ring
entities.desc:
The Witch of Izalith and her daughters, scorched by the Flame of Chaos, taught humans the art of pyromancy and offered them this ring.
Greatly boosts pyromancies.
Every pyromancer is familiar with the parable that tells of the witches espousing the need to fear the flame, and teaching the art of pyromancy to men in hopes that they might learn to control it.
entities.avail: Found in the Catacombs of Carthus just before reaching the Abandoned Tomb, on a corpse lying at the end of a small corridor past the area with the Demon and several Skeletons. The body holds both the ring and the Old Sage's Blindfold.

entities.name: Wolf Ring
entities.desc:
Ring associated with Abysswalker Artorias, one of the Four Knights of Gwyn, the First Lord.
Increase Poise.
Artorias had an unbendable will of steel, and was unmatched with a greatsword.
entities.avail:
• Wolf Ring
    • Awarded to the player for reaching Rank 2 in the Watchdogs of Farron. Achieving this rank requires offering 30 Wolf's Blood Swordgrass to the Old Wolf of Farron.
  • Wolf Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in Farron Keep, hidden behind a wall around the Keep Ruins bonfire.
  • Wolf Ring+2 (NG++)
    • Found in the Cemetery of Ash, on a corpse lying immediately to the left after opening the door from the Iudex Gundyr bonfire.
  • Wolf Ring+3
    • Found in The Ringed City. After reaching the great stairway that leads down to the Ringed City Streets, cross over the first bridge that overlooks the stairway. After defeating a sword-wielding Ringed Knight and continuing on the path, the Seeker of the Spurned will invade. Defeat him and he will drop the ring.

entities.name: Wood Grain Ring
entities.found: Firelink Shrine (sold by the Shrine Handmaid)
entities.desc:
This special ring crafted in an Eastern land is made of metal, but with a wood grain crest on its surface. Slows equipment degradation.
Wielders of swords originating in the same region follow a practice of inscribing special words on the blades of their swords, and are naturally drawn to this ring.
entities.avail:
• Wood Grain Ring
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 3,000 souls once she has been given the Easterner's Ashes.
  • Wood Grain Ring+1 (NG+)
    • Found in the Consumed King's Garden. When taking the lift to enter the garden, the ring is on a corpse lying behind the lift at the bottom.
  • Wood Grain Ring+2 (NG++)
    • Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley. From the Distant Manor, head back into the drainage ditch and into the gallery guarded by three Silver Knights. The ring can be found on a corpse lying to the right after exiting the gallery.
entities.notes: • Degradation reduction only affects durability damage incurred by being damaged by attacks (in the case of armor) and by attacking entities (in the case of weapons). This means that it is incapable of reducing degradation from Acid Surge.

entities.name: Young Dragon Ring
entities.desc:
Ring given in Vinheim, home of sorcery, when newly ordained as a sorcerer.
Boosts sorceries.
Apropos to the Dragon School, the seal depicts an everlasting dragon. A young dragon presages the great length of the journey to mastery.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Sorcerer class.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Gift from Orbeck of Vinheim after meeting the following criteria:
      1. Play any class other than a Sorcerer.
      2. Purchase at least four sorceries from him.
      3. Give him at least one scroll.
entities.notes: • In order to obtain the Master of Rings achievement/trophy with the Sorcerer as the starting class, this ring needs to be dropped on the ground and picked back up again.

entities.name: Alva Set
entities.desc:
Protection of Alva, seeker of the spurned. This steel body armor was trimmed to reduce weight.
To this day, troubadours sing of tales of the wandering knight Alva and his travels, and of his involvement with the saint and the witch. Needless to say, the songs traditionally end in tragedy.
entities.avail: The entire set is found on a corpse near Karla's cell in Irithyll Dungeon, on the lowest level guarded by numerous Jailers. The set will only appear once Alva, Seeker of the Spurned has been defeated in the area between the Distant Manor and Irithyll Dungeon bonfires.

entities.name: Antiquated Plain Set
entities.desc:
Ordinary garb from an ancient land of sorcery. The gold embellishments betray a faint residue of magic, but this clothing was never intended for battle.
When a mission visited the Ringed City long ago, one of its younger missionaries elected to stay behind. It was he who became the last recorded Spear of the Church.
entities.avail:
• The Loincloth is found in The Dreg Heap, within Earthen Peak's swamp guarded by Poisonhorn Bugs and an Angel.
  • The garb and gloves are found within the Ringed City, on a corpse in front of the altar before fighting Darkeater Midir.

entities.name: Antiquated Set
entities.desc:
Dress sewn in long-lost fashion.
The elaborately embroidered, ivory-colored silk is imbued with ancient magic power.
No protection is offered by this garment, as it was never intended for battle.
entities.avail:
The Crown of Dusk is found near the Keep Ruins bonfire under the white birch in the Farron Keep's poisonous swamp, guarded by a Great Crab.

The dress, gloves, and skirt are located near the Golden Scroll found in a cave to the right of the initial bonfire, guarded by several Basilisks.

entities.name: Archdeacon Set
entities.desc:
White crown/Holy garb/Skirt worn by an Archdeacon of the Cathedral of the Deep.
(Crown) Presented solely to delegates of the gods.
Of the three Archdeacons of the Deep, one cast off his white crown and left the cathedral to stand by Aldrich.
(Garb) A sign of the Way of White's highest rank.
Of the three Archdeacons of the Deep, one stood over Aldrich's casket, with hope that he would return one day.
(Skirt) Worn underneath holy garb.
Of the three Archdeacons of the Deep, one attended to Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth, whom he deemed a goddess.
entities.avail: Found in the Cathedral of the Deep, on Archdeacon Royce's corpse. The body will appear after defeating the Deacons of the Deep and resting at the bonfire.

entities.name: Assassin's Set
entities.desc:
Soft leather armor worn by assassins who lurk in the shadows.
The thick leather offers reasonable absorption without creating any undesired noise. A well-crafted piece of protection.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Assassin class.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for a total of 6,000 souls once he has returned from his first scavenge expedition in the Undead Settlement.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Greirat's Ashes.

entities.name: Black Hand Set
entities.desc:
Attire of hunters known as the King's Black Hands.
A black cape covers leather armor, shrouding the wearer in darkness.
Black Hand was a title established to honor hunters who served successive kings.
To date, no more than three such individuals have borne this distinction.
entities.avail:
The hat and armor are sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 7,500 souls after defeating Black Hand Kamui in the Grand Archives.

The gloves and trousers are sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for a total of 3,000 souls after he returns from pillaging the Undead Settlement. The Shrine Handmaid will also sell them at this price should she be given Greirat's Ashes.

entities.name: Black Iron Set
entities.desc:
Chest piece made of black iron, from the set of armor for which Knightslayer Tsorig was infamously known.
Offers extensive and particularly effective protection from fire.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 21,500 souls after defeating Knight Slayer Tsorig in the Smouldering Lake.

entities.name: Black Knight Set
entities.desc:
Armor of the Black Knights who roam the lands.
The Knights served the First Lord Gwyn, and followed him into the flame upon its linking. They became ash, but still wander the realms to this day.
entities.avail: Dropped by Black Knights in Road of Sacrifices, Smouldering Lake and Untended Graves.

entities.name: Black Leather Set
entities.desc:
Black dyed leather armor. Enables its wearer to hide in the shadows with silent finesse.
The wearer of this fine attire was admired by friends and enemies alike, for his skills were unmatched, and his heart was true as gold. As their new owner, you have quite the shoes to fill.
entities.avail:
• The head piece is sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 400 souls. If given Greirat's Ashes, the Shrine Handmaid will sell it in his place.
  • The chest, hands and legs pieces are sold by Unbreakable Patches for a total of 6,500 souls. If given Patches' Ashes, the Shrine Handmaid will sell them in his place.

entities.name: Black Set
entities.desc:
Attire of the three mentors of the Sable Church of Londor.
These maidens of a Primordial Serpent were renowned as founders of the Sable Church, which offered salvation for Hollows.
It is apparent that the women in black were highly skilled fencers, capable of founding the Sable Church between just the three of them.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 18,000 souls upon Yuria of Londor's death.
  • Alternatively, the whole set can be found, along with Darkdrift, at Yuria's location in Firelink Shrine if she was summoned for and survived the fight against Soul of Cinder.

entities.name: Black Witch Set
entities.desc:
The purple garb of the witch Zullie, who intended to seduce Alva the Wayfarer, but eventually became his closest supporter, spending her entire life with him.
It is said that Zullie the witch, who was never loved, nor loved another, experienced all manner of misfortune, and yet in the end, found her purpose in life.
entities.avail:
• Armor set with the hat: found on a corpse behind where the dark spirit Alva, Seeker of the Spurned invades in the Ringed City.
  • Veil: found in the Ringed City Streets area, guarded by a Ringed Knight near the sunken church.
  • Blindfold Mask: Dropped by the Moaning Knight who invades in the Shared Grave area after first encountering Darkeater Midir.

entities.name: Brass Set
entities.desc:
Armor of a knight once known as the Darkmoon. It is said this brass armor hides something hideous within.
Something about its silhouette suggests femininity.
entities.avail: Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, on a corpse within Lord Gwyn's honorary tomb before reaching Anor Londo.

entities.name: Brigand Set
entities.desc:
Armor from a foreign land.
Probably belonged to a brigand who met his match.
In foreign lands, undead were banished to send a message to populace, and when the message was not heard, they banished the living, too.
entities.avail:
Found in the Road of Sacrifices.

From the Road of Sacrifices bonfire, follow the path toward a stone bridge and from there head to the left and down a narrow path guarded by the madwoman, which leads into a cave where the set is found.

entities.name: Catarina Set
entities.desc:
Distinctively shaped armor worn by the Knights of Catarina.
Often ridiculed for its onion-like shape, infuriating the country's proud knights, but the masterfully forged curved design makes it very effective for deflecting blows.
entities.avail:
Only one set is available per playthrough.

  • Siegward of Catarina
    • Dropped by Siegward upon his death by any cause.
    • Found in Yhorm the Giant's arena upon the completion of Siegward's questline.
  • Unbreakable Patches, after he has stolen the armor from Siegward
    • Purchased from Patches for a total of 15,000 souls. He will sell the set once he is met as a merchant and the double doors on the second level of the Cathedral of the Deep (past the elevator near the Deacons of the Deep) have been opened.
    • Dropped by Patches upon death, if it has not been purchased from him.

entities.name: Cathedral Knight Set
entities.desc:
Massive iron armor worn by knights serving the Cathedral of the Deep.
Repulsive creatures of the deep are sure to attract the foolish, but the cathedral knights are prepared to meet such intruders head on with their more than ample might.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by Cathedral Knights in Cathedral of the Deep.
  • Dropped by Consumed King's Knights in Consumed King's Garden.

entities.name: Chain Set
entities.desc:
Armor of thin interlinking rings of steel.
Popular due to its ease of crafting, respectable damage absorption, and light weight.
Knights may favor imposing armor, but for warriors on the battlefield, that which keep them alive is armor enough.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 2,300 souls.

entities.name: Cleric Set
entities.desc:
Garb worn by a cleric turned undead.
Unmistakable vibrant blue robes.
It is said that they were entrusted with a duty, still its nature is yet to be revealed.
They bore large covers on their backs to ensure they would not become seedbeds for spreading darkness.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment of the Cleric class, excluding the hat.
  • Found in the Undead Settlement. From the Dilapidated Bridge bonfire, head towards the cemetery, then turn left and double back. The set will be on a corpse near a house guarded by a single Thrall.

entities.name: Conjurator Set
entities.desc:
Attire of traveling conjurators.
Conjurators were the predecessors to pyromancers, and spent their lives roaming the lands. No wonder their attire was designed to protect them from fire, poison, and other threats of nature.
entities.avail: Found on a corpse near the Great Swamp Pyromancy Tome on the Road of Sacrifices, between a large tree and a wall near the Crucifixion Woods bonfire.

entities.name: Cornyx's Set
entities.desc:
Attire of Cornyx, pyromancer of the Great Swamp.
In the Great Swamp, it was customary to adorn oneself with articles of nature. Cornyx favored the use of raven feathers.
Ravens are said to have once been Firelink messengers, guiding the undead to the land of ancient gods.
entities.avail:
• The head piece is in the Catacombs of Carthus, on the path between the cut bridge and Smouldering Lake. After defeating or running past the Demon, the player can go into the small hallway to find a corpse at the end holding the blindfold along with the Witch's Ring.
  • The chest, arm, and leg pieces are all dropped by Cornyx of the Great Swamp upon death, or found near his cage in the Undead Settlement if the player defeats the Old Demon King with the aid of the Great Swamp Cuculus. Cuculus must survive the fight in order for the set to appear.

entities.name: Court Sorcerer Set
entities.desc:
Robe worn by court sorcerers of the Profaned Capital.
The formal gold stitching suggests they may have also been oracles.
There are many sorcerers who claim heirship to the great sage "Big Hat" Logan, and the Profaned Capital houses one of two leading schools.
entities.avail:
Found in the Profaned Capital.

In the toxic swamp area, climb up the ladder and into the building. The set is located on a corpse next to the central pillar, guarded by a Monstrosity of Sin and Mimic.

entities.name: Dancer's Set
entities.desc:
Armor worn by the Dancer of the Boreal Valley.
The black eyes of the Pontiff eventually transformed the Dancer into a beastly creature, her armor fusing with her own hide.
entities.avail: Purchased from the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 31,000 souls after defeating the Dancer of the Boreal Valley.

entities.name: Dark Set
entities.desc:
Armor of the Darkwraiths, relics of a small country that fell to the dark long ago.
Looks as if it may crumble to dust at any moment.
The Darkwraiths were the oldest of the Red Eye Invaders, and rumored to have served a Primordial Serpent.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Darkwraiths in High Wall of Lothric and Farron Keep.

entities.name: Deacon Set
entities.desc:
Robe worn by deacons of the Cathedral of the Deep.
The deep red pigment denotes the blessing of fire.
In time, those dedicated to sealing away the horrors of the Deep succumbed to their very power. It seems that neither tending to the flame, nor the faith, could save them.
entities.avail: Dropped by Deacons in the Cathedral of the Deep, Irithyll of the Boreal Valley and Anor Londo.

entities.name: Desert Pyromancer Set
entities.desc:
Garb of the desert pyromancers, who once walked the halls of the Earthen Peak. It is said that the thin, burgundy cloth breathes with magic.
Desert pyromancers, most of them female, were known for their great fans of flame, and enchanting looks.
But what is enchanting can also be deadly, especially when clothed in such alluring garb.
entities.avail:
The pieces are found scattered all throughout the Earthen peak section of The Dreg Heap:

  • The Garb is found shortly after the Earthen Peak Ruins bonfire, to the left of the initial area guarded by the second Angel. It is on the opposite side of a ruined house, guarded by two Thralls.
  • The Gloves are located on the right-hand side of the Poison swamp area, on a stone ramp that is within the third Angel's patrol area.
  • The Skirt is located next to the Gloves, within the swamp itself and guarded by several Poisonhorn Bugs.
  • The Hood is found at the very top of the area, on the cliffside where Desert Pyromancer Zoey is fought and before traversing the tree branches.

entities.name: Deserter Set
entities.desc:
Common soldier's armor.
Its insignia is worn beyond recognition.
This musty, rusted hunk of metal befits one reduced to thievery.
entities.avail:
• The Deserter Armor and Deserter Trousers are the starting equipment of the Thief class.
  • Dropped by Hollow Soldiers.

entities.name: Dragonscale Set
entities.desc:
Armor of a nameless king who was ally to the ancient dragons.
The golden crown, buried amidst long strands of bristling ash, is said to closely resemble that of the First Lord.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 36,000 souls after The Nameless King is defeated.

entities.name: Dragonslayer Set
entities.desc:
Golden lion armor associated with Dragonslayer Ornstein, from the age of gods, and imbued with the strength of lightning.
In the dragonless age, this knight, who long guarded the ruined cathedral, left the land in search of the nameless king.
entities.avail: Found on the far side of the courtyard below The Nameless King's arena, after defeating the Nameless King.

entities.name: Drakeblood Set
entities.desc:
Armor of the Drakeblood Knights, worshippers of the blood of dragons. The red cloth is said to symbolize their yearning for blood.
Dragon worship has captured the hearts and minds of warriors across the lands for many ages. Perhaps such warriors are attracted to doctrines of few words.
entities.avail: Found in the Consumed King's Garden, on the corpse that teaches the Path of the Dragon gesture. For it to appear, the player must first defeat at least one Drakeblood Knight at Archdragon Peak.

entities.name: Drang Set
entities.desc:
Armor of the Drang Knights, proclaimed descendants of the land known for the legend of the Linking of the Fire.
Fine protection that is both light and strong, having been reinforced with rare geisteel.
The Drang knights were once feared sellswords, until treason meant descending into the abyss, and they were separated forever.
entities.avail: Found in the Cathedral of the Deep, in the murky waters near the staircase that leads to the Deacons of the Deep. It is guarded by a Giant Slave, several Writhing Rotten Flesh and a Man-grub.

entities.name: Eastern Armor Set
entities.desc:
Distinctive armor made in an Eastern land.
The exquisite craftsmanship and artistic design made these prized pieces in the collection of any nobleman.
Offers excellent damage absorption, particularly from slashing attacks from katanas, which are commonly encountered threats in battles fought in the East.
entities.avail: Purchased from the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 23,000 souls after giving her the Easterner's Ashes.

entities.name: Elite Knight Set
entities.desc:
Armor said to have been given to elite knights of fallen Astora.
The mere mention of Astora invoked wistful pangs, and perhaps it was such a dream that drew Anri to this faraway home known only by name.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 13,500 souls upon the death of Anri of Astora, either from the completion of Yuria of Londor's questline or from killing Anri.

entities.name: Evangelist Set
entities.desc:
Robe of an evangelist sent from the cathedral.
These teachers, all women, came to enlighten inhabitants of the Undead Settlement and sent carriers on the path of sacrifice.
entities.avail: Drops from the Evangelists in the Undead Settlement, Cathedral of the Deep and Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

entities.name: Executioner Set
entities.desc:
Steel armor of Horace the Hushed, who took a liking to its cold, bulky insides.
The original owner was said to be a corrupt executioner, who was killed and stripped of his armor.
Horace is one of only two children to escape Aldrich's clutches.
entities.avail: Purchased from the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 18,000 souls after Horace the Hushed is killed.

entities.name: Exile Set
entities.desc:
Armor of the watchdogs of Farron's Keep.
After the Legion's Watchers became Lords of Cinder, the wolf blood dried up, and Farron was consumed by a festering wood.
Within the wood, an emaciated old wolf commands watchdogs to defend the sanctity of sleeping warriors.
Both the exiles were surely watchdogs themselves, for Farron has always been a land of itinerants.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 13,500 souls once the player has defeated the two Exile Watchdogs in the Road of Sacrifices who guard the way to the Farron Keep.

entities.name: Fallen Knight Set
entities.desc:
Armor of an order of fallen knights who disbanded and fled, but met untimely deaths.
The drab, tattered cloth conceals tough, black metal which provides dependable protection from fire.
It is just possible to make out the majestic gold engravings on its surface.
entities.avail: Found in the Road of Sacrifices. In the Crucifixion Woods swamp area, it is found on a corpse before the ladder to Farron Keep, where the two Exile Watchdogs stand guard.

entities.name: Faraam Set
entities.desc:
Armor named after a god of war.
The armor of the Forossa Lion Knights was preserved even after the destruction of their homeland, and is mentioned in numerous legends, alongside the names of those who are said to have gone beyond death.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 18,000 souls after defeating Lion Knight Albert in the Grand Archives.

entities.name: Fire Keeper Set
entities.desc:
Robe worn by the guardian of the shrine.
The Fire Keepers were robbed of light, to better serve as vessels for souls. Only those who cherish the writhing, searing darkness were given the keepers' black attire.
entities.avail:
Found on a corpse by dropping off the bridge in front of the lift in the tower containing the Fire Keeper Soul in Firelink Shrine.

Instead of jumping safely to the casket on the right (when looking at the lift), look to the left of the bridge and there will be a dead body visible below. Jumping toward it will most likely make the player miss their footing and sustain massive fall damage as a consequence, killing them even at maxed out Vigor and with the Silvercat Ring equipped. It's recommended just to run off instead of jumping.

entities.name: Fire Witch Set
entities.desc:
Armor of witches who bore the Profaned Flame, now harrowed spirits of Irithyll.
The witches who lead the Pontiff's Knights were originally ordained as holy knights. It was not long however, before their hearts were swallowed by the Profaned Flame.
entities.avail: Dropped by Fire Witches in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley and Irithyll Dungeon.

entities.name: Firelink Set
entities.desc:
Armor of the Soul of Cinder, a deific manifestation of the Lords of Cinder, who linked the First Flame.
It resembles a knight's armor, but bears hideous burns and contortions.
It exists as a symbol of the great Lords and the noble act of linking the fire, though it is no more than an empty husk.
entities.avail:
Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 40,000 souls after defeating the Soul of Cinder.

It is not required to enter NG+ in order to buy it, although if bought in NG, a second Firelink Set will become available in NG+.

entities.name: Follower Set
entities.desc:
Armor worn by the Farron Followers.
When a warrior of Farron fell to the Abyss, the tall, lean Followers, with their hollowed eyes, quietly appeared in groups to hunt them down.
Farron and its Watchers fell to ruin, but the Followers survived as a wandering pack of Hollows.
entities.avail: Dropped by Farron Followers in the Painted World of Ariandel.

entities.name: Grave Warden Set
entities.desc:
Rotting, tattered robe. Attire of grave wardens at the Cathedral of the Deep.
Grave wardens were tasked with disposing of the ever rising corpses that plagued the cathedral. Their clothes are utterly putrid, drenched in the blood and mucilage of their undertaking.
entities.avail: Dropped by Grave Wardens in the Cathedral of the Deep and Untended Graves.

entities.name: Gundyr's Set
entities.desc:
Ancient chest piece of a set of cast iron armor, belonging to Champion Gundyr.
Gundyr, or the Belated Champion, was bested by an unknown warrior. He then became sheath to a coiled sword in the hopes that someday, the first flame would be linked once more.
entities.avail: Purchased from the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 36,000 souls after defeating Champion Gundyr.

entities.name: Harald Legion Set
entities.desc:
Armor worn by the Harald Legion, who sought the dark soul.
The armor sank into the dark with the legion, where their cavities bloated in grotesque displays, never again to fit any ordinarily-shaped body.
entities.avail: Dropped by Harald Legion Knights.

entities.name: Hard Leather Set
entities.desc:
Armor made of thick, layered leather.
Used by warriors of old, but one can still expect sound defense.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for a total of 6,000 souls.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Greirat's Ashes.

entities.name: Havel's Set
entities.desc:
Armor as if hewn from a giant boulder. Highly protective, but excessively heavy.
The warriors who followed Havel the Rock never flinched, nor retreated from battle, crushing any foe that stood in their way.
entities.avail:
Found on a corpse in the area guarded by the Stray Demon on the bridge above the Old Wolf of Farron bonfire.

The corpse will only appear after defeating Havel the Rock at the top of Archdragon Peak. Defeating the version summoned by the Man Serpent Summoner will not cause the set to appear.

entities.name: Herald Set
entities.desc:
Steel armor with a pure white cape, the signature of Heralds of the Way of White.
Protection made of steel has excellent physical absorption, but is found lacking against blunt strikes and lightning damage.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Herald class.
  • Found on the path after the Crystal Sage arena that leads to the Cathedral of the Deep. The set may be found on a corpse in a clearing, guarded by an Evangelist next to a large bonfire.

entities.name: Iron Dragonslayer Set
entities.desc:
Stark melted iron body armor of the ancient Dragonslayer Armour.
The Armour, defeated by the Champion of Ash in Lothric, was left ages to rust, until it slipped into an abyssal swamp, where it was possessed once again by the memory of the hunt.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Iron Dragonslayer in the Ringed City.

entities.name: Iron Set
entities.desc:
Chainmail armor and white coat featuring a large rendition of the holy symbol of the sun.
The choice attire of a singular Knight of Sunlight from a previous age. The symbol was painted by the knight himself, but the armor never bore any special power, sacred or otherwise.
entities.avail:
Trading the following items with Pickle Pee will net all four armor pieces:

  • Lightning Urn gives the Iron Helm.
  • Siegbräu gives the Armor of the Sun.
  • Homeward Bone gives the Iron Bracelets.
  • Seed of a Giant Tree gives the Iron Leggings.

entities.name: Jailer Set
entities.desc:
Robe worn by the jailers of Irithyll Dungeon.
Originally ritualistic formal wear.
The jailers were among the few survivors inhabiting the Profaned Capital, later serving under Pontiff Sulyvahn.
Perhaps the screams emanating from the cells help them forget their old home.
entities.avail: Dropped by Jailers in the Irithyll Dungeon.

entities.name: Karla's Set
entities.desc:
Coat of the dark witch Karla.
This stained coat is torn and odorous, telling of a long journey and even longer imprisonment.
It would be madness to wear such a thing.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 23,000 souls once she has been given the Prisoner Chief's Ashes.
  • Dropped by Karla.

entities.name: Knight Set
entities.desc:
Armor of a lowly knight, fashioned from solid iron.
This iron armor might be on the heftier side compared to others of its ilk, but as such offers great physical absorption in exchange for its imposing weight.
Do not think to wear it without the necessary Vitality.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Knight class.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for a total of 10,000 souls once he returns from his first pillaging journey.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Greirat's Ashes.

entities.name: Lapp's Set
entities.desc:
Steel armor of the amnesiac Lapp.
This plate-armor body, that covers the torso cleanly without even slight gaps, provides heavy defense.
Quite fit to conceal a hollowed body, and indeed, one's very identity.
entities.avail:
• Left by Amnesiac Lapp at his final meeting place in the Shared Grave, at the end of his questline.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 31,000 souls if the player kills Lapp.

entities.name: Leather Set
entities.desc: Armor made of smooth leather. Even lighter and more flexible than most leather armors.
entities.avail:
• The armor, gloves and boots are sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 1,800 souls after giving her the Dreamchaser's Ashes.
  • The hat can be obtained as a guaranteed drop from one of the three Elder Ghrus located near the Keep Ruins bonfire in Farron Keep.

entities.name: Leonhard's Set
entities.desc:
Garb of Ringfinger Leonhard.
Leonhard was born into royalty, which is believed to be the reason for his skill in both sorcery and swordsmanship.
Indeed, this dingy garb is in fact embroidered with gold thread, betraying its purpose as military wear designed for a noble.
entities.avail: The mask is dropped by Ringfinger Leonhard upon death. The remaining pieces are sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 10,500 souls after Leonhard is killed.

entities.name: Lorian's Set
entities.desc:
Armor of Prince Lothric's older brother Lorian. This black-dyed brass armor was passed down to him from the royal family.
Lorian, raised as a knight, is said to have been left mute and crippled by his younger brother's curse. It is also said that Lorian, in fact, wished it so.
entities.avail: Sold by Shrine Handmaid for a total of 45,000 souls after Lorian, Elder Prince and Lothric, Younger Prince have been defeated.

entities.name: Lothric Knight Set
entities.desc:
Armor of a celebrated Lothric knight.
The coat of distinction is all but fallen apart.
The Knight has served as one of the Three Pillars since ancient times, and shares place alongside the wyverns as a symbol of Lothric.
Only those possessing a knight's resolve are fit to wear this garment.
entities.avail: Dropped by Lothric Knights in the High Wall of Lothric, Lothric Castle, Grand Archives and The Dreg Heap.

entities.name: Maiden Set
entities.desc:
White robe worn by traveling maidens.
Part of their formal attire, regardless of rank.
It is soft and well-made, but ill-suited for use in battle.
entities.avail: Found on a corpse in the Cathedral of the Deep, at the feet of a Giant Slave in the murky pool farthest away from the Deacons of the Deep.

entities.name: Master's Set
entities.desc:
A terribly worn shirt.
Men are fond of weaving tales to explain the raggedness of their garb.
My sixth sense warned me of danger, and I danced between flurries of blades, unscathed, but alas, my clothes went to tatters.
entities.avail:
• The Attire and Gloves are dropped by the Sword Master outside of Firelink Shrine.
  • The Mask is found in Farron Keep, to the left of the initial bonfire guarded by Rotten Slugs.
  • The Loincloth is found in Undead Settlement, next to the Statue of Velka; it requires the Grave Key to obtain. Alternatively, it is the starting equipment for the Deprived class.

entities.name: Millwood Knight Set
entities.desc:
Armor worn by knights of Millwood. The charbronze breastplate and the thick black cape are adorned with the symbol of the Ethereal Oak.
When the fabled Millwood forest was discovered it was a vacant ruin. The only thing left was the Ethereal Oak, stood rotting. No corpses were discovered, yet their belongings lay neatly on the ground.
entities.avail: Purchased from the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 23,500 souls after giving her the Captain's Ashes.

entities.name: Mirrah Chain Set
entities.desc:
Formal attire of the honorable knights of Mirrah, featuring their heraldry, a stag set against a blue field.
Oddly, it was a dishonorable deserter who wore this attire most religiously.
entities.avail: Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley. After defeating Creighton of Mirrah when he invades in the graveyard past the Church of Yorshka bonfire, return to the bridge that leads into Central Irithyll. The set can be found on a corpse in the middle of the bridge where Creighton was first fought.

entities.name: Mirrah Set
entities.desc:
Garb worn by Mirrah Knights sent on journeys. This hard leather vest is bestowed only upon proven knights.
Knights travel afar to fulfill their sacred duties, but few are ever able to deliver on their vows.
entities.avail:
• Set without Lucatiel's Mask can be found on a corpse in a tower along with the Chloranthy Ring in the Undead Settlement. The tower is accessible by dropping down off the rooftop where two Evangelists guard Flynn's Ring.
  • Lucatiel's Mask is obtained by trading a Vertebra Shackle with Pickle Pee at Firelink Shrine.

entities.name: Morne's Set
entities.desc:
Black armor bestowed upon knights of Carim.
Modeled on Morne, the Archbishop's apostle, cast from a unique mineral resembling stone.
A Carim knight will dedicate an entire career to attending a single maiden, just as Morne once served one goddess alone.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 23,000 souls after completing Eygon of Carim's questline. The Shrine Handmaid will also sell it should the player kill Eygon.

entities.name: Nameless Knight Set
entities.desc: Armor of a nameless knight. Crafted with thin metal greatly reinforced by a grooved finish.
entities.avail: Found in Farron Keep. From the Keep Ruins bonfire, head towards the gate that leads towards the Abyss Watchers mausoleum and turn right, following along the wall within the swamp. In the deep swamp zone, the set can be found inside a crevice where the wall ends and an impassable cliff begins.

entities.name: Northern Set
entities.desc:
Iron armor of a stalwart northern warrior. Supported by interwoven chainmail.
Iron defensive wear grants superior absorption. Being from the north, it should also offer resistance to the cold.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Warrior class.
  • Found on a hanging corpse in the Undead Settlement, at the same area where the Demon is fought alongside Siegward of Catarina.

entities.name: Old Sorcerer Set
entities.desc:
Traditional attire worn by sorcerers of the Vinheim Dragon School.
Long ago, sorcerers were said to always dress properly, even while on distant journeys of discovery, even before such journeys were established curriculum.
entities.avail: Found in Irithyll Dungeon. In the initial cell block, navigate down to the lower level and enter the first cell encountered. The set will be found in this cell, guarded by four Infested Corpses.

entities.name: Ordained Set
entities.desc:
Garb of Friede, Sister of the Painted World. A light blue dress sewn with thin fabric.
After renouncing everything, Friede discovered a people that she wished to protect, and assumed the precise form that they yearned for.
entities.avail: Purchased from the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 33,000 souls once Sister Friede has been defeated.

entities.name: Outrider Knight Set
entities.desc:
Armor of an Irithyll outrider knight.
Enveloped in a dimly cool air.
The knights were given the eyes of the Pontiff, but the eyes transformed them into savage, raving warriors who only knew how to serve as mindless guards.
entities.avail: Guaranteed drop from the Boreal Outrider Knight in the Grand Archives. The knight is located inside a hidden room behind an illusory wall on the fourth floor, on an alcove on the left wing.

entities.name: Painting Guardian Set
entities.desc:
Attire of the Painting Guardians, whose forms are described in the mythology of heretics.
A smooth pale gown that deters magic.
The hunchbacked teller of ancient tales describes unwanted souls who are unwelcome across the lands, and are eventually drawn into a cold, painted world.
entities.avail: Found on a corpse while dropping down the Prison Tower from platform to platform in Anor Londo, where Captain Yorshka resides.

entities.name: Pale Shade Set
entities.desc:
Attire worn by those who kill in the name of the Sable Church of Londor.
The Pale Shades of the Sable Church are all undying Hollows, giving rise to much fear and contempt.
Their fight is one of neither honor nor exaltation, yielding nothing but withered moans.
entities.avail:
Found in Firelink Shrine after defeating the Londor Pale Shade in both of his invasions. The set can be found near Yoel of Londor's corpse.

The availability requires structured events to occur:

  1. Displease or kill Yuria of Londor at Firelink Shrine.
  2. Find and defeat the Londor Pale Shade in Farron Keep.
  3. Find and defeat the Londor Pale Shade in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

entities.name: Pontiff Knight Set
entities.desc:
Armor of the Pontiff's Knights, now harrowed spirits of Irithyll.
This blue-gray armor, shrouded in a thinly cold air, is light and brittle.
entities.avail: Dropped by Pontiff Knights in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

entities.name: Prayer Set
entities.desc:
The prince, destined to be a Lord of Cinder, was cherished by the royal family, despite being born into illness, a frail and shriveled child.
His swaddling clothes were made of aged, coarse cloth used in ancient prayer, and are all that he has ever worn.
entities.avail: Found in Lothric Castle. From the Lothric Castle bonfires, head into the next room and it can be found in a chest to the right.

entities.name: Pyromancer Set
entities.desc:
Attire of pyromancers of the Great Swamp. Comprised of bronze ornamentation and animal pelt.
In the Great Swamp, bronze was used ritualistically to ward off evil spirits and keep darkness at bay.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Pyromancer Class.
  • Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for a total of 2,300 souls.

entities.name: Ringed Knight Set
entities.desc:
Malformed black armor of the Ringed Knights. The armor of early men was forged in the Abyss, and betrays a smidgen of life.
For this reason the gods cast a seal of fire upon such armor, and those who possessed them.
entities.avail: Dropped by Ringed Knights.

entities.name: Ruin Set
entities.desc:
Armor of the company of knights who were sent to the Ringed City on an old king's orders.
The knights sought the dark soul, but were so soundly crushed, they had little choice but to swear themselves to the Judicator Giant.
The ill-fated company was later immortalized in a dark fable, inspiring the aspect of certain golems in whom their name lived on.
entities.avail: Found in The Ringed City, on a corpse below the Mausoleum Lookout bonfire. After descending the stairs, take a hard right and walk under the stairs instead of towards the gravestones.

entities.name: Sellsword Set
entities.desc:
Metal armor interwoven with coarse cloth. Able to endure the hardships of battle and prolonged travel.
It is light considering the build, striking a fine balance between absorption and substance.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Mercenary class.
  • Found within Crucifixion Woods. On the far side of the swamp to the right, past two Lycanthropes, it is found on a corpse down a flight of stairs guarded by a Black Knight.

entities.name: Set of Favor
entities.desc:
Armor of the pitiable Embraced knight.
Depicts the affection of the goddess Fina.
The face is crafted to depict the goddess's embrace, quite ignoring the fact that her love is in fact as fickle as the weather.
entities.avail: Purchased from the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 31,000 souls after defeating the two Sulyvahn's Beasts in the Water Reserve.

entities.name: Set of Thorns
entities.desc:
Armor of Kirk, the notorious knight of Thorns.
A dense patch of thorns grows from its surface.
A fitting item for the murderous Kirk, for even the simple act of rolling can damage enemies when wearing this attire.
entities.avail: Found in the Cathedral of the Deep. After defeating Longfinger Kirk when he invades, go to Rosaria's Bed Chamber, where it can be found on a corpse.

entities.name: Shadow Set
entities.desc:
Black cloth mask worn by spooks from an Eastern land. Sacrifices defense for greater mobility.
The late King Oceiros was obsessed by dragons, to the extent that he would later be known as the Consumed King. Countless assassins were sent to end his reign, but none returned.
entities.avail: Found in the Consumed King's Garden, on a corpse in the Toxic ground, under the terrace at the center of the garden.

entities.name: Shira's Set
entities.desc:
Armor of Shira, knight in service to Filianore. A rare women's piece from ancient times.
With a spun gold shawl draped over the silver breastplate and a green woven skirt, this armor offers a subdued yet refined elegance, apropos to both a handmaiden of the Princess and one whose veins course with royal blood.
entities.avail: Found in The Ringed City. After defeating Shira, Knight of Filianore at Filianore's Rest, return to her door within the Ringed City, at the top of the great stairway. Her door will now be open, and the set can be found on a corpse inside.

entities.name: Silver Knight Set
entities.desc:
Armor of the Silver Knights allegiant to the royals of old.
It is said that even after the family's passing, the knights continued to watch over their manor, and the ruined cathedral.
entities.avail: Dropped by Silver Knights in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley and Anor Londo.

entities.name: Slave Knight Set
entities.desc:
Armor issued to slave knights. The fine craftsmanship made this a symbol of honor.
Long ago, only the Undead served as slave knights, warriors used as fodder in the bleakest of battles.
They grew decrepit, their skin charred black and their bones twisted. Eventually they went outright mad, but were never relieved from duty.
entities.avail: Found in the Painted World of Ariandel. In the Corvian Settlement, navigate to the rooftops and into the tower with the ladder that leads to the bridge to the cliffside. Inside the tower is a drop-down which leads to a locked room with three Forlorn Corvian Settlers within. The set will be on a corpse inside.

entities.name: Smough's Set
entities.desc:
Grotesque armor associated with Smough, the last knight to stand in defense of the ruined cathedral.
Boasts extremely high defense and can be donned by humans, but not without great difficulty.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 31,000 souls after defeating Aldrich, Devourer of Gods.

entities.name: Sorcerer Set
entities.desc:
Attire of a sorcerer from the Vinheim Dragon School. Long, ash-colored robes.
Underneath is a deep blue sorcerer's coat; conventional uniform of the academy.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Sorcerer class.
  • Found in the Road of Sacrifices. From the Crucifixion Woods bonfire, drop into the swamp and head towards the ruins. Before the stairs that lead into the ruins, there is a doorway that leads into a small room. The set can be found on a corpse inside, alongside the Sage Ring, guarded by a Lycanthrope.

entities.name: Sunless Set
entities.desc:
Attire of a knight from the Sunless Realms, known for their resistance to both magic and the dark.
Metal plating and chainmail, treated with silver.
Sunless Knights serve the nameless moon, and perhaps it is for this reason the attire casts a feminine silhouette.
entities.avail: Purchased from the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 23,000 souls once Sirris of the Sunless Realms has died, whether she is killed by the player or upon completion of her questline.

entities.name: Sunset Armor Set
entities.desc:
Armor of Hodrick, holy knight of Sunless Realms.
This light gold armor, named for its sunset hues, is now faded and wrapped in tainted rags.
The sorry fool was known to wander the battlefield as a crazed ghoul, lashing out at friend and foe alike.
entities.avail: Found in the Pit of Hollows in the Undead Settlement, after defeating Holy Knight Hodrick alongside Sirris of the Sunless Realms during her questline.

entities.name: Undead Legion Set
entities.desc:
Attire of the Abyss Watchers, the Undead Legion of Farron.
These undead warriors vowed to partake of wolf blood.
They acted in the dark, seeking out any sign of the Abyss, fighting a constant war with its abominations.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 31,000 souls after defeating the Abyss Watchers.

entities.name: Vilhelm's Set
entities.desc:
The black armor of Vilhelm, Knight of Londor, and a nice fit for any lean Hollow.
This hollow knight, who served the three sisters who founded the Sable Church, was particularly loyal to the eldest, and was known as a cold-blooded hangman.
entities.avail: Found within the Painted World of Ariandel. Within the rotting basement of Ariandel Chapel, several Giant Flies guard it and other loot on the lower level.

entities.name: Winged Knight Set
entities.desc:
Armor of the Winged Knights, named for their appearance, who swore themselves to the Angels.
Worship of the divine messengers was viewed as heresy in Lothric and unrecognized by any of the Three Pillars of rule.
Third paragraph - This is believed to be why Gertrude, the Heavenly Daughter, was imprisoned in the lofty cell of the Grand Archives.
entities.avail: Found in Lothric Castle. From the initial bonfire, traverse up the pathway and enter the room with the ladder and the axe-wielding Winged Knight. At the top of the stairs, hit the rightmost panel of the backt wall to reveal an Illusory Wall. The set can be found on a corpse in front of a painting of a Winged Knight.

entities.name: Wolf Knight Set
entities.desc:
Armor of a knight tainted by the dark of the Abyss. The twilight blue cape is damp, and will ever remain so.
A vanquished knight left behind only wolf's blood, and his legacy of duty. The Undead Legion of Farron was formed to bear his torch, and the armor of these Abyss Watchers suggests their own eventual end.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid in Dark Firelink Shrine for a total of 46,000 souls after defeating the Abyss Watchers.

entities.name: Worker Set
entities.desc:
Garb worn by inhabitants of the Undead Settlement.
Official attire for the dissection and burial of undead. Naturally the ceremonial significance of such work is long forgotten.
Indeed, no one could continue to entertain such horrors.
entities.avail: Drop from the Peasant Hollows in the Undead Settlement.

entities.name: Xanthous Set
entities.desc:
Yellowish overcoat covering a band of brass medallions.
Xanthous clothing is the mark of a researcher of lost sorceries, and the number of medallions denotes their success. A point of prided for the researchers, even if its signficance is lost on others.
entities.avail:
• The set, minus the crown, is sold by the Shrine Handmaid for a total of 24,000 souls once she has been given the Xanthous Ashes.
  • The Xanthous Crown can be obtained twice within the same playthrough:
    1. Dropped by Yellowfinger Heysel after defeating her at either Crucifixion Woods or Farron Keep. She will only drop it once.
    2. Dropped by the Man-grub that spawns in Rosaria's Bed Chamber after the first three Lords of Cinder (excluding Ludleth) have been killed.

entities.name: Affinity
entities.desc:
A forbidden dark sorcery. Casts a dark manifestation of humanity.
It appears to be an expression of envy, or perhaps love towards another, that will tenaciously pursue its target. Even if, like so many human desires, it amounts to nothing but misfortune.
entities.avail: Sold by Karla for 15,000 souls.
entities.use:
Conjures up five orbs around the caster, similar to Homing Soulmass. When an enemy within the caster's frontal arc gets close enough, the orbs lock on and slowly chase the target, with each orb capable of dealing 0.6 times the Spell Buff of the wielded catalyst as Dark damage upon impact. If the orbs collide with any level geometry without flying at a target, they will automatically explode.

As with other Dark Sorceries, this spell is subject to having its power boosted by wielding the proper catalyst.

Unlike Homing Soulmass and Homing Crystal Soulmass, the number of orbs conjured is always 5, regardless of the caster's Intelligence.

entities.name: Aural Decoy
entities.desc:
Sorcery developed by a certain surreptitious
sorcerer at Vinheim Dragon School.
Distracts foes with a distant sound.
The sound carries with it a strangely infectious
resonance that may cause one to stray from their
post and expose their back.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 2,000 souls.
entities.use: Conjures an orb that flies in the casting direction. Once the orb hits solid level geometry or travels its maximum distance, it will produce running sounds, distracting any nearby enemies and causing them to face the source of the sound. The orb will produce sound for 3 seconds before vanishing.

entities.name: Cast Light
entities.desc:
Lost sorcery from Oolacile, land of ancient golden Sorceries. Casts a light to illuminate surroundings.
This light producing magic is elementary, but nonetheless demonstrates the pure nature of golden sorceries; the likes of which have not been developed even at the Dragon School.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 1,000 souls once he has been given the Golden Scroll.
entities.use: Conjures a glowing orb above the caster's head. The orb persists for 60 seconds, and the duration can be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

entities.name: Chameleon
entities.desc:
Lost sorcery from Oolacile, land of ancient golden sorceries. Transforms into something inconspicuous.
Far from formally developed, this magic was instead born from the mischief of a young girl who sought relief from the solitude of the woods at dusk.
entities.avail:
Can be obtained in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley by any of the following sources:

  • Dropped by the Old Woman of Londor in the Church of Yorshka. If following Anri's questline, an additional statue will appear at the back-left corner of the church, among many others. Hitting it will reveal it to be a pilgrim concealed by using this same spell.
  • Found on the Old Woman of Londor's dead body in the Darkmoon Tomb behind an illusory wall, just before arriving to Anor Londo. Requires the player to proceed though Anri's questline for the body to appear.
entities.use:
Transforms the caster into an inconspicuous object that blends with the environment. While transformed, the caster can change equipment and switch weapons without breaking camouflage, though attacking,, getting attacked, using items, interacting with the world or gesturing will cause the transformation to end. Movement is reduced to walking speed, and dropping off a ledge of any height will break the illusion.

Chameleon can transform the caster into the following objects:

Cemetery of Ash and Untended Graves

  • Large tombstone
  • Small headstone

High Wall of Lothric and Consumed King's Garden

  • Barrel
  • Candle-holding praying statue (lit candle)
  • Headless Lothric Knight armor (from the Winged Knight courtyard onward)

Undead Settlement

  • Cage Spider
  • Tree-headed corpse
  • Covered pot

Road of Sacrifices

  • Box crate
  • Circular short crucifix
  • Chained three-pronged crucifix

Farron Keep

  • Box crate
  • Circular short crucifix
  • Rotting Ghru crucifix

Cathedral of the Deep

Cathedral exterior:

  • Box crate
  • Large tombstone
  • Short urn ornament

Cathedral interior:

  • Chair
  • Stooping hollow statue
  • Mourning woman statue

Catacombs of Carthus

  • Bone-filled small urn
  • Bone-filled tall urn
  • Covered powder barrel

Smouldering Lake

  • Demon Statue on pedestal
  • Covered powder barrel

Irithyll of the Boreal Valley

  • Small stooping priest statue
  • Silver Knight Straight Sword-holding squire statue

Anor Londo

  • Sword-holding Silver Knight statue

Irithyll Dungeon and Profaned Capital

  • Tall-backed chair
  • Aristocrat's Mask

Lothric Castle

  • Ornate wooden chair
  • Unlit candelabrum
  • Wooden box

Grand Archives

Archives exterior:

  • Crown-wearing gargoyle

Archives interior:

  • Armillary sphere
  • Wooden lectern

Archdragon Peak

  • Broken pillar
  • Short Nameless King statue
  • Path of the Dragon male pseudo-dragon statue

Kiln of the First Flame

  • Flame-scorched pillar
  • Large tombstone

Painted World of Ariandel

Snowfield, Rope Bridge Cave, Snowy Mountain Pass:

  • Birch Woman
  • Medium-height tree

Corvian Settlement:

  • Destroyed woman statue
  • Medium white tombstone
  • Wooden box

Ariandel Chapel:

  • Short stepladder
  • Wooden box
  • Wooden chair

Depths of the Painting:

  • Snow-covered rock

The Dreg Heap

Upper Dreg Heap:

  • Headless Lothric Knight armor
  • Londor Pilgrim
  • Wooden crate

Earthen Peak:

  • Large stone block
  • Londor Pilgrim
  • Wooden crate

The Ringed City

Mausoleum Lookout:

  • Hollow mausoleum tombstone
  • Small covered pot
  • Sword of Avowal statue

Upper Ringed City, Shared Grave, Church of Filianore:

  • Spear-wielding Ringed Knight statue
  • Small covered pot
  • Sword of Avowal statue

Ringed city swamp:

  • Dark crystal growth
  • Humanity Phantom (only within the swamp itself)
  • Small covered pot
  • Spear-wielding Ringed Knight statue
  • Sword of Avowal statue

Pygmy's Throne:

entities.name: Crystal Hail
entities.desc:
Unique sorcery developed by extraordinary preacher twins known as the Crystal Sages.
Casts a cascade of small crystal soulmasses from above. Crystal soulmasses have piercing qualities.
In a pact said to have been formed long ago, one of the Sages allied with the Undead Legion in order to train the sorcerers of Farron.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of a Crystal Sage and 1,500 souls with Ludleth of Courland.
entities.use: Conjures a large crystal mass, which rises skyward. After a short delay, the crystal mass sequentially launches numerous crystal soulmasses, 22 in total, which rain down on the general area. Each soulmass has minor tracking capability, homing in on targets within the area and inflicting 0.62 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage upon impact, as well as minor stagger.

entities.name: Crystal Magic Weapon
entities.desc:
Further sharpens Magic Weapon via crystallization.
Reinforces right weapon with crystal.
After much experimentation, Logan found the crystal medium facilitated a strong bond between weapon and soul.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 10,000 souls once he has been given the Crystal Scroll.
entities.use:
Reinforces right-hand weapon with Magic, adding 95% of the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage for 60 seconds. The duration of the buff can be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

For catalysts that scale with both Intelligence and Faith, only the Intelligence portion of the Spell Buff is counted. Special catalysts such as the Archdeacon's Great Staff and Man-grub's Staff are treated as having the base 100 Spell Buff.

entities.name: Crystal Soul Spear
entities.desc:
Further sharpens Soul Spear via crystallization.
Fires a piercing crystal soul spear.
According to the Crystal Sages, old Big Hat achieved enlightment within the Regal Archives, where he came to find the quintessence of sorcery in the facets of a certain crystal.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 15,000 souls once he has been given the Crystal Scroll.
entities.use:
An enhanced version of Soul Spear, and one of the most devastating Sorceries in the game. Fires a piercing crystal soul spear that can go through a line of enemies, inflicting 3.05 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage upon any enemies struck. The spear has long range and fast travel speed, but requires a longer cast time.

Alongside Soul Spear, this spell has the longest range among all Sorceries.

entities.name: Dark Edge
entities.desc:
A forbidden dark sorcery. Strikes with blade formed of humanity's darkness.
Passed from mother to daughter, this blade was intended for both protection and as a means of taking one's own life. The young girl never swung it more than once.
entities.avail: Sold by Karla for 8,000 souls.
entities.use: Creates a blade imbued with Dark energy, striking down vertically in front of the player. The blade will inflict 2.05 times the Spell Buff of the wielded catalyst as Dark Damage, which can be boosted by wielding a dark catalyst. The sword can hit targets through walls, as well as foes above the wielder.

entities.name: Deep Soul
entities.desc:
Sorcery of Archdeacon Royce and his deacons, said to have been imparted to them by McDonnell of the Boreal Valley.
Fires dark soul dregs.
Souls which swell from the deep pursue their target, drawn towards life.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Deacons of the Deep with Ludleth of Courland. No souls are required to complete the transposition.
entities.use: Quickly conjures soul dregs, which slowly home in on the target, dealing 1.0 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Dark damage upon impact. Costs very little FP and stamina, and is subject to modification by Faith and Dark bonus on certain specialized catalysts.

entities.name: Farron Dart
entities.desc:
Variation of Soul Arrow developed by sorcerers of the Undead Legion of Farron.
Fire a soul dart.
