Well known among the Farron sorceries, it is learned far and wide due to its ease of use.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid and Yoel of Londor for 1,000 souls.
  • Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 500 souls.
entities.use:
A miniaturized version of Soul Arrow. Fires a soul dart at the target, dealing 0.52 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage. The dart deals little damage and cannot inflict stagger on their targets, but cost very little FP and cast extremely quickly.

Unlike other Soul Arrow variants, Farron Dart can be cast while rolling and running.

entities.name: Farron Flashsword
entities.desc:
Alteration of Soul Greatsword developed by sorcerers of the Undead Legion of Farron.
The legion has a tendency to emphasize speed over power, and this practical alteration of an existing sorcery is no exception.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 5,000 souls.
entities.use: Conjures a sword made of souls from the staff and swings it quickly, dealing 1.03 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Magic damage to any enemy struck by the blade.

entities.name: Farron Hail
entities.desc:
Sorcery which improves upon Farron Dart. Fires a cascade of soul darts.
Entrusted to the leader of the Legion's acolytes, and apparently a sorcery of his daughter, Heysel, that was refined by a Crystal Sage.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 5,000 souls once he has been given the Sage's Scroll.
entities.use:
The caster charges the catalyst for a short period, and then unleashes a barrage of soul darts in a spread in front of the caster, in four waves of five darts each (for a maximum of 20 total darts). Each wave inflicts 0.58 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage to any targets hit. It does not matter how many darts hit a target in each wave, the damage from a wave that strikes a target is always the same.

The FP cost is expressed as a per-wave basis, with a potential cost of 16 FP for all four waves (12 FP with Dusk Crown Ring equipped). Should the caster have enough FP for one wave but not all four, all waves will be cast regardless.

entities.name: Frozen Weapon
entities.desc:
One of the spells left behind by the young sorcerer Sulyvahn before leaving the Painted World. Imbues right-hand weapon with frost.
Sulyvahn was born and raised inside the painting yet had little use for his frigid homeland, since he had not yet experienced loss.
entities.avail: Found amongst the Giant Flies in an egg-infested area near the Rope Bridge Cave, shortly past the Snowfield.
entities.use: Adds 48 Frost build-up to right-hand weapon. Buff lasts for 60 seconds, but cannot be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

entities.name: Great Deep Soul
entities.desc:
Sorcery which improves upon Deep Soul. Fires powerful darkened soul dregs.
Archdeacon McDonnell, a sorcerer himself, delighted in the cathedral's stagnating souls. For him, they represented the glorious bedrock of this world.
entities.avail: Obtained as a reward for reaching Rank 1 in the Aldrich Faithful covenant. To achieve this, the player must offer 10 Human Dregs to Archdeacon McDonnell in the Water Reserve.
entities.use: Quickly fires powerful darkened soul dregs that home in on the target, inflicting 1.3 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Dark damage upon impact. Has a short cast time similar to Deep Soul, and can benefit from Faith scaling as well as Dark bonus depending on the catalyst used.

entities.name: Great Farron Dart
entities.desc:
Sorcery which improves upon Farron Dart. Fires a more powerful soul dart.
Entrusted to the leader of the Legion's acolytes, and apparently a sorcery of his daughter, Heysel, that was refined by a Crystal Sage.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 2,000 souls once he has been given the Sage's Scroll.
entities.use:
An upscaled version of Farron Dart. Fires a powerful soul dart at the target, dealing 0.59 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage. Like Farron Dart, it cannot stagger enemies hit by the projectiles but casts extremely quickly and costs little FP, and like Farron Dart it has special rolling and running attacks which make it extremely flexible.

The spell's larger damage multiplier compared to Farron Dart allows it to break through low values of Magic Defense more easily (such as against players that do not level Intelligence). As a result, it inflicts damage that increases roughly in tandem with its FP cost, meaning that it can still deal respectable damage without being as inefficient as the multiplier difference would suggest.

entities.name: Great Heavy Soul Arrow
entities.page: Great Heavy Soul Arrow (Dark Souls III)
entities.desc:
Sorcery which improves upon Heavy Soul Arrow.
Fires a more powerful heavy soul arrow
Sorceries are a logical discipline; their strength influenced by the caster's intelligence.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 4,000 souls.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for the same price once she has been given Orbeck's Ashes.
entities.use:
The most powerful version of the basic Soul Arrow, and an enhanced version of Heavy Soul Arrow. Fires a heavy soul arrow, dealing 2.42 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage. Has the same casting time as Heavy Soul Arrow, while dealing more damage.

As the large multiplier on a single damage instance allows it to easily break through low to moderate values of Magic defense on the target, reducing its effectiveness, Great Heavy Soul Arrow is the most efficient Sorcery in the game, in terms of damage-to-FP ratio, once reductions from defense and absorption are factored in.

entities.name: Great Magic Shield
entities.desc:
Sorcery which improves upon Magic Shield. Greatly reinforces left shield with magic.
Only sorcerer-swordsmen with special duties are permitted the use of this spell, which temporarily grants even the smallest of shields fortitude more akin to that of a greatshield.
entities.avail: Dropped by a Corpse Grub in a cell found in the Irithyll Dungeon. After the first Jailer, drop down one floor and open the door to the creature.
entities.use: Greatly reinforces shield in the left hand, increasing damage absorption in all categories to 100% regardless of prior resistances, while increasing stability by 50%. Skills that inflict damage through raised shields such as Blind Spot and Shield Splitter will also be completely blocked. Effects last for 30 seconds, and duration can be increased by equipping a Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

entities.name: Great Magic Weapon
entities.desc:
Sorcery which improves upon Magic Weapon. Greatly reinforces right weapon with magic.
Only sorcerer-swordsmen with special duties are permitted use of this spell. The azure blade is said to cut down heavily armored knights with ease.
entities.avail: Found in Farron Keep, down the path from the Farron Keep Perimeter bonfire, past the Ravenous Crystal Lizard and near the shortcut gate back to the Crucifixion Woods.
entities.use:
Reinforces right-hand weapon with Magic, adding 85% of the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage for 60 seconds. The duration of the buff can be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

For catalysts that scale with both Intelligence and Faith, only the Intelligence portion of the Spell Buff is counted. Special catalysts such as the Archdeacon's Great Staff and Man-grub's Staff are treated as having the base 100 Spell Buff.

entities.name: Great Soul Arrow
entities.desc:
Sorcery which improves upon Soul Arrow. Fires a more powerful soul arrow.
Many sorceries inflict magic damage, making them effective against iron armor, tough scales, and other physically resilient materials.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 3,000 souls.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for the same price once she has been given Orbeck's Ashes.
entities.use: A stronger variant of Soul Arrow. Fires a soul arrow at the target, dealing 1.5 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage. Has the same cast time as Soul Arrow but deals more damage, though still less than Heavy Soul Arrow.

entities.name: Great Soul Dregs
entities.desc:
A sorcery that fires great dark soul dregs that have stewed for ages, far within the deep.
This sorcery is the highest form of Deep Soul.
Some of the murkmen who rise from the depths are possessed by soul dregs, which have a grave likeness to the human form.
entities.avail: Found in The Dreg Heap. After finding the first Lothric Knights in the area, players can exit to the left of the small chapel and into a building infested with Murkmen. At the end of the corridor is an illusory wall that reveals a staircase to the second floor. The spell can be found at the end of the last room, guarded by numerous Dregs-possessed Murkmen.
entities.use: Conjures a large soul dreg which accelerates upon cast and homes in on its target, exploding and inflicting 2.55 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Dark damage upon impact. Certain Dark catalysts will boost the damage output of this spell, and allow the wielder to take advantage of Faith scaling.

entities.name: Heavy Soul Arrow
entities.desc:
Elementary, yet practical sorcery from long ago. Fires a heavy soul arrow.
Offers greater power but slower casting time, entailing a vulnerability that makes this sorcery trickier to handle.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Sorcerer class.
  • Sold by Yoel of Londor (or by Yuria of Londor after his death) for 2,000 souls.
  • Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for the same price.
entities.use: A heavy version of Soul Arrow. Fires a heavy soul arrow, dealing 2.15 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage. Inflicts more damage than Soul Arrow and Great Soul Arrow, but has a moderate casting time.

entities.name: Hidden Body
entities.desc:
Lost sorcery from Oolacile, land of ancient golden sorceries. Turns body nigh on invisible.
Although perfect invisibility is unachievable due to the risk of dissipation, the caster need only stand still for a moment to blend in to environs with astounding camouflage.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 3,000 souls once he has been given the Golden Scroll.
entities.use: Turns the caster nearly invisible for 15 seconds. This duration can be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

entities.name: Hidden Weapon
entities.desc:
Lost sorcery from Oolacile, land of ancient golden sorceries. Turns right weapon invisible.
The weapon itself undergoes no inherent changes. Effective use of this, like any tool, perhaps, is reliant upon the ingenuity of its caster.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 1,500 souls once he has been given the Golden Scroll.
entities.use:
Turns the caster's right-hand weapon completely invisible. Buff lasts for 45 seconds, and can be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

As it is technically a weapon buff, it can only be cast on weapons that are capable of being buffed.

entities.name: Homing Crystal Soulmass
entities.desc:
Sharpens Homing Soulmass via crystallization.
Releases homing crystal soulmass. Crystal soulmass has piercing qualities.
According to the Crystal Sages, old Big Hat achieved enlightment within the Regal Archives where he came to find the quintessence of sorcery in the facets of a certain crystal.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 18,000 souls once he has been given the Crystal Scroll.
entities.use:
An upgraded form of Homing Soulmass. Conjures a number of crystalline orbs above the caster, requiring a longer casting time than Homing Soulmass. These orbs will automatically target and fly at any enemy that gets close enough to the caster's frontal arc, with each orb dealing 0.65 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage upon collision, inflicting stagger upon impact.

If the crystal orbs collide with any solid level geometry without flying at a target, they will automatically explode. However, unlike Homing Soulmass, they will not self-destruct when they collide with destructible level geometry (e.g., chairs, tables), instead destroying them while remaining ready to trigger.

The number of orbs conjured is dependent on the caster's Intelligence:

IntelligenceNumber of Orbs
304
31-995

entities.name: Homing Soulmass
entities.desc:
Sorcery developed by Big Hat Logan, the great sorcerer who left the Dragon School in an age long past.
Releases homing soulmass.
This sorcery may offer a clue as to what Logan sought, but further investigation suggests its attraction to living things mirrors the nature of the dark.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 6,000 souls once he has been given Logan's Scroll.
entities.use:
Quickly conjures up a number of floating orbs above the caster. Orbs will automatically target and fly at any enemy that gets close enough to the caster's frontal arc, with each orb inflicting 0.49 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage upon collision, staggering the target for each impact. If the orbs collide with any level geometry without flying at a target, they will automatically explode, destroying any destructible objects and then vanishing.

The number of orbs conjured is dependent on the caster's Intelligence:

IntelligenceNumber of Orbs
20-243
25-304
31-995

entities.name: Magic Shield
entities.desc:
Sorcery for casters who wield swords. Reinforces left shield with magic.
Shields augmented by magic have higher stability and damage absorption.
Even the smallest of shields can be toughened considerably with the use of this spell.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Yoel of Londor (or Yuria of Londor after his death) for 4,500 souls.
  • Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 3,000 souls.
entities.use:
Reinforces the player's left-hand shield. Increases damage absorption while increasing stability by 20%.

Percentage of damage that chips through a raised shield is reduced by 30%, so weaker shields get larger absorption bonuses. For example, if a shield would normally block 50% of Fire damage, buffing it with Magic Shield would allow it to block 65%; if a shield blocks 80% of Fire damage, buffing it will cause it to block 86% of Fire damage. Therefore, chip damage can never be fully negated except in cases where absorption was already at 100% (e.g., physical damage).

Effect lasts for 60 seconds. Duration can be increased via equipping a Lingering Dragoncrest Ring. Switching the weapon equipped in the off-hand away from the shield will remove the effect.

entities.name: Magic Weapon
entities.desc:
Sorcery for casters who wield swords.
Reinforces right weapon with magic.
The power of the sorcerer-swordsmen of Vinheim is predicated upon this and Magic Shield Many warriors learnt sorcery just for this enchantment.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Yoel of Londor (or Yuria of Londor after his death) for 4,500 souls.
  • Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 3,000 souls.
entities.use:
Reinforces right-hand weapon with Magic, adding 75% of the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage for 90 seconds. This duration can be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

For catalysts that scale with both Intelligence and Faith, only the Intelligence portion of the Spell Buff is counted. Special catalysts such as the Archdeacon's Great Staff and Man-grub's Staff are treated as having the base 100 Spell Buff.

entities.name: Old Moonlight
entities.desc:
A memory of an old sword found deep within Midir.
This sorcery uses souls to grant form to the thought, and attack with it.
Attacks are coupled with lightwaves, and sustaining the stance before attacking increases their speed and potency.
The sword is named after moonlight, but it is slightly different than the one fashioned of the paledrake Seath. Perhaps it is rooted in an older memory, from not long after the Beginning.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Darkeater Midir with Ludleth of Courland for 15,000 souls.
entities.use:
The caster conjures a Moonlight Sword with the staff and holds it ready. It can be released at any time, performing a crosswise horizontal slash like Soul Greatsword while also unleashing a moonlight wave like the Moonlight Greatsword. FP is only consumed upon releasing the attack, and the caster can move slowly with the sword at the ready or roll to cancel it. The spell is made up of two components, the Moonlight Sword and the moonlight wave; the Moonlight Sword inflicts 1.25 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Magic damage, while the moonlight wave deals 1.5 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Magic damage.

If the spell is held for 2 seconds, the sword is charged with moonlight, increasing the damage dealt by the wave by 57%, causing it to inflict 2.35 times the Spell Buff of the wielded catalyst as Magic damage. The damage dealt by the sword itself is not affected by charging it. A charged beam deals damage comparable to Great Heavy Soul Arrow, and will out-damage even Crystal Soul Spear if both the sword and the charged beam connect on the same target.

<tabber>Official translation= A memory of an old sword found deep within Midir. This sorcery uses souls to grant form to the thought, and attack with it.

Attacks are coupled with lightwaves, and sustaining the stance before attacking increases their speed and potency.

The sword is named after moonlight, but it is slightly different than the one fashioned of the paledrake Seath. Perhaps it is rooted in an older memory, from not long after the Beginning. |-|Original description (Japanese) = ミディールの深層にあった古い剣の記憶 それをソウルにより形作り、攻撃する魔術

攻撃は光波を伴い 攻撃前の構えを継続することで その威力、速度が増す

古い剣の名は、これもまた月光であるが 白竜シースのそれとは、少し姿が異なる その記憶は、よりはじまりに近いようだ |-|Literal translation = Memory of an old sword that existed deep within Midir. Sorcery that grants it form using the soul to attack with it.

Attack are accompanied by light waves, and by continuing to maintain the stance before the attack, its power and speed increase.

The name of the old sword is also Moonlight, but its appearance is slightly different from that of White Dragon Seath. That memory seems to be closer to the Beginning. </tabber>

entities.name: Pestilent Mist
entities.desc:
Highly dangerous sorcery employed by Dragon School spooks. Only taught to trusted members.
Releases dense mist that eats away at HP. Beware, as the caster is not immune to its effect.
A body caught in the silent mist cloud lies still, while the face twists in a tortured scream. The names of these learned sorcerers became feared for this gruesome spectacle.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 1,000 souls once he has been given any Sorcery scroll.
entities.use:
Creates a cloud of mist that deals damage to anything within it, including the caster. Mist persists for roughly 16.3 seconds, and deals damage at 5 instances per second for a total of 79 or 80 total instances of damage. The duration cannot be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

The damage inflicted by Pestilent Mist, per instance, is calculated as follows:

10 +

Where X is the maximum HP of the target, rounded down to the nearest 1,000.

entities.name: Repair
entities.desc:
Lost sorcery from Oolacile, land of ancient golden sorceries.
Repairs equipped weapons and armor. Includes weapons with exhausted durability.
While the effects of this spell are rather subtle, its foundations are a well-guarded secret. Light is time, and the reversal of its effects is a forbidden art.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 2,000 souls once he has been given the Golden Scroll.
entities.use: Restores 50 durability to all currently equipped weapons and armor, including weapons not currently being wielded. This applies to equipment that has been completely broken as well (e.g., has 0 durability).

entities.name: Snap Freeze
entities.desc:
One of the spells left behind by the young sorcerer Sulyvahn before leaving the Painted World. Creates a cloud of near-freezing mist.
Sulyvahn was born and raised inside the painting, yet had little use for his frigid homeland, since he had not yet experienced loss.
entities.avail: Located after the Depth of the Painting bonfire. Run to the left past the Great Crab and it will be on a corpse behind a Birch Woman.
entities.use: Creates a cloud of freezing mist, rapidly inflicting 15 Frost buildup per tick on enemies within. Cloud persists for 5 seconds, and the duration cannot be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

entities.name: Soul Arrow
entities.desc:
Elementary sorcery.
Fires a soul arrow.
To use sorceries, equip a staff and attune a sorcery at a bonfire.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Sorcerer class.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 2,000 souls.
  • Sold by Yoel of Londor (or Yuria of Londor after his death) for 1,000 souls.
  • Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 1,000 souls.
entities.use: The most basic form of Soul Arrow. Fires a soul arrow at the target, dealing 1.27 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage. Has a fast casting time.

entities.name: Soul Greatsword
entities.desc:
Sorcery developed for sorcerer-swordsman. Attacks with a greatsword formed from souls.
The ephemeral blade only exists as an extension of the caster, but its power is said to rival that of physical greatswords. Even the most obstinate magic purists may resort to this spell in times of crisis.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Yoel of Londor (or Yuria of Londor) for 5,000 souls.
  • Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for the same price.
entities.use: Forms a soul greatsword after a short delay, then swings it in a wide arc in front of the caster, dealing 2.0 times the Spell Buff of the wielded catalyst as Magic damage to all enemies struck.

entities.name: Soul Spear
entities.desc:
Sorcery developed by Big Hat Logan, the great sorcerer who left the Dragon School in an age long past.
Fires a soul spear.
The spear boasts superior penetrating power, and is testament to Logan's strength in battle.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 5,000 souls once he has been given Logan's Scroll.
entities.use: Fires a soul spear at the target, dealing 2.5 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Magic damage. The spear has a relatively short cast time and high travel speed, being capable of penetrating its target and hitting multiple foes at once if they are standing close together.

entities.name: Soul Stream
entities.desc:
Sorcery imparted by the first of the Scholars, when Lothric and the Grand Archives were but young.
Fires a torrential volley of souls.
The first of the Scholars doubted the linking of the fire, and was alleged to be a private mentor to the Royal Prince.
entities.avail: Found on the corpse of a sitting scholar in a short hallway beyond the Boreal Outrider Knight that is hidden behind an illusory wall on the fourth floor of the Grand Archives.
entities.use:
Soul Stream is notable in that it is the only Sorcery that requires two Attunement slots.

The caster charges their catalyst with power for a few seconds in preparation for firing the spell; during this time, it is possible to walk slowly to change position and aiming direction. Once charging is complete, a wide beam of powerful soul energy is unleashed, inflicting extreme amounts of Magic damage to any enemies caught within its path.

For the duration of the attack, no movement is possible. The stream inflicts 6 instances of damage throughout the attack, as well as stagger and knockdown on enemies caught within; each damage instance will deal between 0.8 to 1.2 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Magic damage, increasing in strength with each successive instance. Combined, all 6 damage instances will deal the most amount of raw damage of any Sorcery in the game.

The beam has a relatively long effect range, roughly the same range as a Soul Spear.

entities.name: Spook
entities.desc:
Sorcery developed by a certain surreptitious sorcerer at Vinheim Dragon School.
Masks noises of the caster and prevents fall damage.
Their mastery of this sorcery alone allows Vinheim spooks to demand handsome payment for their services.
entities.avail:
• Part of the Assassin class starting equipment.
  • Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim in Firelink Shrine for 2,000 souls.
entities.use: • Spook is one of the four Sorceries required to purchase, in order for Orbeck to bestow the Slumbering Dragoncrest Ring and "Silent Ally" gesture.

entities.name: Twisted Wall of Light
entities.desc:
Lost sorcery from Oolacile, land of ancient golden sorceries. Distorts light in order to deflect magic.
A closely-guarded light manipulation spell that contorts the very fabric of fundamental laws, negating magic by denying its claim to physicality.
entities.avail: Sold by Orbeck of Vinheim for 6,000 souls once he has been given the Golden Scroll.
entities.use: Deflects any magic attacks made against the player, similar to a Spell Parry.

entities.name: White Dragon Breath
entities.desc:
Sorcery of the deluded Consumed King Oceiros.
Emits crystal breath of Seath the Scaleless.
Crystal breath has piercing qualities.
Seath's research seemed to strike a chord with old Big Hat who, in his mad, disrobed state, made divine works such as this, his own. Oceiros was no doubt edified by this.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Consumed Oceiros with Ludleth of Courland for 10,000 souls.
entities.use: The caster charges and then fires a beam from their staff, forming a vertical line of crystals on the ground in front. Anything standing in the path of the beam as the crystals form will take Magic damage equal to 2.65 times the Spell Buff of the caster's catalyst.

entities.name: Atonement
entities.desc:
Miracle given to those cast out from the Sable Church of Londor.
Attracts more attention from foes.
This is the only tale known by exiles, who believe it carries words of forgiveness. Cursed journeys, too, must come to an end.
entities.avail:
Found in Farron Keep.

From the Farron Keep Perimeter bonfire, turn around and head further into the ruins. Look for a hole on the right wall and drop through it. The spell can be looted from a nearby corpse, along with another holding a Hollow Gem.
entities.use: Increases the enemies' aggro range toward the player. Lasts for 30 seconds.

entities.name: Blessed Weapon
entities.desc:
Miracle taught to Lothric Knights.
Blesses right weapon, increasing attack power, as well as gradually restoring HP.
The Knight is one of the Three Pillars of Lothric, said to have strengthened ties with the High Priestess after the Scholars acquired the Grand Archives.
entities.avail: Sold by Irina of Carim for 8,000 souls once she has been given the Braille Divine Tome of Lothric.
entities.use:
Buffs right-hand weapon, increasing Physical damage by 7.5%, and also gradually restoring HP for 45 seconds. The HP restored per second is 1 for every 50 Spell Buff of the casting tool used.

Additionally, the weapon gains the same properties as a Blessed-infused weapon, in that it will deal bonus damage to skeletons and prevent them from reviving.

entities.name: Bountiful Light
entities.desc:
Miracle taught to knights of Gertrude, holy maiden to the Queen.
Gradually restores a large amount of HP.
The Heavenly Daughter is said to be the Queen's child.
entities.avail: Sold by Irina of Carim for 5,000 souls once she has been given the Braille Divine Tome of Lothric.
entities.use:
Restores 7 HP per second for 58-59 seconds, for a total of 406-413 HP.

The duration of the heal, and thus amount of HP recovered, cannot be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

entities.name: Bountiful Sunlight
entities.desc:
Special Miracle granted by the Princess of Sunlight.
Gradually restores a large amount of HP for self and those in the vicinity.
The miracles of Gwynevere, loved as both mother and wife, bestow their blessing on a great many warriors.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Rosaria with Ludleth of Courland for 0 souls.
entities.use:
Restores 10 HP per second for 58-59 seconds, for a total of 580-590 HP, for caster and all nearby allies.

The duration of the heal can be extended by using the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring, but this only decreases the rate at which the spell heals with no effect on the total amount healed.

entities.name: Caressing Tears
entities.desc:
Miracle taught by Morne, the Archbishop's apostle.
Cures bleed, poison, and frost for self and those in the vicinity.
Caressing Tears is a tale of the many deaths surrounding the goddess Caitha, of whom Morne was a known follower.
entities.avail: Sold by Irina of Carim for 1,500 souls.
entities.use: Cures Bleed, Poison, Toxic and Frost for self and those in the vicinity. Also removes buildup of the above status effects if they have not procced.

entities.name: Dark Blade
entities.desc:
Miracle of the Sable Church of Londor.
Reinforces weapons with dark.
The third daughter Liliane, one of the founders of the Sable Church, is said to recount tales that portray the suffering and conflict of Hollows.
entities.avail: Sold by Irina of Carim or Karla for 10,000 souls once either of them has been given the Londor Braille Divine Tome.
entities.use: Reinforces right hand weapon with Dark damage. It adds 85% of an equipped talisman/sacred chime's Spell Buff as Dark damage for the next 60 seconds.

entities.name: Darkmoon Blade
entities.desc:
Miracle of those who devoted themselves to the Darkmoon covenant.
Reinforces right weapon with Darkmoon light.
Miracles of the Darkmoon are tales of revenge, but Captain Yorshka recites only for the sake of remembering her brother, without knowledge of its meaning.
Perhaps this is better, as revenge is better left to the Blades.
entities.avail: Obtained as a reward for reaching Rank 2 in the Blade of the Darkmoon covenant. To achieve this, the player must offer 30 Proofs of a Concord Kept to Company Captain Yorshka.
entities.use:
Reinforces the player's right hand weapon with Darkmoon light, adding 95% of casting talisman/sacred chime's Spell Buff as Magic damage for the next 60 seconds.

Lingering Dragoncrest Ring increases the duration to 78 seconds.

For catalysts that scale with both Intelligence and Faith, such as Caitha's Chime and White Hair Talisman, only the Faith portion of the Spell Buff is accounted for.

entities.name: Dead Again
entities.desc:
Sacrilegious miracle of the Sable Church of Londor
Bless corpses, transforming them into traps.
Londor, the Hollow Realm, is a society of undead, comprised of the corpses and shades of those who led unsavory lives. Is such blessing really something one must ponder?
entities.avail: Sold by Irina of Carim or Karla for 5,000 souls once either of them has been given the Londor Braille Divine Tome.
entities.use:
Upon cast, a droplet of energy is released from the catalyst and lands on the ground. This will bless the three closest corpses to the caster, within a moderate radius. These corpses will explode after a brief delay, inflicting Dark damage to any nearby foes. The explosions can hit multiple foes.

The damage dealt by each explosion is a flat amount determined solely by the caster's Faith. It is not affected by wielding a catalyst that boosts the power of Dark Spells, such as the Sunless Talisman, nor is it affected by spell boosting equipment or Spell Buff (and therefore the upgrade level of the catalyst or increases from Ring of the Sun's First Born or Awakening). However, each explosion's damage output can be increased by secondary pieces of equipment that affect Dark damage, such as the Blindfold Mask, Dark Clutch Ring and Red Tearstone Ring.

The damage for each explosion is expressed as follows:

FaithDamage
23-29350
30-39450
40-49550
50-59650
60-69710
70-79770
80-99830

entities.name: Deep Protection
entities.desc:
Miracle taught to inaugurated deacons of the Cathedral of the Deep
Slightly boosts attack, damage absorption, and resistance, while also increasing stamina and recovery speed.
The deep was originally a peaceful and sacred place, but became the final rest for many abhorrent things. This tale of the Deep offers protection for those who worship amidst those horrors.
entities.avail: Sold by Irina of Carim or Karla for 4,000 souls once either of them has been given the Deep Braille Divine Tome.
entities.use:
Increases damage absorption across the board by 5%, status effect resistance by 20 in all categories, damage dealt by all weapons and spells by 5%, and stamina regeneration by 3 points per second. Buff lasts for 60 seconds.

In PvP, increases damage absorption by 2% and damage dealt by 2%.

entities.name: Divine Pillars of Light
entities.desc:
Miracle of Gertrude, the Heavenly Daughter.
Brings down multiple pillars of light in the vicinity.
The Queen's holy maiden Gertrude was visited by an angel, who revealed this tale to her.
Despite losing both her sight and her voice, she was determined to record the tale. Ordinary men cannot decipher her fragmentary scrawl, nor comprehend how it became the foundation of the Angelic faith of Lothric.
entities.avail: Found in the Grand Archives, on Gertrude's lifeless body lying inside a large bird cage at the top of the archives. To reach it, enter the tower guarded by the three Gertrude's Knights and drop through the open hatch inside. Make way through the rafters and drop through the open door on top of the cage.
entities.use:
When cast, multiple pillars of light will erupt at random points around the caster over a period of several seconds, each dealing 1.9 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as physical damage and knocking most opponents into the air. Each pillar is regarded as its own separate damage instance, meaning that getting hit by a pillar early in the cast will not prevent an enemy from being hit by another one in the same cast instance.

FP cost is based on the number of pillars summoned. Upon initial cast, 13 FP is consumed, and additional FP for each pillar afterward. A maximum of 15 pillars (including the one from the initial cast) can be called down for a total cost of 55 FP. Interrupting the caster will also halt the FP consumption of the Miracle.

entities.name: Dorhys' Gnawing
entities.desc:
Miracle of Dorhys the deranged evangelist.
Summons great insect swarm to feast on foes.
Those who linger too long on the brink of the Deep will often slip. Dorhys is sure to have wallowed in this darkness, intoxicated by its peril.
entities.avail:
Guaranteed drop from the Evangelist in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

From the Central Irithyll bonfire, players must make their way past the plaza guarded by Irithyllian Slaves and Fire Witches. After veering to the left past the second Fire Witch and the pair of Pontiff Knights, a small terrace with a Crystal Lizard can be found. The banister closest to the building on the right-hand side is illusory, and will reveal a staircase once hit.

Heading down these stairs will bring the player to a smaller terrace guarded by another Pontiff Knight, and taking the next set of stairs leads to a ledge overlooking a courtyard. The Evangelist can be fought upon dropping down into this area, though she can also be fought from the ledge itself with magic or archery. The spell is awarded as soon as she is defeated.
entities.use:
A stronger variant of Gnaw. Fires a swarm of insects at the target, inflicting 1.2 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Dark damage and dealing 210 Bleed build-up. As a Dark Miracle, it is subject to augmentation from being cast using a Dark catalyst like Sunless Talisman.

<tabber>Official translation= Miracle of Dorhys the deranged evangelist.

Summons great insect swarm to feast on foes.

Those who linger too long on the brink of the Deep will often slip. Dorhys is sure to have wallowed in this darkness, intoxicated by its peril. |-|Original description (Japanese) = 狂った教導師、ドーリスの奇跡

蟲の大群を召喚し、敵を酷く蝕む

深みの縁に立つ者は、ときに足を滑らせる 彼女は肥え、きっと酔ってもいたのだろう |-|Literal translation = Miracle of Doris, the mad preacher.

Summons a swarm of insects that severely devour the enemy.

Those who stand at the edge of the Deep sometimes slip to the bottom. She was fattened and must have been intoxicated. </tabber>

entities.name: Emit Force
entities.desc:
Traditional miracle of Catarina.
Releases a shockwave in front.
The people of lands known for festivity and drink are typically outspoken. One can be sure that they will not bottle their emotions, instead venting anger and the like with confidence.
entities.avail: Obtained as a gift from Siegward of Catarina by exhausting his dialogue in the kitchen found after the sewer area in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
entities.use:
The caster briefly charges an orb, and then launches it forward. The orb will explode upon impact, inflicting 1.2 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as physical damage with direct contact, and stagger or knock down enemies caught in the explosion. The explosion inflicts 0.6 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst.

The orb has a long travel distance and does not arc, allowing the caster to knock down targets from very far away.

entities.name: Force
entities.desc:
Elementary miracle among clerics.
Creates a shockwave.
While it inflicts no direct damage,
this miracle propels foes back, staggering them.
Can also defend against incoming arrows.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Cleric class.
  • Sold by Irina of Carim for 1,000 souls once she has been given the Braille Divine Tome of Carim.
entities.use:
Propels enemies back, staggering them. Inflicts no damage. Can be used to neutralize incoming arrows.

Affected foes will be knocked in the facing direction of the caster. Mechanically, it inflicts the knockdown via Poise damage, so it is possible to ignore the spell's effects with enough Hyper Armor or via Unfaltering Prayer cast from the Sunlight Talisman.

entities.name: Gnaw
entities.desc:
Dark miracle taught in the Cathedral of the Deep.
Summons insect swarm to feast on foes.
These insects which lurk in the Deep have tiny jaws lined with fangs to tear open the skin and burrow into the flesh in the blink of an eye, causing intense bleeding.
entities.avail: Sold by Irina of Carim or Karla for 2,000 souls once either of them has been given the Deep Braille Divine Tome.
entities.use:
Fires a swarm of insects at the target, inflicting 0.9 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Dark damage and dealing 150 Bleed build-up. As a Dark Miracle, it is subject to augmentation from being cast using a Dark catalyst like Sunless Talisman.

<tabber>Official translation= Dark miracle taught in the Cathedral of the Deep.

Summons insect swarm to feast on foes.

These insects which lurk in the Deep have tiny jaws lined with fangs to tear open the skin and burrow into the flesh in the blink of an eye, causing intense bleeding. |-|Original description (Japanese) = 深みの聖堂に伝わる暗い奇跡

蟲の群れを召喚し、敵を蝕む

深みに潜む蟲たちは、小さな顎に牙を持ち 瞬く間に皮膚を裂き、肉に潜り込む それは激しい出血を伴うという |-|Literal translation = Dark miracle told in the Church of the Deep.

Summons a swarm of insects to devour the enemy.

The insects that lurk in the Deep have small jaws with fangs that tear the skin and burrow into the flesh in the blink of an eye. It is said to be accompanied by severe bleeding. </tabber>

entities.name: Great Heal
entities.desc:
Glorious miracle used by high-ranking clerics. Restores a large amount of HP for self and those in the vicinity.
Only a select few have learned to recite the epic tale in its entirety, but those who do are amply rewarded.
entities.avail:
Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

Upon reaching the swamp area below the city, past the dark room filled with Irithyllian Slaves, follow the right side to find the corpse of a Man-grub holding the spell. It is guarded by two Sewer Centipedes.
entities.use:
Restores HP for the caster and nearby allies equal to 5.5 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst, and consumes 205 stamina. For catalysts that also scale with Intelligence such as Crystal Chime and Sunless Talisman, only the Spell Buff from Faith is taken into account.

Due to the high stamina cost of this spell, action after casting is severely restricted, preventing the caster from rolling or attacking immediately after.

entities.name: Great Lightning Spear
entities.desc:
Primal account of Lightning Spear, which tells of an ancestral dragonslayer.
Hurls a giant lightning spear.
Gwyn, the First Lord, slew dragons with his sunlight spear, a tradition upheld by his firstborn and the greatspear he wielded.
Much of this resplendent tale of father and son, while epic, remains tragically untold.
entities.avail: Obtained as a reward for reaching Rank 2 in the Warrior of Sunlight covenant. To achieve this, the player must offer 30 Sunlight Medals to the Sunlight Altar in Lothric Castle.
entities.use:
Conjures a large spear made of Lightning, then hurls it at the target. The projectile inflicts 1.85 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Lightning damage.

When cast at extremely close range, the spear will inflict an additional 1.45 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Lightning damage. A successful point-blank cast will also result in vibration feedback through the player's controller, providing confirmation of inflicting additional damage.

entities.name: Great Magic Barrier
entities.desc:
The tale which was later interpreted as Magic Barrier.
Greatly increases the magic damage absorption by covering the body in a strong white protective coating.
Said to be a tale of Havel the Rock, arch enemy of Seath the Scaleless. Havel despised magic, and was never complacent in preparing means to counter it.
entities.avail: Found in Archdragon Peak. From the rooftop where Havel the Rock stands before a dead wyvern, hug the left and drop down into a hidden area below. Follow the path to where a Rock Lizard guards the miracle.
entities.use:
Increases Magic absorption by 60%. Buff lasts for 70 seconds.

Unlike most other buffs, this value is the same in PvP.

entities.name: Heal
entities.desc:
Elementary miracle cast by clerics. Restores HP for self and those in the vicinity.
To use miracles, equip a talisman or sacred chime and attune a miracle at a bonfire.
entities.avail:
• Starting spell for Cleric class.
  • Sold by Irina of Carim for 1,000 souls.
entities.use: Restores HP for the caster and nearby allies equal to 3 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst, and consumes 92 stamina. For catalysts that also scale with Intelligence such as Crystal Chime and Sunless Talisman, only the Spell Buff from Faith is taken into account.

entities.name: Heal Aid
entities.desc:
Miracle imparted as charity to those of little faith.
Slightly restores HP.
To use miracles, equip a talisman or sacred chime and attune a miracle at a bonfire.
entities.avail:
• Starting spell for Herald class.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 500 souls.
entities.use:
Restores HP for the caster equal to 1.5 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst, and consumes 61 stamina. For catalysts that also scale with Intelligence such as Crystal Chime and Sunless Talisman, only the Spell Buff from Faith is taken into account.

Unlike other healing Miracles, this spell does not force the caster to kneel down in prayer, and casts extremely quickly. However, it only heals the user and not nearby allies, unlike the other healing Miracles.

entities.name: Homeward
entities.desc:
Miracle taught to traveling clerics. Returns caster to the last bonfire used for resting, or to the bonfire in the shrine.
It would normally link to one's homeland, only the curse of the Undead has twisted its power, redirecting casters to a bonfire. Perhaps for the Undead, the bonfire serves as home.
entities.avail: Sold by Irina of Carim for 3,000 souls.
entities.use: Casting this miracle will present the player with the option of teleporting to either Firelink Shrine or to the last bonfire they rested at.

entities.name: Lifehunt Scythe
entities.desc:
Miracle of Aldrich, Devourer of Gods.
Steals HP of foes using an illusory scythe.
Aldrich dreamt as he slowly devoured the God of the Darkmoon. In this dream, he perceived the form of a young, pale girl in hiding.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of Aldrich with Ludleth of Courland for 5,000 souls.
entities.use:
When cast, a scythe will materialize in the caster's hands, which is then swiped in an arc in front of the caster. The scythe inflicts 2.05 times the catalyst's Spell Buff as Dark damage, and is subject to modification by casting with a dark catalyst like the Sunless Talisman.

Upon hit, this spell also restores HP on the caster, between 0.73 and 0.88 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst, being more effective with higher Faith; if multiple targets are hit, the caster will be healed multiple times. Unlike its damage, however, the heal does not scale with Intelligence, making it less effective depending on the catalyst used.

entities.name: Lightning Arrow
entities.desc:
The few female knights who served in the age of the gods used this miracle for dragonslaying.
Draw lightning bow to fire a lightning arrow.
The lightning arrows offer a great improvement to the range of the spears, and were said to have been used to pierce the eyes of the dragons from afar.
But remember, beautiful stories are always marked by embellishment.
entities.avail:
Found in The Ringed City, after the Shared Grave bonfire.

In the building with the shortcut to the Ringed Inner Wall bonfire, in the lowest room, hit the wall to the right of the stairs to reveal an Illusory Wall containing a Hobbled Cleric. Past the cleric are two more Illusory Walls, beyond which this miracle can be found.
entities.use:
The caster conjures a bow and arrow made of Lightning and holds it ready.

Much like a regular bow and arrow, the projectile remains nocked while the cast button is held, and is fired upon its release; there is a delay before the arrow can be released, which is subject to casting speed. FP is only consumed upon launching the arrow, and the spell can be cancelled by rolling out at any time. When casting this Miracle with a Talisman, using the Unfaltering Prayer weapon art will allow the player to retain their Hyper Armor up until the projectile is released.

The arrow inflicts 1.6 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Lightning damage. While it does not have the point-blank bonus modifier of the Lightning Spear family of Miracles, Lightning Arrow has significantly more range and a higher travel speed, making it much harder to dodge. As well, it costs less FP than Lightning Spear, allowing the caster to use it more frequently before having to replenish their Focus Points.

<tabber>Official translation= The few female knights who served in the age of the gods used this miracle for dragonslaying.

Draw lightning bow to fire a lightning arrow.

The lightning arrows offer a great improvement to the range of the spears, and were said to have been used to pierce the eyes of the dragons from afar. But remember, beautiful stories are always marked by embellishment. |-|Original description (Japanese) = 神々の時代、数少ない女騎士たちが 竜狩りに用いた奇跡

雷の弓を引き絞り、雷の矢を射る

槍に比べて射程距離に優れ 彼方から竜の瞳を射抜いたともいう 美々しい物語には、誇張が付き物だ |-|Literal translation = Miracle used by the few female knights that hunt dragons in the Age of the Gods.

Draw the lightning bow and shoot a lightning arrow.

It has a greater range compared to a spear, and is said to have been able to pierce a dragon's eye from the distance. Beautiful stories are often full of exaggerations. </tabber>

entities.name: Lightning Blade
entities.desc:
Miracle allegedly wielded by a certain dragonslayer knight in the Age of Gods.
Reinforces right weapon with lightning.
Tales of dragonslayers are now a rare thing, told only in fragments and whispers in remote regions.
entities.avail: Found in Irithyll Dungeon. Take the left-hand exit upon reaching the bottom floor of the dungeon patrolled by multiple Jailers, towards the statues praying towards Archdragon Peak, and find the elevator that leads back up to the upper cell blocks. Activate the elevator, then turn around and drop off it on the way up. The Miracle can be found on a corpse hidden in an alcove.
entities.use:
Reinforces right-hand weapon with Lightning. Adds 95% of equipped talisman/sacred chime's Spell Buff as Lightning damage for 60 seconds.

Lingering Dragoncrest Ring increases the duration to 78 seconds.

entities.name: Lightning Spear
entities.desc:
Miracle allegedly used by Warriors of Sunlight.
Hurls a lightning Spear.
The spears inflict lightning damage, providing an effective counter to magic or fire. Especially powerful against metal armor and dragons.
entities.avail:
Found in Farron Keep.

From the Old Wolf of Farron bonfire, take the lift up and climb the stairs to the right. Turn towards the closed gate opposite the Stray Demon and search for a broken railing that can be dropped through onto several ledges that lead beyond the gate. The miracle can be found in an open area amongst two Crystal Lizards, near a dead wyvern.
entities.use:
Conjures a spear made of Lightning, then hurls it at the target. The projectile inflicts 1.45 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Lightning damage.

When cast at extremely close range, the spear will inflict an additional 1.15 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Lightning damage. A successful point-blank cast will also result in vibration feedback through the player's controller, providing confirmation of inflicting additional damage.

entities.name: Lightning Stake
entities.desc:
A lost dragonslaying miracle.
Strikes with a stake of lightning.
This tale describes the lost practices of ancient dragonslayers, who found that in order to pierce dragonscale, lightning should not be hurled as a bolt, but rather be thrust as a stake directly into the dragon's hide, to be truly effective.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Carthus Sand Worm in the Smouldering Lake.
entities.use:
The caster conjures a large stake made of Lightning, and then plunges it into the ground. The spell has a very short range, but inflicts damage in an area around the impact point.

The stake can inflict up to four instances of damage, depending on how long any valid targets are standing within the impact radius. In quick succession, the stake will deal 0.9, 1.45, 1.45 and 0.8 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Lightning damage to any enemies that are immediately in front of the caster. While short-ranged, the combined total damage will exceed that dealt by Great Lightning Spear.

entities.name: Lightning Storm
entities.desc:
Miracle of the Nameless King, ally to the ancient dragons.
Calls forth furious bolts of lightning.
Once a slayer of dragons, the former king and wargod tamed a Stormdrake, on which he led a lifetime of battle. This miracle is likely a tale of their bond.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Nameless King with Ludleth of Courland for 5,000 souls.
entities.use:
The caster charges the catalyst for a short period of time, then releases power, creating numerous arcs of Lightning at the caster's feet that radiate outward. The shockwave from the cast, as well as each individual Lightning arc, will inflict 1.3 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Lightning damage and 166 Fire damage.

Each individual arc is capable of inflicting repeated instances of damage to any enemy that stands within its immediate area, allowing this spell to hit the same target numerous times, being more damaging the closer they are standing to the caster. The concentrated nature of the Lightning arcs makes this spell extremely difficult if outright impossible to roll through, meaning that the only way to avoid damage is to stand far away from the caster.

entities.name: Magic Barrier
entities.desc:
Miracle of clerics who wield weapons.
Increases magic damage absorption by covering the body in a white protective coating.
There was a short period in history where clerics and sorcerers opposed one another. Thus it became necessary for even simple clerics to have some means of opposing magic.
entities.avail: Sold by Irina of Carim for 5,000 souls once she has been given the Braille Divine Tome of Lothric.
entities.use:
Increases Magic absorption by 35%. Buff lasts for 90 seconds, or 1 minute and 30 seconds.

Unlike most other buffs, this value is the same in PvP.

entities.name: Med Heal
entities.desc:
Miracle superior to Heal.
Restores moderate HP for self and those in the vicinity.
Miracles are fruit of the study of divine tales, a blessing received from the gods, through acts of prayer. Miracle strength depends on the caster's faith.
entities.avail: • Sold by Irina of Carim for 3,500 souls once she has been given the Braille Divine Tome of Carim.
entities.use:
Restores HP for the caster and nearby allies equal to 4.1 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst, and consumes 123 stamina. For catalysts that also scale with Intelligence such as Crystal Chime and Sunless Talisman, only the Spell Buff from Faith is taken into account.

This is the highest tier instant-heal Miracle that does not completely deplete the stamina bar of the caster upon completion. Thus, it allows for action immediately after the spell ends, such as rolling to evade incoming danger.

entities.name: Projected Heal
entities.desc:
A miracle discovered in the last days of Lothric. Toss a light that heals those near the point of impact.
Even those who had forgotten the caress and bounty of the Princess of Sunlight did their best to recall her image. The stories spun about her were most certainly childish, and yet gravely sincere.
entities.avail: Found in The Dreg Heap. After meeting Amnesiac Lapp for the first time, progress through the area past him guarded by numerous Murkmen. Upon reaching the area overlooking the Harald Legion Knight, look to the right, where there is an ash pile at the bottom of a drop leading to a battlement remnant being patrolled by a banner-wielding Lothric Knight and several Murkmen. Drop onto the ash pile below and clear the area, the Miracle will be on a corpse behind a summoning Murkman.
entities.use: The caster fires an orb that heals everything in its vicinity upon hitting a surface. Has the same animation as Emit Force. All allied players affected by the spell will be healed for 1.7 times the Spell Buff rating of the catalyst. For catalysts that also scale with Intelligence such as Crystal Chime and Sunless Talisman, only the Spell Buff from Faith is taken into account.

entities.name: Replenishment
entities.desc:
Miracle once cherished by cleric knights. Gradually restores HP.
Replenishment is a relic of the old Lloyd faith, whose cleric knights were unfaltering in battle.
entities.avail: Sold by Irina of Carim for 1,000 souls.
entities.use:
Restores 5 HP per second for 58-59 seconds, for a total of 290-295 HP.

The duration of the heal, and thus amount of HP recovered, cannot be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

entities.name: Sacred Oath
entities.desc:
Miracle of those chosen by the Sunlight covenant.
Temporarily boosts attack and damage absorption for self and those in the vicinity.
This is the tale of the Sun's firstborn, his faithful first knight, and the brave dragonslayer who served them both.
entities.avail: Obtained as a reward for reaching Rank 1 in the Warrior of Sunlight covenant.
entities.use: Increases damage absorption by 10% across the board, while also increasing damage dealt with all weapons and spells by 10%, for 60 seconds. In PvP, the effects are 5% absorption and 5% damage bonus.

entities.name: Seek Guidance
entities.desc:
Miracle of stray souls.
Displays more help from other worlds and reveals summon signs without using an ember.
Faith serves as a guide for clerics, meaning they should have no need for secondhand wisdom. Be that as it may, this miracle has been passed down from soul to soul, providing a tiny ray of hope for the lost.
entities.avail: Found in the Cathedral of the Deep. Head past the first Giant Slave on the second floor and take the path on the left after descending a small set of stairs. Follow this path to the end to reach a corpse holding the miracle under a Writhing Rotten Flesh.
entities.use:
Displays extra messages, as well as developer-set messages. Reveals the location of summon signs without the use of an Ember.

Does not allow the player to summon phantoms while unembered.

entities.name: Soothing Sunlight
entities.desc:
Special miracle granted to the maidens of the Princess of Sunlight.
Restores a large amount of HP for self and those in the general area.
The miracles of Gwynevere, the princess cherished by all, bestow their blessing on a great many warriors.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Dancer and 5,000 souls with Ludleth of Courland.
entities.use:
Restores HP for the caster and allies within the general area equal to 7 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst, and consumes 205 stamina. For catalysts that also scale with Intelligence such as Crystal Chime and Sunless Talisman, only the Spell Buff from Faith is taken into account.

Due to the high stamina cost of this spell, action after casting is severely restricted, preventing the caster from rolling or attacking immediately after.

entities.name: Sunlight Spear
entities.desc:
Miracle of Gwyn, the First Lord.
Hurls a sunlight spear.
The tales of Gwyn's Archdragon hunts describe the inception of the Age of Fire.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Lords with Ludleth of Courland for 10,000 souls.
entities.use:
The strongest variant of the Lightning Spear family of Miracles. Conjures a deep-colored spear made of Lightning, then hurls it at the target. The projectile inflicts 2.6 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Lightning damage.

When cast at extremely close range, the spear will inflict an additional 1.9 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Lightning damage. A successful point-blank cast will also result in vibration feedback through the player's controller, providing confirmation of inflicting additional damage.

While extremely damaging, Sunlight Spear is also very costly in terms of FP.

entities.name: Tears of Denial
entities.desc:
Miracle taught by Morne, the Archbishop's apostle.
Grants one chance to endure when HP reaches 0.
Intended to grant the dying a few moments for a final farewell. Tears are shed for the sake of the living, more so than the deceased.
entities.avail: Sold by Irina of Carim for 10,000 souls once she has been given the Braille Divine Tome of Carim.
entities.use: When Tears of Denial is in effect, it will allow the player to survive a single killing blow, leaving them at 1 HP.

entities.name: Vow of Silence
entities.desc:
Miracle of the Sable Church of Londor.
Prevents spells in the vicinity, including one's own.
Members of the Sable Church are all trained swordsmen, each sworn only to their weapons as they bear the leaden silence of Londor.
entities.avail: Sold by either Irina or Karla for 15,000 souls after giving one of them the Londor Braille Divine Tome.
entities.use:
Prevents usage of magic in the area, including the caster, for 15 seconds.

Duration is increased on affected targets if they are wearing a Lingering Dragoncrest Ring. This applies to the one who casts this miracle as well.

entities.name: Way of White Corona
entities.desc:
A lost Way of White miracle. Launches a white discus which slices into foes and returns to the conjurer.
Long ago, when the imprints left by the gods were still deep, miracles of the Way of White existed alongside aureoles.
Those who yearned for the long-lost aureoles fully believed that they would return, one day.
entities.avail: Found inside a chapel near the end of the Corvian Settlement, after ascending to the top of the settlement and traversing a cliff-side then dropping into the building. It is guarded by two Corvian Knights, one of each variant.
entities.use:
The caster quickly conjures a white discus and launches it forward. The discus deals 0.85 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as physical damage.

The disc will be destroyed upon hitting any solid level geometry, such as walls and floors. If it travels the full distance it will hover in place, dealing damage up to 3 times at its location, before returning to the caster, also inflicting damage as it returns. Thus, including the travel forward and back, Way of White Corona can inflict up to 5 instances of damage in a single cast. Multiple instances of this Miracle can be active at once.

entities.name: Wrath of the Gods
entities.page: Wrath of the Gods (Dark Souls III)
entities.desc:
Primal form of Force. Creates a powerful shockwave.
Wrath of the Gods is an epic tale, while Force is but a woefully incomplete version of that yarn.
This primal account of profound fury emits a shockwave that also inflicts damage.
entities.avail: Found within the Profaned Capital. In the area with the toxic swamp, climb up to the roof of the main building. There will be a hole in the wall, next to the Court Sorcerer. Drop down to find the spell on a corpse.
entities.use:
The caster charges themselves with energy, and then releases it in an explosive shockwave centered around the caster. While the spell is charging, the caster can slowly walk and hold it at the ready. The explosion inflicts 3.2 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as physical damage, and knocks down any enemies caught by it.

Due to the moderately slow casting time, it is recommended that a talisman be used to cast as they have the Unfaltering Prayer skill, which grants the user temporary Hyper Armor and thus greatly decreases the chances of the spell being interrupted. The Sunlight Talisman provides the strongest poise in its skill.

entities.name: Acid Surge
entities.desc:
Pyromancy of Carthus of the Sands.
Emits an acid which corrodes weapons and armor.
Carthus' swordsmen attached great value to victory, and would not shun the use of such pyromancies. For where is the honor in death and scoured bones?
entities.avail: Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 6,000 souls once he has been given the Carthus Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use:
The caster spews a cloud of corrosive mist, which damages the durability of all applicable equipment of enemies caught within by about 2 points per second. Cloud persists for 5-6 seconds and moves forward from the caster upon cast, meaning that each cast has the potential to reduce target durability by up to 12 points.

The durability damage inflicted by Acid Surge cannot be mitigated by wearing the Wood Grain Ring.

entities.name: Black Fire Orb
entities.desc:
Pyromancy discovered by grave wardens after High Lord Wolnir fell to the Abyss.
Hurls a black fireball.
The black flame inflicts dark damage, striking targets with weighty force.
entities.avail: Sold by Karla for 10,000 souls once she has been given the Grave Warden Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use: Hurls a black fireball at the target, inflicting 2.4 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Dark damage. Enemies caught in the explosion at the impact point rather than being hit by the fireball itself will take only 2.2 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Dark damage.

entities.name: Black Flame
entities.desc:
Pyromancy discovered by grave wardens after High Lord Wolnir fell to the Abyss.
Creates a giant, black flame in hand.
Black flames born from the Abyss bear no shadow. They are said to be the impenetrable fires of humanity.
entities.avail: Sold by Karla for 10,000 souls once she has been given the Grave Warden Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use: Creates a dark explosion from the palm of the caster's hand, inflicting 2.4 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Dark damage. If a target is only caught in the flames lingering after the initial explosion, they will take only 2.2 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Dark damage.

entities.name: Black Serpent
entities.desc:
Pyromancy discovered from the Abyss by High Lord Wolnir that inspired the black arts of the grave wardens.
Releases undulating black flames that trace the ground.
Be it sorcery or pyromancy, all techniques that infringe on humanity lead to the same place. That is to say, they all seek a will of their own.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of High Lord Wolnir with Ludleth of Courland.
entities.use: The caster conjures a rippling black flame at their feet that surges forward and weaves across the ground, tracking on the locked-on target. Has minor homing capability, and inflicts 1.65 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Dark damage to enemies it passes through.

entities.name: Boulder Heave
entities.desc:
Art of a stray demon of stifled flame.
Spews a boulder from one's mouth.
The boulder is heavy, but shatters easily.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of a Stray Demon with Ludleth of Courland for 0 souls.

entities.name: Bursting Fireball
entities.desc:
Pyromancy of old restored by Cornyx. One of the Great Swamp's more advanced spells.
Hurls an exploding fireball.
A rare technique that undergoes change after leaving the caster's hand, making this a spell renowned for its difficulty.
entities.avail: Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 5,000 souls once he has been given the Great Swamp Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use: Throws a fireball that immediately splits into 11 smaller splinters, which spread out in a fan in front of the caster. Each splinter inflicts 0.71 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage to any enemies caught, and multiple splinters can hit the same target.

entities.name: Carthus Beacon
entities.desc:
The most obscure pyromancy developed in Carthus of the Sands.
Damage increases with consecutive attacks.
Carthus's aggression has been likened to an uncontrollable fire, and since ancient times its beacon has been used as a signal for war.
entities.avail: Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 8,000 souls once he has been given the Carthus Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use:
Damage increases by 7-15% with consecutive attacks, as long as attacking persists and is not interrupted. The base effect works on spells but the further damage increase does not.

Buff lasts for 30 seconds and does not stack with Power Within.

entities.name: Carthus Flame Arc
entities.desc:
Pyromancy of Carthus of the Sands. Reinforces right weapon with flame.
Warriors of Carthus favored supplemental pyromancies such as this, which was used to enhance the curved blades of its swordsmen.
entities.avail: Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 10,000 souls once he has been given the Carthus Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use:
Reinforces right-hand weapon with Fire. Added damage is dependent on the Spell Buff rating of the tool used, and is not affected by spell-boosting rings like the Great Swamp Ring:
