Base duration of the buff is 90 seconds, which can be increased via equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

entities.name: Chaos Bed Vestiges
entities.desc:
Traces of the tumultuous seedbed that birthed the beings known as Demons.
Hurls chaos flame that scorches vicinity.
Demons born from fire bore its smoldering essence and perished soon after. Man shares this rapport with the flames to this day.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Old Demon King with Ludleth of Courland for 5,000 souls.
entities.use:
If this spell hits directly, it causes great damage; excluding the lava pool produced by Great Chaos Fire Orb, this spell is the most powerful direct-damage pyromancy in the game. While both Great Chaos Fire Orb and Seething Chaos can deal more damage under optimal circumstances, enemies can move away from the lava pool left by Great Chaos Fire Orb, and Seething Chaos requires manipulation and timing in order to deal the most damage.

Unlike its predecessor, Chaos Bed Vestiges does not leave a lava pool, has less range and will begin to arc after a shorter distance (approximately slightly longer than Fire Orb). However, it is easier to reach enemies at higher elevations with this spell than it is with the various "fireball" spells. As well, like its predecessor, its extremely short cast time and fast travel speed allows players to use this spell to quickly punish enemies' openings.

entities.name: Chaos Storm
entities.desc:
Art of the Flame of Chaos, from Ancient Izalith. Erects multiple chaos fire pillars in vicinity.
Chaotic flame melts even great boulders, and creates a brief surge of molten lava on impact.
The all-engulfing Chaos Flame eventually formed a tumultuous seedbed, which birthed the twisted things known as Demons.
entities.avail: Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 12,000 souls once he has been given the Izalith Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use:
The caster focuses power in the catalyst, and then lays down a sweeping wide blanket of erupting fire pillars. Each pillar will inflict 1.95 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage and knock any targets skyward. After eruption, a lava pool will persist at the eruption point, inflicting 0.9 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage to any enemy that touches it.

The FP cost of this spell is expressed per-pillar. Upon initial successful cast, the spell will consume 13 FP (11 FP with the Dusk Crown Ring equipped), and additional Focus is consumed as each pillar materializes. A maximum of 15 pillars (including the one created by the initial cast) can be conjured in a single cast of this spell, resulting in total consumption of 55 FP (53 FP with Dusk Crown Ring equipped).

entities.name: Fire Orb
entities.desc:
The signature flame-manipulating spell common to pyromancers. Hurls a giant fire orb.
The blazing fire orb explodes on impact, dealing fire damage to the surrounding area.
They say that once a pyromancer learns this spell, their understanding of the flame deepens, together with a yearning for it.
entities.avail: Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 3,000 souls once he has been given the Great Swamp Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use:
Hurls a fire orb at the target, inflicting 2.25 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage. If the target is only caught in the splash of the explosion, they will take 2.1 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage.

Due to peculiarities in scaling it doesn't benefit from the Faith scaling of a Pyromancy Flame unless a minimum level of Intelligence has been reached: starting at 22 Intelligence for a +0 Flame and gradually going down to 18 Intelligence for a +10 Flame.

entities.name: Fire Surge
entities.desc:
Pyromancy of Cornyx of the Great Swamp. Emits a constant stream of fire.
Cornyx is a venerable pyromancer of an older mold, said to have restored a number of spells lost to the past, amongst which this is the most well-known.
entities.avail: Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 1,000 souls.
entities.use: Emits a constant stream of fire, with each tick inflicting 0.67 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage.

entities.name: Fire Whip
entities.desc:
Primal pyromancy taught by Quelana, daughter of the Witch of Izalith. Sweeps foes with a fire whip.
The caster manipulates the flames at will, making this an extremely difficult spell to use.
Pyromancy is at once the knowledge of controlling flame, and the knowledge that control is impossible.
entities.avail: Sold by Karla for 10,000 souls once she has been given the Quelana Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use:
The caster conjures a sweeping flame at point-blank range and waves it back and forth. The whip inflicts 0.65 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage for each instance that hits an enemy.

The FP cost of the spell is expressed per-instance. The whip will lash for 17 to 19 instances, consuming FP as each instance materializes, resulting in a total consumption of 34 to 38 FP.

entities.name: Fireball
entities.desc:
Elementary pyromancy that is often the first learned. Hurls a fireball.
To use pyromancies, equip a pyromancy flame and attune a pyromancy at a bonfire.
entities.avail:
• Starting equipment for the Pyromancer class.
  • Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 1,000 souls.
entities.use:
Hurls a fireball at the target, inflicting 1.7 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage. If the target is only caught in the splash of the explosion, they will take 1.55 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage.

Due to peculiarities in scaling it doesn't benefit from the Faith scaling of a Pyromancy Flame unless a minimum level of Intelligence has been reached: starting at 22 Intelligence for a +0 Flame and gradually going down to 18 Intelligence for a +10 Flame.

entities.name: Firestorm
entities.desc:
Primal pyromancy taught by Quelana, a daughter of the Witch of Izalith.
Surrounds the caster with multiple pillars of flame.
The raging storm is indiscriminate; such is the intrinsic horror of the flame.
entities.avail: • Sold by Karla for 15,000 souls once she has been given the Quelana Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use:
The caster focuses power in the catalyst, and then lays down a sweeping wide blanket of erupting fire pillars. Each pillar will inflict 1.75 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage and knock any targets skyward.

The FP cost of this spell is expressed per-pillar. Upon initial successful cast, the spell will consume 12 FP (10 FP with the Dusk Crown Ring equipped), and additional Focus is consumed as each pillar materializes. A maximum of 15 pillars (including the one created by the initial cast) can be conjured in a single cast of this spell, resulting in total maximum consumption of 40 FP (38 FP with Dusk Crown Ring equipped), assuming that the spell is not interrupted.

entities.name: Flame Fan
entities.desc:
Pyromancy of Zoey, descendant of the desert pyromancers.
Use repeatedly to brush the fan left and right.
Zoey possessed true beauty, as did all the desert pyromancers, but hers did not poison, and so she became the unassuming queen of the feeble ones.
entities.avail: Dropped by Desert Pyromancer Zoey.
entities.use:
Upon cast, the player manifests a fiery fan and swipes it at enemies at melee range, inflicting 1.55 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage. It can be used continuously by repeating the cast, alternating sweeping direction until FP or stamina is exhausted.

It inflicts stagger on enemies, subjecting them to Instability damage if they take another hit while recoiling, either from a second swipe with the fan or any other damage source.

entities.name: Flash Sweat
entities.desc:
Unique pyromancy of the Great Swamp associated with Carmina.
Intense sweating increases fire damage absorption.
An influential pyromancy that internalizes flame, likely forming the foundation for many subsequent spells.
entities.avail: Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 1,500 souls.
entities.use: Increases Fire damage absorption by 30%. Buff lasts for 30 seconds. Duration can be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

entities.name: Floating Chaos
entities.desc:
Pyromancer Dunnel was fascinated by this ceremonial art employed by the clerics of the Smouldering Lake.
Summons a fire-spitting chaos orb.
Chaos burns away in the blink of an eye, but was the primordial life born in the Bed of Chaos, and a grievous symbol of Izalith's sin.
entities.avail: Dropped by Livid Pyromancer Dunnel in the Painted World of Ariandel, who invades the player in Crossbreed Priscilla's boss arena.
entities.use:
The caster conjures a fire orb, which begins to levitate at its casting point. After 2.5 seconds, the orb begins shooting projectiles at the enemy that the caster was locked on to upon cast, launching three shots before dispersing. It can also shoot at the nearest enemy, if no hostile was locked on to. Each projectile will inflict 0.85 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage.

Multiple instances of this spell can be active at once.

entities.name: Great Chaos Fire Orb
entities.desc:
Art of the Flame of Chaos, from Ancient Izalith. Hurls a great chaos fire orb.
Chaotic flame melts even great boulders, and creates a brief surge of molten lava on impact.
The Witch of Izalith and her daughters birthed the Flame of Chaos, but it devoured them along with their home.
entities.avail: Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 10,000 souls once he has been given the Izalith Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use:
Hurls a large Chaos-infused fire orb at the target; whether they are hit by the projectile itself or caught by the explosion on impact, targets will take 3.3 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage. A pool of lava will persist at the impact point for 3 seconds, inflicting 1.5 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage for as long as any enemy makes contact with it.

Due to peculiarities in scaling it doesn't benefit from the Faith scaling of a Pyromancy Flame unless a minimum level of Intelligence has been reached: starting at 22 Intelligence for a +0 Flame and gradually going down to 18 Intelligence for a +10 Flame.

entities.name: Great Combustion
entities.desc:
Pyromancy which improves upon Combustion. Creates a powerful, giant flame in hand.
A very powerful, yet simple spell to use.
Pyromancy is to at once know fear and longing, the resultant power of which depends on both the caster's intelligence and faith.
entities.avail: Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 3,000 souls.
entities.use: Creates a powerful explosion in front of the caster, inflicting 1.95 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage. If foes catch the lingering flame after the initial explosion, they will take only 1.85 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage.

entities.name: Iron Flesh
entities.desc:
Pyromancy that internalizes flame.
Iron flesh boosts damage absorption and resistance, but significantly increases weight.
Not advisable for walking in marshlands, perhaps resulting in its obsolescence in the Great Swamp.
entities.avail: Found in the poisonous swamp in Farron Keep. From the Farron Keep bonfire, enter the swamp and turn right. The spell can be seen amongst some trees in the middle of the swamp, within the deep water leading to the Basilisks.
entities.use:
Increases physical absorption by 40%, while decreasing Lightning absorption by 60%, and increases all status effect resistances by 45. Also grants the player constant Hyper Armor for the duration of the spell, but in return greatly increases their weight to the point where only slow-walking and fat-rolling are possible.

Cast animation takes 2 seconds to complete, and spell effect is active for 17 seconds. Duration of the buff can be extended via equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

entities.name: Poison Mist
entities.desc:
Unique pyromancy crafted by Eingyi, a heretic inhabiting the Great Swamp long ago. Creates a poison mist.
Eingyi was driven from the Great Swamp, however his pyromancy continues to succeed him.
Perhaps dwellers of the Great Swamp were reminded that their very existence is one rooted in heresy.
entities.avail: Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 2,000 souls once he has been given the Great Swamp Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use: The caster reels back and then exhales a cloud of purple mist, inflicting 15 Poison buildup per tick to foes that stand in it. The cloud persists for 6 seconds.

entities.name: Power Within
entities.desc:
Forbidden pyromancy amongst those who internalize flame.
Temporarily boost attack, but gradually lose HP.
A pyromancer fears the flame.
However, this fear subsides once it is accepted as a substitute for strength.
entities.avail: Found in the Grand Archives. Inside the darkened room located after the big wax vat area, the first wax vat, look for a lever on a pillar along the wall between 2 bookcases and pull it. While facing the lever, a bookcase on your left will move, revealing a secret room with a corpse holding the spell.
entities.use:
Increases all damage dealt by the caster by 20%, as well as increasing stamina recovery speed by 30 points per second. The caster constantly loses approximately 1% of their maximum HP per second for the duration of the spell. Buff lasts for 30 seconds and does not stack with Carthus Beacon.

In PvP, attack power is increased by 15% instead.

entities.name: Profaned Flame
entities.desc:
Pyromancy deriving from the Profaned Flame.
Engulfs foes at range and burns them to ashes.
The Profaned Capital was consumed by fire after Yhorm the Giant became a Lord of Cinder. The fire, born of the sky, is said to have incinerated naught but human flesh.
entities.avail: Found in Irithyll Dungeon, on the floor in the Giant Slave's cell. It is guarded by the giant itself and numerous Hound Rats.
entities.use: The caster waves the catalyst, conjuring a flame at the target's location. The flames concentrate and focus at the location for approximately 1 second before exploding, inficting 2.6 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage. The explosion will also knock down any enemies in the area.

entities.name: Profuse Sweat
entities.desc:
Advanced pyromancy that internalizes flame, associated with Carmina.
Profuse sweating temporarily boosts resistance to bleeding, poison, frost and curses.
The yellowish sweat cures all kinds of ailments.
entities.avail: Sold by Cornyx of the Great Swamp for 2,000 souls once he has been given the Great Swamp Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use: Temporarily increases resistance to Bleed, Poison, Frost and Curse buildup by 80. Buff lasts for 60 seconds, and can be extended by equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

entities.name: Rapport
entities.desc:
Advanced pyromancy of Quelana, a daughter of the Witch of Izalith.
Charms the enemy, making them temporary ally.
The living are lured by flame, and this tendency is elemental to the art of pyromancy.
entities.avail: Sold by Karla for 7,000 souls after she has been given the Quelana Pyromancy Tome.
entities.use:
At range, this spell turns a regular enemy into a friendly ally for 30 seconds. The spell takes two seconds to cast and can miss fast enemies but has considerable range, as it works by firing a small, invisible projectile straight forward.

The spell has no effect on other enemies, bosses, invaders or other players. However, there is no limit to the number of creatures that can be converted.

Whilst under Rapport, the targeted enemy:

  • Will stop attacking the player and any allies they have.
  • Will be considered as an ally for spells that affect allies.
  • Cannot be targeted with lock-on.
  • Can be backstabbed.
  • Can still harm the player during their attack targeting other enemies.
  • Will attack invaders.

entities.name: Sacred Flame
entities.desc:
Pyromancy taught among savages. Flame burrows inside foes and ignites.
Originally used in a ceremony for cleansing sacrificial impurities, thereby lending the spell its name.
As barbaric as it seems, this may in fact be quite fitting for the savage pyromancers who consider themselves servants of the divine.
entities.avail: Found inside a lava pool in the Smouldering Lake. Make way through the level until reaching the lowermost floor, past the area with several Basilisks and where Knight Slayer Tsorig attacks. The Sacred Flame lies on the left wall among the lava, the other item being an Ember.
entities.use:
The caster conjures a flame in their catalyst hand, then lunges forward in a grabbing motion. If it successfully connects with a valid target, it will place them in a riposte-like state, where the caster is granted invulnerability frames for the duration of the attack animation.

The caster thrusts the flame into the target, inflicting 0.3 times the Attack Rating of the catalyst as Fire damage. The flame then burns the target for 9 more instances of damage, each inflicting 0.1 times the Attack Rating of the catalyst as Fire damage. Finally, the flame explodes, knocking the target down and inflicting a critical amount of damage. The standard Pyromancy Flame will inflict 2.3 times the Attack Rating of the catalyst as critical damage, the Pyromancer's Parting Flame will inflict 2.5 times the Attack Rating of the catalyst for an increase of 9% in damage over the standard Pyromancy Flame (while not inflicting the bonus Combustion damage), and the Demon's Scar will inflict 20% more damage for a 2.76 multiplier. The White Hair Talisman inflicts its physical component as Thrust damage, as well as its Fire component, both using the 2.3 multiplier.

If a non-valid target is hit by the spell (one that cannot be placed into a riposte state), they will instead take two smaller instances of damage instead. Attempting to hit a valid target but failing due to terrain elevation differences will result in only dealing the initial grab damage.

entities.name: Seething Chaos
entities.desc:
The last flame lit by the demon prince.
This pyromancy hurls a clump of chaos.
Upon impact, this clump of chaos seethes wildly, condenses briefly, then explodes violently.
To the demons, these clumps are shreds of life.
entities.avail: Obtained by transposing the Soul of the Demon Prince with Ludleth of Courland for 10,000 souls.
entities.use: The caster conjures a fragment of the Flame of Chaos, then tosses it in the aimed direction. If the projectile makes contact with an enemy or destructible level geometry (tables, chairs, boxes, etc.), it will impact and stagger, deal 2.0 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage. However, if it lands on solid level geometry such as a floor or wall, it will attach to it and begin seething and growing in strength. Roughly 4.5 seconds after initial contact with the surface, it will explode, dealing 3.92 times the Spell Buff of the catalyst as Fire damage in an area.

entities.name: Toxic Mist
entities.desc:
Unique pyromancy of Eingyi that never gained currency in the Great Swamp.
Creates an intense poison mist.
Driven from the Great Swamp, they say that at the end of his journey, Eingyi happened upon a virulent poison and a young lady.
entities.avail:
Found in the Smouldering Lake, on a corpse in a lava pool located behind an illusory wall in a room with three Hound Rats in it. After the exit to the right in the hallway with the Smouldering Ghru, it will be down some stairs on the left-hand side and is found on the visible first corpse.

In order to survive the trip inside the lava, there are many strategies that can be followed and combined before venturing inside. The main idea is to slow down the loss of HP enough to allow the player to heal and advance a bit further, until they have successfully retrieved the item and returned to solid ground.

Possible survival techniques include:

  • Wearing pieces of armor that each provide the best Fire resistance from all other armor collected so far.
  • Making sure one is a Host of Embers in order to have a larger HP pool, thus having a better chance of surviving between heals.
  • Casting Flash Sweat.
  • Consuming a Red Bug Pellet.
  • Equipping rings that provide useful effects, such as:
    • Flame Stoneplate Ring (increases Fire resistance)
    • Estus Ring (gives 20% more HP when drinking from the Estus Flask)
    • Chloranthy Ring (increases stamina regeneration rate)
  • Equipping gear that provides HP regeneration, like the Sun Princess Ring and the Ancient Dragon Greatshield.
entities.use:
The caster reels back, then exhales a deep cloud of toxic mist, inflicting 12 Toxic buildup per tick to foes that stand in it. The cloud persists for 6 seconds.

Buildup is static and is not affected by rings or spell buffs.

entities.name: Warmth
entities.desc:
Peculiar pyromancy of the Mound-makers. Creates a gentle flame that restores HP on touch.
They feared separation from the gods and sought a familial bond, perhaps leading to the creation of this flame of harmony.
entities.avail: Obtained as a reward for reaching Rank 2 in the Mound-makers covenant. To achieve this, the player is required to offer 30 Vertebra Shackles to the altar in the Pit of Hollows.
entities.use:
The caster conjures a floating flame that gradually heals all entities within its radius, regardless of affiliation. This includes the caster, allies and enemies. While under the flame's effect, entities will recover 35 HP per tick. The spell ticks once per second and lasts for 60 seconds, resulting in a maximum of 2,100 HP restored.

Only one instance of Warmth can be active at a time, as casting the spell before the previous instance expires will cause the previous flame to disappear, being replaced by the new one. The duration of the flame cannot be increased via equipping the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring.

entities.name: Blessed Gem
entities.usage: Used in infusion to create Blessed weapons.
entities.desc:
A gem of infused titanite. Commonly known as a charm kept by saints.
Used in infusion to create blessed weapons.
Special blessed weapons gradually restore HP and heavily damage reanimated foes.
entities.avail:
• Firelink Shrine
    • One can be obtained once per playthrough by trading the Moaning Shield with the Nestling.
  • High Wall of Lothric
    • Dropped by Winged Knights.
  • Undead Settlement
    • Dropped by Evangelists.
  • Road of Sacrifices
    • Dropped by Corvian Storytellers.
  • Cathedral of the Deep
    • Dropped by Evangelists.
    • On a corpse on the rafters leading to Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth. The corpse is located at the far wall, guarded by a greatsword-wielding Cathedral Knight.
  • Irithyll of the Boreal Valley
    • Dropped by the one Evangelist.
  • Lothric Castle
    • Dropped by Lothric Priests.
    • Dropped by Winged Knights.
  • Grand Archives
    • Dropped by Corvian Storytellers.
    • Dropped by Gertrude's Knights.
    • On a corpse found along the rafters after dropping down from Gertrude's bird cage.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • Found on a corpse at the base of the rotting tower in the abandoned village guarded by Millwood Knights, on the outside near the cliffside.
  • The Ringed City
    • Dropped by Hobbled Clerics.
    • Found on a corpse in the Shared Grave area, below where Amnesiac Lapp's questline concludes.
entities.use:
Grants Faith scaling to any innate Physical, Fire, Lightning and Dark damage, or increases any prior Faith scaling, but reduces Strength and Dexterity scaling, along with reducing base damage considerably.

When wielded, the player slowly regenerates health at a rate of 3 HP every 4 seconds (0.75 HP per second or 45 HP per minute). Reinforcing it will reduce the tick interval by 0.25 seconds per upgrade level. At +10 reinforcement, a Blessed weapon will replenish 3 HP per 1.5 seconds, (2 HP per second or 120 HP per minute).

Weapons with the Blessed infusion will deal 20% bonus damage to skeletal creatures (e.g., most foes within Catacombs of Carthus). Killing an enemy with a blessed weapon also prevents them from reviving.

If infused onto a shield, its damage absorption will drop 5% across the board, and stability will be reduced to base value (e.g., will not increase with upgrades).

entities.name: Blood Gem
entities.usage: Used in infusion to create lacerating weapons.
entities.desc:
A gem of infused titanite.
Slurped by Irithyll slaves.
Used in infusion to create lacerating weapons.
Such weapons inflict lacerating damage.
Most effective with sharp or spiked weapons.
entities.avail:
• Irithyll of the Boreal Valley
    • Dropped by Irithyllian Slaves.
    • Found in the area after the dark room filled with Irithyllian Slaves, at the base of a tree guarded by more Irithyllian Slaves before entering the riverbed.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • Found at the bottom of the rotted basement of Ariandel Chapel, guarded by numerous Giant Flies.
entities.use:
The player must obtain the Profaned Coal and give it to Andre of Astora to allow infusion of this gem into a weapon.

Use the Blood Gem to infuse a weapon with the Bleed effect. The infusion will reduce base physical damage and scaling, while adding or increasing Bleed buildup, which scales with Luck.

entities.name: Chaos Gem
entities.usage: Used in infusion to create Chaos weapons.
entities.desc:
A gem of infused titanite.
Relics of lands scorched by the Chaos Flame.
Used in infusion to create chaos weapons.
Chaos weapons inflict fire damage, and scale with intelligence and faith.
entities.avail:
Smouldering Lake

  • Found at the end of a cave located within the area's main cavern, guarded by several Great Crabs.
  • Dropped by Demon Clerics.
  • Dropped by the Crystal Lizard closest to the destructible floor that leads from the lake to the Old King's Antechamber bonfire.

Grand Archives

  • Dropped by a Crystal Lizard in the room after the first wax pool.
entities.use:
Infuses weapons with Fire damage, adding Intelligence and Faith scaling but reducing Strength and Dexterity scaling, as well as reducing base damage. Intelligence and Faith scaling will also be increased for any pre-existing Magic, Lightning and Dark damage.

For the Fire damage, scaling soft caps at 30 Intelligence and 30 Faith.

entities.name: Crystal Gem
entities.usage: Used in infusion to create Crystal weapons.
entities.desc:
A gem of infused titanite. Introduced to Lothric by the Crystal Sages.
Used in infusion to create crystal weapons.
Crystal weapons inflict magic damage, and scale effectively with intelligence.
entities.avail:
• Road of Sacrifices
    • Dropped by Sage's Devout.
    • Dropped by Sage's Prentice.
    • Guaranteed drop by the Crystal Lizard within the ruins before Crystal Sage.
  • Cathedral of the Deep
    • Dropped by Large Devouts of the Deep.
  • Grand Archives
    • Dropped by Grand Archives Scholars.
    • Dropped by Thralls.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • Dropped by Frost Crabs.
    • One is rewarded for defeating the two initial Frost Crabs near the Depths of the Painting bonfire.
entities.use:
Infuses weapons with Magic damage, granting Intelligence scaling but reducing Strength and Dexterity scaling, as well as reducing base damage.

Scaling soft caps at 40 Intelligence.

entities.name: Dark Gem
entities.usage: Used in infusion to create dark weapons.
entities.desc:
A gem of infused titanite.
Born of disembodied humanity.
Used in infusion to create dark weapons.
Dark weapons inflict dark damage, and scale with faith.
entities.avail:
• High Wall of Lothric
    • Dropped by Pus of Man.
  • Catacombs of Carthus
    • Dropped by the second Skeleton Boulder.
  • Consumed King's Garden
    • Found on a corpse under the left set of stairs that lead to the courtyard in front of the boss room.
    • Dropped by Pus of Man.
    • Dropped by Rotten Slugs.
  • Lothric Castle
    • Dropped by Pus of Man.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • Within the rotting house at the top of the Corvian Settlement, near the locked gate, guarded by two Giant Flies.
  • The Dreg Heap
    • Dropped by Harald Knights
  • The Ringed City
    • Dropped by Harald Knights
    • Found in the Ringed City Streets, shortly after the great stairway.
entities.use:
Infuses weapons with Dark damage, adding Intelligence and Faith scaling but reducing Strength and Dexterity scaling, as well as reducing base damage. Intelligence and Faith scaling will also be increased for any pre-existing Magic, Fire and Lightning damage.

For the Dark damage, scaling soft caps at 30 Intelligence and 30 Faith.

entities.name: Deep Gem
entities.usage: Used in infusion to create deep weapons.
entities.desc:
A gem of infused titanite. Found in the dregs of the Cathedral of the Deep.
Used in infusion to create deep weapons.
Deep weapons inflict dark damage, but lose scaling effects.
There is a darkness that lies beyond human ken.
entities.avail:
• Cathedral of the Deep
    • Dropped by Thralls.
    • Dropped by Devouts of the Deep.
    • Dropped by Deacons.
    • One is found shortly after entering the cathedral by the back door, in a small room located at the bottom of a long staircase, before the first Giant Slave. The gem lies on a balcony, just in front of an Evangelist looking outside.
  • Irithyll of the Boreal Valley
    • Dropped by Deacons.
    • One is found in the Water Reserve area, in the large room with the two Sulyvahn's Beasts. This area can be reached by climbing down the long ladder concealed behind an illusory wall on the left wall of the building after the courtyard with dead Giant Slaves.
  • Anor Londo
    • Dropped by Deacons.
entities.use:
In order to unlock the Deep infusion for use, the player must first give the Sage's Coal to Blacksmith Andre.

Using a Deep Gem will infuse the target weapon with a deepened form of Dark, and in turn, will make a weapon deal both physical damage and dark damage, at an equal-split margin with one another.

Deep infusions also remove all scaling effects present on the weapon after infusion, much like a Fire Gem does, which means in order to achieve maximum damage on deep weapons, the player will have to fully-reinforce one.

entities.name: Fire Gem
entities.usage: Used in infusion to create fire weapons, but removes scaling effects.
entities.desc:
A gem of infused titanite.
Found in rare cases inside demons.
Fire weapons inflict fire damage, but lose scaling effects.
entities.avail:
• Can be chosen as a burial gift at the beginning of the game.
  • Undead Settlement
    • Dropped by Peasant Hollows.
    • Guaranteed drop from the Demon that Siegward helps to defeat.
  • Smouldering Lake
    • Dropped by Writhing Rotten Flesh.
entities.use:
Fire Gems can be used to infuse a weapon with an essence of fire, which will cause a weapon to inflict equally-split physical and fire damage.

Many Undead enemies or creatures, such as Peasant Hollows and Starved Hounds, are naturally weak to Fire damage, and thus, a Fire-infused weapon can prove useful. However, one must be cautious, as attacking an enemy with such a weapon now has to take into account two defenses. As such, enemies that possess a resistance to fire will take notably less damage.

Fire infusions also remove all scaling effects present on the weapon after infusion, which means that it is most efficient when using such an infused weapon at its minimum wielding requirements.

entities.name: Heavy Gem
entities.usage: Used in infusion to create heavy weapons.
entities.desc:
A gem of infused titanite.
Famously used to forge Farron greatswords.
Used in infusion to create heavy weapons.
A warrior can appreciate a heavy weapon, for they scale effectively with strength.
entities.avail:
• Firelink Shrine
    • Gift from Hawkwood the Deserter after defeating the Curse-rotted Greatwood. Otherwise, dropped by Hawkwood if he is killed before it is gifted.
  • Undead Settlement
    • Dropped by a Crystal Lizard found at the bottom of the chasm before reaching Irina of Carim's cell (Grave Key required).
  • Farron Keep
    • Dropped by Rotten Slugs.
    • Dropped by Ghrus.
    • Dropped by Elder Ghrus.
    • Dropped by a Crystal Lizard in the ruined fortress. From the Old Wolf of Farron bonfire, take the lift up and climb the stairs. Turn around and search for a broken part of the scenery. Drop to and follow the ledges below. The lizard can be found at the base of a staircase surrounded by hollows.
  • Grand Archives
    • Dropped by a Crystal Lizard on the rooftops. On the sloped rooftop above the Corvians, there will be two Crystal Lizards guarded by a pair of Gargoyles.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • Dropped commonly by Millwood Knights.
    • Found in the abandoned village guarded by Millwood Knights, next to a destroyed wall guarded by a great hammer-wielding knight.
entities.use:
Infusing a weapon with the Heavy property will significantly improve the Strength scaling on that weapon, but compromises the Dexterity scaling by completely removing it, putting emphasis on only Strength after the infusion is done.

Like most other infusions, it will also lower the weapon's base damage slightly. Heavy infusions should only be used if there is a large gap between one's Strength and Dexterity, as if both are nearly equal to one another, the weapon's overall damage after the infusion may be lower than it was prior to.

entities.name: Hollow Gem
entities.usage: Used in infusion to create hollow weapons.
entities.desc:
A gem of infused titanite. A stone plentiful in Londor, land of Hollows.
Used in infusion to create Hollow weapons.
Hollow weapons are said to peer into the essence of its wielder, whose luck boosts attack.
entities.avail:
• Firelink Shrine
    • Once per game cycle, one can be obtained by trading the Eleonora with the Nestling.
  • Road of Sacrifices
    • Dropped by Corvian Storytellers.
  • Farron Keep

entities.use:
Grants Luck scaling to Physical damage. Reduces Strength and Dexterity scaling, as well as base damage, though the scaling is gradually restored with upgrade levels.

Hollow-infused weapons will increase Luck based on the upgrade level of the weapon, if the wielder has at least 15 Hollowing:

Weapon upgrade levelBonus Luck
+02
+1 to +43
+5 to +94
+105

Bonus Luck is granted for weapons regardless of which hand they are held in, and can stack with each other even when two-handing one of them. Thus, it is possible to have a total of +10 additional Luck by wielding a +10 Hollow-infused weapon/shield in each hand.

entities.use:
Can be used to create Refined weapons through Blacksmith Andre in Firelink Shrine.

Infusing a weapon with a Refined Gem will increase the scaling bonuses from both Strength and Dexterity, without compromising one or the other, while also equalizing their scaling. While it does also lower the weapon's base damage slightly, the improved scaling bonuses, in most cases, will result in an overall damage increase.

Refined infusions are a solid choice if a player is utilizing a quality build, where Strength and Dexterity are leveled equally. Furthermore, Refined weapons are still able to be fully buffed by resins, bundles, or spells.

entities.use:
Infusing a weapon with the Sharp property will increase the Dexterity scaling on that weapon, and as such, is an excellent choice for players who invested heavily into dexterity. As a result of the infusion, however, the Strength scaling will be lowered, or entirely removed on some weapons, and the weapon's base damage will be slightly reduced.

Weapons that scale well with dexterity from their base level will benefit greatly from sharp infusions.

As of the 1.32 Regulations patch, Sharp-infused weapons will gain increased scaling at very high levels of Dexterity. Between 40 and 60 Dexterity, scaling is poor, however beyond 60 Dexterity it will greatly increase until it gradually begins to fall off at roughly 80 Dexterity.

entities.use:
Infuses weapons with Magic damage, granting Intelligence scaling but reducing Strength and Dexterity scaling, as well as reducing base damage. Compared to the Crystal infusion, the scaling is higher in all areas, but the base damage of the weapon is lower, meaning that the weapon will do less damage overall.

The benefit of the Simple infusion is that when wielded, the weapon slowly regenerates FP at a rate of about 1 FP per 5 seconds, or 0.2 FP per second. Reinforcing it will reduce the tick interval by roughly 0.217 seconds per upgrade level. At +10 reinforcement, a Simple weapon will replenish 1 FP per 2.85 seconds, or roughly 0.35 FP per second.

entities.use:
Used to reinforce special weapons up to +4. These include all soul-transposed weapons, as well as several otherwise unique weapons.

Reinforcement initially costs only a single Titanite Scale, but doubles in cost for each subsequent level, requiring 8 Titanite Scales to upgrade to +4, and finally a Titanite Slab to upgrade to +5. Fully reinforcing such a weapon requires the use of 15 Titanite Scales and one Titanite Slab. Each level of reinforcement is equal to 2 levels for a weapon upgraded through regular Titanite.

entities.avail:
The number of Titanite Slabs that can be obtained in a single playthrough are limited. 8 can be found in the base game, 3 can be found in Ashes of Ariandel for a total of 11, and 4 can be found in The Ringed City for a maximum of 15.

Base Game

Slab No.Directions
Profaned Capital
1
Gifted by Siegward of Catarina after rescuing him from his cell. The Old Cell Key is required to unlock the door.
Grand Archives
2
On the third floor, below the balcony where the Crystal Sage teleports to after engaging him at the beginning of the level and next to a wax pool, there is a lever located between two bookshelves facing the center of the Archives towards the first wax pool. Activating the lever will move a bookshelf in that area. Returning to the first wax pool and exploring the newly opened path will reveal a chest containing the Slab.
3
Reward for defeating the three Gertrude's Knights at the very top of the Archives.
Lothric Castle
4
After unlocking the final elevator shortcut of the Grand Archives (at the end of the bridge) which leads back down to Lothric Castle, send the elevator up while standing at the bottom. The elevator will reveal itself to be a tandem elevator, boarding the bottom carriage and going down will lead to a corpse holding the Slab.
Firelink Shrine
5
Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 30,000 souls once all four Cinders of a Lord have been placed on their respective thrones.
6
Trade the Coiled Sword Fragment with Pickle Pee (only once per playthrough).
Archdragon Peak

8Found on a corpse in the main courtyard after defeating the Nameless King.

Ashes of Ariandel

Slab No.Directions
1
From the Depths of the Painting bonfire, turn left on the riverbed and proceed past the three Frost Crabs. Past the Birch Women in the riverbed is a unique one guarding the Snap Freeze Sorcery. Defeating her will cause a ladder to materialize on the riverbank. Climb up to the top to claim a Slab from a corpse.
2
Reward for defeating Father Ariandel and Friede.
3Gifted by the Forlorn Corvian Settler in the Corvian Settlement, after granting his wish to bring fire to the painted world by defeating Blackflame Friede. If the player has killed him, the Slab can be found at his initial meeting place.

The Ringed City

Slab No.Directions
The Dreg Heap
1
Within the poison swamp of Earthen Peak Ruins guarded by the third Angel, there is a cave on the opposite side with several Poisonhorn Bugs and two Harald Legion Knights, one patrolling the cave and the second guarding the Slab in a corridor at the back. If the player reloads the area several times without retrieving it (either due to leaving or dying and respawning), Amnesiac Lapp will kill the second Harald Legion Knight and gift it to the player at the bonfire.
The Ringed City
2
Reward for defeating Halflight, Spear of the Church for the first time.
3
Gifted by Shira, Knight of Filianore after fulfilling her request of defeating Darkeater Midir. If the player has woken Filianore without obtaining this Slab, it will be dropped by Shira at Pygmy's Throne once she is defeated.

    • Three are found in a chest past the Great Belfry, guarded by a Rock Lizard at the base of the ladder leading to Havel the Rock.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • Dropped by a Crystal Lizard inside the tower guarded by two Millwood Knights wielding greatbows in the abandoned village. It can be found after ascending the staircase, climbing the ladder and then going down the staircase.
    • Dropped by a Crystal Lizard within the Corvian Settlement. After ascending the tower to the cliffside above the settlement, the lizard can be spotted on the next crossing, guarded by an overhanging Corvian Knight.
    • Two are dropped by a pair of Crystal Lizards within the Ariandel Chapel basement. After revealing the illusory wall that blocks the path to Crossbreed Priscilla's tower (and Livid Pyromancer Dunnel's arena), the lizards can be found in the very next room.
    • Dropped by a Crystal Lizard within the Depths of the Painting. After navigating the first set of twisted branches under the rope bridge, it can be found in the crossing that leads to the next set of twisted branches, guarded by two Farron Followers.
  • The Dreg Heap
    • After falling through the window into the remnants of the Grand Archives, one can be found on a corpse at the other end of the room, guarded by Murkmen.
    • Two are dropped by each of the Pilgrim Pupas controlling the Angels encountered throughout the area, for a total of six.
    • After encountering the second Angel shortly after entering Earthen Peak, turn around and head towards the dead end next to the drop-down from the bonfire. Climb onto the tree root and follow it right to find a Twinkling Titanite on a corpse.
    • When traversing the great tree branches extending above Earthen Peak after defeating Desert Pyromancer Zoey, there is a drop-down to the right that hides a corpse holding a Twinkling Titanite. Following this root will lead back to the original path.
  • The Ringed City
    • Dropped by a Crystal Lizard in the Mausoleum Lookout, after jumping to the ruins to the right of the path to the Judicator Giant.
    • Found on a corpse in the spiral stair building guarded by numerous Hobbled Clerics. It can be accessed by dropping down onto the chandelier in the middle and then jumping to a hidden alcove where a Hobbled Cleric awaits.
    • Two are dropped by a Crystal Lizard at the top of the long ladder from the swamp, next to the great stairway guarded by Harald Knights. It will attempt to lead the player into an ambush of two Ringed Knights.
    • One is found in the swamp on the left-hand side, on a corpse guarded by a White-faced Locust.
    • One is found in the back end of the sunken building guarded by four Ringed Knights, before dropping down to the area leading to Darkeater Midir's crossing.
    • One is dropped by a Crystal Lizard within the Shared Grave area, on the other side of the collapsing stair trap.
    • Two are found on a corpse in front of the Church of Filianore.
entities.use: Allows reinforcement of unique weapons up to +4.

entities.name: Farron Coal
entities.usage: Give to Andre to allow the use of gems for heavy, sharp and poison infusion.
entities.desc:
Coal used for weapon infusion.
Long ago, used to forge the greatswords of the Undead Legion of Farron.
Give to the blacksmith in the shrine to allow the use of gems for heavy, sharp and poison infusion.
entities.avail: Found in the Road of Sacrifices on what once was the eastern access to the keep. The area can be reached by following the eastern shore of the marsh, fighting a couple of Lycanthropes along the way. The coal can be found at the end of a blocked passageway, guarded by a Black Knight.
entities.use:
The coal can be given to Blacksmith Andre in Firelink Shrine to allow usage of the following gems for infusions:

  • Heavy Gem: Allows to infuse weapons with the Heavy attribute.
  • Sharp Gem: Allows to infuse weapons with the Sharp attribute.
  • Poison Gem: Allows to infuse weapons with Poison.

entities.name: Giant's Coal
entities.usage: Give to Andre to infuse weapons with Lightning, Simple, or Chaos.
entities.desc:
Coal used for weapon infusion.
It is said that the giant blacksmith of Anor Londo was once the blacksmith of the gods.
Give to the blacksmith in the shrine to allow the use of gems for lightning, simple, and chaos infusion.
entities.avail:
Found in Anor Londo, on the remains of the Giant Blacksmith in the west wing of the cathedral.

From the Anor Londo bonfire, head up the large staircase; once at the top, head left through a metal door archway and then enter a doorway on the right to find the giant's body holding the coal.
entities.use:
Give the coal to Blacksmith Andre in Firelink Shrine to allow usage of the following gems for infusions:

  • Chaos Gem → Infuses a weapon with the Fire element, as well as granting Intelligence and Faith scaling to it.
  • Lightning Gem → Infuses a weapon with the Lightning element, as well as granting Faith scaling to it.
  • Simple Gem → Infuses a weapon with the Magic element, as well as granting FP regeneration while wielded (about 1 FP every 5 seconds).

entities.name: Profaned Coal
entities.usage: Give to Andre to infuse weapons with Dark, Blood or Hollow.
entities.desc:
Coal used for weapon infusion.
Remnants of the fire that burned down the Profaned Capital, preserved in an icy skull.
Give to the blacksmith in the shrine to allow the use of gems for dark, blood, and hollow infusion.
entities.avail: Found in the Irithyll Dungeon, in the lower cell block that precedes the route to the Profaned Capital. It is inside the cell containing several Wretches, just opposite of Karla's cell.
entities.use:
Give the coal to Blacksmith Andre in Firelink Shrine to allow usage of the following gems for infusions:

  • Dark Gem → Dark
  • Blood Gem → Blood
  • Hollow Gem → Hollow

entities.name: Sage's Coal
entities.usage: Give to Andre to infuse weapons with crystal, blessed, or deep.
entities.desc:
Coal used for weapon infusion
The white magic flame produced by this coal was given to the Undead Legion long ago by one of the Crystal Sage twins.
Give to the blacksmith in the shrine to allow the use of gems for crystal, blessed, and dark infusion.
entities.avail: Found in the Farron Keep. From the Farron Keep bonfire, proceed through the area along the left-hand side until reaching a small, circular structure guarded by a Darkwraith. The coal lies within.
entities.use:
Give the coal to Blacksmith Andre in Firelink Shrine to allow usage of the following gems for infusions:

  • Crystal Gem
  • Blessed Gem
  • Deep Gem

Umbral ash of the Captain of the Millwood Knights. With this, the Shrine Handmaiden will prepare new items.
Long ago, when the Millwood Knights lost the forest they called home, they began a journey so long that even thoughts of their sworn enemy washed away, replaced by a vision of a cold and brittle wood.
entities.avail: Found in the Painted World of Ariandel. At the top of the tower in the ruined Millwood village guarded by several Millwood Knights, along with two Millwood archers. The ashes can be found on a corpse at the very top of the tower.

Cornyx was tired and defeated until he discovered one final pupil, like so many pyromancers before him.

Umbral ash of the fallen warrior who chose the path of the ancient dragons. With this, the shrine handmaid will prepare new items.
Whatever it is, it is sure to grant strength to the most unrelenting warrior.
entities.avail:
Found in Archdragon Peak.

From the Great Belfry bonfire, take the left exit. Proceed straight forward through the courtyard outside and follow a small path on the left, near the archway with the big ambush of Man Serpents. The ashes are on a corpse behind a Rock Lizard.

entities.usage: Give to the Shrine Handmaid to increase her inventory.
entities.desc:
Umbral ash of one who dreamt of joining the Undead Legion. With this, the shrine handmaid will prepare new items.
In the end, the dream chasers who wandered aimlessly in the rotted forest found a sense of fulfillment.
entities.avail: Found in the Farron Keep, on a corpse hanging on a window near to the Old Wolf of Farron. To reach it, exit the chamber and walk along the right-hand ledge of the fortress. entities.desc:
Umbral ash of an armor merchant from an eastern land. Surely the handmaid of Firelink Shrine can turn this into a few new things.
The merchant, a captain of a clan of hunters, was fascinated with weaponry.
entities.avail: Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, in the area where several Silver Knight archers are posted on the rooftops. The ashes can be found on a corpse hanging on the edge of a small ledge reached by climbing down a set of a stairs on the right-hand side.

Unclean umbral ash coated with excrement.
Perhaps it's possible the handmaid of Firelink Shrine could turn this into a few new things...
"Oh to savor the sweet pungency but once more...
entities.avail:
Found in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.

Head to the lake in Irithyll and look for the entrance to the sewers. Be careful of the Sewer Centipedes in this area and keep a lookout for a small alcove directly across from the stairs that lead to the kitchen. The ashes are on a corpse resting in shin-high water.

entities.desc:
Umbral ash of the grave warden of the catacombs of Carthus. With this, the shrine handmaid will prepare new items.
The old man began as a squire, carrying his master's accoutrements. He ended his days a grave warden, and carried them still.
entities.avail:
Found in the Catacombs of Carthus.

From the Catacombs of Carthus bonfire, turn left and go downstairs. Climb up any of the two sets of stairs found on the nearby wall (one of them hidden behind an illusory wall). The ashes are on a corpse lying at the far end of this area, guarded by three Skeleton Swordsmen.

entities.usage: Give to the Shrine Handmaid to increase her inventory.
entities.desc:
Umbral ash of Greirat of the Undead Settlement. With this, the shrine handmaid will prepare new items.
Greirat was a thief who fancied himself a martyr for the poor, which is what drove him to climb the wall.
entities.avail:
Dropped by Greirat of the Undead Settlement if he is killed by the player, or if he dies during one of his pillaging attempts.

  • If Greirat dies during his pillaging travel in Irithyll, his ashes can be found on his body floating on a corner of the drainage ditch inhabited by several Sewer Centipedes.
  • Once Greirat is killed during his pillaging travel in Lothric Castle, his ashes can be found along the rooftops of the Grand Archives. Proceed past a congregation of Corvians in the open area after the library, and make a leap to the rooftop below, where Greirat's body lies.
entities.use: Give to the Shrine Handmaid to expand her inventory to include items that Greirat was selling upon death, as well as what his next pillaging journey would have yielded.

entities.name: Hollow's Ashes
entities.usage: Give to the Shrine Handmaid to increase her inventory.
entities.desc:
Umbral ash of a Hollow who faithfully served a woman, only to become separated from her. With this, the shrine handmaid will prepare new items.
It takes but a brief glance at this thing to easily envision Londor, the foreboding land of Hollows.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by Yoel of Londor.
  • Found in the dark Firelink Shrine version of the Untended Graves, only if Yoel died of natural causes (i.e. the player entered the Catacombs of Carthus without following his questline). The ashes can be found on the spot where Yoel used to reside when he was alive.

entities.usage: Give to the Shrine Handmaid to increase her inventory.
entities.desc:
Umbral ash of Irina of Carim. With this, the shrine handmaid will prepare new items.
Irina was a frail woman. this frailty led to her becoming a saint of Carim, and to her grand treachery.
entities.avail: Dropped by Irina of Carim.
entities.use: Extends the Shrine Handmaid's inventory to include items initially sold by Irina. The items will be exactly the same as Irina's stock at the time of her death, including items from divine tomes. Items that were already bought from Irina will be listed but exhausted.

entities.name: Karla's Ashes
entities.usage: Give to the Shrine Handmaid to increase her inventory.
entities.desc:
Umbral ash of Karla. With this, the shrine handmaid will prepare new items.
The spurned child of the Abyss never dies, but phases in and out of its fringes. Only, there is no one to search for her any longer.
entities.avail: Dropped by Karla.
entities.use: Give to the Shrine Handmaid to extend her inventory to include spells sold by Karla at the time of death.

entities.name: Mortician's Ashes
entities.usage: Give to the Shrine Handmaid to increase her inventory.
entities.desc:
Umbral ash of a resident of the Undead Settlement who made a living burying corpses.
With this, the shrine handmaid will prepare new items.
entities.avail:
Found in the Undead Settlement.

From the Dilapidated Bridge, head forward to the cemetery where the giant archer's arrows rain down. Instead of entering the house on the far end, turn left and head uphill. The ashes are found on a body lying next to a tree.

The player may opt to befriend or kill the giant first to avoid being harassed by the falling arrows while scouting around.

entities.desc:
Umbral ash of the old stone-humped woman.
Things that have dreadfully run their course accrue at the great dreg-heap. This old woman was once the wet nurse of royalty.
entities.avail:
Found in The Dreg Heap, near the first bonfire:

  • Dropped by the Stone-humped Hag.
  • Also obtained from her corpse at the same location after reaching the Filianore's Rest bonfire.

entities.usage: • Give to the Shrine Handmaid to increase her inventory. • Give to Yuria to receive the Morion Blade.
entities.desc:
Umbral ash of Orbeck of Vinheim. With this, the shrine handmaid will prepare new items.
Orbeck was fascinated with sorcery but without means, so offered to serve as an assassin in exchange for acceptance into the Dragon Academy, believing that one day he could reinvent himself as a sorcerer.
entities.avail:
• Dropped by Orbeck of Vinheim.
  • Alternatively, they can be found on Orbeck's corpse in the Grand Archives upon the completion of his questline and defeating the Twin Princes.
entities.use:
• Extends the Shrine Handmaid's inventory to include items sold by Orbeck of Vinheim upon his death, i.e. his Sorceries.
  • Can be given to Yuria of Londor to receive the Morion Blade.

entities.name: Paladin's Ashes
entities.usage: Give to the Shrine Handmaid to increase her inventory.
entities.desc:
Umbral ash of a worn-out paladin who sought the Cathedral of the Deep. With this, the shrine handmaid will prepare new items.
This paladin paid quite a price for his headstrong justice.
entities.avail:
Found in the Cathedral of the Deep.

From the Cathedral of the Deep bonfire, head toward the stairs and turn left, following a small path downhill. The ashes are located on a corpse lying on the far end, behind the Fallen Knight.

He marched in one direction, and that direction was dead ahead. Did you see him passing by?

The prisoner chief used his clout to hoard all manner of things, but died without putting them to use.

Umbral ash of a sorcerer who explored the golden sorceries of a long-lost land. With this, the shrine handmaid will prepare new items.
They were called xanthous scholars, but some foolishly imitate them by simply dressing in yellow.

Having three founders of the Black Church ensured Yuria's legacy would survive. Her two sisters could carry the torch, making certain their lord claims the flame, for the sake of all Hollows.

Completing Yuria's questline by defeating the Soul of Cinder with her as a summon, and her surviving to the end of the battle, will only award players with Darkdrift and the Black Set, her ashes cannot be obtained after this point.

The easiest way kill Yuria is after performing the marriage ceremony with Anri of Astora, as Yuria will not retaliate against the Lord of Hollow's attacks.

entities.usage: Give to Irina to learn advanced Carim miracles.
entities.desc:
A sacred braille tome from Carim, filled with advanced miracles.
Give to a storyteller to learn advanced Carim miracles.
In the Way of White, there is a tradition of placing great faith in the words of the blind, and braille tomes are not unusual.
entities.avail:
Found in the Road of Sacrifices.

From the Road of Sacrifices bonfire, drop from the ledge behind the first Corvian Storyteller. Continue onward until reaching a bridge with another Storyteller at the end and several Corvians scattered about. Drop by the right side before crossing and to a small ledge below, then follow the narrow path until reaching a cave guarded by two Festering Starved Hounds. The tome can be found on a corpse inside, along with another one that holds Morne's Ring.

entities.usage: Give to Irina to learn Lothric miracles.
entities.desc:
A sacred braille tome from Lothric, filled with miracles for use by knights.
Give to a storyteller to learn Lothric miracles.
It is said that no paladin inside Lothric castle could fall, owing to the divine protection they enjoyed.
entities.avail: The tome is located in Lothric Castle. From the Dragon Barracks bonfire the player can proceed through the area until they reach the Dragonslayer Armour fog wall. Before entering, head to the left, dropping down to the platform containing one of the Lothric Wyverns. The tome is in the room behind it.
entities.use:
Given to Irina of Carim will unlock the following miracles:

  • Blessed Weapon
  • Bountiful Light
  • Magic Barrier

entities.usage: Give to Cornyx to learn advanced pyromancies.
entities.desc:
A pyromancy tome from Carthus containing pyromancies crafted for battle.
Give to the old master pyromancer to learn advanced pyromancies of the Carthus.
Carthus pyromancies developed in isolation from other forms, explaining their divergent evolution.
entities.avail: Found in the Catacombs of Carthus. After crossing the long bridge at the beginning of the level, jump off the left side near the end of the bridge. At the end of the short hall will be the tome.

entities.desc:
Secret crystal scroll of the Grand Archives of Lothric.
Give to a sorcerer to learn crystal sorceries.
These sorceries are the work of the paledrake, Seath the Scaleless, whom Logan is said to have met, a branch of sorcery that has been carried on by the Crystal Sages.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Crystal Sage found in the Grand Archives.

entities.desc:
A braille divine tome of the Deep, belonging to the deacons of the cathedral.
Give to a storyteller to learn miracles of the deep.
Intended to teach divine protection to the deacons of the deep, but later, dark tales were added to its pages, such that it is now considered a thing profane.
entities.avail: • Dropped by a Mimic in the Cathedral of the Deep. Once entering the cathedral by the back gate after traversing through the roofs, proceed past the first Giant Slave and go downstairs into a passage. At the end there will be a small prayer room with the mimic chest holding the tome.

A golden scroll chronicling the vast research of the xanthous scholars.
Give to a sorcerer to learn the arts of Oolacile.
In the lost land of Oolacile, the sorceries orchestrated light, and were said to shine in golden hues.
entities.avail:
Found in Farron Keep.

From the Keep Ruins bonfire, head toward the main gate and then turn right, following the wall. Once reaching a clearing inhabited by many Basilisks, turn right to find a cave with a corpse holding the scroll, along with a chest containing the Antiquated Set.
