entities.usage: Give to Karla to learn black flame pyromancies.
entities.desc:
A pyromancy tome of the grave warden, from the Carthus Catacombs.
Give to the pyromancer master to learn black flame sorceries.
High Lord Wolnir of Carthus succumbed to the Abyss, but the pyromancer later became a grave warden, and discovered the black flame.
entities.avail: Located in the Catacombs of Carthus. Upon entering the boss fight of High Lord Wolnir, the item will be in the center of the arena where he spawns. If not picked up during the boss fight, it can be found on a corpse at the far-left corner of the goblet chamber after reloading the area.
entities.use:
Giving the tome to Karla will unlock the following dark pyromancies in her stock of wares:

  • Black Flame
  • Black Fire Orb

entities.name: Great Swamp Pyromancy Tome
entities.usage: Give to Cornyx to learn advanced pyromancies of the Great Swamp.
entities.desc:
Pyromancy tome from the Great Swamp containing advanced pyromancies.
Give to the old master pyromancer to learn advanced pyromancies of the Great Swamp.
Spells of the Great Swamp are passed down from master to pupil. Without a master, there is no pupil, but without a pupil, there is also no master.
entities.avail: The tome is located within the swamp of the Road of Sacrifices, pinned between a large tree and a wall found inside a patch of deep water. A Great Crab will be guarding the area.
entities.use:
After providing the tome to Cornyx of the Great Swamp, the following pyromancies will be available to the player:

QuantityItemCost
1Fire Orb3,000
1Bursting Fireball5,000
1Poison Mist2,000
1Profuse Sweat2,000

entities.name: Izalith Pyromancy Tome
entities.usage: Give to Cornyx of the Great Swamp to learn chaos pyromancies of Izalith.
entities.desc:
A pyromancy tome from Izalith containing pyromancies of the witches.
Give to the old master pyromancer to learn chaos pyromancies of Izalith.
Chaos pyromancies manipulate lava, and birthed all later forms of pyromancy.
entities.avail: Found in the Smouldering Lake. From the Old King's Antechamber bonfire, head into the passage with the Demon Cleric and proceed forward into a room guarded by three Smouldering Ghrus. The tome can be looted from a corpse "praying" in front of a statue.
entities.use:
Giving the tome to Cornyx of the Great Swamp will unlock the following pyromancies in his stock of wares:

QuantityItemCost
1Great Chaos Fire Orb10,000
1Chaos Storm12,000

entities.name: Logan's Scroll
entities.usage: Give to Orbeck of Vinheim to to learn Big Hat Logan's sorceries.
entities.desc:
Secret scroll of the Profaned Capital court sorcerers, containing sorceries of Logan.
Give to a sorcerer to learn Logan's Sorceries.
The court sorcerers used this scroll to claim heirship to Logan's legacy, though how that claim stands up to closer scrutiny is another story.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Court Sorcerer Eamon in the Profaned Capital.
entities.use:
Give to Orbeck of Vinheim in Firelink Shrine to upgrade his stock of sorceries:

QuantityItemCost
1Homing Soulmass6,000
1Soul Spear5,000

entities.name: Londor Braille Divine Tome
entities.usage: Give to either Irina or Karla to learn miracles of Londor.
entities.desc:
A braille tome of Londor, first spoken by Liliane of the Sable Church.
Give this to a storyteller to learn miracles of Londor.
This is a forbidden tome, as it offers salvation to all Hollows, and conversely curses all things living.
entities.avail: Sold by Yuria of Londor for 50 souls in Firelink Shrine.
entities.use:
The tome can be given to either Irina of Carim or Karla in Firelink Shrine. Once done, the character who received the tome will add the following Dark Miracles to their stock:

AvailableItemCost
1Dark Blade10,000
1Vow of Silence15,000
1Dead Again5,000

entities.name: Quelana Pyromancy Tome
entities.usage: Give to Karla to learn Quelana's pyromancies.
entities.desc:
A pyromancy tome of Quelana containing her unique spells. These pyromancies can only be taught by a female master.
Give to a female pyromancy master to learn Quelana's pyromancies.
Quelana, the sole surviving witch of Izalith, once accepted a human pupil, but after the pupil moved on, she never took another.
entities.avail:
Found in the Smouldering Lake.

From the Old King's Antechamber bonfire, follow a nearby corridor (through a hidden wall) that leads to a room with two Demon Clerics. Drop down and follow a passageway nearby containing several Hound Rats. Hitting the wall directly opposite to this corridor reveals an illusory wall (the wall can be identified by a blue glow). The corpse of a giant spider-humanoid lies behind it, along with the tome.
entities.use:
Giving the tome to Karla in Firelink Shrine unlocks the following pyromancies for purchase:

  • Fire Whip
  • Firestorm
  • Rapport

entities.name: Sage's Scroll
entities.usage: Give to Orbeck of Vinheim to learn the sorceries of the Crystal Sages.
entities.desc:
Scroll containing sorceries of the Crystal Sages.
Give to a sorcerer to learn sorceries of the Sages.
As any sorcerer knows, sorcery is a talent, and these sorceries were refined to nurture a very special talent.
entities.avail: Found in Farron Keep. From the Keep Ruins bonfire, head down the path, turn left and look for a family of dead Mushroom people and several Ghrus scattered around. The scroll will be nearby.
entities.use:
Give to Orbeck of Vinheim in Firelink Shrine to upgrade his stock of Sorceries:

QuantityItemCost
1Great Farron Dart2,000
1Farron Hail5,000

entities.name: Soul of a Crystal Sage
entities.usage: • Consume for 3,000 souls. • Transpose for Crystal Sage's Rapier. • Transpose for Crystal Hail.
entities.desc:
Soul of a Crystal Sage. One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire numerous souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
The twin Crystal Sages once served as spiritual guides to the scholars of the Grand Archives, and one went on to ally with the Undead Legion.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating the Crystal Sage in the Road of Sacrifices.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 3,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Crystal Sage's Rapier or the Crystal Hail sorcery.

entities.name: Soul of a Demon
entities.usage: • Consume for 20,000 souls. • Transpose for Demon's Greataxe. • Transpose for Demon's Fist.
entities.desc:
Soul of a demon.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire numerous souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
Demons were born of the Chaos Flame, but the flame has not survived, and the demons are a dying race.
entities.avail: Obtained by defeating the Demon in the Catacombs of Carthus, just before the Abandoned Tomb bonfire.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Demon's Greataxe or the Demon's Fist.

entities.name: Soul of a Stray Demon
entities.usage: • Consume for 20,000 souls. • Transpose for Boulder Heave. • Transpose for Havel's Ring.
entities.desc:
Soul of the Stray Demon. One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire numerous souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
The Stray Demon, now lacking even a trace of flame, was once the gatekeeper of Lothric.
entities.avail: Dropped by the Stray Demon found atop the fortress in Farron Keep.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Boulder Heave pyromancy or the Havel's Ring.

entities.name: Soul of Aldrich
entities.usage: • Consume for 15,000 souls. • Transpose for Lifehunt Scythe. • Transpose for Darkmoon Longbow.
entities.desc:
Soul of Aldrich.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire many souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
When Aldrich ruminated on the fading of the fire, it inspired visions of a coming age of the deep sea.
He knew the path would be arduous, but he had no fear. He would devour the gods himself.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating Aldrich, Devourer of Gods in Anor Londo.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 15,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Lifehunt Scythe or the Darkmoon Longbow.

entities.name: Soul of Boreal Valley Vordt
entities.usage: • Consume for 2,000 souls. • Transpose for Vordt's Great Hammer. • Transpose for Pontiff's Left Eye.
entities.desc:
Soul of Vordt of the Boreal Valley. One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire many souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
Vordt served as an outrider knight, never far from the fleeting dancer.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating Vordt of the Boreal Valley at the bottom of the High Wall of Lothric.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 2,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Vordt's Great Hammer or the Pontiff's Left Eye.

entities.name: Soul of Champion Gundyr
entities.usage: • Consume for 20,000 souls. • Transpose for Gundyr's Halberd. • Transpose for Prisoner's Chain.
entities.desc:
Soul of Champion Gundyr.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire numerous souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
Once, a champion came late to the festivities, and was greeted by a shrine without fire, and a bell that would not toll.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating Champion Gundyr in the Untended Graves.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Gundyr's Halberd or the Prisoner's Chain.

entities.name: Soul of Consumed Oceiros
entities.usage: • Consume for 12,000 souls. • Transpose for Moonlight Greatsword. • Transpose for White Dragon Breath.
entities.desc:
Soul of Oceiros, the Consumed King.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire numerous souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
Oceiros went mad trying to harness his royal blood for a greater purpose, leading him to the heretics of the Grand Archives, where he discovered the twisted worship of Seath the paledrake.
entities.avail: Obtained upon defeating Oceiros, the Consumed King in the Consumed King's Garden.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 12,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Moonlight Greatsword or the White Dragon Breath sorcery.

entities.name: Soul of Darkeater Midir
entities.usage: • Consume for 20,000 souls. • Transpose for Frayed Blade. • Transpose for Old Moonlight.
entities.desc:
Soul of Darkeater Midir.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire many souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
Midir, descendant of Archdragons, was raised by the gods, and owing to his immortality was given a duty to eternally battle the dark, a duty that he would never forget, even after the gods perished.
entities.avail: Obtained upon defeating Darkeater Midir.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Frayed Blade or the Old Moonlight.

entities.name: Soul of Dragonslayer Armour
entities.usage: • Consume for 15,000 souls. • Transpose for Dragonslayer Greataxe. • Transpose for Dragonslayer Greatshield.
entities.desc:
Soul of the Dragonslayer Armour.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire many souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
The Dragonslayer Armour, controlled by the Pilgrim Butterfly, lost its master long ago, but still remembers their sporting hunts.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating the Dragonslayer Armour in Lothric Castle.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 15,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Dragonslayer Greataxe or Dragonslayer Greatshield.

entities.name: Soul of High Lord Wolnir
entities.usage: • Consume for 10,000 souls. • Transpose for Wolnir's Holy Sword. • Transpose for Black Serpent.
entities.desc:
Soul of the High Lord Wolnir.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire many souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
Lord Wolnir of Carthus sentenced countless souls to gruesome deaths, keen to outlive them all.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating High Lord Wolnir in the Catacombs of Carthus.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 10,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either Wolnir's Holy Sword or the Black Serpent pyromancy.

entities.name: Soul of Pontiff Sulyvahn
entities.usage: • Consume for 12,000 souls. • Transpose for Greatsword of Judgment. • Transpose for Profaned Greatsword.
entities.desc:
Soul of Pontiff Sulyvahn.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire many souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
Pontiff Sulyvahn of Irithyll imprisoned a god of the old royalty in the abandoned cathedral, to be fed to the devourer.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating Pontiff Sulyvahn in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 12,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Greatsword of Judgment or the Profaned Greatsword.

entities.name: Soul of Rosaria
entities.usage: • Use to resurrect Rosaria. • Consume for 5,000 souls. • Transpose for Bountiful Sunlight.
entities.desc:
The soul of Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth, stolen by Ringfinger Leonhard.
Return this to her extant corpse, and mother Rosaria will spring back to life.
As if nothing had ever happened.
entities.avail: Obtained by using the Black Eye Orb in Gwynevere's empty chamber in Anor Londo, located above the Aldrich, Devourer of Gods bonfire. The player will invade the world of Rosaria's murderer, Leonhard, and receive the soul upon exacting revenge against him.
entities.use:
• Use on Rosaria's corpse to resurrect her after she has been slain by Leonhard.
  • Consume for 5,000 souls.
  • Transpose with Ludleth to create the Bountiful Sunlight miracle.

entities.name: Soul of Sister Friede
entities.usage: • Consume for 20,000 souls. • Transpose for Friede's Great Scythe. • Transpose for Rose of Ariandel.
entities.desc:
Soul of Sister Friede. One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire numerous souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
Friede was the first Ash to enter the painting, but together with the good Father, they chose rot over fire.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating Sister Friede in the Painted World of Ariandel.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either Friede's Great Scythe or the Rose of Ariandel.

entities.name: Soul of Slave Knight Gael
entities.usage: • Consume for 20,000 souls. • Transpose for Gael's Greatsword. • Transpose for Repeating Crossbow.
entities.desc:
Soul of Slave Knight Gael.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire many souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
The red-hooded, wandering slave knight Gael sought the blood of the dark soul as pigment for the Painted World. But Gael knew he was no Champion, that the dark soul would likely ruin him and that he had little hope of a safe return.
entities.avail: Obtained upon defeating Slave Knight Gael.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either Gael's Greatsword or Repeating Crossbow.

entities.name: Soul of the Blood of the Wolf
entities.page: Soul of the Blood of the Wolf
entities.usage: • Consume for 20,000 souls. • Transpose for Farron Greatsword. • Transpose for Wolf Knight's Greatsword.
entities.desc:
Soul of the Blood of the Wolf. One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire numerous souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
The blood was spread amongst the Abyss Watchers, and their souls are one with the soul of the wolf blood master.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating the Abyss Watchers in the Farron Keep.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Farron Greatsword or the Wolf Knight's Greatsword.

entities.name: Soul of the Dancer
entities.usage: • Consume for 10,000 souls. • Transpose for Soothing Sunlight. • Transpose for Dancer's Enchanted Swords.
entities.desc:
Soul of the dancer.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire many souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
The Pontiff Sulyvahn bestowed a double-slashing sword upon a distant daughter of the formal royal family, ordering her to serve first as a dancer, and then as an outrider knight, the equivalent to exile.
entities.avail: Obtained upon defeating the Dancer of the Boreal Valley in the High Wall of Lothric.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 10,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Soothing Sunlight miracle or the Dancer's Enchanted Swords.

entities.name: Soul of the Deacons of the Deep
entities.page: Soul of the Deacons of the Deep
entities.usage: • Consume for 20,000 souls. • Transpose for Deep Soul. • Transpose for Cleric's Candlestick.
entities.desc:
Soul of the Deacons of the Deep.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire numerous souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
After Aldrich left for the Boreal valley, Archdeacon Royce remained in the cathedral with the high priests, to keep eternal watch over their master's coffin.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating the Deacons of the Deep in the Cathedral of the Deep.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Deep Soul or the Cleric's Candlestick.

entities.name: Soul of the Demon Prince
entities.usage: • Consume for 20,000 souls. • Transpose for Seething Chaos. • Transpose for Demon's Scar.
entities.desc:
Soul of the Demon Prince.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire many souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
The demons, birthed from a common Chaos, share almost everything between them, even the pride of their prince, and his near-faded flame.
So that the last demon standing may rekindle it.
entities.avail: Obtained upon defeating the Demon Prince in The Dreg Heap.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either Seething Chaos or the Demon's Scar.

entities.name: Soul of the Lords
entities.usage: • Consume for 20,000 souls. • Transpose for Firelink Greatsword. • Transpose for Sunlight Spear.
entities.desc:
Soul of the Lords.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire numerous souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
Since Lord Gwyn, the first Lord of Cinder, many exalted lords have linked the First Flame, and it is their very souls that have manifested themselves as defender of the flame.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating the Soul of Cinder in Kiln of the First Flame.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Firelink Greatsword or the Sunlight Spear miracle.

entities.name: Soul of the Nameless King
entities.usage: • Consume for 16,000 souls. • Transpose for Storm Curved Sword. • Transpose for Dragonslayer Swordspear. • Transpose for Lightning Storm.
entities.desc:
Soul of the Nameless King.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire many souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
The Nameless King was once a dragon-slaying god of war, before he sacrificed everything to ally himself with the ancient dragons.
entities.avail: Obtained by defeating the Nameless King in Archdragon Peak.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 16,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Storm Curved Sword, the Dragonslayer Swordspear or the Lightning Storm miracle.

entities.name: Soul of the Old Demon King
entities.page: Soul of the Old Demon King
entities.usage: • Consume for 10,000 souls. • Transpose for Old King's Great Hammer. • Transpose for Chaos Bed Vestiges.
entities.desc:
Soul of the Old Demon King.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire many souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
The shriveled Old Demon King is now like a clump of burnt ash, but he is the last living witness of the Chaos of Izalith.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating the Old Demon King in the Smouldering Lake.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 10,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Old King's Great Hammer or the Chaos Bed Vestiges.

entities.name: Soul of the Rotted Greatwood
entities.usage: • Consume to acquire 3,000 souls. • Transpose to create the Hollowslayer Greatsword. • Transpose to create Arstor's Spear.
entities.desc:
Soul of the Curse-rotted Greatwood.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire many souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
Ever since its establishment, all manner of curses have managed to seep into the Undead Settlement. The worst of them were sealed away inside a spirit tree, but eventually the curses took their toll.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating the Curse-rotted Greatwood in the Undead Settlement.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 3,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either the Hollowslayer Greatsword or Arstor's Spear.

entities.name: Soul of the Twin Princes
entities.usage: • Consume for 20,000 souls. • Transpose for Lothric's Holy Sword. • Transpose for Lorian's Greatsword.
entities.desc:
Soul of the Twin Princes.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire numerous souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
The two princes rejected their duty to become Lords of Cinder, and settled down far, far away to watch the fire fade from a distance. A curse makes their souls nearly inseparable.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating the twin princes, Lorian and Lothric, in Lothric Castle.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either Lothric's Holy Sword or Lorian's Greatsword.

entities.name: Soul of Yhorm the Giant
entities.usage: • Consume for 20,000 souls. • Transpose for Yhorm's Great Machete. • Transpose for Yhorm's Greatshield.
entities.desc:
Soul of Yhorm the Giant.
One of the twisted souls, steeped in strength.
Use to acquire numerous souls, or transpose to extract its true strength.
Yhorm is the descendant of an ancient conqueror, but was asked by the very people once subjugated to lead them, serving as both a weighty blade and a stone-hard shield.
entities.avail: Obtained upon defeating Yhorm the Giant in the Profaned Capital.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls or transpose with Ludleth to create either Yhorm's Great Machete or Yhorm's Greatshield.

entities.name: Basin of Vows
entities.usage: Place on the statue of the beheading knight to summon the Dancer of the Boreal Valley.
entities.desc:
Chalice used in old ceremony in which Lothric Knights take their vows. It is only a formality now, but it remains as an empty practice.
Place this basin at the statue of a beheading knight.
entities.avail:
• High Wall of Lothric
    • Automatically added to the player's inventory once Emma, High Priestess of Lothric Castle dies as part of the storyline
    • Dropped by Emma if the player kills her.
entities.use:
Approaching the beheading statue behind Emma's chair with the Basin of Vows in hand will trigger the Dancer of the Boreal Valley fight.

Once the Dancer has been defeated, interacting with the beheading statue will place the basin in front of it, triggering a cutscene that unlocks access to Lothric Castle.

entities.name: Cell Key
entities.usage: Unlocks Greirat's cell in the High Wall of Lothric.
entities.desc:
Key to a cell holding thieves and the like.
The is no shortage of brash thieves in Lothric, and these particular thieves likely scaled the wall from the Undead Settlement.
But they are only willing to practice their thievery on the High Wall, for their fear of Lothric Castle, rumored to devour men, keeps them clear of its grounds.
entities.avail: From the Tower on the Wall bonfire, head downstairs and drop down a level. Proceed through an arch to the outside rooftops with the Pus of Man. Take the ladder down and enter the room with the spear-wielding Lothric Knight. Make way past the knight and find a room with several Large Hollow Soldiers and two Starved Hounds. The key can be found at the bottom of a small staircase, in a corner guarded by one of the hounds.
entities.use: Unlocks Greirat's cell below the Tower on the Wall bonfire.

entities.name: Champion's Bones
entities.usage: Burn at the Firelink Shrine bonfire to access Undead Matches.
entities.desc:
The charred but warm bones of a champion.
Long ago, an Undead declared a fight. A fight to celebrate their undeath, and so to preserve what remained of their souls. So it was that the Undead Matches were born. The merit of an Undead is measured in deaths. Could there be a greater gift for such a creature, than a fight that has no end?
entities.avail:
• Dropped by Champion's Gravetender and Gravetender Greatwolf.
  • Obtained by completing Amnesiac Lapp's questline, or dropped by Lapp upon death, if it has not been obtained by defeating the Gravetender and Greatwolf.
entities.use: The player may burn them at the Firelink Shrine bonfire in order to access Undead Matches.

entities.name: Cinders of a Lord
entities.usage: Place on the Abyss Watchers' throne in Firelink Shrine.
entities.desc:
Cinders of a lord left by the Abyss Watchers.
If the lords will not return to their thrones themselves, let them return as cinders.
The Watchers of the Abyss swore upon their shared wolf's blood, which also served as their mandate as lords.
entities.avail:
There are four cinders to be obtained in the game, each belonging to a Lord of Cinder.

  1. Obtained by defeating the Abyss Watchers in the Farron Keep.
  2. Obtained by defeating Yhorm the Giant in the Profaned Capital.
  3. Obtained by defeating Aldrich, Devourer of Gods in Anor Londo.
  4. Obtained by defeating Lothric in the Grand Archives.
entities.use: When all cinders have been placed at their respective thrones in Firelink Shrine, the player gains access to the Kiln of the First Flame, where they can confront the Soul of Cinder.

entities.name: Coiled Sword
entities.usage: Ignites the bonfire in Firelink Shrine.
entities.desc:
Sword missing from the shrine bonfire. Cannot be equipped as a weapon. Thrust into the shrine bonfire to restore its power and enable travel between bonfires.
This sword is only bequeathed to chosen ash, as judged by the Iudex, who awaits the arrival of ash as a scabbard.
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating Iudex Gundyr in the Cemetery of Ash.
entities.use: Used to ignite the bonfire in Firelink Shrine and allow the player to travel between bonfires.

entities.name: Contraption Key
entities.usage: Unlocks the attic of the archive in the Corvian Settlement.
entities.desc:
The key to the contraption leading to the attic of the archive found on the edge of the Corvian Settlement.
After Sir Vilhelm led a white-haired woman to the attic of the library, he kept this key as if it were his life.
entities.avail: Dropped by Sir Vilhelm after defeating him in the Painted World of Ariandel.
entities.use: Unlocks the path leading to the attic of the archive found on the edge of the Corvian Settlement.

entities.name: Dark Sigil
entities.usage: Represents the Ashen One's level of hollowing.
entities.desc:
A black, gaping hole in the flesh that resembles the brand of an Undead.
The darkness of humanity seeps from this bottomless pitch-black hole, the gap filled by the accumulation of the curse.
This Dark Sigil will never heal, but there is a tale told of a Fire Keeper who returned from the Abyss, and brought great comfort to a bearer of the curse.
entities.avail:
• Five are given to the player after letting Yoel of Londor draw out their true strength, granting a free level each time. Yoel grants a session at 0, 2, 6, 12 and 15 Hollowing.
  • Three are granted during Yuria of Londor's questline, once the player completes the Rite of Avowal with Anri of Astora at Anor Londo.
entities.use:
• Increases the player's Hollowing level by the number of accumulated Sigils upon death.
  • Grants bonus Luck when wielding Hollow-infused weapons if Hollowing is 15 or greater, based on the upgrade level of the weapon.
  • Once eight Dark Sigils are acquired, the Lord of Hollows ending may be unlocked.

entities.name: Eyes of a Fire Keeper
entities.usage: Give to the Fire Keeper to unlock the End of Fire ending.
entities.desc:
A pair of dark eyes.
Said to be the eyes of the first Fire Keeper, and the light that was lost by all Fire Keepers to come.
It reveals to the sightless Fire Keepers things that they should never see.
entities.avail: Found in the Untended Graves, inside the Flameless Shrine. They can be found on a body lying beyond an illusory wall located where Irina normally resides in Firelink Shrine. The existence of this wall is hinted by the shorter length that corridor has, if compared to its normal shrine version counterpart.
entities.use: Given to the Fire Keeper adds an option to her services to unlock the End of Fire ending.

entities.name: Fire Keeper Soul
entities.usage: Give to the Fire Keeper to allow her to heal dark sigils.
entities.desc:
Soul of a Fire Keeper who is said to have returned from the Abyss.
This Fire Keeper preserves the bonfire, and serves its champion. She is said to have soothed and accepted the dark sigil, which has tainted her soul.
And yet, her soul will one day embed itself in the bosom of another Fire Keeper.
entities.avail: • Found on the corpse of a fire keeper at the top of the bell tower in Firelink Shrine. The entrance to this tower can only be unlocked by using the Tower Key, sold by the Shrine Handmaid.
entities.use: Give the soul to the Fire Keeper in Firelink Shrine, thus allowing her to remove dark sigils contracted after leveling up with Yoel of Londor.

entities.name: Grand Archives Key
entities.usage: Unlocks the main entrance to the Grand Archives.
entities.desc:
Key to the main entrance to the Grand Archives of Lothric.
With the fire fading, and the spreading pus of man tainting the castle, the Grand Archives closed its doors for good.
Today, only a few of its keys remain. This one likely belonged to Gotthard, one of king's Black Hand, who fled the castle.
entities.avail: Found in Lothric Castle, on the lifeless body of Black Hand Gotthard which can be encountered lying just before the entrance to the Grand Archives. The body will only appear once the player has defeated the first three Lords of Cinder: Abyss Watchers, Aldrich and Yhorm.
entities.use: Unlocks the main entrance to the Grand Archives of Lothric.

entities.name: Grave Key
entities.usage: Unlocks the barred door in the sewers of the Undead Settlement that lead to Irina's cell.
entities.desc:
Key to the barred door leading from the sewer below the Undead Settlement to a moist grave.
The grave, which no longer receive visitors, was once the site of a statue of Velka, Goddess of Sin, and was believed to pardon wrongdoing and life curses.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid in Firelink Shrine for 1,500 souls, once she has been given the Mortician's Ashes.
entities.use: Unlocks the barred door in the sewers of the Undead Settlement that lead to a tunnel complex which eventually ends in Irina's cell. Also, this key allows to lock the door it is intended to. To lock this door, user must be standing near it at the side of tunnel catacomb(not the side of bridge and sewers) and open the door with the key. After it, door can be locked from the both sides, but if it is open from the side of sewers once, it cannot be locked anymore. If the door was open from the tunnels and player left current location, took rest near bonfire or left game, door also cannot be locked anymore. This opportunity can be used to lock an invader in, forcing them to return to their world.

entities.name: Hawkwood's Swordgrass
entities.usage: Bears a message from Hawkwood to meet him in the Farron mausoleum.
entities.desc:
Blood-stained swordgrass of Hawkwood, deserter of the Undead Legion.
Traditionally, the Undead Legion of Farron sends the gravest of messages using swordgrass.
"Come to the mausoleum in Farron. Only one can take the path of ancient dragons."
entities.avail: Once the player has obtained the Twinkling Dragon Torso Stone in Archdragon Peak, the swordgrass will be given to the Ashen One by Andre in Firelink Shrine, along with a message from Hawkwood.
entities.use:
Bears a message from Hawkwood:

<p style="text-align: center;">"Come to the mausoleum in Farron. Only one can take the path of ancient dragons."</p>

While this item by itself does not have any particular use, it hints the player into visiting the mausoleum in Farron once more, in the same place where they fought the Abyss Watchers. Upon arrival, Hawkwood will be already expecting them and challenge them to a duel to the death for the Twinkling Dragon Torso Stone and the title of who is the best "dragon" of both.

entities.name: Jailbreaker's Key
entities.usage: Unlocks the barred window in the Irithyll Dungeon.
entities.desc:
Key to the barred window in the Irithyll dungeon.
But the window only leads to a bottomless black pit below, and above, a paltry view of the ruined Profaned Capital.
The very architecture appears to be a cruel joke the jailers played on would-be escapees.
entities.avail: Found in the Irithyll Dungeon, in a cell at the end of the second floor, in the hallway that is accessed by traveling through the hole connecting two adjacent cells.
entities.use: Unlocks the barred window found at the end on the first corridor on the second floor of the Irithyll Dungeon.

entities.name: Jailer's Key Ring
entities.usage: Unlocks many cell doors in the Irithyll Dungeon, including Karla's.
entities.desc:
Ring of keys to the Irithyll dungeon held by the jailer.
Opens most cell doors.
On what grounds do they remain imprisoned, considering that by now they are mindless Hollows, or unrealized, gibbering fools?
entities.avail: Found in the upper levels of the Giant Slave's cell in the Irithyll Dungeon. To reach it, the player must head through the toxic swamp of the Profaned Capital, up the chapel, and through a passage with a hole on the wall overlooking the giant and guarded by two invisible Jailers. The key lies at the end of the hallway.
entities.use:
Unlocks three cells in the Irithyll Dungeon:

  1. Unlocks a cell near the Irithyll Dungeon bonfire with a corpse holding a Rusted Gold Coin.
  2. Unlocks both gates of a cell on the lower-east wing of the first cell block with a corpse holding the Prisoner Chief's Ashes.
  3. Unlocks Karla's cell in the second cell block. The area is patrolled by several Jailers.

entities.name: Lift Chamber Key
entities.usage: Unlocks the lift in the High Wall of Lothric.
entities.desc:
Key to the room of the lift that descends to the deepest dungeon in Lothric.
A surviving Darkwraith, from the land swallowed by darkness, is said to be held here.
entities.avail: Obtained from Ringfinger Leonhard when spoken to after obtaining a Pale Tongue (can be found in Undead Settlement and Cathedral of the Deep or dropped by Darkwraiths in Farron Keep).
entities.use: Unlocks the door to a lift in the High Wall of Lothric. The door can be found downstairs from the Tower on the Wall bonfire, opposite to a halberd-wielding hollow, and takes the player down to a hidden chamber with a Darkwraith that drops the Red Eye Orb.

entities.name: Old Cell Key
entities.usage: Unlocks the oldest cell in the Profaned Capital.
entities.desc:
Key to the oldest cell in the Irithyll dungeon.
The first prisoner of the dungeon was a lone giant. Cells for men were built at his feet.
entities.avail: Found in the Irithyll Dungeon, at the end of the sewage system inhabited by Hound Rats and opposite to a Mimic. Picking up the key unleashes several Basilisks in the area.
entities.use:
Unlocks the oldest cell in the Profaned Capital. From the Profaned Capital bonfire, climb down the nearby ladder and proceed through the level until reaching a ruined church located among the toxic swamp. Climb up the ladder on the right and head forward until reaching the rooftops (fighting the Court Sorcerer along the way). Look for an open window nearby and jump inside. The cell can be found just ahead, with a body inside holding the Covetous Gold Serpent Ring.

If the player followed Siegward's questline, he can also be found at this location and will present a Titanite Slab in gratitude for freeing him.

entities.name: Small Doll
entities.usage: Grants access to Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
entities.desc:
Small silverwork doll depicting a young squire.
In the legendary old city of Irithyll situated in the Boreal Valley, the Pontiff Sulyvahn gave this doll to valued subjects, so that they might use it to cross the barrier when they return home.
Listen carefully, and you can hear it say, "Wherever you go, the moon still sets in Irithyll. Wherever you may be, Irithyll is your home."
entities.avail: Obtained after defeating the Deacons of the Deep in the Cathedral of the Deep.
entities.use: Breaks the seal on the bridge that grants access to Central Irithyll.

entities.name: Small Lothric Banner
entities.usage: Used to gain access to the Undead Settlement.
entities.desc:
Small banner held by Lothric messengers.
Hold up outside the main castle gate to be greeted by an escort.
When the High Wall appeared, the path to the Undead Settlement was blocked, and messengers came bearing this banner. They were sent out with a duty, but had no way of returning.
entities.avail:
• Given to the player by Emma, High Priestess of Lothric Castle in the High Wall of Lothric's cathedral.
  • Dropped by Emma if she is killed by the player.
entities.use: Allows the player to be carried to the Undead Settlement after defeating Vordt of the Boreal Valley thanks to an escort of Batwing Demons.

entities.name: Sword of Avowal
entities.usage: Ceremonial tool used to conclude Anri's questline.
entities.desc:
Ceremonial sword of Londor.
Cannot be equipped as a weapon.
It is said that a rite of wedlock will presage a true Hollow lord.
Your spouse's name is Anri, who patiently awaits a rightful lord, deep within the mausoleum.
entities.avail: Given to the player by a Londor pilgrim outside of the Darkmoon Tomb in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, just before reaching Anor Londo.
entities.use:
Used to conclude Anri of Astora's questline.

Interacting with Anri's body in front of Gwyn's tomb will play a cutscene where the player plunges the sword into his/her body, concluding with this the rite of wedlock that will presage the coming of a true hollow lord.

entities.name: Tower Key
entities.usage: Unlocks the bell tower behind Firelink Shrine.
entities.desc:
Key to the decrepit tower behind Firelink Shrine which leads to the Bell Tower.
The Bell Tower is the grave of the Fire Keepers past. When a Fire Keeper has served her purpose, she is led to true darkness, where she enjoys a long-deserved sleep.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid in Firelink Shrine for 20,000 souls.
  • Dropped by Irina of Carim after her death.
entities.use: Unlocks the gate that gives access to the decrepit bell tower behind Firelink Shrine.

entities.name: Transposing Kiln
entities.usage: Give to Ludleth, Lord of Cinder, to conduct soul transposition.
entities.desc:
An old transposing kiln from Courland, crafted with stitched crystal lizard hide.
Give to Ludleth, Lord of Cinder, to conduct soul transposition.
This kiln can transpose twisted souls to craft special items with their concentrated essence. Deemed forbidden by those unable to make proper use of it.
entities.avail: Received upon defeating the Curse-rotted Greatwood in the Undead Settlement.
entities.use: Give the kiln to Ludleth of Courland in Firelink Shrine to conduct transposition of boss souls.

entities.name: Young Grass Dew
entities.usage: Increases damage absorption and stamina regeneration.
entities.desc:
A small, transparent stone that once graced the green young grass crest.
This semi-precious gem honors a Spear of Church after a battle well-fought, and is said to slightly enhance their blessing of protection. (while held, this effect is constant)
entities.avail: Obtained as a reward for reaching Rank 1 in the Spears of the Church covenant. To achieve this, the player must offer 10 Filianore's Spear Ornaments to the Divine Spear Monument in the Ringed City.
entities.use: Slightly increases damage absorption and stamina regeneration.

entities.name: Dark Arrow
entities.usage: Inflict 65 Dark damage.
entities.desc:
Ritual arrows said to have been used by savage hunters.
Inflict dark damage.
It is said that these arrows scrape out death from their targets, but savages are known to tell tall tales.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 200 souls each, once she has been given the Easterner's Ashes.
entities.use: Besides inflicting Dark damage on foes, Dark Arrows have a moderate amount of homing ability, curving to chase down targets, much like Affinity.

entities.name: Dragonslayer Greatarrow
entities.usage: Shoot with a greatbow to deal 90 damage.
entities.desc:
Large spear-like arrows created by the giant blacksmith of the gods.
Can only be used with greatbows.
These large arrows were said to have been used by dragon hunters during the age of the gods.
Easily pierces human flesh.
entities.avail:
• Five can be found on a corpse alongside a Dragonslayer Greatbow on a ledge in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, past Pontiff Sulyvahn's boss room and below the flying buttresses where the greatbow-wielding Silver Knights are posted.
  • Dropped by greatbow-wielding Silver Knights.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 500 souls if he returns safely from pillaging Irithyll.
  • Sold by Shrine Handmaid if given Greirat's Ashes, provided that he survived the first pillaging journey.

entities.name: Dragonslayer Lightning Arrow
entities.usage: Deal 90 Lightning damage to target.
entities.desc:
Large spear-like arrows enveloped in lightning created by the giant blacksmith of the gods.
Can only be used with greatbows.
Lightning has been a weapon of dragonslayers ever since the time of Gwyn, the First Lord.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 750 souls if he returns safely from pillaging Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
  • Sold by Shrine Handmaid if given Greirat's Ashes, provided that he survived the first pillaging journey.

entities.name: Exploding Bolt
entities.usage: Deal 140 Fire damage to target.
entities.desc:
Bolts that explode on impact. Deals area fire damage in the immediate vicinity.
Due to the risk of detonation, the amount of bolts the user can carry is greatly limited.
These are, after all, prototypes created by the weapon craftsman Edmond. You get what you pay for.
entities.avail:
• Six can be found on a corpse by the first Giant inside the Cathedral of the Deep.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 500 souls once she has been given Greirat's Ashes, after sending him to pillage Lothric Castle.
entities.use: Deals Fire damage in small surrounding area on impact.

entities.name: Feather Arrow
entities.usage: Deal 40 physical damage to target.
entities.desc:
Red feathered arrows used by hunters.
Their long range makes them ideal for distant targets.
Simultaneously equip up to two types of arrows, and switch between them as needed.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 100 souls each after giving her the Dreamchaser's Ashes.

entities.name: Fire Arrow
entities.usage: Deals 25 physical damage and 40 Fire damage to target.
entities.desc:
Shoot arrows with burning tips dealing fire damage.
Simultaneously equip up to two types of arrows, and switch between them as needed.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 100 souls each.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Greirat's Ashes.
  • Dropped by Skeleton Swordsman archers, in bundles of 12, in the Catacombs of Carthus.
entities.use: Fire Arrows deal minimal thrust damage, as well as adding some Fire damage to each shot. They can be useful for applying Fire damage to distant targets, such as staggering a Pus of Man or igniting a stack of gunpowder barrels.

entities.name: Heavy Bolt
entities.usage: Deal 64 physical damage to target.
entities.desc:
Large, more powerful bolts with a shorter range due to their weight.
Simultaneously equip up to two types of bolts, and switch between them as needed.
entities.avail:
• Rare drop from the Devout of the Deep enemies in the Cathedral of the Deep.
  • Sold by the Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 100 souls each, once he returns from his first pillaging journey.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Greirat's Ashes.

entities.name: Large Arrow
entities.usage: Deal 55 physical damage to target.
entities.desc:
Large, more powerful arrows with a shorter range due to their weight.
Simultaneously equip up to two types of arrows, and switch between them as needed.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 50 souls each, once he has returned from his first pillaging journey.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid after she has been given Greirat's Ashes.

entities.name: Lightning Bolt
entities.usage: Inflicts 110 lightning damage.
entities.desc:
Bolts imbued with lightning created by the giant blacksmith of the gods.
However, the gods never used crossbows.
These bolts are likely artifacts of the dragonless era, when the pact between gods and humans was upheld.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement when he returns from his pillaging journey to Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid if given Greirat's Ashes, provided that he returned successfully from his first pillaging journey.
  • Ten bolts can be found in the Irithyll Dungeon, on a wooden roof only accessible by climbing a ladder located near the Mimic that drops Dragonslayer Lightning Arrows, in a small passage near the feet of the chained Giant Slave.
entities.use: Lightning Bolts inflict lightning damage, dealing additional damage to most enemies, especially those which are weak to this element. Likewise, the additional damage is greatly reduced on enemies resistant to lightning.

entities.name: Millwood Greatarrow
entities.usage: Deal 97 physical damage to target.
entities.desc:
Heavy, sturdy greatarrows made of black oak that deal heavy damage but have limited range.
Can only be fired using a greatbow.
It is said that the Millwood Knights used these to face their sworn enemy, the Abyss Dragon.
entities.avail:
• Purchased from the Shrine Handmaid for 800 souls after giving her the Captain's Ashes.
  • 5 are found on a corpse alongside the Millwood Greatbow.
entities.use:
Millwood Greatarrows function much like Large Arrows do for conventional bows, in that they deal more damage, but reduce the bow's effective range.

Care should be taken when using these arrows, as like Onislayer Greatarrows, they are incapable of knocking down their targets, with the only exception being certain weaker enemies upon headshot. As such, they should primarily be used to inflict damage on targets rather than attempting to displace them.

Because of the slow drawing nature of greatbows, it is ideal to equip the Hawk Ring, fire the arrows from an Onislayer Greatbow or fire the arrow using the Puncturing Arrow skill, in order to counter the reduced effective range of the greatarrows.

entities.name: Moonlight Arrow
entities.usage: Deals 75 Magic damage to target.
entities.desc:
Magical arrows said to have been used by the Darkmoon Knights.
Imbued with a silver light, these arrows inflict magic damage.
It is said that long ago the God of the Darkmoon Gwyndolin wielded these arrows with a matching golden bow.
entities.avail:
Firelink Shrine

  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement after he successfully returns from pillaging Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid after she is given Greirat's Ashes, provided they are obtained after he has returned from his second pillaging journey.

Anor Londo

  • ×6 are found on a ledge inside the cathedral.
entities.use: Moonlight Arrows deal Magic damage, this makes them useful for fighting enemies with shields, or who are resistant to thrusting damage. In addition, the damage output of these arrows is augmented when fired with the Darkmoon Longbow.

entities.name: Onislayer Greatarrow
entities.usage: Deal 60 physical damage to target.
entities.desc:
Large arrows used to destroy giant horned oni in an eastern land.
Can only be used with greatbows.
Made from the feathers of an aged crow, it is said that these arrows fly as straight as their master.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 600 souls each, once she has been given the Easterner's Ashes.
  • 8 are found in the Profaned Capital, on the stone bridge patrolled by the Gargoyle that leads towards Yhorm the Giant's boss arena, above where the Onislayer Greatbow is found.

entities.name: Poison Arrow
entities.usage: Deal 10 physical damage and 30 Poison build-up.
entities.desc:
Arrows with poisoned tips.
Inflict poison damage that gradually wears down foes.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Unbreakable Patches, once he becomes a merchant, for 120 souls each.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 120 souls each, after she is given Patches' Ashes.
entities.use: Poison arrows deal minor physical damage as well as causing 30 Poison build-up.

entities.name: Sniper Bolt
entities.usage: Deal 53 physical damage to target.
entities.desc:
Red feathered bolts used by snipers of Carim. Their long range makes them ideal for distant targets.
Though typically used with Sniper Crossbows in Carim, these bolts can still be used with any kind of crossbow.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 150 souls once he returns from his first pillaging journey.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Greirat's Ashes.

entities.name: Splintering Bolt
entities.usage: Deal 20 physical damage and 3 bleed build-up.
entities.desc:
Bolts that explode immediately after being shot.
Makes unusual shots possible, and releases splinters that cause immense bleeding.
These are, after all, prototypes created by the weapon craftsman Edmond. You get get what you pay for.
entities.avail: • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 280 souls once she has been given Greirat's Ashes, provided that he has pillaged Lothric Castle.
entities.use: Deals Thrust damage to the target, while also inflicting Bleed buildup. If the target is very close and is hit by the bolt before it splinters, they will take a flat 25 Bleed damage. However, once the bolt splinters, each fragment will inflict 3 Bleed damage.

entities.name: Standard Arrow
entities.usage: Deals 45 physical damage to target.
entities.desc:
Standard arrows used with bows.
Simultaneously equip up to two types of arrows, and switch between them as needed.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 10 souls.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid at the same price once she has been given Greirat's Ashes.
  • Found as loot with a longbow across the bridge from the High Wall of Lothric bonfire.
entities.use: Shot with a bow, the standard arrow deals 21-45 physical damage dependent on the distance of the enemy.

entities.name: Standard Bolt
entities.usage: Deal 48 physical damage to target.
entities.desc:
Standard bolts used with crossbows.
Simultaneously equip up to two types of bolts, and switch between them as needed.
entities.avail:
• Found as common drops from hollow soldiers.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 30 souls each.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Greirat's Ashes.

entities.name: Wood Arrow
entities.usage: Deals 30 physical damage to target.
entities.desc:
Inexpensive wooden arrows.
Weaker arrows that can be easily purchased in bulk.
Simultaneously equip up to two types of arrows, and switch between them as needed.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 5 souls each.
entities.use: Deals 30 physical damage upon impact to an enemy.

entities.name: Wood Bolt
entities.usage: Deals 38 physical damage to target.
entities.desc:
Inexpensive wooden bolts.
Weaker bolts that can be easily purchased in bulk.
Simultaneously equip up to two types of bolts, and switch between them as needed.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 10 souls each.
entities.use: Deals 38 physical damage upon impact.

entities.name: Alluring Skull
entities.usage: Attracts nearby foes when thrown. Does not work on all enemies.
entities.desc:
A skull resplendent in the scent of souls.
Prepared by evangelists of the Cathedral of the Deep.
Throw to shatter, spreading souls which attract enemies. Not effective for all foes.
entities.avail:
Firelink Shrine

  • ×6 are sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given the Mortician's Ashes.
  • Sold by Unbreakable Patches for 800 souls each.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for the same price once she has been given Patches' Ashes.

Undead Settlement

  • ×2 on a corpse being devoured by two Starved Hounds behind a broken carriage near the beginning of the area.
  • ×2 on a corpse lying behind a small house guarded by two Starved Hounds. The house is opposite to the entrance to the sewers, across the stone bridge in the area with three Hollow Manservants.

Catacombs of Carthus

  • Dropped by the Skeleton mage that controls the first boulder after descending the big staircase.
entities.use: Alluring Skulls crash upon impact after being thrown, releasing an attracting mist that draws the attention of most enemies toward its location. Most enemies will hover around or attack the mist for a short time giving the player time to flee or attack them.

entities.name: Ashen Estus Flask
entities.usage: Restores lost FP upon use (reusable).
entities.desc:
Undead treasure these dull ashen flasks.
Fill with Estus at bonfires, and drink to restore FP.
Quite befitting of an Unkindled, an Ashen Estus Flask turns a bonfire's heat cold.
entities.avail: Found at the beginning of the game in the Cemetery of Ash, on a corpse lying on the remains of the central fountain.

entities.name: Black Bug Pellet
entities.usage: Boosts Dark damage absorption for 60 seconds.
entities.desc:
Medicinal pellet made from crushed insects.
The black type temporarily boosts Dark damage absorption.
At all times, the Abyss Watchers of the Undead Legion keep a supply of these concoctions, prepared by the acolytes. Rumor has it their Ghru descendants still make these concoctions.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 1,500 souls each once she is given the Dreamchaser's Ashes.
  • Dropped by Ghrus in Farron Keep.
entities.use: Boosts Dark damage absorption by 15% for 60 seconds, 10% in PvP.

entities.name: Black Firebomb
entities.usage: Explodes, inflicting great fire damage.
entities.desc:
More powerful bisque filled with special black powder. Explodes, inflicting great fire damage.
Fire damage, which differs from physical damage, is highly effective against creatures of flesh, beasts, and other foes that might naturally have cause to fear the flame.
entities.avail:
• Selectable as a Burial Gift.
  • Sold by Unbreakable Patches for 300 souls each.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Patches' Ashes.
  • Can be found in the Consumed King's Garden.
  • 3 can be found above a Wing Knight in the High Wall of Lothric.
entities.use: Throw it at the enemy to deal great Fire damage (compared to the Firebombs).

entities.name: Bloodred Moss Clump
entities.usage: Reduces bleeding build-up.
entities.desc:
Red moss clump used as maggot repellent.
Reduces bleeding build-up.
Bleeding builds up when attacked by sharp blades or spikes, and once triggered causes severe damage. Use this moss clump before it reaches this point.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Greirat while in Firelink Shrine for 500 souls.
  • If Greirat dies, the player can obtain Greirat's Ashes and provide them to the Shrine Handmaid to increase her stock allowing for the purchase of these clumps.
  • Common drop by the Lesser Crabs in the Road of Sacrifices marshes.
  • Rare drop from Grave Wardens found in the Cathedral of the Deep.
entities.use: Bloodred Moss Clumps are used to remove Bleed buildup. They can also remove the maggot debuff from the player's body.

entities.name: Blooming Purple Moss Clump
entities.page: Blooming Purple Moss Clump (Dark Souls III)
entities.usage: Reduces Poison and Toxic. Cures ailments.
entities.desc:
Potently medicinal purple moss clump with a flower.
Reduces poison and toxin. Cures ailments.
A toxin is a more vicious form of poison which quickly leads to death.
Moss clumps without blooms are useless against toxin, and those who neglect to carry this flowered variety are simply courting an early demise.
entities.avail:
• Initially four are sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 1,000 souls each once she has been given the Paladin's Ashes.
    • The Shrine Handmaid's stock is upgraded to infinite once she is given the Excrement-covered Ashes.
  • Three on the wooden scaffolding at the toxic swamp with Sewer Centipedes in the Profaned Capital.
entities.use: The Blooming Purple Moss Clump will both reduce the build-up of, and cure, Toxic and Poison.

entities.name: Blue Bug Pellet
entities.usage: Boosts Magic damage absorption for 60 seconds.
entities.desc:
Medicinal pellet made from crushed insects.
The blue type temporarily boosts magic damage absorption.
The Boreal Valley is infested with moon bugs, meaning ingredients are never far from hand for the Irithyllian slaves who concoct this medicine.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 1,500 souls each once she is given the Excrement-covered Ashes.
  • In the Road of Sacrifices, near Orbeck of Vinheim, two Blue Bug Pellets can be found on a broken staircase.
  • Dropped by Irithyllian Slaves in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
entities.use: Boosts Magic damage absorption by 15% for 60 seconds, 10% in PvP.

entities.name: Budding Green Blossom
entities.usage: Large temporary boost to Stamina recovery speed.
entities.desc:
Green flower-shaped weed with small white blooms.
Large temporary boost to stamina recovery speed.
Flowers of the Green Blossom are ethereal, blossoming only on the surface of chilled, but not frozen, water.
entities.avail:
• Irithyll of the Boreal Valley
    • Dropped by Sewer Centipedes.
    • On a corpse by the fountain with several Irithyllian Slaves and the first Fire Witch.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • A unique version of this item, with a different description, is sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 10 souls after defeating Aldrich and while following Sirris's questline.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • Three are found outside of the Corvian Settlement. After taking the ice slide, take the left-side path up an incline and down some drop-downs.
  • The Ringed City
    • Two are found on a corpse shortly after the stairs heading down from the Mausoleum Lookout bonfire, in the grass on the left.
    • Two more are found on a corpse next to the stairs leading up to the first Judicator Giant.
    • Three are found on a corpse to the left of the path leading up the Halflight, Spear of the Church arena, across from the Divine Spear Monument.
entities.use: Increases Stamina regeneration by +9.

entities.name: Carthus Rouge
entities.usage: Temporarily applies bleeding effect to right-hand weapon.
entities.desc:
Highly vicious scarlet plant secretions.
Temporarily applies bleeding effect to right-hand weapon.
Associated with the warriors of Carthus, whose blades take on the scarlet hues of both this sanguine substance and the spatters of their victims' blood.
entities.avail:
Firelink Shrine

  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 1,000 souls each after she is given the Grave Warden's Ashes.

Catacombs of Carthus

  • Dropped by Skeletons and Skeleton Swordsmen.
entities.use:
Adds 20 Bleed build-up to right-hand weapon for 60 seconds. A Blood Loss proc will inflict an additional 100 damage if the threshold was crossed by the build-up from a Carthus Rouge buffed weapon.

The build-up increase scales with the Luck of the wielder, increasing up to to 26 build-up at 50 Luck.

entities.name: Hello Carving
entities.usage: When used, the carved head shouts: "Hello!".
entities.desc:
A strange head of unknown origin carved from archtree. It speaks when thrown on the ground.
This head says 'Hello'. Have another look. Do you sense the amicability in its eyes?

entities.name: Charcoal Pine Bundle
entities.usage: Quickly applies fire to right-hand weapons.
entities.desc:
A small bundle of charcoal pine resin.
Quickly applies fire to right-hand weapons.
Does not last for long, but can be used in inventive ways, such as applying it in the middle of a series of blows.
entities.avail:
• Bundles can be found throughout gameplay as loot and as drops from enemies; most notably the Peasant Hollows in the Undead Settlement.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 300 souls each, once she is given the Mortician's Ashes.
entities.use:
Unlike resins, which require the user to remain stationary while applying the buff, bundles take less than a second to activate and can be used while moving. While they grant more damage than their respective resins and many more bundles can be carried at once, the trade-off is that the duration of the buff is reduced to less than 20% of that of a resin.

The quick application time, high stock and low duration of these items makes them very flexible tools, useful for applying in the midst of combat based on the situation. Whereas a resin may find a large fraction of its duration wasted from inactivity between attacks, a bundle may be quickly activated when an opportunity to deal damage presents itself, and the advantage pressed until the buff expires. This includes, in particular, the short duration of vulnerability between parrying a foe and taking the riposte.

entities.name: Charcoal Pine Resin
entities.usage: Temporarily applies fire to right-hand weapons.
entities.desc:
Black charcoal-like pine resin.
Temporarily applies fire to right-hand weapons.
Used in the Undead Settlement to preserve Undead bodies after dissection, and to bury them.
entities.avail:
• Along with Charcoal Pine Bundles, the resins can be looted upon discovery or dropped/farmed from Peasant Hollows located in the Undead Settlement.
  • Can be purchased from the Shrine Handmaid for 500 souls each, once she is given the Mortician's Ashes.

entities.name: Church Guardian Shiv
entities.usage: Projects illusory blades which seek targets.
entities.desc:
This special throwing blade has a flat tip, and is wielded by guardians of the Church of Filianore.
Consume FP to project illusory blades which seek their targets.
Guardians of the Church, of whom few remain, watch over Princess Filianore's eternal slumber along with the Spears of the Church.
entities.avail: Found in The Ringed City. From the Ringed City Streets bonfire, head out into the swamp. Head all the way to the back end where there is a chapel of sorts surrounded by praying Hobbled Clerics. It is located inside.
entities.use:
Inflicts 40 Thrust damage, scaling with the player's Strength and Dexterity. Knives do not stagger the target but can be thrown very quickly.

Each Shiv consumes 9 FP when thrown, and will slightly home in on targets that are locked on.

entities.name: Coiled Sword Fragment
entities.usage: Returns the player to Firelink Shrine or to the last bonfire rested at.
entities.desc:
Fragment of the coiled sword of a bonfire which served its purpose long ago.
Returns caster to last bonfire used for resting, or to the bonfire in Firelink Shrine.
Can be used repeatedly.
Bonfires are linked to one another irreversibly, retaining their affinity long after their purpose is exhausted.
entities.avail: Picked up from the extinguished bonfire inside of Firelink Shrine in the Untended Graves. Champion Gundyr must be defeated in order to reach the shrine.
entities.use: Using the Coiled Sword Fragment will present the player with the option of teleporting to either Firelink Shrine or to the last bonfire they rested at. Unlike Homeward Bones, it has unlimited uses.

entities.name: Darksign
entities.usage: Returns the player to Firelink Shrine or to the last bonfire rested at, at the cost of losing all souls.
entities.desc:
The Darksign is the sign of an accursed Undead.
The Darksign returns its bearer to the last bonfire rested at, or the bonfire at Firelink Shrine, but at the cost of all souls held.
Carriers of the Darksign are reborn after death, and eventually lose their minds turning Hollow. And so it is they are driven from their homelands.
entities.avail: Already included within the player's inventory at the beginning of the game.
entities.use: Activate to return to either Firelink Shrine or to the last bonfire rested at, at the cost of losing all souls.

entities.name: Divine Blessing
entities.usage: Fully restores HP and cures all ailments.
entities.desc:
Holy water blessed by the Queen of Lothric.
Fully restores HP and cures ailments.
The Queen of Lothric, married to the former King Oceiros, was initially revered as a goddess of fertility and bounty. After giving birth to Ocelotte, her youngest, she quietly disappeared.
entities.avail:
• Can be chosen as a burial gift at the beginning of the game.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • One is sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 8,000 souls, once he returns from pillaging the Undead Settlement.
    • A second is sold for the same price if he returns safely from pillaging Irithyll of the Boreal Valley. Otherwise, it will be sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she is given his ashes, provided that he has at least looted the Undead Settlement.
  • Irithyll of the Boreal Valley
    • Found in the leftmost chest on the second floor of the painting room guarded by three Silver Knights.
    • Guaranteed drop from the Silver Knight in front of Gwynevere, Princess of Sunlight's painting.
  • Grand Archives.
    • After reaching the top of the Archives and falling into the cage containing Gertrude, navigate the rafters and kill the Man-grub, then climb down the nearby ladder to find two chests, one containing a Divine Blessing.
  • The Dreg Heap
    • One is sold by the Stone-humped Hag for 8,000 souls.
    • After encountering the first Angel, drop down to the next level and turn left, a Divine Blessing can be found in the open in the opposite direction of immediate cover.
    • At the very top of Earthen Peak, when navigating the large roots after Desert Pyromancer Zoey, drop down onto the wooden rooftops next to the fallen tower to find a Divine Blessing on a corpse.
  • The Ringed City
    • Guaranteed drop from the Judicator Giant guarding the Mausoleum Lookout.
    • Guaranteed drop from the Judicator Giant in the rooftops section before the Purging Monument.
entities.use: Fully restores HP and cures Poison, Toxic, Bleed, and Frost when used, as well as reducing the build-up of each status. They can be used anywhere and by anyone, including phantoms and dark spirits. However, unlike in the previous installments, they will not reduce Curse build-up.

entities.name: Duel Charm
entities.usage: Nulls special area effects for a short time.
entities.desc:
Tool used in duels of judgment. Nulls effects of special area effects for a short time.
Allfather Lloyd's knights lived in fear of his duels of judgment, in which verdicts were carried out by his Sword of Law.
entities.avail:
• Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 500 souls each after she is given the Paladin's Ashes.
  • Cathedral of the Deep
    • Dropped by Man-grubs.
entities.use: Multiple of these items can prove to be very useful in PvP encounters, as they allow to prevent the use of buffs.

entities.name: Dung Pie
entities.usage: Turns enemy toxic, but also affects user
entities.desc:
Dried fecal waste material, moist on the inside.
Throw at enemy to inflict toxin build-up, but also ups your own toxicity.
Though the stench makes it difficult to carry on one's person, inflicting toxins on an enemy yields high damage over time. Perhaps some Undead have fond memories of waste. Or, perhaps not.
entities.avail:
• Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 50 souls each after she is given the Excrement-covered Ashes.
  • Cathedral of the Deep
    • Dropped by Giant Slaves (×4).
  • Irithyll Dungeon
    • Dropped by Peasant Hollows.
    • Dropped by the Giant Slave.
  • Irithyll of the Boreal Valley
    • Dropped by Giant Slaves.
  • Profaned Capital
    • Dropped by Monstrosities of Sin.
entities.use: Throw at an enemy to inflict 65 Toxic buildup but 0 damage on the target, while also increasing Toxic buildup on self by 55.

entities.name: Ember
entities.usage: Consume to enter Host of Embers mode, restoring all HP and increasing the maximum by 30%.
entities.desc:
No Unkindled can ever truly claim the embers that burn within a champion's bosom, which is precisely what makes their yearning for warmth so keen.
Gain the strength of flame and increased max HP until death.
With the strength of fire, the summoning signs of Unkindled become visible, and seekers of embers can be summoned to join in co-operating. But beware, the embers may also attract invaders.
entities.avail:

    • x4 rewarded for defeating the two Pus of Man infesting the corpses of the Lothric Wyverns.
  • Grand Archives
