  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • x1 found on a corpse in the same building as the Forlorn Corvian Settler, just before the Corvian Settlement bonfire.
    • x1 found on a corpse in the building to the left after exiting the Corvian Settlement bonfire and crossing the bridge.
    • x1 found on a corpse in the Snowy Mountain Pass area. In a small cave recessed into the rock wall to the left of the large bell, guarded by two Farron Followers.
    • x1 found on a corpse halfway down the root system between Ariandel Chapel and the Depths of the Painting bonfire. Near a Follower throwing Javelins at the player.
  • The Dreg Heap
    • x5 sold by the Stone-humped Hag for 2,500 souls each.
    • x1 found on a corpse around the curved lip to the right of the Stone-humped Hag.
    • x1 found on a corpse under the Within Earthen Peak Ruins bonfire.
  • The Ringed City
    • x1 found on a corpse near the stairs leading up to the first Judicator Giant, at the base of a small monument.
    • x1 found on a corpse near the Ringed Inner Wall bonfire, on the balcony next to Amnesiac Lapp.
    • x1 found on a corpse in the hidden passage halfway down the elevator next to the Ringed Inner Wall bonfire.

entities.name: Estus Flask
entities.usage: Restores lost HP upon use (reusable).
entities.desc:
The Undead treasure these dull green flasks.
Fill with Estus at bonfires, and drink to restore HP.
The journey of an Undead has always traced the bonfires, and no journey of import has been made without an Estus Flask.
entities.avail: Given to the player at the start of the game.

entities.name: Estus Shard
entities.usage: Give to Andre to increase usages of the Estus Flask.
entities.desc:
A shard soaked in Estus.
Give to the blacksmith at the shrine to increase usages of the Estus Flask.
In the old days, it was rare to see an Estus Flask far from its owner, but this shard offers hope, however shattered.
entities.avail:
A total of eleven Estus Shards can be collected in a single game cycle.

Shard No.Directions
Firelink Shrine
1
Purchase the Tower Key from the Shrine Handmaid and unlock the bell tower behind the shrine. Make way upstairs and onto a bridge; drop at the middle to land on the shrine's roof. Head to the front of the building and look for an open skylight; enter it and walk along the rafters to find the shard next to the Nestling's secondary trading spot.

Alternatively, the shard can be collected from the very first moment one sets foot in Firelink Shrine. Make your way to the bell tower and run toward the nearby tree close to the low rooftop, you will be able to walk up a small portion of the tree; jump to the right while at the highest point to land on the rooftop (many attempts may be required). From there, just look for the skylight on the front of the building and walk along the rafters until reaching the shard.
High Wall of Lothric
2Near the end of the level, and just before reaching the big courtyard that leads to Vordt, there is a building inhabited by several Large Hollow Soldiers and three Starved Hounds. The shard is in plain sight, on top of a table near the Cell Key.
Undead Settlement
3Found at the burning tree in the big open area with several praying peasants and an Evangelist.
Road of Sacrifices
4From the Crucifixion Woods, head toward the keep but instead of entering, follow the narrow path on the left. The shard can be found on a corner right after dropping down a ledge and before reaching two Lycanthropes resting at a campfire.
Cathedral of the Deep
5Found on an obelisk surrounded by four praying hollows just outside the Cleansing Chapel.
Farron Keep
6Found in the poison swamp, on a fallen tower guarded by several Rotten Slugs. The tower lies in front of the staircase that leads to the first brazier.
Smouldering Lake
7
Found at the end of a corridor filled with several Writhing Rotten Flesh. The corridor itself is located behind an illusory wall near the Old King's Antechamber bonfire.

The shard can also be reached if coming from the Demon Ruins bonfire side by jumping over a gap on the floor. The jump is difficult to perform, though, and the player will fall down to an area filled with enemies if they don't manage to get across.
Irithyll Dungeon
8Dropped by a Mimic encountered in the first room of the second building after exiting the initial cell block.
Anor Londo
9In a chest found in the main hall of the cathedral, along the left wall. The area is inhabited by groups of Deacons, several Writhing Rotten Flesh dropping from the ceiling, and a Deep Accursed.
Consumed King's Garden
10From the Dancer of the Boreal Valley bonfire (High Wall of Lothric), climb up the ladder and head left toward the Consumed King's Garden. Ride the lift down and jump onto a ledge before reaching the bottom. Head right to find a corpse with the shard.
Grand Archives
11Once reaching the final open area that leads to the boss room, turn around and walk along the library's main dome. Keep circling it and head toward the general area behind it until reaching an archway that gives access to a segment of roof with the shard. Be careful not to get too close to the tower at the center of the dome or a trio of Gertrude's Knights will attack.
entities.use: Give to Blacksmith Andre in Firelink Shrine to increase usages of the Estus Flask. The shards can be allotted in either fashion regarding the Estus and Ashen Estus Flasks.

entities.name: Firebomb
entities.usage: Explodes, inflicting fire damage.
entities.desc:
Bisque urn filled with black powder.
Explodes, inflicting fire damage.
Fire damage, which differs from physical damage, is highly effective against creatures of flesh, beasts, and other foes that might naturally have cause to fear the flame.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid in Firelink Shrine for 100 souls each.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 50 souls each. Giving Greirat's Ashes to the Shrine Handmaid will update her prices to match.
  • Five can be found near the first bonfire in the Cemetery of Ash, guarded by two Gravetender Hollows.
  • Dropped by certain Hollow Soldiers.
entities.use:
Many types of enemies, like hollowed humans and animals, skeletons and maggot-infested creatures, are weak to Fire in Dark Souls III. Additionally, some of them can be heavily staggered when attacked with Fire-based weaponry.

A notable example is a Pus of Man hollow found on the rooftops in the High Wall of Lothric, below the Tower on the Wall bonfire. This enemy can impose a real threat near the beginning of the game, being capable of chasing the player and kill them in just a few attacks. However, throwing firebombs at it will allow for ranged engagement from a safe distance, deal heavy damage and stagger it every time.

entities.name: Gold Pine Bundle
entities.usage: Quickly applies lightning to right-hand weapon.
entities.desc:
Rare pine resin which emits golden sparks.
Collected in a small bundle.
Quickly applies lightning to right-hand weapon.
Does not last for long, but can be used in inventive ways, such as applying it in the middle of a series of blows.
entities.avail:
• Six are found near the White Birch tree in the Farron Keep
  • After receiving the Dreamchaser's Ashes, the Shrine Handmaid will sell a stock of 6 for 600 souls each.
  • After receiving the Xanthous Ashes, the Shrine Handmaid sells an unlimited amount at the same price.
entities.use:
Unlike resins, which require the user to remain stationary while applying the buff, bundles take less than a second to activate and can be used while moving. While they grant more damage than their respective resins and many more bundles can be carried at once, the trade-off is that the duration of the buff is reduced to less than 20% of that of a resin.

The quick application time, high stock and low duration of these items makes them very flexible tools, useful for applying in the midst of combat based on the situation. Whereas a resin may find a large fraction of its duration wasted from inactivity between attacks, a bundle may be quickly activated when an opportunity to deal damage presents itself, and the advantage pressed until the buff expires. This includes, in particular, the short duration of vulnerability between parrying a foe and taking the riposte.

entities.name: Gold Pine Resin
entities.usage: Temporarily applies lightning to right-hand weapon.
entities.desc:
Rare pine resin which emits golden sparks. Chunks of it are even rarer.
Temporarily applies lightning to right-hand weapon.
Its origins are unknown, although some have speculated that it may in fact be a type of fungal resin.
entities.avail:
• Two are found in the High Wall of Lothric, inside a hidden alcove underneath the dead wyvern, on the path between the High Wall and Tower on the Wall bonfires.
  • The Shrine Handmaid will sell 3 for 1,000 souls each, once she is given the Dreamchaser's Ashes.
    • Once she receives the Xanthous Ashes, her stock will be upgraded to unlimited for the same price.

entities.name: Green Blossom
entities.usage: +6 stamina regeneration speed.
entities.desc:
Green weed, shaped like a flower.
Temporary boost to stamina recovery speed.
The Undead Legion of Farron are remembered for using this annual plant, normally found near clear water, to swing their mighty swords with abandon.
entities.avail:
• Purchased from the Shrine Handmaid for 1,000 souls once she is given the Dreamchaser's Ashes.
  • Dropped by Sewer Centipedes in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley and the Profaned Capital.
  • High Wall of Lothric
    • 2 are found in the building below the second Pus of Man, past the Tower on the Wall bonfire, at the end of the upper wooden walkway that leads to the Astora Straight Sword.
    • 3 are found on the path from the Winged Knight courtyard that leads to the elevator shortcut back to the first bonfire. In the clearing with the Praying Hollow Soldiers ambush, make a hard left upon entering the area and they can be found in a corner next to several empty Lothric Knight armors.
  • Road of Sacrifices
    • A total of 6 are found on two corpses found within the swamp guarded by the two Great Crabs.
  • Irithyll of the Boreal Valley
    • A total of 7 are found in the riverbed below the bridge that leads into Irithyll, scattered between three corpses.
entities.use: Increases the player's stamina recovery rate by +6 points per second. Effect lasts for 60 seconds.

entities.name: Hidden Blessing
entities.usage: Fully restores FP.
entities.desc:
Holy water blessed by the Queen of Lothric.
Fully restores FP.
There is a grave in Lothric that sees no visitors, a dark place where rootless warriors rest. The Queen of Lothric alone cared to wish the poor souls good fortune.
entities.avail:
• Can be chosen as a burial gift at the beginning of the game.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 1,000 souls, once she has been given the Dreamchaser's Ashes. She will only sell it if she is told where the Ashen One found the ashes.
    • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 8,000 souls once he returns from pillaging Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, or by the Shrine Handmaid once his ashes are given to her, provided that he has at least returned successfully from pillaging the Undead Settlement.

  • Untended Graves

  • The Dreg Heap
    • Sold by the Stone-humped Hag for 8,000 souls.
  • The Ringed City
    • Found inside the indoors tomb beneath the Judicator Giant guarding the Mausoleum Lookout.
    • Guaranteed drop from the Judicator Giant patrolling the Ringed City Streets.
entities.use: Fully restores FP. They can be used anywhere and by anyone, including phantoms and dark spirits.

entities.name: Homeward Bone
entities.usage: Returns the player to Firelink Shrine or to the last bonfire rested at.
entities.desc:
Bone fragment reduced to white ash.
Return to the last bonfire used for resting, or to the shrine bonfire.
Bonfires are sustained by the bones of the Undead. In rare cases, their previous owner's strong urge to seek bonfires enchants their bones with a homeward instinct.
entities.avail:
• Cemetery of Ash
    • One is found near the cliffside to the right, past the Iudex Gundyr bonfire.
    • One is found by taking the path to the right before entering the shrine, on a corpse lying on a tombstone guarded by a Starved Hound.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 500 souls each.
    • Three are found on the shrine's rooftop.
  • Undead Settlement
    • One is given to you by Holy Knight Hodrick when you meet him for the first time in the Pit of Hollows.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • At the edge of the cliff past the first encounter with the giant wolf, in the ruins before the tower with Millwood Knights.

entities.name: Human Pine Resin
entities.usage: Temporarily applies dark to right-hand weapon.
entities.desc:
Charcoal pine resin rotted with human body fluids.
Temporarily applies dark to right-hand weapon.
Normally used in the Undead Settlement for preservation and burials, but can mature into this state, becoming a valuable substance, used in a certain ceremony. Often seen for trade at exorbitant prices.
entities.avail:
• Firelink Shrine
    • Three are sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 1,500 souls each, once she has been given the Mortician's Ashes.
    • Sold by Unbreakable Patches for 1,500 souls each. In the case of Patches' death, his ashes can be given to the Shrine Handmaid to increase her stock, allowing her to continue selling these resins.
  • Undead Settlement
    • Dropped by the skeletons found along the tunnels that lead to Irina's cell.
entities.use: Adds 95 Dark damage to right-hand weapon for 60 seconds.

entities.name: Kukri
entities.usage: Inflict physical damage and bleed buildup.
entities.desc:
Small throwing machete.
Throw at enemies to cause bleeding damage.
A unique weapon originally used by swordsmen of Carthus, but now popular among bandits and thieves.
entities.avail:
• Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 50 souls each once she has been given the Grave Warden's Ashes.
  • Undead Settlement
    • Nine are found on a corpse hanging high from the tree where the Evangelist and the peasants are praying. Use a ranged attack to bring the body down.
  • Catacombs of Carthus
    • Dropped by Skeletons and Skeleton Swordsmen.

entities.name: Large Soul of a Crestfallen Knight
entities.page: Large Soul of a Crestfallen Knight
entities.usage: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls.

Use to acquire a large amount of souls.
Let the Fire Keeper transform this sovereignless soul into a source of strength, for to be Unkindled is to be a vessel for souls.
entities.avail:
A total of six can be found in each playthrough. Three are found in the base game, one in Ashes of Ariandel and two in The Ringed City:

  • Grand Archives
    • On the fifth floor of the library, in the area with four Grand Archives Scholars. The item is at the other end of the central bookshelves, where several Clawed Curses spawn.
    • In the big courtyard past the roofs section, where Lion Knight Albert, Black Hand Kamui and Daughter of Crystal Kriemhild attack the player. The soul can be looted from a corpse right before the encounter.
  • Archdragon Peak
    • Past the Great Belfry, there is a large courtyard with ruins and numerous Man Serpents. The item is found on a corpse close to Hawkwood the Deserter's summon sign.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • In the Snowy Mountain Pass, near the end is a valley with an Earth Seeker wielding Millwood Knight. The soul can be found on a corpse lying against the large tree in the center of the valley.
  • The Ringed City
    • At the end of the great stairway leading to the Ringed City Streets, three Harald Legion Knights will rise up from the swamp. The soul can be found on a corpse in front of them.
    • On the way to the Purging Monument, after climbing down the ladder and crossing the bridge over the great stairway, the soul can be found on a corpse to the left of the bridge, with the path leading to the Purging Monument on the right.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 20,000 souls.

    • On the upper floor, in front of the Lothric Wyvern.
    • On the roof with the Pus of Man.
    • Near the entrance to the small courtyard with the Winged Knight.
  • Undead Settlement

    • To the right of the big open area with several peasants and an Evangelist.
    • On a cliff behind a house located just after exiting the far-left building of the big open area with the first Evangelist and before reaching the Dilapidated Bridge. The path is hidden behind some barrels.
    • In the cemetery past the Dilapidated Bridge.
    • Dropped by the Giant Hound Rat.
  • Cathedral of the Deep
    • Dropped by Corpse Grubs.
  • Untended Graves
    • Dropped by Gravetender Hollows.

entities.avail:
Fifteen can be obtained per playthrough. Six can be found in the base game, two in Ashes of Ariandel and seven in The Ringed City:

  • Irithyll Dungeon
    • On the path from the bottom floor cell block towards the Profaned Capital, one can be looted from a corpse prior to encountering a Gargoyle.
  • Anor Londo
    • Past the two Silver Knights that patrol the stairs to the cathedral, to the left before the gate leading to the Giant Blacksmith is a corpse.
  • Profaned Capital
    • On the path leading to Yhorm the Giant. Past the Gargoyle guarding the narrow bridge is a corpse outside the side building entrance.
  • Lothric Castle
    • Found on a corpse on the path to the Dragon Barracks. Before going up the stairs guarded by the two crossbow-wielding Hollow Soldiers, keep going down the left path. The corpse is near a parapet patrolled by a Large Hollow Soldier.
    • After reaching the lever that opens the castle gate, there is a corpse perched on a drop-down above an ultra greatsword wielding Lothric Knight.
  • Archdragon Peak
    • Found at the beginning of the Ancient Wyvern boss fight. Immediately under the wyvern's landing zone is a corpse holding the item.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • In the Snowfield, within the village guarded by several Millwood Knights. The soul can be found on a dead Millwood Knight at the top of the tower, near the Captain's Ashes.
    • On top of the closed chapel at the end of the Corvian Settlement that houses Way of White Corona.
  • The Dreg Heap
    • On the hidden path to the right after meeting Amnesiac Lapp. After the initial drop-down leading to Projected Heal, there is another drop-down that is guarded by two root-infested Lothric Knights. To the left after the landing is a corpse holding the item.
    • In the Earthen Peak Ruins, there is a cave that offers shelter from the third Angel. Past the Harald Legion Knight is a pillar surrounded by numerous Poisonhorn Bugs, and a corpse holding the soul.
    • Another can be found in the open swamp beneath the Angel, patrolled by another Harald Knight.
  • The Ringed City
    • At the Mausoleum Lookout, a corpse in the open area guarded by the Judicator Giant holds the item. It is at the end of the graveyard roughly under where the fire-breathing dragon head spawns to prevent progress.
    • In the swamp within the Ringed City Streets. The soul is held by a corpse in the middle of the swamp, near the patrol path of the Judicator Giant.
    • On the cliffside path to the Shared Grave that is guarded by Darkeater Midir, the right-side path patrolled by Undead Clerics has a corpse holding the item.
    • In the shrine past Darkeater Midir, before the stairs leading up to the statue of Gwyn, Lord of Sunlight, there is a doorway leading to a lone Hobbled Cleric. Behind it is an illusory wall hiding a corpse that holds the soul.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 8,000 souls.

entities.avail:
A total of nineteen can be obtained per playthrough.

  • Road of Sacrifices
    • On a corpse at the far end of the Crucifixion Woods, adjacent to the dry land where the Exile Watchdogs are fought. To the left of the stairs that lead to the ladder down to Farron Keep, a corpse is holding the item.
  • Cathedral of the Deep
    • On the path to the cathedral from the bonfire immediately after the Crystal Sage, there is a wooded area guarded by three crossbow-wielding Devout of the Deep and several Starved Hounds. On one of the upper cliffs of this area is a corpse propped against a wall holding the consumable.
    • Two are found on corpses in the rooftop mausoleum, near the white birch tree guarded by the Giant Archer of the Undead Settlement.
    • On the cathedral rooftops past the mausoleum, on a corpse propped up against a railing of a circular courtyard immediately past some walkways. The area is patrolled by numerous Thralls and Devout of the Deep, including two clinging to the outside of the railings close to the corpse that will climb over and ambush the player should they attempt to approach the corpse.
    • Inside of the cathedral, near the second shortcut that leads back to the Cleansing Chapel bonfire, is a side area patrolled by a Cathedral Knight and two Thralls. Near them is a corpse holding the item.
    • Under the second Giant Slave are several corpses holding items that are guarded by multiple Writhing Rotten Flesh. One of the corpses holds the soul item, while others hold the Drang Set and other treasures.
  • Farron Keep
    • In the deep water patrolled by a Great Crab near the door that opens after extinguishing the three flames, is a white birch tree guarded by the Giant Archer of the Undead Settlement. One of the corpses in this area holds the soul item.
  • Catacombs of Carthus
    • At the bottom of the large stairway that leads into the second half of the catacombs, past the reviving curved greatsword-wielding Skeleton Swordsman, there is a hallway with a pressure plate trap guarded by two sword and Carthus Shield-wielding Skeleton Swordsmen. Immediately to the left of the pressure plate trap is a corpse that the item can be looted from.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • Immediately after the Snowfield bonfire, a corpse in the distance holding the item can be seen. Approaching the corpse directly will cause a javelin-wielding Farron Follower to throw a projectile at the player.
    • After falling into the snowfield proper from the collapsing snowbank, loop to the right to return to the bonfire via a side path guarded by Birch Women and Farron Followers. On the path up towards the top of the cliff, a corpse holding the soul item can be found.
    • In the open area where the Gravetender Greatwolf is first fought, there is a corpse holding the consumable that is guarded by several Wolves.
    • On the path towards the decrepit village patrolled by Millwood Knights, after the first encounter with the Gravetender Greatwolf, there is a corpse at the base of a tree on the cliff's edge. The item can be looted from this corpse.
    • After the second encounter with the Gravetender Greatwolf, there is a collapsing snowbank that eventually leads to the Rope Bridge Cave. On the series of drop-downs there is a corpse on one of the ledges holding the item.
    • Immediately after the ice slide that leads from the Rope Bridge Cave to the Corvian Settlement, hook a hard right and follow the wall towards the cliff ledge, where a hidden corpse holds the soul item.
    • Found on a corpse in the riverbed leading into the Corvian Settlement. The first Corvian Knight is encountered immediately prior to this corpse.
    • Hanging from a window above the Corvian Settlement bonfire is a corpse holding the consumable. It can be reached by turning left after the bridge over the riverbed and navigating a cliff pathway.
    • After encountering the first rapier-wielding Corvian Knight and turning right to navigate the cliffside buildings, a Toxic-breathing Corvian is encountered right before a ladder leading to the village rooftops. To the left of the stairs leading up to this Corvian is a hidden corpse and another Corvian, with the corpse holding the item.
    • At the top of the previous ladder, a bridge can be crossed that leads to the building where the Forlorn Corvian Settler was met. On the same rooftop area where the Crow Talons can be found is a corpse holding the item.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 1,000 souls.

entities.name: Lightning Urn
entities.usage: Explodes upon contact, inflicting lightning damage.
entities.desc:
Dragon-hunting tool used by Lothric knights. Explodes upon contact, inflicting lightning damage.
The knights of Lothric have since tamed dragons, but were once hunters of dragons themselves.
This explains their special hunting gear, and why they worshipped the sun.
entities.avail:
• Firelink Shrine
    • Six are sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement once he returns from pillaging the Undead Settlement.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 700 souls each, once she has been given Greirat's Ashes after he was sent to pillage Lothric Castle.
  • Lothric Castle
    • Three are found in the moat guarded by the two Lothric Wyverns, behind some crates in the room before fighting the Hollow Assassins.
    • Six are found on a corpse immediately past the bridge under the left-side (white) Wyvern, which can only be safely retrieved once the wyverns are defeated.
  • Archdragon Peak
    • Four are found within the Ancient Wyvern arena. On the path to the left, prior to the building where the first Man Serpents in the arena are encountered, a corpse to the left of the entrance holds the items.
  • The Dreg Heap
    • Four are found on a corpse laying next to the first building after encountering the first Angel, before entering the chapel with the two Lothric Knights. A Murkman will attempt to ambush the player nearby.
entities.use: Inflicts 150 Lightning damage, scaling with the wielder's Faith. If it explodes on a watery surface, it generates a shockwave that inflicts 80 Lightning damage in an area shortly after impact.

entities.name: Mossfruit
entities.usage: Temporarily boosts bleed, poison, frost, and curse resistance.
entities.desc:
A small clump of mossfruit.
Temporarily boosts bleed, poison, frost, and curse resistance.
All mossfruit is the same regardless of its color, and has the effects of moss of all colors.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 1,500 souls each, once she has been given the Easterner's Ashes.
  • Found in The Ringed City.
  • Dropped by Basilisks.
  • Dropped by Wolves.
entities.use: Increases Bleed, Poison, Frost, and Curse resistances by 80 for 60 seconds.

entities.usage: Temporarily applies magic to right-hand weapon.
entities.desc:
Pale pine resin that faintly glimmers.
Temporarily applies magic to right-hand weapon.
The blood red substance sometimes found within suggests there is more to this so-called resin than meets the eye.

• Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 1,000 souls each, once she has been given the Prisoner Chief's Ashes.
  • Irithyll Dungeon
    • Dropped by Wretches.
  • Lothric Castle
    • 1 found on a corpse inside the room before the lever that raises the main gate to the castle, near the Mimic that drops three Titanite Scales.
entities.use: Adds 90 Magic damage to right-hand weapon for 60 seconds.

entities.name: Pale Tongue
entities.usage: Give to Rosaria to either reallocate attributes, change appearance, or rank up in Rosaria's Fingers.
entities.desc:
Proof of a red orb invader's victory over a Host of Embers.
Claiming tongues as trophies was originally the practice of an infamous troupe of invaders, who offered them to their speechless goddess.
entities.avail:
Single player

  • Undead Settlement
    • In the same area where the Demon is encountered, can be looted from the leftmost hanging corpse. The corpses can be dropped by using the piece of ceiling debris below as a stepping platform or via ranged attacks.
  • Cathedral of the Deep
    • In the sludge at the feet of the Giant Slave that is sleeping next to the stairway that leads to the prayer area before Deacons of the Deep.
    • On the roof area, outside of the entrance to the rafters. It is being guarded by two Thralls.
  • Farron Keep
    • Dropped by Darkwraiths.

Online play

  • Gained through successful invasions whilst in the Rosaria's Fingers covenant.
  • Obtained by invading other players while not wearing any of the covenant items.
entities.use:
• Offered to Saint Rosaria to gain ranks within the Rosaria's Fingers covenant.
  • Offering one to Rosaria allows the player to respec attributes or change appearance up to five times in a single playthrough.

entities.name: Poison Throwing Knife
entities.usage: Throw at enemies to inflict poison damage.
entities.desc:
A throwing knife dipped in poison.
Throw at enemies to inflict poison damage.
Used by assassins of Londor, land of Hollows.
The poison is jokingly known as Hollow's blood.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Yuria of Londor for 100 souls.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Yuria's Ashes or the Hollow's Ashes (only one or the other may be obtained in a given playthrough).
entities.use: Throw at enemies to inflict 47 Thrust damage, scaling with the player's Strength and Dexterity, and increase target's Poison buildup by 25, scaling with the player's Luck. Knives do not stagger the target but can be thrown very quickly.

entities.name: Prism Stone
entities.usage: Can be used as path markers.
entities.desc:
Warm pebble emitting a beautiful phasing aura of seven colors, with a very rare eighth.
The prism stone does nothing special, but can serve as a path marker, or perhaps dropped off a cliff to judge height by the sound of its descent. If a loud noise is heard upon its landing, then a fall from the ledge is surely lethal.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 10 souls each.
  • Ten can be found in the Farron Keep, looted from a corpse near the first brazier in the poison swamp.
  • Ten can be found in the Painted World of Ariandel.
entities.use:
When used, the player will drop one of these pebbles on the ground; each stone dropped will begin to sparkle in one of a few various colors, serving as a sort of marker. Known colors include: blue, green, purple, yellow, white and orange. What color a dropped stone will become is random and cannot be chosen.

They can also be dropped from ledges or cliffs in order to judge whether the player will survive a fall or not. If the stone emits a scream, then the drop is fatal.

In online play, Prism Stones can be useful for White Phantoms to guide hosts through levels, by signaling areas and items of interest (such as treasure chests and levers) or to provide trace amounts of light without equipping a Torch.

entities.name: Proof of a Concord Kept
entities.usage: Used to rank up in the Blade of the Darkmoon and Blue Sentinels covenants.
entities.desc:
Blood-drained, shrunken ear.
Souvenir taken for subduing the guilty.
The knights called the Blades of the Darkmoon punish the guilt-soaked offenders of the Gods and take this as proof of their conquest.
The earless corpses of the guilty will be left behind as a warning to others, inspiring both fear and respect for the Gods. Such is the eternal mandate of the Dark Sun.
entities.avail:
• Received as a reward for defeating the guilty (an invader) as a Blade of the Darkmoon or Blue Sentinel.
  • Irithyll of the Boreal Valley
    • One is found on a body lying next to a tree, outside of the Church of Yorshka.
  • Anor Londo
    • Dropped by Silver Knights.
    • One is found at the middle of the left staircase in the cathedral's main hall, next to three Deacons.
entities.use: Give to Captain Yorshka in Anor Londo to rank up in the Blade of the Darkmoon and Blue Sentinels covenants.

entities.name: Purging Stone
entities.usage: Cures hollowing.
entities.desc:
Ash-colored stone encasing a skull.
Reduces undead curse build-up and cures hollowing.
Inhabitants of Londor, the land of Hollows, use this secret treasure to feign normalcy.
Occasionally, a Hollow fools even himself, and turns on his own kind.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Yuria of Londor for 4,500 souls each.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for the same price once she is given Yuria's Ashes. If she is given the Hollow's Ashes instead, she will sell them for 3,000 souls.
  • Dropped by Sewer Centipedes.
  • Four can be found in the Profaned Capital:
    • One is found in the Toxic swamp with multiple Sewer Centipedes.
    • Three may be found inside the chapel containing three Monstrosities of Sin.
  • Two are found in The Ringed City, on the path leading to the Ringed Inner Wall bonfire and guarded by multiple Undead Clerics.
entities.use: Resets Hollowing to 0. Does not remove the Dark Sigil, so Hollowing will still build up as a result of player death.

entities.name: Purple Moss Clump
entities.usage: Reduces poison buildup. Cures Poison status.
entities.desc:
Medicinal purple moss clump.
Reduces poison build-up. Cures poison.
Poison builds up in the body, and when it breaks out, it causes gradual damage over a period of time.
Poison can be exasperating, so be sure to carry sufficient moss clumps when traveling to a blighted area.
entities.avail:
• Firelink Shrine
    • Six are sold initially by the Shrine Handmaid for 500 souls each.
    • The Handmaid will sell an unlimited amount once she has been given the Paladin's Ashes.
  • Road of Sacrifices
    • Dropped by Lesser Crabs.
  • Farron Keep
    • From the Farron Keep bonfire, exit the building and turn right. The clumps are found on a corpse at the end of the path. (×3)
    • On top of one of the two broken bridge sections, near the area with the first brazier and opposite to the Greatsword. (×4)
    • Found just in front of the second brazier. (×2)
entities.use: Reduces poison buildup. Cures Poison status.

entities.name: Red Bug Pellet
entities.usage: Boosts Fire damage absorption for 60 seconds.
entities.desc:
Medicinal pellet made from crushed insects. The red type temporarily boosts fire damage absorption.
Prepared in the Cathedral of the Deep by evangelists, who dole them out to followers to ease their suffering when they burn.
entities.avail:
• Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by Unbreakable Patches in for 1,000 souls each.
    • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for the same price if she is given Patches' Ashes.
  • Cathedral of the Deep
    • Dropped by Devouts of the Deep.
    • Dropped by Devout Bombers.
entities.use: Boosts Fire damage absorption by 15% for 60 seconds, 10% in PvP.

entities.name: Repair Powder
entities.usage: Repairs equipped weapons and armor, as long as they are not broken.
entities.desc:
Lightly enchanted golden powder.
Repairs equipped weapons and armor, as long as they haven't already broken.
Use of a weapon depletes its durability, eventually causing it to break.
As long as a weapon is not broken, its durability can be restored at a bonfire, but for distant journeys, one may wish to prepare ahead.
entities.avail:
• Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 600 souls each.
  • Sold by Greirat of the Undead Settlement for 300 souls once he has returned from pillaging the Undead Settlement. The Shrine Handmaid will update her stock to sell at the reduced price once she has been given Greirat's Ashes.
  • Undead Settlement
    • Two are found on a corpse on the second floor of the first building filled with Thralls, around the corner from the corpse holding Loretta's Bone.
  • Farron Keep
    • Four are found on a corpse in the swamp where Yellowfinger Heysel invades, in the shallow swamp infested with Basilisks and close to the cave containing the Antiquated Set and Golden Scroll.
  • Cathedral of the Deep
    • Three can be found on a corpse in the area where the white birch tree sits, guarded by the Giant Archer of the Undead Settlement.
entities.use: Restores 150 durability to all equipped weapons and armor. Weapons that are fully broken cannot have durability restored.

entities.name: Rime-blue Moss Clump
entities.usage: Reduces Frost build-up. Cures Frostbite status.
entities.desc:
Moss clump radiating gentle heat and light.
Reduces frost build-up. Cures frostbite status.
Frost accumulates in the body causing frostbite, which sap one's health, lowers absorption, and slows stamina recovery.
Weapons imbued with frost are a rare thing indeed, most of them originating in the Boreal Valley.
entities.avail: Sold by the Shrine Handmaid for 500 souls each, once she has been given the Prisoner Chief's Ashes.
entities.use: These clumps can be especially useful in PvP action against an opponent who uses a Frost imbued weapon, or on PvE enemies, most notably those residing in the Painted World of Ariandel The simple lack of stamina recovery and increase in damage received could end one's battle quicker than expected.

entities.name: Rope Black Firebomb
entities.usage: A black firebomb that is thrown behind, inflicting great fire damage.
entities.desc:
Black bisque urn attached to a string and filled with black powder.
Thrown behind and explodes, inflicting fire damage.
No different to a black firebomb, save for the direction in which is is thrown. Enables a different fighting style, and flexibility in adjusting to one's circumstances.
entities.avail:
• Sold by Unbreakable Patches for 300 souls each.
  • Sold by the Shrine Handmaid once she has been given Patches' Ashes.
entities.use: Rope Black Firebombs are specifically designed to help players escape from chasing enemies. Their odd behavior gives them some versatility and players may use them in imaginative ways in online matches, as their usage is commonly non-expected.

Thrown behind and explodes, inflicting fire damage.

entities.desc:
Pine resin that has rotted and turned poisonous. Likely rotten from the start.
Temporarily applies poison to right-hand weapon.
Farron Keep was swallowed by the rotted wood, where the blunt-horned Ghrus concoct this resin.

The build-up increase scales with the Luck of the wielder, up to 59 build-up at 50 Luck.

entities.desc:
Rubbish with no value.
Who in their right mind would bother carrying this around? Perhaps you need help.

Firelink Shrine

  • Sold by Unbreakable Patches for 200 souls each.

Road of Sacrifices

entities.usage: Increases item discovery by 50 units for 60 seconds.
entities.desc:
An old rusted copper coin.
Crushing the coin boosts item discovery.
Those who have lost their fortunes rely upon this superstitious practice, hoping to retrieve what was once theirs and more.
entities.avail:
• Undead Settlement
    • Two can be found by jumping from the roof of a house near the second Evangelist to a wooden balcony located above a Crystal Lizard, near the Dilapidated Bridge.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Sold by Unbreakable Patches for 200 souls each. If Patches dies, give his ashes to the Shrine Handmaid to increase her stock, allowing her to sell them at the same price.
  • Dropped by Jailer Handmaids.
  • The Dreg Heap (The Ringed City)
    • Sold by the Stone-humped Hag for 200 souls each. If she dies, give her ashes to the Shrine Handmaid to increase her stock, allowing her to sell them at the same price.
entities.use: Increases Item Discovery by 50 units for 60 seconds.

entities.name: Rusted Gold Coin
entities.usage: Boosts item discovery by 100 units for 60 seconds.
entities.desc:
A rusty old gold coin that surely has no currency.
Crushing the coin gives a large, if temporary, boost to item discovery.
A rich man lost his fortune, but it returned to him twinfold. He was swift to squander his retrieved fortune., smugly confident that it was bound to double once again.
entities.avail:
• A set of 7 coins can be chosen as a burial gift at the beginning of the game.
  • Firelink Shrine
    • Gifted by Unbreakable Patches if the player does not forgive him for trapping them in the tower containing the Fire Keeper Soul.
  • Farron Keep
    • One is found on a corpse near the extinguishable flame nearest where Yellowfinger Heysel invades the player, hidden behind the wall to the right of the flame.
  • Irithyll of the Boreal Valley
    • One is found at a dead end alley after the Church of Yorshka, on a corpse being devoured by two Irithyllian Beast-Hounds.
    • One is found on a corpse at the Distant Manor, off the ledge at the bottom of the curved staircase.
  • Irithyll Dungeon
    • One is found on a corpse shortly after the Irithyll Dungeon bonfire, in the last cell on the right before the first Jailer. The cell is locked and requires the Jailer's Key Ring to open.
  • Profaned Capital
    • Dropped by Jailer Handmaids throughout the level.
    • Two are dropped by a Mimic in the treasury hall to the right of Yhorm's boss arena.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • Three are found on a separated rooftop within the Corvian Settlement, which requires climbing to the crosswalks to the cliff above the settlement and then dropping down to reach.
  • The Dreg Heap
    • Three are sold by the Stone-humped Hag directly in front of the Dreg Heap bonfire for 1800 souls each.
entities.use: Increases Item Discovery by 100 points for 60 seconds.

entities.name: Seed of a Giant Tree
entities.usage: World enemies react to invaders.
entities.desc:
Makes enemies react to invaders.
The giant trees were also known as watcher trees, and their seed unmask invaders.
When used effectively, these seeds will help counter dark spirits.
entities.avail:
Obtained from the giant tree located just outside of the upper exit in Firelink Shrine.

Every time a player is invaded, whether by an NPC or by another player, there is a chance that they will be able to pick a Seed from the tree. If a Seed is not available following an invasion, the probability increases incrementally until a Seed spawns, after which the chance resets.
entities.use: Upon use, enemies in the player's world will react to red and purple spirits, whether they are invaders or if they are summoned via a Red Sign Soapstone. The effect lasts for 45 seconds.

entities.name: Siegbräu
entities.usage: Restores HP equal to 20% of your maximum HP + 100 and boosts frost resistance for 60 seconds.
entities.desc:
Special brew of Siegward of Catarina.
Perfect for travel in its jolly barrel mug.
Restores HP and temporarily boosts frost resistance.
Leave it to Siegward to discover a drink that even an Undead can enjoy. Perhaps his long years spent Undead have left him wanting to drain a cup or two and revel as if he were still among the living.
entities.avail:
Up to three Siegbräus can be collected in a single playthrough in the base game, all of them presented by Siegward of Catarina during various stages throughout his questline:

  • Undead Settlement: Given by Siegward after defeating the Demon.
  • Irithyll of the Boreal Valley: Given after meeting Siegward sleeping in the kitchen near the Distant Manor bonfire.
  • Profaned Capital: Given at the aftermath of Yhorm the Giant's boss battle if Siegward assisted and survived.

Two more per playthrough can be obtained in Dark Souls III: The Ringed City:

  • If the player obtains the Titanite Slab in the Earthen Peak Ruins swamp without Amnesiac Lapp's assistance, he will toast the player and give them a Siegbräu. Otherwise, once he has moved on to the Ringed Inner Wall, a Siegbräu will be left at his location near this bonfire.
  • Once the player meets Lapp within the Ringed Inner Wall, he will toast them and give them a Siegbräu.

entities.name: Soul of a Champion
entities.usage: Consume to acquire 25,000 souls.
entities.desc:
Soul found in the corpse of a champion of legend.
Use to acquire enough souls to sate a lord.
Let the Fire Keeper transform this sovereignless soul into a source of strength, for to be Unkindled is to be a vessel for souls.
entities.avail: Can only be obtained in NG+ onward, where it replaces the Soul of a Crestfallen Knight.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 25,000 souls.

entities.name: Soul of a Crestfallen Knight
entities.usage: Consume to acquire 10,000 souls.
entities.desc:
Soul found in the corpse of a crestfallen knight.
Use to acquire a large amount of souls.
Let the Fire Keeper transform this sovereignless soul into a source of strength, for to be Unkindled is to be a vessel for souls.
entities.avail:
A total of seventeen can be found in each playthrough. Ten can be found in the base game, three can be found in Ashes of Ariandel and four can be found in The Ringed City:

  • Smouldering Lake
    • Deep within the Demon Ruins, on the bridge above Knight Slayer Tsorig's lava pit, there is an ultra greatsword wielding Black Knight that guards the ladder to the ballista. Next to this Black Knight is a corpse holding the item.
  • Irithyll Dungeon
    • The Giant Slave sleeping past the initial wing of cell blocks is guarding a Crystal Lizard as well as a corpse holding the soul.
  • Anor Londo
    • Turning right before the cathedral doors (the path that normally leads to the Batwing Demons and the flying buttress guarded by two Dragonslayer Greatbow-wielding Silver Knights), there is a single red-eyed Silver Knight. A nearby corpse holds the item.
  • Untended Graves
    • Near the broken Lordvessel where the Ashen Estus Flask is looted in the Cemetery of Ash, there is instead a corpse that holds the soul.
    • At Dark Firelink Shrine, there is a set of stairs in the direction of the Chaos Blade that is guarded by an ultra greatsword wielding Black Knight. Past it, on the level above the shrine entrance, is a corpse holding the item.
  • Lothric Castle
    • In the first room past the Dancer of the Boreal Valley, there is a red-eyed Lothric Knight kneeling before an altar and a Lothric Priest in attendance. Before the altar is a corpse holding the soul.
    • To the left before the Dragonslayer Armour's boss fog, there is a broken railing that can be dropped down. This leads to the Pus of Man infecting the white Lothric Wyvern's leg. Perched on another broken railing under the wyvern itself is a corpse holding the item.
  • Grand Archives
    • Past the first Crystal Lizard and down the drop-down, a corpse can be seen holding an item. Turning left at the first opportunity down the narrow pathway will lead to an encounter with a Thrall, past which is the corpse holding the soul.
    • After exiting the domed building that holds the shortcut back to the ground floor of the Archives, turning left will allow the player to climb to the top of the building. On the other side of the dome after the stairs is a corpse holding the item.
  • Archdragon Peak
    • In the Dragon-Kin Mausoleum, go up the stairs and turn towards the left corner at the top. A corpse holds the soul, opposite the path leading to the Man Serpent Summoner.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • At the end of the Corvian Settlement, there is an enclosed chapel with two Corvian Knights guarding Way of White Corona. The soul item can be found on a corpse on the rafters above, which can be reached by dropping in from the windows on the roof.
    • In the second part of the Snowy Mountain Pass, there is a valley patrolled by three Millwood Knights; one wielding the axe, one with a great hammer and one carrying a greataxe. A corpse within the valley holds the soul.
    • Within the same valley, there is a second corpse opposite it that holds another soul.
  • The Dreg Heap
    • After the first two dropdowns, two root-infested Lothric Knights, one wielding a banner, can be seen praying at an altar. Lying on the altar is a corpse holding the item.
  • The Ringed City
    • In the midst of engaging the Judicator Giant at the Mausoleum Outlook, a gazebo outcropping to the right of the graveyard allows the player to temporarily drop down out of the giant's line of sight. Dropping down from the roof and walking back under it, there is a corpse holding the soul.
    • At the bottom of the great stairway that leads into the Ringed City Streets, turning left will lead into a small alleyway with a ladder and three Hobbled Clerics. Two of the clerics at the far back are guarding a corpse that holds the item.
    • In the midst of the Ringed City Streets, there is a large abyss crystal near the sunken chapel that holds the Church Guardian Shiv. A corpse lying against the crystal holds the item.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 10,000 souls.

entities.name: Soul of a Deserted Corpse

Soul found in a deserted corpse.
Use to acquire souls.
Let the Fire Keeper transform this sovereignless soul into a source of strength, for to be Unkindled is to be a vessel for souls.
entities.avail:
A minimum of nine can be found per playthrough.

  • Cemetery of Ash
    • To the right of the Ashen Estus Flask.
    • On a corpse near the tower behind Firelink Shrine.
  • High Wall of Lothric
    • Left from first spawn on the bridge.
    • Dungeon under the Lothric Wyvern.
    • On a bridge just before the Tower on the Wall bonfire.
    • After leaving the room under the Tower on the Wall bonfire, take the right exit for the soul item.
    • In the room with the Lothric Knight after dropping from the rooftop with the Pus of Man and the Praying Hollow Soldiers.
    • Near the elevator shortcut leading to an area just before the first bonfire.
    • To the left upon exiting the small courtyard with the Winged Knight.
  • Undead Settlement
    • Dropped by Hound Rats.
  • Catacombs of Carthus
    • Dropped by Hound Rats.
  • Smouldering Lake
    • Dropped by Hound Rats.
  • Irithyll Dungeon
    • Dropped by Hound Rats.

Let the Fire Keeper transform this sovereignless soul into a source of strength, for to be Unkindled is to be a vessel for souls.
entities.avail:
Seventeen can be found in each playthrough. Twelve are found in the base game, one in Ashes of Ariandel and four in The Ringed City.

  • Irithyll of the Boreal Valley
    • In the plaza at the beginning of Irithyll, there is a corpse on the opposite side of the fountain near the Central Irithyll bonfire holding the item.
    • Up the first set of stairs from the bonfire towards the first Pontiff Knights, turn left and double back to enter a small alcove where it can be looted from a corpse hanging from a railing.
    • On the path to the main square below the grand cathedral, there is a path to the left that leads to the Church of Yorshka and which loops around to the side of the square. On a broken railing leading towards the shortcut to the cathedral is a corpse hanging off of a ledge overlooking a Fire Witch. The corpse holds the consumable.
    • The above Fire Witch is standing watch over a corpse holding another soul consumable.
    • On the path towards the grand cathedral from the right, shortly after the house filled with Irithyllian Slaves is a stairway leading directly to the cathedral. The item can be found on a corpse to the left of the stairway.
    • Past Pontiff Sulyvahn, at the start of the courtyard with Giant Slaves is a corpse in the open holding the soul item.
  • Irithyll Dungeon
    • Beyond the initial cell blocks and past the Mimic are a large group of Peasant Hollows. At the end of the hallway they are guarding is a corpse holding the consumable.
    • Found on a corpse in the sewer tunnel past the large Giant Slave. Several Hound Rats and a Basilisk trap guard the corpse.
  • Consumed King's Garden
    • On the beginning path from the Dancer of the Boreal Valley's arena, a corpse before encountering a Consumed King's Knight can be found holding it.
  • Grand Archives
    • On a corpse on the roofs section, near where a spear-wielding Gargoyle appears.
  • Archdragon Peak
    • At the very start of the area after arriving from Irithyll Dungeon, there is a tree to the left of the path that leads to the first Man Serpent encounter of the area. The item can be found on a corpse sitting at the tree's base.
    • Past the Dragon-kin Mausoleum on the path towards the Great Belfry, it can be found on a corpse hanging from an open window located shortly before reaching the second Ancient Wyvern.
  • Painted World of Ariandel
    • In the village on the edge of the Snowfield guarded by Millwood Knights, it can be found on a corpse inside the first floor of the tower with the greatbow archers.
  • The Dreg Heap
    • In the first area where the Murkmen are encountered, there is a corpse hanging from an unstable outcropping. Approaching it will break the outcropping, causing the player and the corpse to fall into the remains of the Grand Archives below. The soul item can be looted from the corpse at the bottom.
  • The Ringed City
    • In the start of the swamp that comprises the Ringed City Streets, a corpse in the open is guarded by submerged White-faced Locusts. The corpse holes one of the soul consumables.
    • A corpse directly underneath the Judicator Giant patrolling the swamp holds the item.
    • Near the Ringed Knight sunken chapel is a sunken spire guarded by two White-faced Locusts, it can be found on a corpse hanging off of the spire.
entities.use: Consume to acquire 5,000 souls.
