sections.title: How to level up
sections.need: You'll need: souls and the shrine bonfire lit with the Coiled Sword.

steps.t: Travel to the Firelink Shrine bonfire.
Talk to the Fire Keeper and choose Level Up.
Add points to one stat at a time. Each level costs more souls than the last one.
Advice: Stop adding to a stat when it reaches its soft cap (table on the Builds page) unless your build needs more.
If you die, go back to where you died and touch your bloodstain to get your souls back. Die again first and they are gone.

sections.check: The stat you raised shows its new value on the status screen.

sections.title: How to get more Estus
sections.need: You'll need: Estus Shards or Undead Bone Shards from the world. 11 Estus Shards and 10 Undead Bone Shards exist per playthrough.

steps.t: Pick up every Estus Shard. A full set of 11 takes your flasks to 15 charges in total.
Give each shard to Blacksmith Andre in Firelink Shrine.
Ask Andre to split the charges between the Estus Flask (HP) and the Ashen Estus Flask (FP). Casters need more Ashen charges.
Burn each Undead Bone Shard in the shrine bonfire. Every shard makes each sip heal more, up to +10.
If you want even more healing per sip, wear the Estus Ring: it increases the HP recovered by each Estus sip by 20%.

sections.check: The flask icon shows the new number of charges after you rest.

sections.title: How to upgrade a weapon
sections.need: You'll need: titanite of the right kind, souls, and the weapon on you.

steps.t: Bring the weapon to Blacksmith Andre in Firelink Shrine and choose Reinforce Weapon.
Use Titanite Shard to reach +3.
Use Large Titanite Shard to reach +6.
Use Titanite Chunk to reach +9.
Use one Titanite Slab to go from +9 to +10.
If the weapon came from a boss soul, use Titanite Scale to reach +4 and a Titanite Slab for +5.
If the weapon cannot be infused (a soulbound weapon, which ordinary titanite cannot reinforce either), use Twinkling Titanite to reach +4 and a Titanite Slab for +5.

If you run out of shards, give the Handmaid more ashes: she sells unlimited Titanite Shard for 800 souls once she has the Dreamchaser's Ashes, and Large Titanite Shard for 4000 souls once she has the Easterner's Ashes.

sections.check: The weapon's name shows the new +level and its attack rating went up.

sections.title: How to infuse a weapon
sections.need: You'll need: a coal given to Andre, the matching gem, and a weapon that can be infused.

steps.t: Give Farron Coal to Blacksmith Andre to unlock Heavy, Sharp and Poison infusions. It is in Road of Sacrifices, guarded by a Black Knight.
Give Sage's Coal to unlock Crystal, Blessed and Deep infusions. It is in Farron Keep, in a small round building guarded by a Darkwraith.
Give Giant's Coal to unlock Lightning, Simple and Chaos infusions. It is in Anor Londo, on the Giant Blacksmith's remains.
Give Profaned Coal to unlock Dark, Blood and Hollow infusions. It is in Irithyll Dungeon, in the cell with several Wretches opposite Karla's cell.
Choose Infuse Weapon at Andre.
Pick the gem: Heavy Gem for Strength, Sharp Gem for Dexterity, Refined Gem for both, Crystal Gem for Intelligence, Blessed Gem for Faith.
For Intelligence and Faith together, a Dark Gem or Chaos Gem infusion soft-caps at 30 Intelligence and 30 Faith, so stop at 30 in each for that weapon.
Advice: Compare the attack rating before you confirm. If the number goes down, cancel: your stats do not suit that infusion yet.

sections.check: The weapon's name now starts with the infusion (for example Heavy Long Sword).

sections.title: How to prepare for a boss
sections.need: You'll need: the boss card open (weaknesses, HP and strategy are on it).

steps.t: Rest at the nearest bonfire so your flasks are full.
Advice: Open the boss card and read the Weak line. Switch to a weapon or buff that deals that damage type.
Use an Ember before the fog wall. It restores all your HP, raises your maximum HP by 30% and makes summoning signs visible.

While embered, look for white summon signs on the ground (players lay them with the White Sign Soapstone) and summon that player as a phantom (a helper in your world) for the area boss. NPC helpers for each boss are on its card under Summons.

Advice: Walk through the fog and watch the first attacks before you swing. Many bosses pause to recover after an attack (the wiki says this of Iudex Gundyr): hit once or twice in that gap, then back off.
Advice: If you die, check the strategy on the card for the attack that hit you, then try again.

sections.check: The boss drops its soul and a new bonfire lights in the arena.

sections.title: How to parry and riposte
sections.need: You'll need: a shield or weapon with the Parry skill in your left hand.

steps.t: Equip a shield whose skill is Parry. Shields that can parry have a small shield icon in the corner. The Buckler and the Target Shield have a longer parry window.
Press the left strong attack button (L2 on PlayStation, LT on Xbox) just before the enemy's attack hits you.
When the enemy staggers, walk up to it and press the right weak attack button (R1 on PlayStation, RB on Xbox) to riposte.
Some enemies cannot be parried. Break their poise (their resistance to being interrupted) with hits instead: they stagger and can be riposted.

sections.check: The riposte plays a short critical-hit animation and takes a large bite of HP.

sections.title: How to turn boss souls into weapons and spells
sections.need: You'll need: the Transposing Kiln and a boss soul.

steps.t: Beat Curse-rotted Greatwood in Undead Settlement. It drops the Transposing Kiln.
Give the kiln to Ludleth of Courland, who sits on the second throne in Firelink Shrine.
Choose Transpose and pick a boss soul. Each soul lists the weapons, rings or spells it can become; the soul's card shows them too.
Do not use a boss soul for souls if you might want its item: once the soul is used it is gone for this playthrough.
If you kneel at the final bonfire after placing the last Cinder of a Lord, Ludleth burns away. Transpose what you want before that, or wait for the next playthrough.

sections.check: The new item is in your inventory and the soul is gone.

sections.title: How to reset your stats
sections.need: You'll need: access to Rosaria's Bed Chamber in Cathedral of the Deep and one Pale Tongue per reset.

steps.t: Reach Rosaria's Bed Chamber in Cathedral of the Deep and talk to Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth.
Join Rosaria's Fingers if she asks. If you are doing Sirris of the Sunless Realms's quest, finish it first: offering a Pale Tongue to Rosaria fails Sirris's quest.
Offer a Pale Tongue to Rosaria.
Choose rebirth. You can then reallocate your stats and change your appearance.
Rosaria allows rebirth up to five times per playthrough, so plan the new stats against the soft caps table before you reallocate.

sections.check: Your soul level is the same but the points are where you put them.

sections.title: How to start New Game Plus
sections.need: You'll need: the Soul of Cinder defeated.

steps.t: Beat Soul of Cinder and choose an ending (see Endings).
Say no when the game offers New Game Plus if you still want to explore. You go back to Firelink Shrine.
Collect anything that only appears after the ending first. For example Yuria of Londor leaves her armor and weapon after the Usurpation of Fire.
Start New Game Plus from the shrine bonfire when you are ready. You keep your level, stats, gear and covenant standing; keys and story items reset.

sections.check: The game restarts at the Cemetery of Ash with your character and enemies are stronger.

sections.title: How to avoid (or cure) Hollowing
sections.need: Only matters if you leveled with Yoel of Londor.

steps.t: If you do not want the Londor ending, never choose Draw Out True Strength with Yoel of Londor. Each use gives a Dark Sigil.
If you already have Dark Sigils, expect your Hollowing to rise each time you die. At 15 your character looks Hollow; it is cosmetic.
To clear the Hollowing level for now, use a Purging Stone. The sigils stay, so it comes back.
To remove the sigils for good, give the Fire Keeper Soul to the Fire Keeper and ask her to heal them. Doing this fails the Londor quest.

sections.check: Your Hollowing is back to zero on the status screen.

level.title: Levelling priority

steps.t: Reach the Strength and Dexterity your weapon needs first: they are required to wield it (each weapon card lists Needs).
Advice: Vigor to 27, then your damage stat to 40 (see the soft caps table).
Advice: Endurance toward 40 for melee, Attunement toward 35 for casters.
Advice: Vigor toward 50 after that.

level.note: This order is a reading of the soft caps, not a ranking of builds.

steps.t: Every Estus Shard and Undead Bone Shard: they raise your flask charges and healing for the whole game.
One main weapon at a time with Blacksmith Andre: titanite is limited until the Handmaid sells it.
Umbral Ashes to the Shrine Handmaid, so she sells Titanite Shard and Large Titanite Shard without limit.

quests.intro: The questlines that change what you can get or which ending you can reach. Steps are in order; red lines are the points you can lose for this playthrough. The full wiki text for each NPC is behind the Full questline button.

npcs.reward: The Usurpation of Fire ending; Yuria's shop
steps: Agree to serve Yoel of Londor at the crumbled bridge near the start of Undead Settlement; he moves to Firelink Shrine.

steps.t: Choose Draw Out True Strength with Yoel: a free level and a Dark Sigil. Each death now raises your Hollowing. At 2, 6, 12 and 15 Hollowing he offers it again, up to 5 sigils.

steps: Talk to Anri of Astora and Horace the Hushed near Halfway Fortress in Road of Sacrifices until they repeat themselves.
Beat Deacons of the Deep and talk to Anri at the shrine until they say they are going to Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
With all 5 sigils, enter Catacombs of Carthus. Yoel dies and Yuria of Londor takes his place at the shrine.
Find Anri near the giant rolling ball and answer No when they ask about Horace.
Talk to Anri at the Church of Yorshka bonfire in Irithyll until you get the Quiet resolve gesture.
Beat Pontiff Sulyvahn, then talk to Yuria until she says Anri waits in the Darkmoon Tomb.
Go to the Darkmoon Tomb before the elevator to Anor Londo, take the Sword of Avowal from the pilgrim and use the action button on Anri's mat.
missable: Get all 5 sigils before the Catacombs of Carthus banner appears: entering the Catacombs kills Yoel. Beating the Abyss Watchers and using their bonfire is still safe.
Do not kill the Old Woman of Londor in the Church of Yorshka: that ends Yuria's quest.
Do not heal your Dark Sigils with the Fire Keeper: that fails the quest.

npcs.reward: Siegward helps against Yhorm (if freed before you first enter the arena); Siegbräu, Catarina armor
steps: Ride the two-stage elevator in the Undead Settlement church and talk to Siegward.
Jump off the elevator halfway onto the hidden platform where Siegward sits on a ledge.
Kill the Demon below together with Siegward for a Siegbräu and the Toast gesture.
After meeting Unbreakable Patches in Cathedral of the Deep, find Siegward stuck in a well outside the Cleansing Chapel bonfire. Get his armor back from Patches (buy it or kill him).
Find him in the kitchen near the Distant Manor bonfire in Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, past the Sewer Centipedes.
Get the Old Cell Key in Irithyll Dungeon, then reach his cell from Profaned Capital: drop from the roof near the Court Sorcerer. Open the cell and talk to him.
missable: To have Siegward join the Yhorm the Giant fight with a Storm Ruler, free him before you first enter Yhorm's boss arena.
Free and talk to Siegward before you beat Yhorm the Giant. Otherwise you only get the Storm Ruler: no armor, shield or Siegbräu.
If you unlock his cell but do not talk to him, he stays there and does not join the Yhorm fight.

npcs.reward: Silvercat Ring, Sunset Shield and armor, Sirris summon for later bosses
steps: Light the Halfway Fortress bonfire; Sirris appears at the shrine briefly.
Give the Dreamchaser's Ashes to the Shrine Handmaid. Sirris comes back, teaches Darkmoon Loyalty and leaves her sign for the Deacons and the Abyss Watchers.
In Irithyll light the Central Irithyll bonfire, reload, and use her sign at the start of the bridge to help her against Creighton. She thanks you with the Silvercat Ring.
After Curse-rotted Greatwood and Aldrich, Devourer of Gods are dead, buy the special Budding Green Blossom from the Handmaid.
Go back to the Greatwood arena in Undead Settlement and use her sign at the edge of the pit to help her against Holy Knight Hodrick.
Accept her vow of knighthood at the shrine. You can then summon her for Dragonslayer Armour and the Twin Princes.
missable: Offering a Pale Tongue to Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth fails Sirris's quest. Finish Sirris first, then Leonhard's quest.

steps: Ride the metal cage on the back of the friendly Hollow Manservant at the top of the highest cliff in Undead Settlement to reach him.
missable: Visit him before you fight Curse-rotted Greatwood: the floor above the Pit of Hollows breaks during the fight and kills him.

npcs.reward: Blue Tearstone Ring and a shop that grows
steps: Open his cell below the Tower on the Wall bonfire in High Wall of Lothric with the Cell Key.
Find Loretta's Bone on the body hanging from the balcony of the first three-story building in Undead Settlement; hit it down and give it to him. You keep the Blue Tearstone Ring.
Reload the area twice (he grieves, then gives the Curl up gesture).
Let him go pillaging. He comes back after you beat any area boss and sells new items.
missable: For the Irithyll trip, Unbreakable Patches must already be at the shrine: he goes to rescue Greirat, and you must reload and beat an area boss for both to return.
Never send him to Lothric Castle: there is no way to save him.

npcs.reward: Sorceries, Young Dragon Ring, Slumbering Dragoncrest Ring
steps: Find him on the second floor of the ruins where Crystal Sage is fought, in Crucifixion Woods.
Have 10 Intelligence (the Scholar Ring counts) and ask to learn sorceries; he moves to the shrine.
Give him at least one sorcery scroll.
Learn any four sorceries for the Young Dragon Ring (not given if you started as a Sorcerer).
Learn Aural Decoy, Farron Flashsword, Spook and Pestilent Mist for the Silent Ally gesture and the Slumbering Dragoncrest Ring.
missable: Bring him a sorcery scroll before you defeat four bosses, or he leaves for this playthrough.

steps: Buy the Grave Key from the Handmaid after giving her the Mortician's Ashes.
Reach Irina's cell in Undead Settlement through the sewers and open the second door with the key.
Accept her service; she moves to the east-wing basement of the shrine and sells miracles.
Talk to her at least once to get Eygon of Carim's summon sign before the Crystal Sage.
missable: Buying even one dark miracle from her makes Eygon take her to the Iudex Gundyr bonfire, where he turns hostile.

npcs.reward: Ring of the Evil Eye, Quiet Resolve; Anri's Straight Sword (Aldrich route) or the Sword of Avowal and three Dark Sigils (Londor route)
steps: Meet Anri and Horace near the Halfway Fortress bonfire in Road of Sacrifices. Horace gives the Blue Sentinels emblem.
Use their summon signs for Deacons of the Deep. Once you have the Small Doll, they appear at Firelink Shrine: talk to Anri.
After the Abyss Watchers, find Anri in the Catacombs of Carthus near the rope bridge, then decide about Horace (in a cavern in Smouldering Lake).
In Irithyll of the Boreal Valley, talk to Anri at the Church of Yorshka to learn Quiet Resolve. Anri gives the Ring of the Evil Eye here if you left the Catacombs without finding out about Horace.

Decide about the assassin hidden in the Church of Yorshka. Kill her: Anri goes on to fight Aldrich, Devourer of Gods and Yuria of Londor's questline ends. Spare her: the Londor route, and Yuria's questline goes on.

Aldrich route, after Pontiff Sulyvahn: use Anri's summon sign in front of the doors of the grand cathedral of Anor Londo and help Anri defeat Aldrich. Then Ludleth of Courland gives you Anri's Straight Sword.
Londor route, after Pontiff Sulyvahn: go to Gwyn's honorary tomb in Anor Londo. The Old Woman of Londor gives the Sword of Avowal; perform the wedding with Anri for three Dark Sigils.
missable: If you leave Horace alive and tell Anri where he is, Anri goes to him and dies: the quest ends.
If you kill Horace first and then tell Anri, you get the Ring of the Evil Eye and the quest goes on.
On the Aldrich route Anri later turns up hollowed and hostile: near the Cathedral of the Deep bonfire, or at Horace's grave in Smouldering Lake if you told Anri where he was.

npcs.reward: Red Eye Orb, Applause; invade him for the Crescent Moon Sword, Silver Mask and Soul of Rosaria
steps: After you light the Tower on the Wall bonfire or defeat Vordt of the Boreal Valley, Leonhard appears at Firelink Shrine and gives you five Cracked Red Eye Orbs.
After the Curse-rotted Greatwood or the Cliff Underside bonfire, talk to him by Lothric's throne while you hold a Pale Tongue: he gives the Lift Chamber Key.
Open the door under the Tower on the Wall bonfire in High Wall of Lothric and kill the Darkwraith at the bottom of the elevator for a full Red Eye Orb.
Talk to him again for the Applause gesture; he asks you to join Rosaria's Fingers.
Offer a Pale Tongue to Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth (not the rebirth or appearance services): Leonhard then greets you near the entrance to her chamber.
When you reach Profaned Capital past Irithyll Dungeon (the Rosaria page says: the first bonfire in Anor Londo), he murders Rosaria and flees to Anor Londo. Take the Black Eye Orb she leaves behind.

Use the Black Eye Orb in Anor Londo, in the chamber that once held the illusion of Gwynevere, to invade Leonhard's world. He drops the Soul of Rosaria, his Silver Mask and the Crescent Moon Sword; the Shrine Handmaid then sells the rest of his set.

Return the soul to revive her, or give it to Ludleth of Courland for the Bountiful Sunlight miracle. Her death has no consequences: you can still reallocate, change appearance and offer Pale Tongues to rank up in the covenant.
missable: Offering a Pale Tongue to Rosaria makes Sirris of the Sunless Realms's questline fail: complete Sirris' questline first, then Leonhard's.

steps: Drop from the right side of the bridge near the guillotine in Undead Settlement onto the ledge below and follow the path (Cliff Underside bonfire) to his cage.
Agree to be his pupil; he moves to the shrine basement and sells pyromancies.
Get the Jailer's Key Ring via the swamp of Profaned Capital (upper levels of the Giant Slave's cell).
Open her cell on the lower level of Irithyll Dungeon and agree to rescue her; she moves under the stairs left of Andre.

npcs.reward: Duel for the dragon stones; summon at Oceiros
steps: Meet him on the stairs in front of the shrine bonfire.
If you own all three dragon stones and got Hawkwood's Swordgrass from Andre, he waits near the Abyss Watchers bonfire in Farron Keep for a duel.

npcs.npc: Giant Archer of the Undead Settlement

s.title: Giant Archer of the Undead Settlement

steps: Carry a Young White Branch when you meet him and he stays friendly.
Collect all the Young White Branches in the base game (Undead Settlement, Cathedral of the Deep and Farron Keep); he dies on his own and you can loot the Hawk Ring.

npcs.reward: Lapp's ending in The Ringed City
steps: Talk to Lapp each time you find him in The Ringed City.
Find the Purging Monument and tell him.
missable: Tell him about the Purging Monument before you fight Slave Knight Gael, or he turns hollow and attacks you.

npcs.reward: Prostration and Patches squat gestures, Rusted Coin, Rusted Gold Coin, a shop at Firelink Shrine
steps: In the Cathedral of the Deep, take the elevator up near the entrance to the Deacons of the Deep boss room and open the large double doors to the rooftop. Patches, wearing the Catarina Set, asks you to cross a bridge.
In the middle of the bridge he lowers it to have the Giant Slaves kill you. He then waits on the opposite side of the bridge, shortly before the room where Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth is met.
Talk to him there and choose "You know who I am": he gives the Prostration gesture and a Rusted Coin, and becomes a merchant.
At Firelink Shrine, take the elevator in the tower (the one that needs the Tower Key) to the top of the belfry: Patches locks the gate behind you.
Get out by dropping down onto the coffins that stick out of the wall (Spook or the Silvercat Ring help) or by warping with a Homeward Bone.

Find him on the upper level of the shrine near the Giant Tree. Refuse to forgive him for a Rusted Gold Coin; he then sells his wares there for the rest of the game. Reload the area and talk to him while he squats for the Patches squat gesture.
If you sent Greirat of the Undead Settlement to pillage and tell Patches, he leaves to save Greirat; both return after you beat an area boss.
missable: Take the elevator to the cathedral roof from the Cleansing Chapel first and the bridge trap does not happen: his first encounter is then the Firelink Shrine trap.
Telling Patches about Greirat makes him leave only if you have not bought the full Catarina Set from him.

npcs.reward: Dignified Bow, Morion Blade, Yuria as a summon for Soul of Cinder; the Usurpation of Fire ending
steps: Draw out true strength with Yoel of Londor until you have all five Dark Sigils before you reach the Catacombs of Carthus. Next time you visit Yoel's place he is dead and Yuria stands close by.
Talk to her for the Dignified Bow gesture.
Once Orbeck of Vinheim has moved to Firelink Shrine she asks you to settle the matter of Orbeck; bring her Orbeck's Ashes for the Morion Blade.
Once you reach the Catacombs of Carthus she says she is guiding Anri of Astora to Irithyll. Keep Anri alive until Pontiff Sulyvahn has been defeated.
Do not kill the Londor Pilgrim within the Church of Yorshka.
Find Anri in the old Darkmoon tomb in Anor Londo and marry Anri for 3 more Dark Sigils, a total of 8.

Yuria then swears fealty to the Lord of Hollows; she no longer turns aggressive if attacked, unless the Fire Keeper heals your Dark Sigils. She can be summoned for Soul of Cinder. Link the First Flame while you hold 8 Dark Sigils for the Usurpation of Fire ending.
missable: If Yoel dies before you have all five Dark Sigils, Yuria never appears.
Yuria disappears if Anri dies at any point before Pontiff Sulyvahn.
If you kill or anger Yuria, the Londor Pale Shade invades you in Farron Keep and Irithyll of the Boreal Valley instead.

npcs.reward: Sacred Chime of Filianore, Titanite Slab
steps: In The Ringed City, climb the stairs above the Ringed City Streets swamp, patrolled by Harald Legion Knights, to a large door. Shira speaks to you from the other side.
Tell her the name of Lord Gwyn, then accept her request to put Darkeater Midir to rest: she gives the Sacred Chime of Filianore.
Her summon sign is inside the small shrine from which Midir's arena can be accessed; summoning her or not makes no difference to her request.
Defeat Midir, then talk to Shira for a Titanite Slab.
missable: Do Midir before you touch the slumbering Filianore: after that Shira leaves her old places, turns permanently hostile and ambushes you in a ruin in the ash desert near the Filianore's Rest bonfire.
If you kill her there she drops the Crucifix of the Mad King and any gift she had not yet given; her set lies on a corpse behind her old door.

route.intro: The order most of the game's paths lead you in. Optional areas are marked; bonfires are listed from the wiki's bonfire page with where each one is. Tap an area, boss or NPC for its card. Mini-bosses and ordinary enemies have no cards in this guide.

steps.t: Pull the Coiled Sword from Iudex Gundyr to start the fight, then carry it to Firelink Shrine.
The hub. Fire Keeper levels you up, Blacksmith Andre upgrades and infuses, the Shrine Handmaid sells items and takes Umbral Ashes, Ludleth of Courland transposes boss souls.

Talk to Emma, High Priestess of Lothric Castle in the chapel. Greirat of the Undead Settlement is locked in a cell below the Tower on the Wall bonfire. For the Cell Key: from that bonfire go downstairs, drop a level, cross the rooftops with the Pus of Man, take the ladder down and pass the spear-wielding Lothric Knight. In the next room (Large Hollow Soldiers, two Starved Hounds, exploding barrels) the key is at the bottom of a small staircase, guarded by a hound. Once you hold a Pale Tongue, Ringfinger Leonhard at the shrine gives the Lift Chamber Key for the locked door downstairs from the Tower on the Wall bonfire.

s.title: Emma, High Priestess of Lothric Castle

steps.t: Recruit Yoel of Londor at the crumbled bridge and free Cornyx of the Great Swamp from his cage. Meet Holy Knight Hodrick in the Pit of Hollows before you kill Curse-rotted Greatwood: get there in the metal cage on the back of the non-hostile Hollow Manservant at the top of the highest cliff. The Pit lies under the boss arena; its floor crumbles during the fight and Hodrick dies.
Meet Anri of Astora and Horace the Hushed near Halfway Fortress. Orbeck of Vinheim is in the Crystal Sage ruins; with 10 Intelligence he moves to the shrine. The Farron Coal is here too.
Cleansing Chapel bonfire: Slave Knight Gael prays here and opens the first DLC. Watch for Unbreakable Patches on the bridge. Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth resets stats in her bed chamber.
Put out the three flaming towers to open the way to the Abyss Watchers, a Lord of Cinder. The Sage's Coal is in a small round building on the left of the keep.
Entering this area kills Yoel of Londor. Take all five Dark Sigils from him first if you want the Londor ending.
Optional. Horace the Hushed is in a cavern on the right side of the lake; what you tell Anri of Astora afterwards decides their quest.
Siegward of Catarina waits in the kitchen near the Distant Manor bonfire. Pontiff Sulyvahn is the area's boss.
Karla is in a locked cell (key from Profaned Capital). The Profaned Coal is in the cell with several Wretches opposite hers.
Yhorm the Giant is a Lord of Cinder; the Storm Ruler that beats him lies beside his throne. Free Siegward of Catarina from his cell first and talk to him so he joins the fight.
Aldrich, Devourer of Gods is a Lord of Cinder. The Giant's Coal is on the Giant Blacksmith in the west wing.
After the first three Lords of Cinder (Abyss Watchers, Aldrich and Yhorm), Emma, High Priestess of Lothric Castle gives you the Basin of Vows and Dancer of the Boreal Valley appears.
Black Hand Gotthard's corpse before the Grand Archives holds the Grand Archives Key.
Optional. Past Oceiros, the Consumed King an illusory wall leads down to Untended Graves.
Optional. The Eyes of a Fire Keeper here unlock The End of Fire ending.

bosses: Lorian, Elder Prince and Lothric, Younger Prince
steps.t: Climb the archives to the Twin Princes at the top of Lothric Castle; their cinder is the last one.

s.title: Lorian, Elder Prince and Lothric, Younger Prince

steps.t: Optional. Ring the Great Belfry to summon The Nameless King.
Place all Cinders of a Lord on their thrones and talk to the Fire Keeper to reach Soul of Cinder. Then pick an ending.

dlc.intro: Both expansions are optional. Ashes of Ariandel came first and The Ringed City follows on from it.

steps.t: Talk to Slave Knight Gael at the Cleansing Chapel bonfire in Cathedral of the Deep and touch the scrap of painting. Sister Friede (with Father Ariandel) is the end; the Gravetender fight is optional.
Use the bonfire at the start of the ramp in Kiln of the First Flame, or the one that appears behind Friede's arena. Gael can be summoned for the Demon Prince.
Tell Amnesiac Lapp about the Purging Monument before you fight Gael. Darkeater Midir is optional; Spear of the Church guards the Church of Filianore and Slave Knight Gael is the final boss.

endings.name: To Link the First Flame
endings.t: Beat Soul of Cinder and interact with the First Flame bonfire yourself without the Londor quest done. This is the default ending.

endings.name: The End of Fire
endings.t: Give the Eyes of a Fire Keeper from Untended Graves to the Fire Keeper. After the boss, do not touch the bonfire: use her summon sign next to it and let the scene play.

endings.name: To Take the First Flame
endings.t: Do The End of Fire, then strike the Fire Keeper while she holds the flame, before the screen fades.

endings.name: The Usurpation of Fire
endings.t: Finish the Londor quest: five Dark Sigils from Yoel of Londor before the Catacombs of Carthus, then follow Anri of Astora and Yuria of Londor to the end. Interact with the First Flame yourself.

new.title: Start here: your first hours
new.intro: You'll need: the base game. About two hours gets you to the second boss. Each line links to the card or page it came from.

steps.t: Advice: Pick a class on the character screen. If you are unsure, pick Knight: its Knight Shield blocks 100% of physical damage.
Pick up the Ashen Estus Flask a short way into the first area. It refills FP; the normal Estus Flask refills HP.
Pull the Coiled Sword out of Iudex Gundyr to start the first boss fight. Hit him while he stands up: he cannot fight back until he picks up his weapon.
Thrust the Coiled Sword into the bonfire in Firelink Shrine. You can now travel between every bonfire you have lit.
Talk to the Fire Keeper at the shrine bonfire to spend souls on levels.
Take every Estus Shard and Undead Bone Shard you find back to the shrine. See How to get more Estus.
Give every Umbral Ash you find to the Shrine Handmaid. Each one adds items to her shop.
Follow the Area order page from High Wall of Lothric onward. It lists the bosses, the bonfires and the NPCs you can lose in each area.

new.check: You are on track when the shrine bonfire lets you travel and the Handmaid sells more than her first stock.

back.title: Coming back after a break
back.intro: Read this before you load an old save. It takes about five minutes.

steps.t: Open your inventory and write down which Cinders of a Lord you already hold. The Area order page shows which boss gives each one.
Check your stats against the soft caps table on the Builds page. Points past a soft cap give much less.

If your stats are spread too thin, talk to Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth in her bed chamber in Cathedral of the Deep and choose rebirth to reallocate them. Each rebirth costs one Pale Tongue; you can do it up to five times per playthrough.
Visit Blacksmith Andre and spend your titanite on one weapon. Use the How to upgrade a weapon steps.
Read the NPC quests page for every character you have already met. Several quests end for good if you go to the wrong area first.
If you want the DLCs, read the DLC order page: Painted World of Ariandel is entered from the Cleansing Chapel bonfire in Cathedral of the Deep.
Practise against the next boss with its card open: each boss card has its weaknesses, its HP and the wiki strategy.

back.check: You are ready when one weapon is upgraded, your main stat is at or below its soft cap and you know your next boss.
